CVE-2026-112788.description: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in Apache Texera (incubating). The Python virtual environment (PVE) management endpoints of a computing unit are not authenticated by the application itself. In the local JVM and single-node Docker Compose deployments, which place no authenticating gateway in front of the services, these endpoints are reachable without credentials. The Kubernetes deployment gates them at the gateway, so only the Kubernetes deployment provides the full security model described in SECURITY.md. This issue affects Apache Texera (incubating): from 1.1.0 through 1.2.0. Users are recommended to use the Kubernetes deployment, which enforces the full security model, and to upgrade to 1.3.0-incubating, which documents that the local JVM and single-node Docker Compose deployments do not provide the full security model and should only be used by trusted users.

CVE-2026-124829.description: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in 'carta_presentacion[contenido]' field in the POST request to '/personas/{persona_id}/cvs/{cv_id}/carta_presentaciones' on the job portal. The server stores the data entered by an authenticated candidate and displays it in the recruitment interface without sanitizing it. When reviewing an application, the recruiter’s browser can execute the injected JavaScript code within the context of their session on the portal.

CVE-2026-124830.description: Uploading PDF files with active content to the languages form. The POST endpoint ‘/people/{person_id}/languages’ checks the declared MIME type and allows an authenticated user to upload a PDF with embedded JavaScript. The portal serves the file via a GET request to ‘/attachments/{attachment_id}’ with the ‘Content-Disposition: inline’ header, so it can be opened in the browser’s PDF viewer during review. The handling of active content depends on the viewer used.

CVE-2026-124831.description: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in 'experiencia_laboral[descripcion]' field in the POST request to '/personas/{persona_id}/experiencias_laborales' on the job portal. The server stores the data entered by an authenticated candidate and displays it in the recruitment interface without sanitizing it. When reviewing an application, the recruiter’s browser can execute the injected JavaScript code within the context of their session on the portal.

CVE-2026-124832.description: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in 'activity[description]' field in the POST request to '/people/{person_id}/cvs/{cv_id}/activities' on the job portal. The server stores the data entered by an authenticated candidate and displays it in the recruitment interface without sanitizing it. When reviewing an application, the recruiter’s browser can execute the injected JavaScript code within the context of their session on the portal.

CVE-2026-127180.description: The SUSE NeuVector image scanner before version 4.331 writes each per-scan task request to a temporary file on disk with mode 0644 (world-readable). This could allow local attackers to gain the registry access credentials of the scanned images.

CVE-2026-127182.description: A stack buffer overflow in DLP/WAF in the enforcer dataplane of SUSE NeuVector before 5.5, 5.5 before 5.5.6, 5.6.0 before 5.6.5 could be used by remote attackers to crash or potentially execute code.

CVE-2026-127183.description: Various memory-safety issues in dataplane of SUSE Neuvector before 5.5, 5.5.0 before 5.5.6, 5.6.0 before 5.6.5 could be used by remote attackers to trigger crashes.

CVE-2026-59415.description: TypesenseVectorStore is vulnerable to a document ID injection in its delete operation that can cause unintended documents to be deleted. TypesenseVectorStore.doDelete(List<String>) builds a Typesense filter_by expression by raw string concatenation of caller-supplied document IDs into the form id: [id1,id2,...] . The Typesense id field uses bare (unquoted) values in this list form with no escaping mechanism. An ID containing characters with syntactic meaning in the Typesense filter grammar — such as a comma ( , ), a closing bracket ( ] ), or operator tokens ( || , && ) — can break out of the list literal and alter the structure of the filter expression. An attacker who controls a document ID passed to the delete operation can use this to delete documents other than the intended ones (comma injection), or to construct a filter that matches every document in the collection (operator breakout), resulting in unintended bulk deletion. Applications that pass externally supplied or user-controlled document IDs to VectorStore.delete(List<String>) backed by TypesenseVectorStore are affected.

CVE-2026-82442.description: Description `HostURLFilter.configure` reads the `ignoreOutsideDomain` parameter but tests the node belonging to `ignoreOutsideHost` when deciding whether the domain mode was configured. A filter configuration that names only `ignoreOutsideDomain`, which the class documentation presents as an independent mode, is therefore discarded: the flag is forced to false, `filter` short-circuits on its guard and every URL is returned unchanged. The filter enforces nothing while appearing to be configured, and the failure is silent. The mirror-image configuration, naming only `ignoreOutsideHost`, fails with a `NullPointerException` while the topology is starting. The effect is the loss of a scope control the operator configured, so a crawled page's outlinks are followed to hosts the operator intended to exclude. Impact beyond crawl scope depends on what the crawler then fetches and is not claimed here. Projects generated from the StormCrawler Maven archetypes are not affected, because all three shipped filter configurations set both parameters. Mitigation Upgrade to 4.0.0, where each parameter is tested independently. Operators whose configuration sets only `ignoreOutsideDomain` will find the crawl restricted to the source domain, as configured, which may reduce the number of outlinks accepted. Users who cannot upgrade immediately should set both `ignoreOutsideHost` and `ignoreOutsideDomain` explicitly in the `HostURLFilter` configuration, which produces the intended behaviour on affected versions. Credit Independently reported to the Apache StormCrawler PMC by n0mi1k, with a proof of concept. Also found by the ASF -- using Claude agents to study the security of open-source projects, validated and reported by Apache StormCrawler.

CVE-2026-82444.description: Description `CookieConverter.getCookies` decides which stored cookies to attach to an outbound request. The applicability check is nested inside a test for the presence of a `Domain` attribute, so a cookie without one, which is the ordinary form of a session cookie, skips scoping entirely and is returned for whatever target URL was passed. RFC 6265 requires the opposite: a cookie with no `Domain` attribute is host-only and belongs to the host that set it. Two further defects sit in the same method. The domain comparison has no notion of a registrable domain, so a `Domain` value of `com` matches every host under it, and the comparison returns true when it throws, so a failure to evaluate the check admits the cookie. Neither the converter nor `MetadataTransfer`, which carries the stored cookie to outlinks, ever considers the host that issued it. Cookie handling is opt-in: it requires `http.use.cookies` to be set to true, which is not the default, and the cookie key to be listed in `metadata.transfer`. The documented recipe does not work as written, because the `metadata.transfer` example in the internals documentation names `set-cookie` while the key present in metadata is `protocol.set-cookie` and the transfer matches key names exactly. Deployments affected are therefore those where an operator determined the correct key, enabled cookie handling and crawls an authenticated site whose pages link or redirect to other hosts. In that case the session cookie of the authenticated origin is sent to those hosts. Mitigation Upgrade to 4.0.0, where a cookie without a `Domain` attribute is sent only to the host that set it, a single-label domain is rejected and the domain check fails closed. Because the protocol does not yet record the host that issued a cookie, cookies without a `Domain` attribute are not sent at all until that host is recorded; operators relying on cookie transfer will notice this. The documentation error is corrected in the same release. Users who cannot upgrade immediately should confine an authenticated crawl to a topology whose URL filters keep it on the origin that issued the credentials, and should not rely on cookie scoping as a boundary. Rotating session credentials used for such crawls is advisable. Credit Independently reported to the Apache StormCrawler PMC by n0mi1k, with a proof of concept. Also found by the ASF -- using Claude agents to study the security of open-source projects, validated and reported by Apache StormCrawler.

CVE-2026-82445.description: Description The SQL status backend serialises per-URL metadata into a single column by concatenating a tabulation, the key, an equals sign and the value, with no escaping. On read-back the string is split on the same two characters, so the round trip is not injective: a value that contains a tabulation returns as one or more additional keys that were never written. Values on that path are supplied by crawled servers. `FetcherBolt` records the raw `Location` header of a redirect as `_redirTo`, and `_redirTo` is part of the default `metadata.persist` set, so a redirect whose `Location` contains a tabulation followed by `key=value` pairs introduces those keys into the crawler's own control metadata on the next scheduling cycle. Several control keys are read without a prefix, so the injected keys are live: `http.proxy.host`, `http.proxy.port`, `http.proxy.user` and `http.proxy.pass` among them, as well as scheduling and request-shaping keys such as `depth`, `max.depth`, `crawl.delay`, `http.content.limit` and `isSitemap`. Where a proxy manager is configured, the consequence is not limited to corrupted scheduling data. `SingleProxyManager.getProxy(Metadata)` consults the per-URL metadata first and returns what it finds, so an injected proxy host and port take precedence over the operator's configured proxy and subsequent fetches, together with any configured `Authorization` header, are routed through a host the crawled content chose. A related defect in `AbstractStatusUpdaterBolt` compounds this: an injected `status.store.as.is.with.nextfetchdate` that is not a valid instant escapes the enclosing try/catch and stops the bolt, and because the stored row is replayed the failure repeats. Deployments using the OpenSearch or Solr status backends are unaffected, because those serialise metadata structurally. Mitigation Upgrade to 4.0.0, where the metadata column is written in an escaped form behind a format marker, rows written by earlier versions are still decoded unchanged, and the stored next-fetch-date is parsed defensively. The fix does not repair rows written before the upgrade. Operators using the SQL status backend should inspect the metadata column of an existing status table for tabulation characters and remove the affected rows, and should assume any proxy credentials configured for the crawl may have been exercised through an attacker-chosen proxy and rotate them. Users who cannot upgrade immediately can remove `_redirTo` from `metadata.persist` to close the demonstrated path, though other crawled values reaching persisted metadata remain. Credit Independently reported to the Apache StormCrawler PMC by n0mi1k, with a proof of concept. Also found by the ASF -- using Claude agents to study the security of open-source projects, validated and reported by Apache StormCrawler.

CVE-2026-82446.description: Description When StormCrawler fetches a host's `/robots.txt` and receives a redirect, `HttpRobotRulesParser` resolves the `Location` header and re-fetches the target for up to five hops. The loop checks neither the scheme, the host nor the port of the resolved target, and it is not governed by `http.allow.redirects`, which only affects the page fetch. A crawled site can therefore point the robots.txt fetch at any address reachable from the fetcher worker, including loopback interfaces, private ranges and cloud metadata endpoints. Every crawled URL triggers a robots.txt fetch on a cache miss, so no unusual configuration is required to reach the loop. The fetched body is only parsed as robots rules and is not returned to the caller, so the read itself is blind. The more direct impact is on credentials: the okhttp protocol applies its configured request headers, including the `Authorization` header built from `http.basicauth.user` and `http.basicauth.password` and anything in `http.custom.headers`, to every request it makes. Because StormCrawler follows the redirect itself and issues a new request, okhttp's own removal of the `Authorization` header across a host change does not apply, and the operator's crawl credentials are delivered to the host the redirect names. The connection-time IP filter, `http.filter.ipaddress.include` and `http.filter.ipaddress.exclude`, is installed as an okhttp network interceptor on the same client and does apply to these hops when it is configured. It ships with no rules, which is why the path is reachable in a default configuration. URL filtering never applies, because the robots.txt fetch does not pass through the outlink filter chain. Mitigation Upgrade to 4.0.0, where a robots.txt redirect is followed only when the target uses http or https and shares scheme, host and port with the URL it was reached from. Deployments that legitimately serve robots.txt through a cross-host redirect can restore the previous behaviour with `http.robots.redirect.crosshost.allow`. Users who cannot upgrade immediately should set `http.filter.ipaddress.exclude` to cover loopback, private, link-local and CGNAT ranges, which is enforced after DNS resolution and therefore also on redirect hops. Operators who configure `http.basicauth.*` or `http.custom.headers` for a crawl should assume those credentials may have been sent to third-party hosts and rotate them, and should scope credentials by running a separate topology per origin. Credit Independently reported to the Apache StormCrawler PMC by n0mi1k, with a proof of concept. Also found by the ASF -- using Claude agents to study the security of open-source projects, validated and reported by Apache StormCrawler.

CVE-2026-96296.description: An API which can allow a user to delete any workflow execution results is missing authentication. This means that any workflow result could be deleted by someone able to reach the Texera instance. This issue affects Apache Texera: from 1.1.0-incubating before 1.3.0-incubating. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.3.0-incubating, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-96298.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in the computing unit workflow websocket of Apache Texera (incubating) allows an authenticated user to view workflow results, control workflow executions, and run code in a computing unit they have not been granted. In local JVM and single-node Docker Compose deployments this is possible directly; in Kubernetes deployments it is possible from code running inside another computing unit in the cluster. This issue affects Apache Texera : from 1.1.0 through 1.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.3.0, which fixes the issue. Local JVM and Docker Compose deployments do not provide the full security model and should only be used by trusted users.

CVE-2026-96353.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in the project REST API of Apache Texera (incubating). The project API did not check that the caller owns, or has been granted access to, the project being accessed. Any authenticated user with an approved account (the REGULAR or ADMIN role; new accounts need administrator approval by default) could view, modify or delete other users' projects, change which workflows those projects contain, and see the e-mail addresses of a project's owner and collaborators. The project feature is hidden in the web UI by default, but the API was reachable regardless of that setting. This issue affects Apache Texera: from 1.1.0-incubating before 1.3.0-incubating. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.3.0-incubating, which fixes the issue by removing the deprecated project feature and its data. If you cannot upgrade immediately, configure the reverse proxy in front of Texera to reject every request whose path starts with /api/project, /api/public/project or /api/access/project, and every request whose path contains ';', which the Texera server ignores when routing. Respond with 403 or 404, not 401: from 1.2.0-incubating the web UI treats a 401 as an expired session, and the workflow pages request the project list when they load. Unless an administrator has enabled the project feature, this does not affect other functionality; those project-list requests are simply rejected. Make sure the Texera server is reachable only through that proxy. Blocking and upgrading do not undo access obtained earlier. Before upgrading, review the project, project_user_access and workflow_of_project tables, which remain empty unless someone has used the feature, and remove rows you do not expect; the upgrade deletes these tables. Do not copy project grants into workflow_user_access without checking each one.

CVE-2026-96354.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in the public project REST API of Apache Texera (incubating). The public project API did not check that a project had been made public before granting the caller read access to it. Any authenticated user with an approved account (the REGULAR or ADMIN role; new accounts need administrator approval by default) could give themselves lasting read access to other users' private projects and to the private workflows in them, including their version and execution history. Only deployments in which users have created projects are affected; the project feature is hidden in the web UI by default. This issue affects Apache Texera: from 1.1.0-incubating before 1.3.0-incubating. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.3.0-incubating, which fixes the issue by removing the deprecated project feature and its data. If you cannot upgrade immediately, configure the reverse proxy in front of Texera to reject every request whose path starts with /api/project, /api/public/project or /api/access/project, and every request whose path contains ';', which the Texera server ignores when routing. Respond with 403 or 404, not 401: from 1.2.0-incubating the web UI treats a 401 as an expired session, and the workflow pages request the project list when they load. Unless an administrator has enabled the project feature, this does not affect other functionality; those project-list requests are simply rejected. Make sure the Texera server is reachable only through that proxy. Blocking and upgrading do not undo access obtained earlier. Before upgrading, review the project_user_access table, which remains empty unless someone has used the feature: treat any READ grant on a project that is not listed in public_project, and that the project's owner did not give, as suspect. The upgrade deletes this table. Removing a grant does not remove copies the user may already have made of the workflows.

CVE-2026-97893.description: A Denial of Service (DoS) vulnerability exists in the ARQ SPARQL Query Optimiser in Apache Jena ARQ prior to version 6.3.0 that allows a SPARQL query to use that cause excessive memory usage. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes this issue. Users who are unable to upgrade immediately, especially those who operate a public facing SPARQL service/application backed by Apache Jena are recommended to configure the ARQ symbol arq:optPathFlatten=false in their SPARQL execution context which disables the problematic optimisation.

CVE-2026-103333.description: Improper input validation in some SPARQL functions available in Apache Jena ARQ allows users to submit SPARQL queries that cause excessive CPU and/or memory usage. This may be the result of intentionally malicious inputs in the query itself, or an expression applied over data that has been insufficiently validated/sanitised Users are recommended to upgrade to version 6.3.0, which fixes this issue.

CVE-2026-103756.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknolojileri Grubu Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows XSS Through HTTP Headers. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-104813.description: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Apache BuildStream allows malicious or compromised artifact or execution servers to write files on the host, with the privileges of the user running BuildStream, as part of `bst artifact checkout`. The impact of this issue is mitigated by: * BuildStream projects should only use trusted servers for remote cache and remote execution as otherwise the build output can also not be trusted This issue affects Apache BuildStream: through 2.8.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.8.2, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-10765.description: RTU500 contains a denial-of-service vulnerability in its IEC 61850 MMS server implementation. A malicious user with access to the IEC 61850 interface can trigger improper handling of asynchronous control operations involving special response and timing criteria. This may result in access to invalid memory structures, leading to a software exception, loss of IEC 61850 communications, or device reboot.

CVE-2026-111600.description: UNIX symbolic link (symlink) following vulnerability in Apache BuildStream allows source plugins to inadvertently read or write files on the host, with the privileges of the user running BuildStream, via symlinks from malicious or compromised source archives or respositories, as part of source fetching. The impact of this issue is mitigated by: * BuildStream projects should only use trusted sources in their elements as otherwise the build output can also not be trusted * None of the source plugins in the buildstream, buildstream-plugins or buildstream-plugins-community repositories use the vulnerable `open_file` method This issue affects Apache BuildStream: through 2.8.1. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 2.8.2, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-117593.description: Weak Password Recovery Mechanism for Forgotten Password vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows Password Recovery Exploitation. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-119543.description: Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-119582.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command ('SQL injection') vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknoloji Grubu Tic. Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows SQL Injection. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.3 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-121375.description: Reflected cross-site scripting in the versioned REST API documentation page in Checkmk versions 2.5.0 before 2.5.0p21 allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the browser of a user who opens a crafted link, in the context of that user's Checkmk session. The API version segment of the documentation URL is inserted into the page without escaping, and the page is reachable without authentication.

CVE-2026-125735.description: SQL injection in the CabinPaq manual code entry module, versions v.1.2.94 and v.1.2.136. The application constructs SQL queries from terminal input without properly sanitising it. With physical access to the terminal, an attacker could bypass code validation and open compartments without authorisation.

CVE-2026-126605.description: Authentication bypass in the Face ID app lock in Proton Pass for iOS before v. 1.21.1 allows an attacker with physical access to an already unlocked device to open vault items behind the lock screen via VoiceOver, leading to the disclosure and modification of stored credentials.

CVE-2026-128420.description: A heap buffer overflow issue exists in the rms_mqtt daemon on Teltonika Networks devices. An authenticated attacker with access to the affected service could trigger a heap-based buffer overflow, resulting in a denial of service. This issue affects RUT: from 7.0 through 7.18.0; RUTX: from 7.0 through 7.18.0; RUTM: from 7.0 through 7.18.0; RUTC: from 7.0 through 7.18.0; ATRM: from 7.16.1 through 7.18.0; TRB: from 7.0 through 7.18.0; OTD: from 7.11.1 through 7.18.0; TAP: from 7.4.3 through 7.18.0; DAP: from 7.12 through 7.18.0; SWM: from 1.6.3 through 1.7.1; TSW: from 1.1 through 1.7.1.

CVE-2026-134858.description: In Apache Pinot 0.7.1 through 1.5.1, a caller who can submit URI ingestion jobs can select local files readable by the controller process. If the file can be ingested using the destination table’s schema and input format, users with query access to that table can read its contents. Upgrade to Apache Pinot 1.6.0 and keep controller.ingestFromURI.allowLocalFileSystem at its default value of false on every controller. Until you can upgrade, block the URI ingestion endpoint if it is unused or restrict it to trusted operators.

CVE-2026-135660.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Apache Allura's ticket tracking tool. This issue affects Apache Allura: before 1.23.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 1.23.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-135747.description: Apache IoTDB MCP Server logs the IoTDB connection password in plaintext during startup, allowing anyone with access to the logs to obtain the credential. This issue affects Apache IoTDB MCP Server: through 0.2.0. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.3.0, which fixes the issue.

CVE-2026-13137.description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in multiple parsers of RTU500 components of User management, REST resolver and SPA-Bus. Attacker controlled input can influence the length of data copied into fixed-size stack buffers without proper bounds checking, which may result in memory corruption leading to denial of service condition.

CVE-2026-59697.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in ex_aws (instance metadata token provider). This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/ex_aws/instance_meta_token_provider.ex and program routines ExAws.InstanceMetaTokenProvider.request_token/1 and ExAws.InstanceMetaTokenProvider.get/1. ex_aws requests its IMDSv2 session token from the link-local metadata endpoint (http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token) with HTTP redirect following enabled. Because the token request follows 3xx redirects and does not restrict the redirect target to the link-local range, an attacker who can influence the response to the metadata request (for example an on-segment neighbor spoofing the link-local address) can answer with a redirect to an arbitrary host. The library follows the redirect and accepts the arbitrary host's response body as the IMDSv2 session token, caching it and sending it as the x-aws-ec2-metadata-token header on every subsequent metadata and credential request. This issue affects ex_aws: from 2.3.0 before 2.8.0.

CVE-2026-59698.description: Relative path traversal in ex_aws allows an attacker who controls an S3 object key to escape the intended bucket or key prefix. When ex_aws builds a path-style S3 request, ExAws.Operation.S3.add_bucket_to_path/2 in lib/ex_aws/operation/s3.ex joins the bucket name and the object key into a single path string and then normalizes it, collapsing . and .. segments the way a filesystem path would. Because the bucket is the first segment of the combined string, a leading ../ in the object key pops the bucket off the path. With bucket mybucket and a key of ../victim/secret.txt, the combined /mybucket/../victim/secret.txt normalizes to /victim/secret.txt, so the request (signed with the application's own credentials) is sent to bucket victim. The same mechanism collapses ../ within a key, defeating any isolation an application enforces by prepending a trusted prefix. Only the default path-style configuration is affected; requests built with virtual_host: true do not run this normalization. Because S3 treats object keys as opaque and does not resolve .. itself, the client-side normalization introduces a traversal that would not otherwise exist. Any application that derives an S3 object key from untrusted input and relies on the bucket, or a key prefix, as a tenant or trust boundary is exposed to cross-bucket or cross-prefix read and write, depending on the operation and the credentials' permissions. This issue affects ex_aws: from 2.1.7 before 2.8.0.

CVE-2026-62269.description: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability in ex_aws (S3 request URL construction). This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/ex_aws/request/url.ex and program routines ExAws.Request.Url.build/2, ExAws.Request.Url.sanitize/2 and ExAws.Request.Url.get_path/2. ex_aws does not percent-encode reserved characters in S3 object keys when it assembles the request URL. A literal ? in an object key survives unencoded: build/2 inserts the operation path verbatim and URI.to_string/1 emits it without encoding, and sanitize/2 then splits the flattened URL on the first ?, treating everything after it as the query string. Because the split runs before uri_encode is applied to the path, the ? is never neutralized, and the recovered query is re-inserted without any encoding. An attacker who controls part of an object key (for example a download or upload keyed by a user-supplied filename) can therefore truncate the key past application-appended suffixes, causing the request to address a different object than the application intended, and can inject live S3 sub-resource operations (such as ?acl, ?tagging or ?versions) into the request. The manipulated URL is signed and transmitted normally, so the tampering is authorized like any legitimate request. This issue affects ex_aws: from 2.1.2 before 2.8.0.

CVE-2026-84785.description: Issue summary: A QUIC peer that sends many small out-of-order STREAM fragments while withholding the first byte of the stream may cause OpenSSL to buffer a large number of reassembly nodes occupying much larger memory than the actual data sent. Impact summary: A remote peer can pin large amounts of memory on a server that accepts incoming QUIC streams, potentially exhausting memory and causing Denial of Service. CWE: CWE-770: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling Description: QUIC receive flow control limits the highest byte offset a peer may reach on a stream. It does not limit how many out-of-order fragments the receiver buffers. OpenSSL allocates a reassembly node for each non-adjacent STREAM fragment and never caps the count. A peer that opens a stream and sends many one-byte fragments at increasing offsets, while withholding the first byte, makes the receiver retain one node per fragment without delivering any data. Only applications that accept incoming streams are exposed. With the default policy, which rejects peer-initiated streams, the stream is torn down before state accumulates. Because the read side never advances past the missing prefix, the flow control window never slides and the nodes stay pinned for the life of the connection. The per-stream window bounds the highest offset, so the memory one stream can pin is finite, but it can reach tens of megabytes and, across many streams and connections, drive memory pressure and Denial of Service. The severity is limited because the exhaustion is bounded by flow control and requires a non-default configuration. FIPS impact: no The affected code is outside the FIPS module boundary.

CVE-2026-94365.description: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknolojileri Grubu Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows XSS Through HTTP Headers. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.1 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-96438.description: Unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknolojileri Grubu Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows Using Malicious Files. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.1 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-97198.description: Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in ITG Bilgisayar Teknolojileri Grubu Ltd. Şti. VSRM allows Privilege Abuse. This issue affects vSRM: from v14.08.1 before v14.08.5.

CVE-2026-120720.description: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws allows an attacker who controls an S3 bucket name to send the application's signed S3 requests to a host of their choice. With virtual_host: true, ExAws.Operation.S3.add_bucket_to_path/2 in lib/ex_aws/operation/s3.ex builds the request hostname from the bucket name and the configured host without checking the bucket name. A bucket such as attacker.example/x? turns the request URL into https://attacker.example/x?.s3.amazonaws.com/key, so the request is signed for and sent to attacker.example. The attacker receives upload bodies, the access key id and request signature, and any STS session token, and controls the response the application parses. With bucket_as_host: true the bucket is the whole hostname, so any valid hostname redirects the request. This issue affects ex_aws: from 2.1.7 before 2.8.0.

CVE-2026-124268.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Arraytics WP Event Solution wp-event-solution allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Event Solution: from n/a through 4.1.30.

CVE-2026-124273.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Arraytics WP Event Solution wp-event-solution allows Stored XSS.This issue affects WP Event Solution: from n/a through 4.1.30.

CVE-2026-124754.description: RTU500 has a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability through the NCMD metric name present in the Sparkplug payload of the MQTT message received, resulting in Denial of Service.

CVE-2026-125441.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Arraytics WP Event Solution wp-event-solution allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP Event Solution: from n/a through 4.1.30.

CVE-2026-127181.description: SUSE Neuvector before 5.5, 5.5.0 before 5.5.6 and 5.6.0 before 5.6.5 handling of ephemeral containers was not setting some checking callbacks, allowing these to bypass permission checks.

CVE-2026-129058.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in VillaTheme CURCY woo-multi-currency allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects CURCY: from n/a through 2.2.22.

CVE-2026-131746.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in VillaTheme Coupzy woo-coupon-box allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Coupzy: from n/a through 2.1.14.

CVE-2026-131747.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Themeisle WP Full Stripe Free wp-full-stripe-free allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects WP Full Stripe Free: from n/a through 8.5.8.

CVE-2026-131762.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in VeronaLabs WP Statistics wp-statistics allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects WP Statistics: from n/a through 14.16.19.

CVE-2026-131779.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP Desk Flexible Quantity – Measurement Price Calculator for WooCommerce flexible-quantity-measurement-price-calculator-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Flexible Quantity – Measurement Price Calculator for WooCommerce: from n/a through 2.4.0.

CVE-2026-133763.description: The sandbox checks that a template may call toString() on an object before converting it to a string. For an object, the is true test evaluates to the object itself, and that result wasn't checked. A sandboxed template could therefore print an object through a denied toString() method: {{ obj is true }} The same applies when the result is concatenated or passed to a filter. No tag needs to be allowed. A test in a boolean context, like {% if obj is true %}, isn't affected, since it doesn't convert the object to a string. The sandbox now checks the result of tests like the result of filters and functions.

CVE-2026-133764.description: The sandbox checks that a template may call toString() on an object before converting it to a string. It didn't check the input of tests. The PHP callable of a test may convert this input to a string, for example when its parameter is typed as string. PHP then calls toString() on an object without the sandbox checking it first: {{ obj is upperish }} Applications are affected when they register such a test and allow it in the sandbox. No built-in test is affected. The sandbox now checks the input of tests like the input of filters. The built-in tests that never convert their input to a string still skip the check.

CVE-2026-133765.description: The sandbox checks that a template may call toString() on an object before converting it to a string. Since Twig 3.23.0, assignments like x = obj, and the destructuring forms [a] = list and {a} = obj, evaluate to the value that they assign. The sandbox didn't check that value, so a sandboxed template could call a denied toString() method: {{ (x = obj) }} {{ ({secret: s} = obj)|join }} No tag needs to be allowed. The sandbox now checks the result of assignments like the result of filters and functions. {% do x = obj %} and {% if (x = obj) %} still work, since they don't convert the value to a string.

CVE-2026-133766.description: Since Twig 3.28.0, the sandbox skips the toString() check of an argument whose PHP parameter can't hold a string, like an int. A spread argument was mapped to a single parameter, although it fills every parameter from its position on. A sandboxed template could therefore call a denied toString() method: {{ tag(...[1, obj]) }} Here, the first parameter of tag() is an int, and a later one accepts strings. Applications are affected when they allow such a function, filter or test in the sandbox. No built-in callable is affected. A spread argument is now checked unless every parameter that it can fill has a safe type.

CVE-2026-133767.description: When the parent of an embed tag was an expression other than a string or a variable, the sandbox didn't see that expression. The functions, filters and tests of the expression weren't checked against the policy, and neither were its conversions to strings. A sandboxed template allowed to use embed could therefore call any function, filter or test, and any __toString() method: {% embed 'leak_' ~ app_secret() %}{% endembed %} Method calls and property reads were not affected, since they're checked at runtime. The sandbox now checks the parent expression of embed like any other expression of the template.

CVE-2026-133768.description: The join filter converted a value that isn't iterable with (array) $value. For an object, that gives every property, including the private and protected ones. A sandboxed template allowed to use join could therefore print properties that the policy denies, and that templates can't read otherwise: {{ user|join(',') }} A value that isn't iterable is now joined as a single item. A Stringable object prints its checked string, and other objects throw, as with the first and last filters.

CVE-2026-133769.description: Cva::apply() converted the values of variants, default variants and compound variants with (array). These values come from the arguments of html_cva(). A sandboxed template could therefore pass any object of its context, and print the private and protected properties of that object: {{ html_cva('base', {c: {p: user}}).apply({c: 'p'}) }} Variant maps that are ArrayAccess objects were also read with a key that the template chooses, without the property check of the sandbox. The template then printed the offsets that the object returned. Applications are affected when the sandbox allows the html_cva function and the apply method of Twig\Extra\Html\Cva. A value that isn't an array is now treated as a single item, so objects are dropped and never match a variant. Variant maps are also only used when they're arrays.

CVE-2026-133770.description: The sandbox allows every method of Twig\Markup objects, including their public constructor. A sandboxed template can therefore call __construct() on any Markup object that it reaches, and replace its content: {% do banner.__construct('<script>alert(1)</script>', 'UTF-8') %} A template gains nothing by rewriting its own output. The impact is on the Markup objects that come from the application and are also rendered elsewhere, like a global in a long-running worker. Their new content then ends up in trusted pages that aren't sandboxed. The sandbox no longer allows calling the constructor of Markup objects.

CVE-2026-133771.description: The escaper considered x.attr, x['key'] and x.method() safe whenever {% import ... as x %} appeared anywhere in the template. Macro calls haven't needed this rule since Twig 3.0. It only matched ordinary variables that have the name of an alias imported in another block or macro, and printed them without escaping: {% block header %}{% import _self as item %}{{ item.hello() }}{% endblock %} {% block content %}{% for item in items %}{{ item.body }}{% endfor %}{% endblock %} Here, item.body is printed raw. This leads to XSS when the value comes from an attacker. The same happens with an import in a macro and an argument of the same name in another macro. It also happens with a template-level import placed after the block that uses the name. The rule is removed. Macro calls through an alias are still considered safe.

CVE-2026-133772.description: The guard tag compiles only one of its branches, depending on whether a callable exists. The other branch was still parsed, though. The extends, use, macro and block tags in it registered their effects on the template. The sandbox doesn't see these tags, since that branch isn't compiled. A sandboxed template allowed to use guard could therefore extend a template, import blocks and define macros, while the policy doesn't allow these tags: {% guard filter upper %}{% else %}{% extends "parent.html" %}{% endguard %} The templates reached this way come from the loader of the sandbox, and they are sandboxed too. What the branch that isn't selected registers on the parser is now discarded.

CVE-2026-133773.description: The html_to_markdown filter of twig/markdown-extra keeps an HtmlConverter for each distinct mapping of options it receives. They're kept in a static array, with no size limit and no eviction. The options are an argument of the filter. A template that passes options taken from the input, or a sandboxed template, can therefore make this cache grow without limit. The cache outlives the environment, so it fills the memory of long-running workers. The cache now keeps at most 100 converters, like the formatter caches of IntlExtension.

CVE-2026-62270.description: Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input in ExAws.Dynamo.Encoder.encode/2 in ex_aws_dynamo allows an attacker who controls map data passed into a DynamoDB call to choose the raw stored DynamoDB AttributeValue. The encode/2 function in lib/ex_aws/dynamo/encoder.ex has one clause per DynamoDB type descriptor ("S", "N", "B", "BOOL", "M", "L", "NS", "SS", "BS", "NULL") that treats any map merely containing such a key as already encoded and returns it verbatim, bypassing the ExAws.Dynamo.Encodable protocol. The match is on the presence of the key alone, so no check is made that the value is well formed for the claimed type, and extra keys and arbitrary nested content survive untouched. An application that threads user-influenced map data (a decoded JSON body, a nested attribute, or an expression_attribute_values entry) into a Dynamo write or query therefore lets the user, rather than the application, decide the stored attribute's declared type, its bytes, and its structure. This type confusion breaks round-trip integrity and enables silent persistent data corruption, injection of attributes and raw binaries the schema never sanctioned, subversion of application authorization checks that trust the decoded type of a value, and a decoder crash on read-back that denies reads of the affected item to other users of the same table. This issue affects ex_aws_dynamo: from 2.0.0 before 4.3.0.

CVE-2026-62271.description: Use of RSA Algorithm without OAEP vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_kms (ExAws.KMS module) causes callers who import external key material to wrap their secret KMS key material with the deprecated PKCS#1 v1.5 padding scheme by default. This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ex_aws/kms.ex and program routine ExAws.KMS.get_parameters_for_import/3. ExAws.KMS.get_parameters_for_import/3 defaults its wrapping_algorithm argument to "RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5". AWS KMS returns this value as the WrappingAlgorithm for the import operation, and it dictates the RSA padding scheme the caller uses to wrap (RSA-encrypt) their secret key material before calling ImportKeyMaterial. AWS KMS also supports the stronger RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1 and RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256 schemes. By defaulting to RSAES_PKCS1_V1_5, the library steers callers who do not explicitly override the argument toward the weakest of the three. PKCS#1 v1.5 encryption padding is susceptible to Bleichenbacher adaptive chosen-ciphertext (padding oracle) attacks, which can recover the wrapped plaintext without the private key given an oracle that reveals whether a decrypted value was validly padded. Because the unwrap happens inside AWS KMS, which does not expose a padding oracle, the practical exploitability is low and this is a defense-in-depth weakness. Callers can avoid the weak default by explicitly passing "RSAES_OAEP_SHA_256" (or "RSAES_OAEP_SHA_1") as the wrapping algorithm. This issue affects ex_aws_kms: from 2.1.0 before 2.7.0.

CVE-2026-120299.description: Improper Input Validation vulnerability in ash-project ash allows an attacker to bypass the input validation of the field types of a :keyword attribute or argument. Ash.Type.Keyword.cast_input/2 in lib/ash/type/keyword.ex converts a map input to a keyword list in try_map_to_keyword/2, which casts each declared field with Ash.Type.cast_stored/3. That function is meant for trusted values read back from the data layer, so client input skips the cast_input/2 of each field type. apply_constraints/2 casts the result again with cast_input/2, but most types accept a value of their own type unchanged. An embedded resource field is built without its create action, so its validations and changes do not run and its non-public attributes can be set. A :function field accepts a capture string such as &Mod.fun/1, and a :term field decodes Erlang external term format. This issue affects ash: from 3.24.0 before 3.38.1.

CVE-2026-129514.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in the application/vnd.hex+erlang request body parser in hexpm hexpm allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute operating system commands via a crafted Erlang external term format request body. This vulnerability was actively exploited against the hex.pm service on 2026-11-23. HexpmWeb.ErlangFormat.decode/1 in lib/hexpm_web/erlang_format.ex decodes the body with Plug.Crypto.non_executable_binary_to_term/2, which accepts maps that have a __struct__ key. HexpmWeb.PlugParser.parse/5 returns the decoded term as the request params. The parser runs in the endpoint before routing and authentication, so a POST to any route reaches it. Elixir dispatches protocols on the __struct__ key, so the client selects which Inspect and Enumerable implementations run when error reporting inspects the params. A chain through Ecto.Query.DynamicExpr and DBConnection.Stream reaches an apply/3 call on a {module, function, args} tuple taken from the request body. This issue affects hex.pm: from 2016-02-23 before 2026-11-23; hexpm/hexpm: from ab1bbcef7cc8395d1056d3b1aa6a174353492d59 before 379b0a29bcc95164249f38ad7d772a37a8ff9533.

CVE-2026-130822.description: In Valkey before 7.2.16, 8.0.x before 8.0.13, 8.1.x before 8.1.12, 9.0.x before 9.0.8, 9.1.x before 9.1.4 and 9.2.0 release candidates, when client eviction is enabled (maxmemory-clients is not 0), an authenticated user who can write to a key that other clients are blocked on (for example with BLPOP, BLMPOP, BZPOPMIN or XREAD BLOCK) can trigger a use-after-free. While the clients blocked on that key are served, evictClients() can select and free the client whose command made the key ready, although that command is still executing, and the server then keeps using the freed client. The blocked clients do not have to belong to the attacker. The result is a reliable crash of the server process. Servers with the default maxmemory-clients 0 are not affected.

CVE-2026-136152.description: Prevent Direct Access – Protect WordPress Files plugin before 2.8.9.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain protected file names and paths by requesting the dynamically generated robots.txt file, which appends Disallow rules containing attachment page URLs and direct _pda/ directory file paths for all protected media. 7631e3d74c1dc8542d910191.title_ko: 삼성SDS, AX·AI 인프라 사업 확대 위해 임원 진용 재편
7631e3d74c1dc8542d910191.summary_ko: 삼성SDS가 2027년 정기 임원 인사에서 부사장 4명과 상무 6명 등 총 10명을 승진시켰다. 전체 승진 규모는 지난해와 같지만 부사장 승진자는 두 배로 늘었으며, 회사는 AX서비스와 AI인프라 등 미래 성장동력 사업 확대와 기술 경쟁력 강화를 추진할 계획이라고 밝혔다.
7631e3d74c1dc8542d910191.background_ko: 삼성SDS는 기업 AX·클라우드 등에서 성과를 낸 리더를 발탁해 현장 중심 리더십을 강화하고 미래 성장동력 사업을 확대하려는 취지라고 설명했다.

6760cb94e5ec0616aa9f0b07.title_ko: 젠슨 황 복귀 소식에 국내 AI 인프라 관련주 반등 보도
6760cb94e5ec0616aa9f0b07.summary_ko: 기사는 젠슨 황의 엔비디아 CEO 복귀 소식 이후 엘리스그룹·래블업·씨이랩 주가가 각각 7.58%, 4.28%, 7.09% 상승했다고 전했다. 증권가는 AI 생태계의 연속성에 대한 불안 완화를 반등 배경으로 보면서도, 엔비디아 관련 조사·규제와 AI 인프라 수요의 실적 전환 여부는 불확실성으로 지적했다고 소개했다.
6760cb94e5ec0616aa9f0b07.background_ko: 기사는 황 CEO 복귀로 AI 생태계의 연속성에 대한 불안이 완화됐다는 증권가 분석을 관련주 반등의 배경으로 제시했다.

60fddaa0bf0d9799399ac429.title_ko: AWS, AI 에이전트 도구 작업 증가에 자체 CPU·클라우드 인프라 강화
60fddaa0bf0d9799399ac429.summary_ko: AWS는 AI 에이전트의 API 호출·코드 실행 같은 도구 작업을 지원하기 위해 자체 CPU 그래비톤 중심의 인프라를 강화한다고 밝혔다. 에이전트 작업의 80%를 CPU가 처리한다는 설명과 함께 AWS AI 팩토리와 격리 실행 환경을 소개하고, 기업 데이터를 지식 그래프로 연결하는 AWS 컨텍스트 출시 계획도 공개했다.
60fddaa0bf0d9799399ac429.background_ko: AWS는 에이전트가 모델 추론보다 API 호출·코드 실행 등 CPU 기반 도구 작업에 많은 연산자원을 사용한다고 설명했다.

curation.reason_ko: AWS가 에이전트의 도구 실행을 지원할 자체 CPU·격리 환경과 데이터 연결 전략을 소개했다.

2c714469d1e303f3f6b49787.title_ko: KrrK 팀원, 대학생 개인정보 판매 주장…실제 침해·거래 확인은 제한적

0419a40675846c3d6aaab08f.background_ko: 과거 대화 원문을 매번 프롬프트에 다시 넣는 부담을 줄이고 여러 세션에 걸쳐 이전 정보를 활용하도록 개발됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 대화 정보를 내부 기억에 저장하는 모델의 가중치·코드와 검색 방식 대비 한계가 함께 공개됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 교육청 AI·디지털 예산안에서 기기 보급과 AI 기본교육 배분이 제시됐으며 의회 심의가 남았다.

89046ac42186ef01dabcf407.title_ko: 정부, AI·스마트안경 활용 국가시험 부정행위 차단 대책 추진

curation.reason_ko: 여러 결제업체의 정보 유출에 금융위가 긴급 점검을 주문해 결제 생태계의 대응 필요성이 높다.

02050c5de4c7b4efb904231c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.31083v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative AI has demonstrated human-level performance on technical work tasks, yet evidence on how these task-level capabilities are changing labor demand remains scarce. We study the firm-level adoption of GitHub Copilot, an AI coding assistant, across 5,414 multinational firms accounting for 38% of the U.S. programming workforce. To identify causal effects, we exploit a natural experiment generated by firms' predetermined software procurement cycles. Early AI-adopting firms hired more workers before the launch of GitHub Copilot and had larger, more technical, and older workforces. After one year, GitHub Copilot adoption reduces quarterly technical hiring by 29% among review-induced adopters, with no effect on separations, overall technical headcount, or vacancy duration. The hiring slowdown is concentrated in the subset of junior technical roles that involve the highest share of coding work. Overall, AI coding assistance causes firms to shift demand towards more experienced workers and roles that pair some coding with broader design responsibilities.
02050c5de4c7b4efb904231c.title_ko: GitHub Copilot 도입이 기술직 채용에 미치는 영향 분석
02050c5de4c7b4efb904231c.summary_ko: 연구진은 미국 프로그래밍 인력의 38%를 고용한 다국적 기업 5414곳을 분석하고, 소프트웨어 구매 주기에 따른 자연실험으로 Copilot 도입 효과를 추정했다. 구매 검토 주기로 도입이 유도된 기업에서는 1년 뒤 분기 기술직 채용이 29% 감소했지만 퇴사와 전체 기술직 인원에는 영향이 없었으며, 감소는 코딩 비중이 높은 초급 직무에 집중됐다고 보고했다.
02050c5de4c7b4efb904231c.background_ko: 생성 AI의 기술 업무 수행 능력은 입증돼 왔지만, 개별 작업 수준의 성능이 기업의 인력 수요를 어떻게 바꾸는지에 대한 근거는 부족했다.

curation.reason_ko: 기업 5,414곳을 분석한 연구가 Copilot 도입 후 초급 코딩 직무 중심의 채용 감소를 추정했다.

832b6f51cf19db4215f8d51c.title_original: ParseGap: Testing What Coding Agents Authorize and What Shells Execute
832b6f51cf19db4215f8d51c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.29546v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM coding agents authorize shell commands by parsing a command string against a policy and passing the raw string to a system shell, so the gate adjudicates one reading while the shell executes another. We present ParseGap, a differential testing framework that runs each command through an unmodified vendor checker and GNU Bash 5.2 in an isolated container, flagging a violation whenever an approved command produces policy-violating runtime effects. Across eight production coding agents, ParseGap identifies 17 root causes across three divergence boundaries: at the parse, where an upstream tree-sitter-bash defect hides a second command from Mistral Vibe and Gemini CLI; at the utility, where every checker permits read-only binaries whose arguments write files or launch programs (9-47 of 55 cases); and at confinement, where an allow rule in OpenAI Codex CLI disables its read-only OS sandbox. Live trials across two frontier models triggered policy violations in all 16 agent-model pairs (14 under configured restrictions). To eliminate the second reading, we design ShellPlan, which compiles a strict Bash subset once into a typed execution plan, validates utility arguments against positive capability specifications, and dispatches approved plans directly via execve without a shell. Over a formal operational model, we prove single-interpretation dispatch and bound touched programs and files under audited assumptions. ShellPlan admitted
832b6f51cf19db4215f8d51c.title_ko: ParseGap, 코딩 에이전트의 명령 승인과 실제 셸 실행 간 보안 격차 분석
832b6f51cf19db4215f8d51c.summary_ko: 연구진은 코딩 에이전트의 명령 승인 결과와 실제 Bash 실행을 비교하는 ParseGap을 제안하고, 상용 에이전트 8개에서 정책 위반을 일으키는 근본 원인 17가지를 찾았다고 보고했다. 명령을 한 번만 해석해 실행 계획으로 처리하는 ShellPlan도 제시했으며, 정적 시험에서 공격 4,174건을 모두 차단했다고 밝혔다.
832b6f51cf19db4215f8d51c.background_ko: 코딩 에이전트의 검사기가 해석한 명령과 원시 명령 문자열을 전달받은 셸의 실행 해석이 달라 보안 정책을 우회할 수 있다는 문제를 다뤘다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진이 코딩 에이전트 8종에서 명령 승인과 실제 셸 실행의 해석 차이로 인한 정책 위반을 보고했다.

c220a13dd0470847933a800a.title_ko: 한컴, 공공기관 HWP 문서 일괄 변환 지원…기본 저장 형식도 HWPX로
c220a13dd0470847933a800a.summary_ko: 한컴은 공공기관의 기존 HWP 문서를 HWPX로 일괄 변환하는 전용 변환기를 공급하고, 한글의 기본 저장 형식도 HWPX로 바꾼다고 밝혔다. HWPX는 XML 기반 개방형 문서 형식으로 AI의 내용·맥락 분석을 지원하며, 한컴은 기관별 행정 시스템 연계 작업도 지원할 계획이다.
c220a13dd0470847933a800a.background_ko: 공공 문서의 개방형 형식 전환 정책과 기존 HWP 문서 변환 문제를 해결하라는 대통령 지시에 따른 조치다.

curation.reason_ko: 공공문서의 HWPX 일괄 변환과 기본 저장 형식 변경은 문서 개방성과 기계 판독에 영향을 준다.

8133c225d226b5224cbfad19.title_ko: Radware, 인증 없는 내부 API 통해 고객 클라우드 접근 키 노출 가능성

8133c225d226b5224cbfad19.background_ko: 내부 전용 Cloud WAF 관리 API가 인증 없이 공용 인터넷에서 접근 가능한 상태로 노출돼 공격자의 무단 접근을 허용했다.

curation.reason_ko: Radware 내부 API를 통한 고객 클라우드 키 노출 가능성으로 키 교체와 접근 기록 점검이 요구된다.

ca393f3870bae821b61959a3.title_ko: 앤트로픽, Claude Ship 베타 출시…코드 검토·수정·정책 기반 승인 연결
ca393f3870bae821b61959a3.summary_ko: 앤트로픽이 GitHub 풀 리퀘스트의 코드 검토·수정과 정책 기반 승인을 연결한 Claude Ship 베타를 출시했다. Claude 팀·엔터프라이즈 조직에 제공되며, 수정 도구는 직접 승인·병합하지 않고 실제 병합은 GitHub의 보호 규칙과 필수 검사 설정에 따른다. 에이전트 이용료는 구독 포함 사용량과 별도로 토큰 사용량에 따라 청구된다.
ca393f3870bae821b61959a3.background_ko: AI의 코드 작성 속도에 맞춰 코드 생성 이후 검토·수정·승인에 걸리는 시간을 줄이는 것이 출시 배경이다.

curation.reason_ko: Claude Ship 베타가 코드 검토·수정·정책 기반 승인을 연결해 개발팀의 작업 흐름을 바꾼다.

bc994fafa37d4d771e0d0dd3.title_ko: 정부, 내년 AI 예산안 약 16조원…산업 AX 적용·풀스택 수출 추진

bc994fafa37d4d771e0d0dd3.background_ko: 국내 AI 모델·기술·서비스를 각 산업에 적용하고 궁극적으로 풀스택 수출로 연결하는 것이 정부가 제시한 AI·AX 정책의 목표다.

b2117a2c7b6e4d28bc7a4ae0.title_ko: OpenAI·Cisco, 미패치 Linux 보호용 오픈소스 Shirudo 공개
b2117a2c7b6e4d28bc7a4ae0.summary_ko: OpenAI와 Cisco가 AI 에이전트를 활용하는 오픈소스 보안 플랫폼 Shirudo를 공개했다. 두 회사는 에이전트가 eBPF 기반 보호 규칙을 생성·시험해 시스템 재시작 없이 취약점 악용을 차단하도록 설계했다고 설명했다. 특정 Linux 커널 기능과 추가 패치, TPM 2.0이 필요한 사전 출시 단계로, 아직 운영 환경에는 적합하지 않다.
b2117a2c7b6e4d28bc7a4ae0.background_ko: AI로 취약점 발견과 악용이 빨라지면서 패치 적용 압박이 커지자, 영구 패치를 설치하기 전 임시 보호를 제공하기 위해 개발됐다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenAI·Cisco가 패치 전 Linux 보호용 Shirudo를 공개했지만 아직 운영 환경에는 적합하지 않다.

6a5519fd2c8ae67d7a14bd7d.title_ko: 한국전력, 150만 명 이상 정보 유출 확인…요금·조달 시스템 침해
6a5519fd2c8ae67d7a14bd7d.summary_ko: 한국전력이 전기요금 플랫폼 KEPCO ON과 전자조달 시스템의 무단 접근으로 고객·직원·거래처 관계자 등 150만 명 이상의 정보가 노출됐다고 밝혔다. 이름·연락처와 일부 금융정보 등이 포함됐으며, 회사는 외부 IP 접근 차단과 해당 서비스 중단 조치를 취했다. Noiem이라는 인물이 범행을 주장했으나 실제 배후와 최초 침입 경로는 확인되지 않았다.

curation.reason_ko: 한전이 150만 명 이상 정보 노출을 확인해 국내 이용자와 거래처의 대응 필요성이 크다.

58a641c060f479129742ea0f.title_ko: 한국정보통신, 가맹점·판매자 정보와 간편결제 거래내역 유출
58a641c060f479129742ea0f.summary_ko: 신용카드 부가통신사업자 한국정보통신(KICC)에서 일부 가맹점·판매자 정보와 제휴 간편결제 거래내역이 유출됐다. 회사는 11월 20일 오후 5시 31분경 비정상적인 접근 시도를 받고 공격자 IP를 차단했으며, 유출 항목에는 상호명·사업자번호·대표자명·주소·MID·거래번호 등이 포함됐다.
58a641c060f479129742ea0f.background_ko: 원문에 따르면 비정상적인 사용자의 접근으로 일부 가맹점 정보가 유출됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 한국정보통신에서 가맹점 정보와 간편결제 거래내역이 유출돼 사업자와 결제정보 보호가 요구된다.

84942652be7cc7753507e3b7.title_ko: Rackspace, 보안 침해 후 Spot 클라우드 서비스 종료 결정
84942652be7cc7753507e3b7.summary_ko: Rackspace는 고객 Kubernetes 클러스터에 대한 무단 접근 사고 이후 Spot 서비스를 2026년 12월 8일 미국 중부시간 오후 5시에 종료한다고 통보했다. 종료 시 남은 작업이 중단되고 데이터에 접근할 수 없게 되므로, 고객에게 사전 이전과 데이터 확보를 요청하고 모든 토큰·클러스터 비밀정보를 잠재적으로 침해된 것으로 취급하도록 안내했다.
84942652be7cc7753507e3b7.background_ko: 공격자가 침해된 인증정보로 Spot에 접근해 고객 클러스터에 무단 파드를 생성하는 사고가 발생했고, Rackspace는 사고 검토 후 서비스 종료를 결정했다.

curation.reason_ko: 침해 후 Spot 서비스 종료가 예고돼 고객은 12월 8일 종료 전 이전과 데이터 확보가 필요하다.

03f361765c8648ac94ce505b.title_original: VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities
03f361765c8648ac94ce505b.excerpt: The critical bugs include an authentication bypass in vCenter and flaws that could allow code execution on ESX hosts. The post VMware Updates Patch Critical ESX, vCenter Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .
03f361765c8648ac94ce505b.title_ko: Broadcom, VMware 취약점 23건 패치…ESX·vCenter 치명적 결함 포함
03f361765c8648ac94ce505b.summary_ko: Broadcom이 VMware 제품군의 취약점 23건을 수정하는 패치를 발표했다. vCenter의 인증 우회와 ESX의 호스트 코드 실행 관련 치명적 결함을 비롯해 Avi Load Balancer와 VMware Tools 문제도 포함됐다. vCenter 8.0 U3m에는 관련 수정이 이미 반영됐으며, 실제 공격 악용 여부는 공지에 언급되지 않았다.
03f361765c8648ac94ce505b.background_ko: ESX의 I/O 필터 서비스와 XHCI USB 컨트롤러에서 메모리 처리 결함이, vCenter의 VMware Directory Service에서 인증 우회 결함이 발견됐다.

curation.reason_ko: VMware 인증 우회·호스트 코드 실행 결함 등 23건이 수정돼 가상화 인프라 점검이 시급하다.

75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.title_original: Supply Chain Compromise Backdoors Six WP connect Plugins, Blocked by WordPress.org’s Release Hold
75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.excerpt: On November 22nd, 2026, a threat actor pushed backdoored releases of six WordPress plugins developed by WP connect, including Air WP Sync, WP Sync for Notion, and Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, which together are estimated to have more than 3,600 active installations. Each release silently loaded the same remote-control module, which phones home to an attacker-controlled server, executes any PHP code it is sent, and exposes a full command set for running shell commands, stealing password hashes, and planting webshells. Thanks to safeguards introduced under WordPress.org’s Protect The Shire initiative, the backdoored versions were never released to sites, and all six plugins were closed on WordPress.org the same evening. While the WordPress plugins team independently detected and stopped this threat, Wordfence’s PRISM also discovered and notified our team to the threat, which was then validated by our team. As a reminder, PRISM is our continuous monitoring and vulnerability research agent created by the Wordfence Threat Intelligence team. The backdoor in Air WP Sync was also independently discovered and reported by Computeronfire , and we thank them for their contribution. Our mission is to secure WordPress through defense in depth, which is why we are investing in proactive vulnerability research of this kind alongside our Bug Bounty Program . 75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.title_ko: WP connect 플러그인 6종에 백도어 삽입…WordPress.org가 배포 차단
75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.summary_ko: Wordfence에 따르면 공격자가 WP connect의 WordPress 플러그인 6종에 원격 코드 실행과 비밀번호 해시 탈취 등이 가능한 백도어를 삽입했다. WordPress.org의 배포 보류 안전장치가 악성 버전의 공개 배포를 막았고, 같은 날 해당 플러그인 6종에 폐쇄 조치가 이뤄졌다. Wordfence는 대부분의 사용 사이트가 영향을 받지 않았을 것으로 설명했다.
75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.background_ko: 개발자의 WordPress.org 계정으로 제출된 플러그인 6종의 릴리스에 원격 제어용 악성 코드가 의도적으로 추가됐다.

curation.reason_ko: WordPress.org의 배포 보류 장치가 플러그인 6종의 백도어 공개 배포를 막은 공급망 방어 사례다.

91a8ffe5b228cea0488165fa.summary_ko: jingyaogong/minimind는 6,400만 매개변수 언어 모델을 처음부터 학습하는 프로젝트로 소개된다. 저장소 설명은 2시간 만에 모델을 학습할 수 있다고 제시한다.

curation.reason_ko: 당일 별 727개가 집계된 minimind는 소형 언어 모델을 처음부터 학습하는 교육·실습용 프로젝트다.

134a40f366b75e18762c644c.title_original: “AI 시대 보안 주권·정책 논의”... KISA, 워크숍 개최
134a40f366b75e18762c644c.title_ko: KISA, AI 보안 주권·취약점 관리 논의하는 정책 워크숍 개최
134a40f366b75e18762c644c.summary_ko: KISA와 한국정보보호학회가 과학기술정보통신부와 함께 내달 4일 서울 섬유센터에서 사이버보안 정책 포럼 워크숍을 연다. AI 시대 취약점 관리와 보안 주권 정책을 논의하며 누구나 참가할 수 있고, 사전 등록은 내달 3일 오후 5시까지다.
134a40f366b75e18762c644c.background_ko: AI 발전으로 사이버 공격이 고도화되고 보안 환경이 급변함에 따라 위협 대응 역량 강화와 AI 보안 주권 확보를 위한 정책 방향을 논의하고자 마련됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 누구나 참여 가능한 KISA 보안정책 워크숍으로 AI 취약점 관리를 다루며 12월 3일까지 등록받는다.

1efad533f92f00c84fa15363.title_ko: Anthropic 스캐너가 발견한 Drupal 취약점, 패치 직후 실제 공격에 악용
1efad533f92f00c84fa15363.summary_ko: CISA와 Drupal 개발진은 Anthropic OSS Scanner가 발견한 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-132165가 실제 공격에 악용됐다고 밝혔다. 11월 18일 패치 이후 이르면 19일부터 악용된 것으로 보고됐으며, 수정 버전은 Drupal 11.4.13·11.3.22·10.6.22다. 공격의 구체적인 양상과 영향받은 웹사이트 수는 공개되지 않았다.
1efad533f92f00c84fa15363.background_ko: Drupal 코어 설치 프로그램의 결함으로, 특정 조건에서 인증되지 않은 공격자가 재설치를 유도해 사이트를 탈취하거나 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Drupal 결함의 실제 악용과 CISA의 3일 내 패치 지시가 전해져 운영자의 신속한 확인이 필요하다.

18eb090438ad1e6c05bb43e1.title_ko: 타이달, AI로만 만든 음원 등록 금지…연말까지 약 2900만 곡 삭제 계획
18eb090438ad1e6c05bb43e1.summary_ko: 타이달이 12월 9일부터 AI로만 만든 음원의 신규 등록을 차단하고 기존 음원도 삭제하는 정책을 발표했다. 연말까지 약 2900만 곡을 삭제할 계획이며, AI를 보조 도구로 활용한 음악은 계속 허용한다. AI 탐지 기술의 오탐 가능성을 고려해 금지 대상을 전적으로 AI가 생성한 곡으로 한정했다.
18eb090438ad1e6c05bb43e1.background_ko: 타이달은 앞서 시행한 AI 생성곡 저작권료 지급 중단만으로 신규 유입을 억제하기 어려웠고, 대량 등록이 실제 아티스트의 노출과 수익을 줄인다고 설명했다.

curation.reason_ko: Tidal이 AI 전용 생성곡의 신규 등록 금지와 기존 음원 삭제를 예고해 창작·유통 정책 변화가 크다.

db1566be0ffe320b78ddad5f.title_ko: 개인정보위, AI 개발용 개인정보 활용 특례의 안전조치·감독 기준 입법예고
db1566be0ffe320b78ddad5f.summary_ko: 개인정보위가 AI 개발 목적의 개인정보 처리 특례에 적용할 안전조치와 심의·감독 기준을 담은 시행령 개정안을 입법예고했다. 익명·가명정보만으로 개발이 어려우면 심의·의결을 거쳐 적법하게 수집한 개인정보를 활용하도록 하되, 접근권한 통제와 필요성 소멸 시 파기 등을 요구한다. 민감정보 활용 등에는 사전 위험평가를 적용하고, 요건 위반 시 처리를 제한하는 내용도 담았다.
db1566be0ffe320b78ddad5f.background_ko: 개정 개인정보 보호법의 2027년 3월 9일 시행을 앞두고 AI 개발 목적 개인정보 처리 특례의 적용 기준과 보호·감독 절차를 구체화하기 위한 후속 조치다.

curation.reason_ko: AI 개발용 개인정보 활용 특례의 안전조치와 심의 절차를 정하는 시행령 개정안이 입법예고됐다.

c95b5506c2a746543f447056.title_ko: 구글, 크롬 취약점 수정…업데이트·재시작 후 실행 버전 확인
c95b5506c2a746543f447056.summary_ko: 구글이 크롬 Variations 구성요소의 입력값 검증 문제인 CVE-2026-134401을 수정했다. 수정 버전은 윈도·맥 158.0.8127.88 또는 158.0.8127.89, 리눅스 158.0.8127.88이며, 업데이트 후 재시작해 실행 버전을 확인해야 한다. 공식 공지에는 CVSS 점수와 실제 악용 여부가 명시되지 않았다.
c95b5506c2a746543f447056.background_ko: 이번 취약점은 크롬의 Variations 구성요소에서 입력값을 제대로 검증하지 못하는 문제로 발생했다.

curation.reason_ko: 데스크톱 Chrome의 치명적 결함 수정이 배포돼 광범위한 브라우저 이용자의 업데이트 확인이 필요하다.

d19962899994f82c42bf3688.title_ko: KT·LG전자, 업로드 용량 최대 4.9배 높인 6G 핵심 기술 검증
d19962899994f82c42bf3688.summary_ko: KT와 LG전자가 6G 핵심 기술인 서브밴드 전이중(SBFD)과 스펙트럼 공유 전이중(SSFD)을 네트워크 장비로 검증했다고 밝혔다. 양사에 따르면 기존 5G TDD 방식 대비 업로드 용량은 SBFD에서 약 2.9배, SSFD에서 약 4.9배로 늘었다. 양사는 기술 개발과 표준화 등 6G 연구 협력을 이어갈 계획이다.
d19962899994f82c42bf3688.background_ko: 피지컬 AI·자율주행 등의 대량 데이터 업로드 수요가 커지는 가운데, 기존 5G TDD는 업로드 시간을 늘리면 다운로드 시간이 줄고 기지국 간 간섭이 생길 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: KT·LG전자가 5G 대비 업로드 용량을 최대 4.9배 높이는 6G 기술을 검증했다고 발표했다.

db63f6336b7c90af99e310cf.title_ko: 미국 랜스 우라늄 사업장, 사이버 사고로 가동 중단
db63f6336b7c90af99e310cf.summary_ko: 페닌슐라에너지가 미국 와이오밍주 랜스 우라늄 사업장의 운영·제어 시스템에 영향을 준 사이버 사고로 가동을 중단했다. 회사는 영향받은 시스템을 격리하고 안전성을 검증 중이며, 급여·재무 등 사무 시스템에는 영향이 없었다고 밝혔다. 가동 재개일과 데이터 피해 범위, 랜섬웨어 사용 여부는 공개되지 않았다.
db63f6336b7c90af99e310cf.background_ko: 회사는 공장과 채굴 구역의 운영·제어 시스템에 영향을 준 사고를 발견한 뒤 예방 조치로 사업장 가동을 멈췄다.

curation.reason_ko: 우라늄 사업장의 운영·제어 시스템 사고로 가동이 중단돼 산업시설 침해의 실물 영향을 보여준다.

cc56e71ce89dc1075deaa79a.title_ko: ShellBench 연구, 일상 작업 에이전트 성능은 실행 환경보다 모델 선택 영향 커
cc56e71ce89dc1075deaa79a.summary_ko: 연구진은 1,000만 건 이상의 사용자 요청을 바탕으로 일상 과제 100개를 구성한 평가 도구 ShellBench를 제안했다. 12개 모델과 5개 에이전트 실행 환경을 평가한 결과, 실행 환경보다 모델 선택의 성능 영향이 컸지만 상위 3개 모델 간 격차는 1.1%포인트에 그쳤다고 보고했다.
cc56e71ce89dc1075deaa79a.background_ko: 일상에서 AI 에이전트 활용이 늘지만 사용자가 자신에게 효과적인 모델과 실행 환경 구성을 판단하기 어렵다는 문제의식에서 연구가 출발했다.

curation.reason_ko: ShellBench 연구는 일상 업무 100개와 5만여 회 실행으로 모델·실행 프레임워크의 성능 차이를 비교했다.

003cb6061c94a1e7d37835b2.title_ko: Aftershock 연구, 공개 Linux 패치로 Android 권한 상승 공격 자동화
003cb6061c94a1e7d37835b2.summary_ko: 연구진은 공개 Linux 패치에서 Android 취약점을 찾아 LLM 에이전트로 권한 상승 공격 코드를 만드는 자동화 체계를 제시했다. 후보 CVE 152개 중 취약점 38개를 재현하고 실제 방어가 적용된 환경에서 공격 코드 17개를 검증했으며, 이들 취약점의 패치가 Pixel에 반영되기까지 중앙값 181일이 걸렸다고 보고했다.
003cb6061c94a1e7d37835b2.background_ko: Android 커널의 Linux 패치 반영이 늦어지는 가운데 LLM 에이전트가 공개 패치를 이용해 기기 수정 전에 공격 코드를 만들 수 있다는 위협을 검증한 연구다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진이 Android 패치 지연 구간에서 AI로 권한 상승 공격 17건을 검증했다고 보고했다.

20c5ae6892f857e5ce684062.title_ko: 개인정보위 사칭 악성메일 유포…유출 통지로 위장해 감염 유도
20c5ae6892f857e5ce684062.summary_ko: 개인정보보호위원회는 직원을 사칭해 개인정보 유출을 알리고 악성 첨부파일 실행이나 가짜 로그인 페이지 접속을 유도하는 메일이 유포되고 있다고 밝혔다. 위원회는 이런 통지 메일을 발송하지 않으며, 실제 유출 통지는 해당 기업·기관이 담당한다고 설명했다. 의심스러운 링크·첨부파일을 열지 말고 공식 홈페이지·앱에서 확인하라고 당부했다.
20c5ae6892f857e5ce684062.background_ko: 공격자들은 잇따른 개인정보 유출 사고로 커진 불안감을 악용해 악성메일을 정상적인 유출 통지로 위장했다.

curation.reason_ko: 개인정보위가 유출 안내를 위장한 악성메일 유포를 알려 국내 이용자의 첨부파일 주의가 필요하다.

a2f025cb5a9dd05ea0d4279e.title_ko: Claude Code 권한 응답으로 접근 거부 정책 삭제 가능…연구진 보고
a2f025cb5a9dd05ea0d4279e.summary_ko: 연구진은 Claude Code에서 원격 서비스의 권한 승인 응답에 포함된 정책 변경으로 기존 접근 거부 규칙을 삭제할 수 있다고 보고했다. 그 결과 엄격한 샌드박스에서도 비밀정보를 읽을 수 있었으며, 변경된 정책은 다음 세션에도 영향을 줬다고 설명했다. 정책 갱신 단계에 연구진이 제시한 제약을 적용하면 공격을 차단할 수 있다고 밝혔다.
a2f025cb5a9dd05ea0d4279e.background_ko: Claude Code가 허용 규칙을 추가하거나 교체하는 정책 변경만 검사하고 거부 규칙 삭제는 검사하지 않는 것이 연구진이 지목한 원인이다.

curation.reason_ko: 연구진은 Claude Code의 원격 권한 응답이 거부 규칙을 삭제해 후속 실행 정책을 바꿀 수 있다고 밝혔다.

95ed7986dbc2295170013e5a.title_ko: 전주대 해킹 피해 확대…학적정보·강사 계좌번호 추가 유출 확인
95ed7986dbc2295170013e5a.summary_ko: 전주대는 AHA 서버 해킹 조사 과정에서 재학생·졸업생의 주민등록번호와 성적, 평생교육원 강사의 계좌번호·암호화된 비밀번호 등이 유출된 사실을 추가 확인했다. 최초 공개 규모는 약 18만 건이며, 추가 확인분을 포함한 전체 피해 인원은 공개되지 않았다. 대학은 대상자에게 개별 통지하고 유출 항목 조회 서비스를 운영하고 있다.
95ed7986dbc2295170013e5a.background_ko: 온라인 교육서비스 AHA 서버에 대한 외부 비인가 접근으로 학생들의 학적정보와 평생교육원 강사의 금융정보 등이 유출됐다.

curation.reason_ko: 전주대가 주민등록번호·성적·강사 계좌정보의 추가 유출을 확인해 학생과 졸업생의 대응이 필요하다.

a2d882d6b698160579913a19.title_ko: CT 소견 인식·위치 추정·보고서 생성을 통합한 FORA 연구
a2d882d6b698160579913a19.summary_ko: 연구진은 CT 검사 30만 4,962건과 판독 보고서로 학습해 1,028개 영상의학 개념의 인식·위치 추정·보고서 생성을 통합하는 FORA를 제안했다. 별도 평가용 CT 3만 6,619건에서 개념 인식 AUROC 0.918을 기록했으며, 보고서 생성의 매크로 평균 소견 재현율은 비교 대상 중 최고 성능 모델보다 3배 이상 높았다고 보고했다.
a2d882d6b698160579913a19.background_ko: 기존 CT 인공지능이 특정 해부학적 부위·검사 유형·사전 정의된 이상 소견에 국한돼 포괄적이고 공간적 근거를 갖춘 판독에 한계가 있다는 문제에서 출발했다.

curation.reason_ko: FORA 연구는 약 30만 건의 CT로 학습해 여러 촬영 방식의 소견 인식과 공간 근거 연결을 제시했다.
