CVE-2026-109484.description: Failure to sanitize special elements into a different plane (special element injection) in Azure App Service allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.
CVE-2026-109484.summary_ko: Azure App Service의 특수 요소 삽입 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 권한을 높일 수 있다.
CVE-2026-109484.background_ko: 특수 요소를 적절히 정제하지 않아 다른 처리 영역으로 주입될 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Azure App Service에서 인증 없이 네트워크를 통해 권한을 상승시킬 수 있다.

CVE-2026-124286.description: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in Erlang OTP ssl (ssl_handshake module) allows an on-path attacker to impersonate any server to a TLS 1.2 or DTLS client. When a server sends no Certificate message and a ServerKeyExchange without a signature, ssl_handshake:decode_server_key/3 reports the signature algorithm as anon, and ssl_handshake:verify_signature/5 returns true for anon without a public key. The client does not require a certificate for a certificate-authenticated key exchange, so the handshake completes for the ecdhe_rsa, ecdhe_ecdsa, dhe_rsa and dhe_dss key exchanges with a cipher suite the client offered. Certificate path validation, verify_fun and the hostname check do not run, and ssl:connect/3 returns {ok, Socket} with {verify, verify_peer} set. The TLS 1.3 client is not affected. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.14, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.0.3, corresponding to ssl from 5.3.4 before 11.2.12.10, 11.6.0.8, and 11.7.3.
CVE-2026-124286.summary_ko: Erlang OTP의 ssl 모듈에서 암호화 서명 검증 오류로 통신 경로상의 공격자가 TLS 1.2 또는 DTLS 클라이언트에 임의의 서버를 사칭할 수 있다. TLS 1.3 클라이언트는 영향을 받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-124286.background_ko: 인증서 기반 키 교환에서도 인증서를 요구하지 않고 공개키 없는 익명 서명을 유효하게 처리해 인증서 경로와 호스트명 검증이 생략된다.

curation.reason_ko: Erlang OTP의 서명 검증 결함으로 TLS 1.2·DTLS 서버 사칭과 인증서 검증 우회가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136411.description: BusyBox through 1.38.0 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in tftpd that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access files outside any intended directory when started without a DIR argument. Attackers can send RRQ or WRQ packets with file names beginning with '/' to read sensitive files like /etc/shadow or overwrite files, typically as root.
CVE-2026-136411.summary_ko: BusyBox 1.38.0 이하의 tftpd에는 DIR 인자 없이 실행할 때 발생하는 절대 경로 탐색 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 의도된 디렉터리 밖의 민감한 파일을 읽거나 파일을 덮어쓸 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136411.background_ko: DIR 인자 없이 시작한 tftpd에서 절대 경로 파일명을 통한 접근이 의도된 디렉터리 안으로 제한되지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: DIR 없이 실행한 BusyBox tftpd에서 인증 없는 원격 파일 열람·덮어쓰기가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136181.description: cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain upstream registry authTokens via the GET /-/registry endpoints lacking AdminAccess middleware. Attackers can request /-/registry or /-/registry/:id and replay the leaked authToken as a Bearer credential to enumerate, download, or publish packages upstream.
CVE-2026-136181.summary_ko: cnpmcore 3.46.0 이상 3.84.3 미만 및 4.0.0 이상 4.37.3 미만에서 인증되지 않은 공격자에게 상위 레지스트리 인증 토큰이 노출될 수 있다. 유출된 토큰으로 상위 레지스트리의 패키지 목록 조회·다운로드·게시가 가능하다.
CVE-2026-136181.background_ko: 레지스트리 조회용 GET /-/registry 계열 엔드포인트에 AdminAccess 미들웨어가 없어 인증 토큰이 노출된다.

curation.reason_ko: cnpmcore의 인증 토큰 노출로 상위 레지스트리 패키지 게시까지 가능해 공급망 위험이 있다.

CVE-2026-135388.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.0.0 until 3.1.13, the implementation selected signature verification based on the certificate public key while deriving the digest from the peer-controlled signature scheme without validating that the scheme, key type, and hash requirements were consistent. The affected verification functions are verifyKeySignature for ServerKeyExchange and verifyCertificateVerify for CertificateVerify. An unauthenticated network attacker who can redirect a DTLS handshake and obtain the genuine peer certificate can submit crafted handshake signatures that are accepted without possession of the certificate private key. This can let the attacker impersonate the peer and compromise the confidentiality and integrity of protected traffic; checking a WebRTC SDP certificate fingerprint does not prevent the attack because the genuine certificate is presented. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.
CVE-2026-135388.summary_ko: Pion DTLS 2.0.0 이상 3.1.13 미만에 서명 검증 취약점이 있다. DTLS 핸드셰이크 경로를 바꾸고 실제 상대 인증서를 확보할 수 있는 미인증 공격자는 상대를 사칭해 통신의 기밀성과 무결성을 침해할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135388.background_ko: 인증서 공개키로 서명 검증 방식을 정하고 상대가 지정한 서명 체계로 해시를 계산하면서, 서명 체계·키 유형·해시 요건 간 일관성을 검증하지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: 통신 경로를 바꿀 수 있는 공격자가 Pion DTLS 서명 검증을 우회해 상대를 사칭할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135792.description: A vulnerability has been found in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This issue affects the function send_email_authcode of the file user.cgi of the component Email Auth Code Sender. Such manipulation of the argument Username leads to os command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-135792.summary_ko: Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10의 이메일 인증 코드 전송 기능에 운영체제 명령 삽입 취약점이 있어 원격 공격이 가능하다.
CVE-2026-135792.background_ko: user.cgi의 send_email_authcode 함수에서 Username 인자 조작으로 운영체제 명령이 주입된다.

curation.reason_ko: Panabit 게이트웨이의 원격 명령 삽입과 공격 코드 공개·공급업체 무응답이 보고됐다.

CVE-2026-135797.description: A vulnerability was identified in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. Impacted is the function exec of the file sslvpn/sslvpn_client.php of the component SSLVPN Client. Such manipulation of the argument img leads to os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
CVE-2026-135797.summary_ko: Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1의 SSLVPN Client에 운영체제 명령 삽입 취약점이 있어 원격 공격이 가능하다.
CVE-2026-135797.background_ko: sslvpn/sslvpn_client.php의 exec 함수에서 img 인자 조작으로 운영체제 명령이 주입된다.

curation.reason_ko: Volans NGFW의 SSLVPN 명령 삽입과 공격 코드 공개·공급업체 무응답이 보고됐다.

CVE-2026-136184.description: compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site request forgery vulnerability because its unauthenticated web UI performs no Origin validation. Malicious websites visited by users can open /ws/shell/{host} or /ws/exec sockets, or abuse unquoted service parameters and PUT /api/console/file, to execute commands on all managed hosts.
CVE-2026-136184.summary_ko: compose-farm 0.19.0 이상 1.22.0 미만에 교차 사이트 WebSocket 하이재킹과 교차 사이트 요청 위조 취약점이 있다. 사용자가 악성 웹사이트를 방문하면 관리 대상 모든 호스트에서 명령이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136184.background_ko: 인증 없는 웹 UI가 요청의 Origin을 검증하지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: compose-farm 사용자가 악성 웹사이트를 방문하면 관리 대상 모든 호스트에서 명령이 실행될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-112732.description: Double free in Microsoft Office Visio allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network.
CVE-2026-112732.summary_ko: Microsoft Office Visio의 이중 해제 취약점으로 인해 권한이 없는 공격자가 네트워크를 통해 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Microsoft Office Visio의 이중 해제로 인증 없는 원격 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-134019.description: PyTables is a Python package to manage extremely large amounts of data. In 3.11.1 and earlier, tables/attributeset.py treats a NumPy bytes scalar ending in a period as a pickled Python object and calls pickle.loads() when the attribute is accessed through AttributeSet.__getattr__ or AttributeSet.__getitem__. Opening an attacker-controlled HDF5 file and reading an affected metadata attribute can execute attacker-controlled code in the consumer’s process. No fixed version is available as of this review.
CVE-2026-134019.summary_ko: PyTables 3.11.1 이하 버전에서 공격자가 제어하는 HDF5 파일을 열고 특정 메타데이터 속성을 읽으면, 사용자 프로세스에서 공격자가 지정한 코드가 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134019.background_ko: tables/attributeset.py가 마침표로 끝나는 NumPy 바이트 스칼라를 피클 객체로 간주하고 속성 접근 시 pickle.loads()로 역직렬화합니다.

curation.reason_ko: PyTables는 악성 HDF5 메타데이터를 읽을 때 코드가 실행될 수 있고 검토 시점 수정 버전이 없다.

CVE-2026-130411.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in woylie flop allows a remote attacker to execute code on the server via a crafted pagination cursor. Flop.Cursor.decode/2 in lib/flop/cursor.ex decodes the after and before parameters with :erlang.binary_to_term/2 in :safe mode. Its check rejects functions, PIDs, ports and references, but it accepts maps, and therefore structs of any module. Flop passes the decoded values to Ecto as query parameters. A cursor value that nests an Ecto.Query.DynamicExpr struct with a DBConnection.Stream struct as its binding fails the Ecto cast. Ecto then inspects the value for the error message, the Inspect implementation enumerates the stream, and DBConnection calls the module, function and arguments in the :log option of the stream. This issue affects flop: from 0.8.0 before 0.26.7, from 0.27.0 before 0.27.3, from 0.28.0 before 0.28.1, and from 0.29.0 before 0.29.2.
CVE-2026-130411.summary_ko: woylie flop의 페이지네이션 커서 처리에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터 역직렬화 취약점이 있습니다. 원격 공격자가 조작된 커서를 통해 서버에서 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-130411.background_ko: 커서 역직렬화 검사가 임의 모듈의 구조체를 허용하고, Ecto의 형 변환 오류 메시지 생성 과정에서 해당 값의 처리가 함수 호출로 이어집니다.

curation.reason_ko: flop의 페이지네이션 커서 역직렬화로 원격 공격자가 서버에서 코드를 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136404.description: ntop n2n supernode 3.0 through 3.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to leak memory and execute code by sending an untrusted 16-bit auth token_size in REGISTER_SUPER_NAK datagrams. Attackers can register an edge in a chosen community, then send an oversized token_size to leak stack canaries and pointers, overwrite the return address, or crash the supernode.
CVE-2026-136404.summary_ko: ntop n2n supernode 3.0~3.1.1에 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 메모리 정보를 유출하거나 코드를 실행하고 supernode를 중단시킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136404.background_ko: REGISTER_SUPER_NAK 데이터그램의 신뢰할 수 없는 16비트 token_size 값을 처리하면서 스택 버퍼 오버플로가 발생한다.

curation.reason_ko: ntop n2n supernode의 버퍼 오버플로로 인증 없는 원격 메모리 유출과 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136441.description: Bytebase DBHub MCP Incorrect Authorization Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Bytebase DBHub. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the MCP server. The issue results from an incorrect authorization decision when parsing untrusted SQL. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-27635.
CVE-2026-136441.summary_ko: Bytebase DBHub의 MCP 서버에 잘못된 인가 판단으로 인한 인증 우회 취약점이 있습니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 시스템 인증을 우회할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-136441.background_ko: MCP 서버가 신뢰할 수 없는 SQL을 파싱할 때 인가 여부를 잘못 판단합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Bytebase DBHub의 MCP 서버가 SQL 처리 중 잘못된 인가 판단으로 원격 인증 우회를 허용한다.

CVE-2026-136434.description: Super Magic PHPSandbox Command Injection Sandbox Escape Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass the sandbox on affected installations of Super Magic. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the PHPSandbox endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute PHP code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escape the sandbox and execute arbitrary code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-28102.
CVE-2026-136434.summary_ko: Super Magic의 PHPSandbox 엔드포인트에 명령어 삽입 취약점이 있습니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 샌드박스를 탈출해 서비스 계정 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-136434.background_ko: PHPSandbox 엔드포인트가 사용자 제공 문자열을 적절히 검증하지 않은 채 PHP 코드 실행에 사용합니다.

curation.reason_ko: Super Magic의 PHPSandbox에서 인증 없는 샌드박스 탈출과 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-128856.description: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the file paths, extensions or contents written by one of its unauthenticated AJAX actions, allowing unauthenticated users to write arbitrary PHP files to a web-accessible directory and execute code on the server.
CVE-2026-128856.summary_ko: WordPress용 Web To Print Shop : uDraw 플러그인 3.4.0 이하에서 인증되지 않은 사용자가 웹 접근 가능 디렉터리에 임의의 PHP 파일을 작성해 서버에서 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128856.background_ko: 인증이 필요 없는 AJAX 동작 중 하나가 기록할 파일의 경로, 확장자, 내용을 제한하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-128857.description: The Web To Print Shop : uDraw WordPress plugin through 3.4.0 does not restrict the source URL, destination path or file type when an unauthenticated AJAX action fetches a file and writes it to a web-accessible directory, allowing unauthenticated users to upload executable PHP files and achieve remote code execution, as well as read arbitrary local files.
CVE-2026-128857.summary_ko: WordPress용 Web To Print Shop : uDraw 플러그인 3.4.0 이하에서 인증되지 않은 사용자가 실행 가능한 PHP 파일을 업로드해 원격 코드를 실행하거나 임의의 로컬 파일을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-128857.background_ko: 인증이 필요 없는 AJAX 동작이 파일을 가져와 웹 접근 가능 디렉터리에 저장할 때 원본 URL, 저장 경로, 파일 형식을 제한하지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: uDraw의 인증 없는 파일 가져오기에서 PHP 업로드·코드 실행과 로컬 파일 열람이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136158.description: In Valkey JSON 1.0.0 through 1.0.2, a recursive JSONPath expression such as $..* returns both an array and elements nested inside it. The size-changing mutators (JSON.ARRAPPEND, JSON.ARRINSERT, JSON.ARRPOP, JSON.ARRTRIM and JSON.CLEAR) process the ancestor first, which can reallocate its element buffer and free the old storage while the descendant entries in the result set still point into it; the module then writes through those dangling pointers. An authenticated user who can run these commands can use this to reliably crash the server, and it has been developed into remote code execution as the user the server runs as. Servers that do not load the JSON module, including through valkey-bundle, are not affected.
CVE-2026-136158.summary_ko: Valkey JSON 1.0.0~1.0.2에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있다. 관련 명령 실행 권한이 있는 인증된 사용자가 서버를 중단시키거나 서버 실행 계정 권한으로 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있으며, JSON 모듈을 로드하지 않은 서버는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-136158.background_ko: 재귀 JSONPath 결과의 상위 배열 변경으로 요소 버퍼가 재할당·해제될 때 하위 요소의 포인터가 남아 있어 해제된 메모리에 쓰기가 발생한다.

curation.reason_ko: Valkey JSON의 해제 후 사용 결함은 인증된 사용자의 서버 중단과 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136547.summary_ko: Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi의 httpd 구성요소에 있는 R7WebsSecurityHandler 함수에서 부적절한 인증 취약점이 확인됐다. 원격 공격이 가능하며 공격 코드가 공개돼 있다.

Attackers can inject input into restricted contexts like preprocessing, th:utext, th:on* handlers, fragment names, or TEXT templates to escalate server-side template injection.
CVE-2026-136410.summary_ko: Thymeleaf 3.1.6.RELEASE 미만에 제한된 표현식 모드 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 금지된 동작을 수행하고 서버 측 템플릿 주입의 영향을 확대할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136156.description: In Valkey before 7.2.15, 8.0.x before 8.0.12, 8.1.x before 8.1.11, 9.0.x before 9.0.7, 9.1.x before 9.1.3 and 9.2.0-rc1, running in cluster mode, clusterCreatePublishMsgBlock computes the length of the cluster bus message for a PUBLISH or SPUBLISH as a size_t but passes it to createClusterMsgSendBlock as a uint32_t. When the channel and message together exceed 4 GiB, the length is truncated, a buffer far smaller than the message is allocated, and the full channel and message are then copied into it. An authenticated user who can publish, for example by building the arguments in a script, can overflow the heap with attacker-controlled bytes. This reliably crashes the server and may lead to remote code execution. Servers that do not run in cluster mode are not affected.
CVE-2026-136156.summary_ko: 클러스터 모드로 실행되는 Valkey의 일부 버전에 정수 잘림으로 인한 힙 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. 메시지 게시 권한이 있는 인증된 사용자가 서버를 중단시킬 수 있으며, 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136156.background_ko: 클러스터 메시지 길이를 size_t에서 uint32_t로 전달할 때 4 GiB를 넘는 길이가 잘려 작은 버퍼가 할당되고, 여기에 전체 데이터가 복사된다.

curation.reason_ko: Valkey 클러스터의 게시 메시지 길이 잘림으로 힙 오버플로가 발생해 서버 중단과 코드 실행 위험이 있다.

CVE-2026-136412.description: OpenResty stream-lua-nginx-module before 0.0.20rc4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows remote peers to trigger access to freed memory when a receiveuntil() pattern iterator is garbage-collected while still referenced by the socket. Attackers can interrupt or close the cosocket connection so later reads or socket closure use the stale pattern pointer, crashing or corrupting the nginx worker.
CVE-2026-136412.summary_ko: OpenResty stream-lua-nginx-module 0.0.20rc4 이전 버전에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있습니다. 원격 공격자가 해제된 메모리 접근을 유발해 nginx 워커의 충돌이나 손상을 일으킬 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-136412.background_ko: 소켓이 참조 중인 receiveuntil() 패턴 반복자가 가비지 수집되어, 이후 읽기나 소켓 종료 시 해제된 패턴 포인터가 사용됩니다.

CVE-2026-16663.description: MCUboot's encrypted serial-recovery path contains an attacker-controlled out-of-bounds stack write in decrypt_region_inplace() in boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c. The routine decrypts an uploaded encrypted image one flash sector at a time into a sector-sized stack VLA buf[sz], but when the current sector is still inside the image header it sets the destination index to the absolute header size (idx = hdr->ih_hdr_size; at boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c:156) and then decrypts into &buf[idx]. The correct sibling routine boot/bootutil/src/loader.c:876 uses the sector-relative idx = hdr->ih_hdr_size - abs_off; the serial path is missing the - abs_off term, so for any sector after the first the index runs past the end of the stack buffer. The ih_hdr_size field is a uint16_t taken verbatim from the uploaded image header. On the second sector onward, when ih_hdr_size exceeds the sector size, &buf[idx] points beyond buf and boot_enc_decrypt() writes attacker-controlled plaintext into adjacent stack frames. The path is reached pre-authentication: bs_upload() calls boot_handle_enc_fw() (boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial.c:1208) after upload, and the pre-decryption signature gate in decrypt_image_inplace() is compiled out (#if 0 at boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c:226-233), so the header is never validated before decryption. A second error in the same window computation affects the first sector. When a sector holds both the end of the header and the start of the TLV area, the decrypt length is clamped to tlv_off - (off + bytes_copied), measured from the start of the sector rather than from idx (boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c:166). An encrypted image whose header and payload end within the first sector is therefore decrypted for ih_hdr_size bytes more than it should be: into the TLV area and, when the image ends near the end of the sector, past buf. This form needs no oversized header, so even an ordinary small encrypted image can trigger it, and it reaches devices with sectors of up to about 128 KiB rather than only those whose sector is smaller than the 16-bit ih_hdr_size. Reaching the sink requires a build with MCUBOOT_ENC_IMAGES and serial recovery enabled, and access to the device's serial/USB recovery interface (unauthenticated by design). With the public-key encryption schemes the AES content key is wrapped to the device's public encryption key, so an attacker can author a fully crafted encrypted image — including a malicious ih_hdr_size — without the image-signing private key. The result is a controllable stack memory-corruption inside the bootloader before any signature check, providing a path to code execution in the secure-boot root of trust that bypasses image authentication, as well as a denial-of-service. A 2048-byte out-of-bounds write was reproduced under AddressSanitizer (sz=4096, off=4096, ih_hdr_size=6144). On releases before v2.0.0 (v1.9.0 and v1.10.0) the destination is a file-scope static uint8_t buf[SOC_FLASH_ERASE_BLK_SZ] in .bss rather than the stack VLA described above — the code then lived in boot/zephyr/single_loader.c, before commit c9fa6088 relocated it to boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial_encryption.c and changed the buffer's storage class. The out-of-bounds write is equally real and equally pre-authentication on those releases, but it corrupts adjacent static data rather than the stack, so a stack-smashing proof of concept written against a current release will not reproduce as-is there.
CVE-2026-16663.summary_ko: MCUboot의 암호화된 직렬 복구 경로에 인증 전 스택 범위 밖 쓰기 취약점이 있다. 암호화 이미지 지원과 직렬 복구가 활성화된 기기의 직렬·USB 복구 인터페이스에 접근할 수 있는 공격자는 이미지 인증 우회, 부트로더 코드 실행 또는 서비스 거부를 유발할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-16663.background_ko: 복호화 대상 인덱스와 길이 계산 오류로 섹터 크기의 스택 버퍼를 벗어나며, 복호화 전 서명 검사가 비활성화돼 이미지 헤더가 검증되지 않는다.

curation.reason_ko: MCUboot의 암호화 직렬 복구에서 인증 전 스택 쓰기로 부트로더 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-16665.description: Summary MCUboot enforces several security-critical invariants on the boot, image-swap, and validation paths using assert(). In a standard release/production build (NDEBUG defined) assert() expands to a no-op, so an invariant the code intends to halt on instead falls through, and execution continues with the bad or inconsistent state. Where the guarded condition is attacker-influenceable through the flash-write boundary (serial-recovery / DFU), this is a security check that is simply absent in release builds. This is one root cause (assert-as-security-guard, no-op under NDEBUG) with one fix approach (replace the security-critical asserts with real fail-closed checks), so it is filed as a single advisory covering the enumerated sites. Worst reachable instance — inconsistent swap status completes the swap without validation In the swap-resume status read, an inconsistent status (erased_sections > 1) is detected, logged, and — when MCUBOOT_VALIDATE_PRIMARY_SLOT is disabled — is meant to abort, because "there is no way to be sure the swapped primary slot is OK." The abort is assert(0): boot/bootutil/src/swap_move.c:181-194 — if (erased_sections > 1) { ... #if !defined(MCUBOOT_VALIDATE_PRIMARY_SLOT) / ... abort! / assert(0); #endif }, then execution falls through to compute bs->op/idx/state from the inconsistent status (lines 197-208) and return 0 (success). boot/bootutil/src/swap_offset.c:266-280 — identical pattern; falls through to bs->op/idx/state and return 0. boot/bootutil/src/swap_scratch.c:227-241 — same invalid/assert(0) pattern for the scratch backend. Under NDEBUG with primary-slot validation off, the inconsistent status is neither aborted (assert is a no-op) nor re-validated (validation off), so boot_complete_partial_swap() finishes the swap on inconsistent metadata and the primary slot is booted without a signature check. An attacker who can write the swap-status trailer can craft the inconsistent status. Reachability (threat model). Secondary slot + scratch trailers are A2-writable by definition (that is what a DFU upload is). Under MCUBOOT_SERIAL_RECOVERY the primary trailer is A2-writable too: boot/boot_serial/src/boot_serial.c:978 opens flash_area_id_from_multi_image_slot(img_num, 0) (== primary) and writes from offset 0 bounded by area_size, so it can paint the primary swap-status/magic. This is how the A2 (recovery/DFU, unauthenticated by design) attacker influences the guarded condition. Property violated: P1 (image authenticity / secure-boot bypass) when un-revalidated content is booted, and P6 (boot/recovery availability). Second reachable instance — resume-path swap_size from an unguarded trailer boot/bootutil/src/loader.c:1190-1193: the swap resume branch does fap = boot_find_status(...); assert(fap != NULL); rc = boot_read_swap_size(fap, &bs->swap_size); assert(rc == 0);. boot_find_status() (boot/bootutil/src/bootutil_misc.c:166-204) searches {scratch, primary} and, on no-valid-magic-match, returns the last-iterated area (primary), not NULL — so assert(fap != NULL) cannot fire even in debug, and under NDEBUG neither assert fires. swap_size is then read from an A2-writable (serial-recovery primary, or scratch) trailer with no fail-closed handling. This is the same swap-metadata-trust family as the recorded resume/swap_size disclosure. Reachable-security sites (center the fix here) 1. boot/bootutil/src/swap_move.c:193 — inconsistent-status assert(0), falls through to complete swap. A2 + !VALIDATE_PRIMARY. [worst] 2. boot/bootutil/src/swap_offset.c:278 — same, swap-offset backend. 3. boot/bootutil/src/swap_scratch.c:239 — same, swap-scratch backend. 4. boot/bootutil/src/loader.c:1191 and :1193 — resume assert(fap != NULL) / assert(rc == 0) guarding swap_size read from an A2-writable trailer; compounded by boot_find_status() never returning NULL. (Truncated. The full description is in the advisory: https://github.com/mcu-tools/mcuboot/security/advisories/GHSA-cr9j-p626-pwcc)
CVE-2026-16665.summary_ko: MCUboot는 릴리스 빌드에서 일부 보안 검사가 사라진다. 복구·DFU 경로로 플래시를 쓸 수 있는 공격자는 주 슬롯 검증이 비활성화된 경우 서명 검증 없이 이미지를 부팅하게 해 보안 부팅을 우회하거나 부팅·복구 가용성을 훼손할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-16665.background_ko: 보안상 중요한 상태 검사를 assert()에 의존해, NDEBUG가 정의된 릴리스 빌드에서는 검사가 무효화되고 잘못되거나 불일치한 상태로 실행이 계속된다.

curation.reason_ko: MCUboot 릴리스 빌드의 보안 검사 누락으로 특정 복구·검증 설정에서 보안 부팅 우회가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-134438.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure download vulnerability in webmin/upgrade.cgi, cluster-webmin/upgrade.cgi and cluster-usermin/upgrade.cgi that fetches upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP with GnuPG signature verification disabled by default. On-path network attackers can substitute a malicious RPM, Debian or tar.gz package during a default upgrade to execute code as root on the Webmin host and managed cluster servers.
CVE-2026-134438.summary_ko: Webmin 2.670 이하의 기본 업그레이드 과정에서 네트워크 경로상의 공격자가 업그레이드 패키지를 악성 패키지로 바꿔 Webmin 호스트와 관리 대상 클러스터 서버에서 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-134438.background_ko: 업그레이드 패키지를 평문 HTTP로 내려받으며, GnuPG 서명 검증이 기본적으로 비활성화돼 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Webmin의 평문 업그레이드를 변조하면 호스트와 관리 서버에서 root 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-134647.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in web-lib-funcs.pl and fastrpc.cgi that sends cluster RPC traffic over raw TCP despite SSL configuration. Network-positioned attackers can read the session ID and remote_eval payloads or alter calls in transit to execute code as root on managed servers.
CVE-2026-134647.summary_ko: Webmin 2.670 이하에서 네트워크 경로상의 공격자가 클러스터 RPC의 세션 ID와 remote_eval 데이터를 읽거나 전송 중 호출을 변조해 관리 대상 서버에서 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-134647.background_ko: web-lib-funcs.pl과 fastrpc.cgi가 SSL 설정에도 불구하고 클러스터 RPC 트래픽을 암호화되지 않은 TCP로 전송한다.

curation.reason_ko: Webmin 클러스터 RPC가 SSL 설정에도 평문 전송돼 변조 시 관리 서버의 root 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-134642.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.
CVE-2026-134642.summary_ko: Webmin 2.670 이하의 fastrpc.cgi에 인증 누락 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 네트워크 공격자가 클러스터 작업 중 전송 파일을 탈취하거나 준비된 패키지를 교체해 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-134642.background_ko: tcpwrite·tcpread 파일 전송 리스너가 세션 검사 없이 연결을 허용하며, 전송 포트를 예측할 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Webmin의 클러스터 파일 전송에 인증이 없어 연결 경쟁으로 파일 탈취·교체와 root 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136426.description: PyTorch Foundation PyTorch PT2 File Parsing Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The specific flaw exists within the parsing of PT2 files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute Python code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32602.
CVE-2026-136426.summary_ko: PyTorch의 PT2 파일 파싱에 코드 삽입 취약점이 있어 원격 공격자가 현재 프로세스 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다. 악용에는 라이브러리와의 상호작용이 필요하며 공격 경로는 구현에 따라 달라집니다.
CVE-2026-136426.background_ko: PT2 파일 파싱 과정에서 사용자 제공 문자열을 적절히 검증하지 않은 채 Python 코드 실행에 사용합니다.

curation.reason_ko: PyTorch의 PT2 파일 파싱 중 입력 검증 누락으로 현재 프로세스 권한의 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136427.description: PyTorch Foundation PyTorch AOTIModelPackageLoader Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation. The specific flaw exists within the AOTIModelPackageLoader. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32262.
CVE-2026-136427.summary_ko: PyTorch의 AOTIModelPackageLoader에 명령어 삽입 취약점이 있어 원격 공격자가 현재 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다. 악용에는 라이브러리와의 상호작용이 필요하며 공격 경로는 구현에 따라 달라집니다.
CVE-2026-136427.background_ko: AOTIModelPackageLoader가 사용자 제공 문자열을 적절히 검증하지 않은 채 시스템 호출 실행에 사용합니다.

curation.reason_ko: PyTorch의 AOTIModelPackageLoader에 명령 삽입으로 인한 코드 실행 취약점이 있다.

CVE-2026-136430.description: PyTorch Foundation PyTorch AOTIModelPackageLoader Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the AOTInductor model package loader. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-33055.
CVE-2026-136430.summary_ko: PyTorch의 AOTInductor 모델 패키지 로더(AOTIModelPackageLoader)에 디렉터리 탐색 취약점이 있어 원격 공격자가 현재 사용자 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다. 악성 페이지 방문이나 악성 파일 열기 등 사용자 상호작용이 필요하다.
CVE-2026-136430.background_ko: 파일 작업에 사용자 제공 경로를 사용하기 전에 적절히 검증하지 않아 발생한다.

curation.reason_ko: PyTorch의 모델 패키지 로더에서 경로 검증 누락으로 악성 파일 처리 시 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-136431.description: PyTorch Foundation PyTorch load_state_dict_from_url Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the load_state_dict_from_url function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32601.
CVE-2026-136431.summary_ko: PyTorch의 load_state_dict_from_url 함수에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터의 역직렬화 취약점이 있어 원격 공격자가 현재 프로세스 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다. 악성 페이지 방문이나 악성 파일 열기 등 사용자 상호작용이 필요하다.
CVE-2026-136431.background_ko: 사용자 제공 데이터를 적절히 검증하지 않아 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터가 역직렬화될 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: PyTorch의 URL 기반 상태 로드 함수가 신뢰하지 않는 데이터를 역직렬화해 코드 실행을 허용할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135768.description: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security.
CVE-2026-135768.summary_ko: Keycloak의 keycloak-services에서 OTP를 요구하는 클라이언트 정책이 있어도 비밀번호만 사용한 SSO 세션이 허용될 수 있다. 사용자 비밀번호나 세션에 접근한 공격자가 2차 인증을 우회하고 더 높은 보안 수준을 표시하는 토큰을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135768.background_ko: 기존 세션 검증이 부적절해, 요청이 특정 인증 보장 수준을 명시하지 않으면 낮은 인증 보장 수준의 세션이 수락된다.

curation.reason_ko: Keycloak의 특정 SSO 정책에서 비밀번호만으로 OTP를 우회하고 높은 인증 수준의 토큰을 얻을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135389.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.0 until 3.1.14, a server with a SessionStore saved the session ID and master secret after ClientKeyExchange, before receiving a valid Finished message and before enforcing the configured client-authentication checks. A remote client can omit its Certificate message, send ClientKeyExchange, leave the first handshake unfinished, and then resume the cached session using the master secret it learned during key exchange. The server must use a SessionStore and negotiate a certificate-based cipher suite. The attack can bypass client certificates required through RequireAnyClientCert or RequireAndVerifyClientCert, or a rejecting VerifyConnection callback. WebRTC users are not affected. The abbreviated handshake can allow unauthorized access to application data. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.14.
CVE-2026-135389.summary_ko: Pion DTLS 2.1.0 이상 3.1.14 미만에서 SessionStore와 인증서 기반 암호군을 사용하는 서버의 클라이언트 인증을 우회할 수 있다. 원격 클라이언트가 애플리케이션 데이터에 무단 접근할 수 있으며, WebRTC 사용자는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-135389.background_ko: 유효한 Finished 메시지 수신과 클라이언트 인증 검사 전에 세션 ID와 마스터 비밀값을 SessionStore에 저장한다.

curation.reason_ko: Pion DTLS의 인증 전 세션 저장으로 특정 서버 설정에서 필수 클라이언트 인증서를 우회할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136227.description: By combining several weaknesses, a crafted email could, when opened, inject commands into the authenticated IMAP connection, and load a web page with JavaScript enabled in place of the message. A bare carriage return in a header let the sender set Thunderbird's internal message flags, marking the message as a feed item and allowing its remote content to load. A reference to an embedded part placed inside an attribute value disclosed the message's internal IMAP URL to the sender. The message ID part of IMAP URLs was not validated, so loading a crafted variant of that URL sent arbitrary IMAP commands, which could modify or delete messages and folders. Finally, a frame reloading the message, together with a legacy feed marker in its content, caused the message pane to load a sender-chosen web page with scripting enabled. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.
CVE-2026-136227.summary_ko: Thunderbird에서 조작된 이메일을 열면 인증된 IMAP 연결에 명령이 주입돼 메시지·폴더가 수정되거나 삭제될 수 있다. 또한 메시지 창에 JavaScript가 활성화된 공격자 지정 웹페이지가 표시될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136227.background_ko: 헤더의 단독 캐리지 리턴 허용, 속성 내 참조를 통한 내부 IMAP URL 노출, URL 메시지 ID 검증 누락, 레거시 피드 처리와 프레임 재로딩 동작이 결합돼 발생한다.

curation.reason_ko: Thunderbird에서 악성 이메일을 열면 IMAP 명령 주입으로 메일·폴더 수정·삭제가 가능하다.

CVE-2026-129959.description: When sftpEnabled=true (the default configuration in etc/org.apache.karaf.shell.cfg), the SSH server exposes the karaf.base directory tree through the MINA SSHD SFTP subsystem and SCP command factory without verifying the authenticated user's roles beyond the initial sshRole login check. Consequently, an authenticated user with only low-privileged roles (such as viewer and ssh) can read sensitive configuration and key files (including etc/users.properties and etc/host.key) or write arbitrary bundles/configurations into monitored directories (such as deploy/ or etc/), leading to privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution. Apache Karaf 4.4.13 and 4.5.0 introduce the sftpRole configuration property in org.apache.karaf.shell (defaulting to admin) and enforce role-based access control on SFTP subsystem creation, SCP command execution, and virtual filesystem access. Mitigation / WorkaroundUsers are recommended to upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.13 or 4.5.0. On earlier versions where SFTP/SCP access is not required, set sftpEnabled=false in etc/org.apache.karaf.shell.cfg and restart the SSH server bundle (or Karaf instance).
CVE-2026-129959.summary_ko: Apache Karaf는 기본 설정에서 낮은 권한의 인증된 사용자가 SFTP/SCP로 민감한 설정·키 파일을 읽거나 감시 대상 디렉터리에 임의의 번들·설정을 쓸 수 있다. 이를 통해 권한 상승과 임의 코드 실행이 가능하다.
CVE-2026-129959.background_ko: SFTP/SCP가 초기 SSH 로그인 역할 확인 이후 추가 역할 검증 없이 karaf.base 디렉터리 트리를 노출한다.

curation.reason_ko: Apache Karaf의 기본 SFTP/SCP 접근 제어 누락으로 저권한 사용자의 키 탈취와 코드 실행이 가능하다.

CVE-2026-130808.description: In Apache Karaf, the default command ACL configuration for the feature scope (etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg, defined in assemblies/features/standard/src/main/feature/feature.xml and the child-instance template instance/src/main/resources/org/apache/karaf/instance/resources/etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg) restricts feature:install, feature:uninstall, feature:start, and feature:stop to users with the admin role, while leaving feature:requirement-add and feature:requirement-remove without ACL entries. Because Karaf's command guard (SecuredSessionFactoryImpl) allows commands with no matching ACL rule (NO_MATCH) to execute, an authenticated SSH user holding only the ssh and viewer roles can execute feature:requirement-add bundle:<uri> (or feature:<name>). RequirementAdd forwards the requirement directly to FeatureService.addRequirements(), causing the resolver to download, install, and start an arbitrary bundle with the Karaf JVM process's full authority, bypassing the admin-only restrictions on feature:install and bundle:install. Similarly, feature:requirement-remove allows removing provisioning requirements and uninstalling features/bundles. MitigationUsers are recommended to upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.13 or 4.5.0. For existing deployments or upgrades that preserve existing files in etc/, add the following rules to etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg (and any child instance etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg files): requirement-add = admin requirement-remove = admin
CVE-2026-130808.summary_ko: Apache Karaf에서 낮은 권한의 인증된 SSH 사용자가 명령 접근 제어를 우회해 임의의 번들을 설치·실행하거나 기능·번들을 제거할 수 있다. 설치된 번들은 Karaf JVM 프로세스의 전체 권한으로 실행된다.
CVE-2026-130808.background_ko: 기본 feature 명령 ACL에 requirement-add와 requirement-remove 규칙이 빠져 있고, 명령 가드가 일치하는 ACL 규칙이 없는 명령의 실행을 허용한다.

curation.reason_ko: Apache Karaf의 기능 요구사항 명령에 접근 제어가 없어 저권한 SSH 사용자가 임의 번들을 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-133462.description: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. From 0.6.49 before 0.11.0, the MCPToolBlock auto-lookup allows a shared agent's author to use the MCP credentials of the user who runs it. Anyone who ran a shared agent containing an MCPToolBlock node, and had already connected the MCP server URL that the node names, had that connection used for any read, write, or delete the server exposes, with the result sent to a host chosen by the author. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.0.
CVE-2026-133462.summary_ko: AutoGPT 0.6.49 이상 0.11.0 미만에서 공유 에이전트 작성자가 MCPToolBlock을 통해 실행자의 기존 MCP 자격 증명을 사용할 수 있다. 해당 서버가 제공하는 읽기·쓰기·삭제 기능을 이용하고 결과를 작성자가 지정한 호스트로 보낼 수 있다.
CVE-2026-133462.background_ko: MCPToolBlock의 자동 조회 기능이 노드에 지정된 MCP 서버 URL에 대한 실행자의 기존 연결을 사용한다.

curation.reason_ko: AutoGPT의 공유 에이전트가 실행자의 MCP 자격 증명으로 읽기·쓰기·삭제를 수행하고 결과를 유출할 수 있다.

75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.title_original: Supply Chain Compromise Backdoors Six WP connect Plugins, Blocked by WordPress.org’s Release Hold
75485d8523ee8a6c77d1d864.excerpt: On November 22nd, 2026, a threat actor pushed backdoored releases of six WordPress plugins developed by WP connect, including Air WP Sync, WP Sync for Notion, and Add-on Brevo for Gravity Forms, which together are estimated to have more than 3,600 active installations. Each release silently loaded the same remote-control module, which phones home to an attacker-controlled server, executes any PHP code it is sent, and exposes a full command set for running shell commands, stealing password hashes, and planting webshells. Thanks to safeguards introduced under WordPress.org’s Protect The Shire initiative, the backdoored versions were never released to sites, and all six plugins were closed on WordPress.org the same evening. While the WordPress plugins team independently detected and stopped this threat, Wordfence’s PRISM also discovered and notified our team to the threat, which was then validated by our team. As a reminder, PRISM is our continuous monitoring and vulnerability research agent created by the Wordfence Threat Intelligence team. The backdoor in Air WP Sync was also independently discovered and reported by Computeronfire , and we thank them for their contribution. Our mission is to secure WordPress through defense in depth, which is why we are investing in proactive vulnerability research of this kind alongside our Bug Bounty Program . 2961a529a19089d478d41fa2.excerpt: 중국 유니트리의 왕싱싱 CEO는 최근 오픈AI의 'GPT-6 아스트라'를 활용해 휴머노이드가 별도의 작업별 모델 훈련 없이 그림을 그리고 체스를 두는 모습을 소개했습니다. 그는 앞서 로봇 분야에도 '챗GPT 모먼트'가 찾아올 것이라고 전망한 바 있습니다.엔비디아의 디푸 탈라 로봇사업 부사장도 GPT-6 아스트라가 로봇 개발에 큰 도움이 될 것으로 평가했습니다. 이들이 주목하는 것은 범용 AI가 기존 로봇 전용 모델의 역할까지 수행하기 시작했다는 점입니다. 로봇 개발에 필요한 별도의 학습과 복잡한 시스템 구성을 줄일 새로운 가능성이

2961a529a19089d478d41fa2.summary_ko: 유니트리는 GPT-6 아스트라로 작업별 추가 모델 훈련 없이 그림을 그리는 로봇을 시연했다고 밝혔다. 엔비디아 연구진도 시뮬레이션 성과를 보고했지만, 실제 로봇 시연에는 기존 제어 소프트웨어와 작업별 스킬이 함께 쓰였으며 정밀 제어와 처리 속도는 과제로 남았다.
2961a529a19089d478d41fa2.background_ko: 로봇 동작 데이터는 확보하기 어렵고 기체마다 구조가 달라, 작업별 데이터 수집과 추가 훈련에 많은 시간과 비용이 든다.

229ed605cea7c37ca54946e7.title_original: [기고] AI가 리만 가설을 풀었다면 수학은 끝난 것인가
229ed605cea7c37ca54946e7.excerpt: ■ 1700만 줄짜리 증명이 도착했다지난 20일 AI 기업 앤트로픽의 수학자 레벤트 알포게가 자사 AI '클로드'로 리만 가설을 증명했다고 발표했다. 1859년 리만이 제기한 뒤 167년 동안 아무도 풀지 못한 수학에서 가장 유명한 난제다. 증명은 컴퓨터가 검사하는 코드 1700만 줄로 쓰였다.다만 컴퓨터의 검사를 통과한 것과 사람이 이해한 것은 다른 일이다. 발표자 자신도 증명을 다 이해하지 못했다고 하고, 수학자들의 평가는 이제 시작이다. 그런데도 며칠 사이 같은 질문을 여러 번 받았다. "교수님 이제 수학은 끝난 건가요?"■

1f2c93a8a441f71ec1149f60.excerpt: 한국 축구 국가대표 이강인 선수가 뛰는 스페인 라리가(LALIGA)의 디지털 서비스 플랫폼이 해킹돼 여러 구단 팬의 개인정보가 유출됐다. 피해 구단 중 한 곳인 CD테네리페는 11월 23일 공식 공지를 통해 팬들이 서비스에 가입할 때 제공한 식별 정보와 연락처 정보가 외부로 반출됐다고 밝혔다. 전체 피해 인원과 세부 유출 항목은 조사 중이다. 이번 공지에서 확인된 유출 대상은 디지털 서비스에 가입한 팬의 정보다. 이강인 소속 구단인 아틀레티코 마드리드 팬이 피해 범위에 포함됐는지는 CD테네리페 공지에서 확인되지 않았다. 9dd33c2d582f0b0c65db3eb7.excerpt: 국내 전자지급결제대행(PG) 업계에서 개인정보 유출 사고가 잇따르고 있다. 웰컴페이먼츠가 결제서비스 이용자 1,326명의 개인정보 유출 사실을 공식 통지한 가운데 NHN KCP와 KIS정보통신에서도 개인정보 유출 사고가 발생한 것으로 파악돼 전자결제업계 전반의 보안관리 실태에 대한 우려가 커지고 있다.PG사는 온라인 쇼핑몰 등 가맹점과 카드사 사이에서 결제 업무를 처리하는 핵심 금융 인프라다. 다수의 가맹점과 연결돼 있고 고객 개인정보와 결제정보를 취급한다는 점에서 침해사고 발생 시 피해가 여러 기업과 소비자에게 확산될 수 있다.■

2efe3b69edf2d45a1098be62.title_original: Staying Ahead of the New Threat Landscape in 2027
2efe3b69edf2d45a1098be62.excerpt: The WordPress threat landscape changed drastically in 2026, and we expect the pace to continue in 2027. Security researchers are using AI coding agents to find vulnerabilities faster. So are attackers. In response, we built our own AI research systems, Wordfence PRISM and Wordfence Argus , which are credited with more than 500 published vulnerability discoveries, and invested heavily in the models, analysts and processes that turn those discoveries into protection for over 5 million WordPress sites. Below, we share the details of that work and how we’re investing in staying ahead of threats in 2027. How the WordPress Threat Landscape Changed in 2026 This year brought the first critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in WordPress core in nearly a decade and two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, the language WordPress runs on . AI coding agents have developed rapidly over the past year, and they quickly surpassed what was humanly capable in vulnerability research. Finding and exploiting vulnerabilities in code used to take years of expertise and significant effort to understand and carry out. Now researchers increasingly do that work with AI coding tools and agentic security testing harnesses. In April, we reported that AI-assisted reports had grown from 16% to roughly 66% of submissions to our Bug Bounty Program . 9ca9e2420904f2d021488fd5.title_ko: 미국, 알리바바 싱가포르 자회사 수출 통제 명단 등재…알리바바 반발

f349e68ab9eb1ec060486557.summary_ko: 아마존이 다양한 AI 칩에서 모델 실행 효율을 높이는 데카르트의 독점 기술을 인수하고 공동 창업자와 연구·개발 인력을 영입하기로 합의했다. 블룸버그는 거래액을 약 75억달러로 보도했지만 아마존은 계약 조건을 공개하지 않았다. 기업 전체 인수가 아닌 기술·인력 확보 거래로, 규제 당국의 승인이 필요하다.

3785ada12359e8861c7ae39c.title_ko: 오케스트로, 중소기업용 CONTRABASS Lite 출시·가상화 전환 웨비나 개최

c12090abf3ca6d3f813fbca9.title_ko: HPE, 서울 콘퍼런스서 AI·네트워킹·하이브리드 클라우드 통합 전략 제시
c12090abf3ca6d3f813fbca9.summary_ko: HPE가 24일 서울에서 연례 콘퍼런스를 열고 기업의 AI 전사 도입을 위한 컴퓨트·네트워킹·하이브리드 클라우드 통합 방안을 소개했다. 보안·데이터 주권·거버넌스와 운영 관리가 주요 의제로 다뤄졌으며, KISTI는 HPE와 구축한 국가 고성능 컴퓨팅 시스템 ‘한강’을 발표했다.

862d40227a689f17eef609ea.title_ko: 솔트웨어, ASF 브론즈 후원사 합류…Sapie-ADP 오픈소스 연계 확대
862d40227a689f17eef609ea.summary_ko: 솔트웨어가 아파치 소프트웨어 재단(ASF)의 브론즈 후원사로 합류하고 AI 데이터 플랫폼 Sapie-ADP의 오픈소스 연계를 확대한다. 회사에 따르면 이 플랫폼은 기존 데이터 시스템을 전면 교체하지 않고 자연어 분석과 AI 에이전트 활용을 지원하며, 온프레미스와 망분리 환경에서도 사용할 수 있다.

3db462b25c110271b0eeb22e.title_original: SAMA: Training-Free Consensus Ridge Tracking for Camera-Based Heart Rate on Five Public Datasets
3db462b25c110271b0eeb22e.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) is usually benchmarked by one heart rate per video, a figure that hides the short windows in which a tele-consultation would actually read the pulse. We present SAMA, a training-free estimator that (i) forms a quality-weighted consensus of POS and CHROM chrominance spectra, (ii) discounts frequencies occupied by pulse-free references derived from the same frames (frame motion, skin-mask geometry and background brightness), (iii) follows the heart rate through time with a Viterbi ridge under a random-walk prior, and (iv) returns a track-filtered, amplitude-normalised waveform with a per-window confidence. No parameter is learned and no dataset-specific tuning is used. On 218 recordings from 111 participants in five public datasets (UBFC-rPPG, PURE, SUMS, M3PD and a two-participant subset of MMPD), all processed with the same fixed face box and scored with a re-implementation of the rPPG-Toolbox protocol, SAMA has the lowest mean absolute error (MAE) averaged over datasets at every protocol level: 4.40 against 5.13,bpm for POS per video, 4.80 against 5.43 on 30,s windows and 5.05 against 6.59 on 10,s windows. Pooled over participants, the bootstrap interval of its paired difference from POS excludes zero on 30,s and 10,s windows (Wilcoxon p=0.11 and 0.004) but not per video, and it does not beat POS on SUMS per video or on the MMPD subset. d591b5b0d6f6ff750e250e4f.title_original: torchtsetlin: Fast, Interpretable Tsetlin Machines for PyTorch
d591b5b0d6f6ff750e250e4f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28195v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Tsetlin machine learns propositional rules with teams of Tsetlin automata that are driven by reward and penalty rather than gradients, so its models are interpretable by construction and cheap to evaluate. Its software, however, consists of C and CUDA kernels behind scikit-learn-style wrappers that sit outside the deep learning ecosystem. torchtsetlin implements the Tsetlin machine family as ordinary PyTorch modules: vanilla and weighted, coalesced, regression, convolutional over sequences, images and volumes, and dense per-pixel segmentation. The automata are a tensor buffer, so a model moves with .to(device), is saved with state_dict() and learns from a mini-batch with one update(x,y) call. Its core technique is a batched formulation of Type I and Type II feedback, in which automaton transitions become event counts realised as binomial draws, with one commit per mini-batch. On ten benchmarks taken from the existing libraries, it matches their accuracy, and on all but the two smallest it trains 2.4-10.9X faster than PyTsetlinMachineCUDA and 10.3-81.2X faster than tmu on the same GPU. The package is pure Python, MIT-licensed and on PyPI; every number in this paper is reproduced by one script. Code: https://github.com/vlbthambawita/torchtsetlin; package: https://pypi.org/project/torchtsetlin/.

8759b84b12e12bc55c945bde.title_original: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
8759b84b12e12bc55c945bde.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improv

db0d5e3e8ea7ae3e90629415.title_original: AutoPILOT: A Visual Agent Harness for Real-Time Gameplay
db0d5e3e8ea7ae3e90629415.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28202v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal foundation models can play video games well when the game waits for them, but often fail when it keeps running. We find that much of this gap lies in the harness, which decides what the model sees, what it remembers, and how its outputs become actions over time. Existing harnesses such as VISTA improve the first two, yet turn each model call into at most one action, so the agent acts only as often as its model thinks. We introduce AutoPILOT, which changes the third: in each model call, the model can send a primitive action, start an open-loop macro, or write a closed-loop controller that keeps playing from the screen without further model calls until it hands control back. To evaluate agents in real-time games, we build AFK-Bench, 120 diverse browser games grouped by how they respond to inaction and playable in real time or with the clock paused. With GPT-6.1 Sol under the same budgets, AutoPILOT reaches 68.6% real-time success against 38.3% for VISTA, and on GameWorld it keeps 80.0% in real time while VISTA drops from 84.1% to 42.9%. Its gains hold across models, and it reaches VISTA's final success rate at a fifth of its API cost. Our results suggest that how a harness turns model outputs into actions over time is a central yet underexplored part of agent design, and we hope AutoPILOT and AFK-Bench will serve as a foundation for agents in a world that does not wait.

a8c590f1444856f4cfc90069.title_original: FinEvo: Recursive Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Financial Modeling
a8c590f1444856f4cfc90069.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28239v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) have expanded their role in high-value productivity tasks, including financial analysis and modeling, while enabling models to play an increasingly active role in their own improvement. This motivates two complementary lines of inquiry: can financial modeling capabilities provide a foundation for model self-evolution, and can self-evolution, in turn, advance financial capabilities? We introduce FinEvo, a self-evolution framework that integrates autonomous experience construction with financial capability improvement. FinEvo prepares financial models, iteratively evolves challenges through self-play, and learns from the resulting interactions using executable rewards, relying on the same model throughout. An end-to-end execution with Qwen3.6-27B shows that solving feedback supports both increasing reasoning demands and identifying specification issues that executable checks can miss. Learning from these experiences raises whole-task success from 22.73 to 29.09 on held-out within-source tasks and from 13.13 to 19.19 on SpreadsheetBench 2 Financial. Comparable gains across task sources and evaluation settings, together with improvement on a task category absent from training, suggest that FinEvo strengthens underlying financial modeling capabilities shared across tasks. These findings support self-evolution as a path toward broader financial competence, advancing the empirical exploration of

778537138ca80daeacb51d58.title_original: Demystifying the Autoresearch Harness: How Context and Skills Shape Self-Evolving Agents
778537138ca80daeacb51d58.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28244v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoresearch agents, which autonomously design, run, and refine experiments, are accelerating scientific progress, particularly in AI research. However, existing agents rely on harnesses that combine multiple mechanisms, making it difficult to determine how individual components contribute to performance. We systematically study harness design for long-horizon, self-evolving autoresearch agents along two dimensions: context management, which determines what an agent retains from its past attempts, and skill management, which governs how it stores and reuses lessons from those attempts. Across MLE-Bench and KernelBench with gpt-oss-120b, gpt-6-luna, and gpt-6-sol, we isolate the effects of individual harness design choices by evaluating each against a recency-truncation baseline within a shared agent framework. For context management, we find that preserving individually accessible records of past attempts is more effective than maintaining a rolling summary, with context folding performing best across all six settings and improving upon the baseline by up to 19.2%. For skill management, selectively discarding persistently unused lessons is more effective on average than consolidating them or promoting them to standing rules. Building on these findings, we combine context folding and skill deletion in MLEvolver, which achieves a 72.7% medal rate on MLE-Bench Lite and a 94% $\mathrm{fast}_1$ score on KernelBench Level 3, substanti

4b0ac8a534a78074d1b4a3f1.title_original: A Nepali-Accented English Evaluation Dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition
4b0ac8a534a78074d1b4a3f1.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems perform strongly on native-English benchmarks, yet their accuracy degrades sharply when the input speech comes from under represented non-native accents. Nepali-accented English is particularly under-served: existing resources either focus on native Nepali speech, cover broader multi-accent settings without dedicated Nepali evaluation, or provide only limited Nepali-accent coverage. This paper presents a Nepali-accented English evaluation dataset designed to support robust ASR benchmarking under accent mismatch. The corpus was collected through a web-based platform that did not collect directly identifying metadata and contains recordings from 57 speakers. Each session follows a fixed 22-prompt protocol consisting of 11 phonetic prompts, 10 domain prompts, and 1 spontaneous prompt, providing complementary coverage of pronunciation, topical vocabulary, and natural speaking style. In addition to transcribed speech, the dataset includes participant metadata for coarse exploratory subgroup analysis and speaker-level manual recording-quality labels. Manual quality assessment shows that 50.9% of sessions are clean and 42.1% contain only mild noise. As a descriptive reference, open-source ASR baselines are substantially worse on this corpus than the corresponding LibriSpeech test-clean values reported in official model cards, reaching 38.15-55.00% WER on the collected set versus reported 2-4%

807e59fc4a81a86c74d23d21.title_original: Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks
807e59fc4a81a86c74d23d21.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28277v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework addressing this duality via a formal, multi-sorted logic where events and states are structurally interdependent. Extending Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN), tLTN grounds state predicates as fuzzy truth-value paths over time points, while events are first-class entities with learnable trapezoidal fuzzy durations and differentiable Allen-style relations. A compositional semantics fuses static, event-structural, and state-dynamic satisfaction into a single differentiable LTN grounding. Crucially, the modalities constrain each other bidirectionally: the interval layer dictates where point-wise constrai

57059a74b63b53b740170773.title_original: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
57059a74b63b53b740170773.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everythin

d7f29f4066f68d9fd3cbc91d.title_original: Feedback-Driven Prompt Refinement for Educational AI: Affective Trajectory Estimation and Bloom's Taxonomy Classification
d7f29f4066f68d9fd3cbc91d.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28293v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Contribution: This study has shown that a shared prompt-refinement procedure, guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals, can improve held-out reference agreement and multi-label classification while reducing affective-generation variability without executor parameter updates. Background: Industry 4.0 has increased demand for personalized technical education across interconnected computing and engineering domains, while prompt sensitivity and generation variability have complicated dependable interpretation of instructional dialogue and learning outcomes. Research Questions: The study has examined whether task-specific feedback can improve affective-reference agreement, generation consistency, and cognitive classification without updating executor parameters. Methodology: A secondary language model has revised executor prompts using executor-output discrepancies against model-generated affective references for four dialogues and annotated Bloom labels for 70 learning outcomes; separate sets of 100 EduTalk conversations and 1,000 outcomes have supported held-out comparisons. Small refinement sets, unvalidated affective references, and absent learner-outcome measures have constrained interpretation. c1bab7f22aeade2d26173c2c.title_original: GERF: A Token-Efficient Multimodal Retrieval Framework for Schema-Guided Scientific Information Extraction
c1bab7f22aeade2d26173c2c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Scientific information extraction (IE) is a fundamental component of AI for Science, transforming experimental knowledge embedded in scientific literature into structured and traceable data for evidence synthesis, scientific database construction, and data-driven discovery. However, critical experimental details are often distributed across text, tables, figures, captions, and surrounding discussion, making them difficult to recover using conventional text-only extraction. Existing LLM-based and multimodal RAG pipelines typically rely on full-document context or coarse page-level retrieval, introducing substantial irrelevant evidence and high textual and visual token costs. We propose GERF, a Graph-based Evidence Retrieval Framework for token-efficient, schema-guided multimodal scientific IE. GERF represents each article as a heterogeneous evidence graph that connects schema fields, text chunks, figures, and figure-derived content through semantic and structural relations. Using schema fields as retrieval anchors, GERF combines direct semantic retrieval, Random Walk with Restart, and null-aware evidence expansion to construct compact, field-specific multimodal evidence packages. Visual interpretation is applied only to graph-selected figures, avoiding indiscriminate processing of the entire document. We evaluate GERF from two complementary perspectives: evidence retrieval quality and pipeline-level input-token consumption. On th

362606a96a29068721307a0c.title_original: INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration
362606a96a29068721307a0c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28314v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.

61b435a7283377384eb67acd.title_original: Selection Policies for Equal-Byte Mixed-Precision Quantization of Small Language Models
61b435a7283377384eb67acd.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can changing which matrices receive 2, 4, or 8 bits improve a small language model without increasing its parameter storage? I compare two parent-selection rules in the same genetic algorithm: a binary-tournament variant and an Alternis-inspired rule. A separate baseline samples repaired random allocations without crossover or mutation. All three use the same MLX affine quantizer, byte ceiling, initialization and candidate allowance within each study. An exploratory study on Qwen3.5-2B evaluates 90 allocations per run. The main study on Qwen3-1.7B evaluates 500 distinct allocations per run over 10 paired seeds. Against uniform four-bit, tournament reduces held-out next-token negative log-likelihood (NLL) by 0.0616 on AG News and 0.0152 on IMDb on average, improving all 10 seeds on each corpus at identical parameter storage. Alternis improves five seeds and ties five on AG News; on IMDb its mean gain is near zero. Random returns uniform four-bit in every seed. The tournament representative answers 156 of 400 ARC-Challenge questions correctly versus 163 for uniform; no accuracy gain is demonstrated on this subset. The result favors this tournament variant for text prediction under the tested protocol, not for compression ratio or task accuracy.

cbe7fc74c302a9355da4f211.title_original: MatHarness: Towards Long-Horizon Open-ended AutoResearch for Computational Materials Science
cbe7fc74c302a9355da4f211.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28324v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials science research is a non-linear, long-horizon process. Existing scientific agents, however, largely rely on specific task execution or predefined workflows, rendering them brittle in open-ended settings. To bridge this gap, we present MatHarness, an agent harness designed for open-ended, long-horizon computational materials research spanning the complete lifecycle from initial ideation to manuscript writing. MatHarness couples three mechanisms: execution robustness through pre-flight verification, expert-distilled skills, and just-in-time auditing; epistemic adaptability through persistent research artifacts and an evolving scientific mental model; and collective intelligence through a heterogeneous multi-agent round table under targeted human oversight. We evaluate MatHarness on adsorbate-induced surface segregation in Cu-Zn alloys, an open question in methanol-synthesis catalysis. Over a multi-week trajectory consuming roughly 10^3 GPU-hours (50 production DFT relaxations prescreened by 171 machine-learning-potential evaluations) the system revised its plan six times, recovered autonomously from failed calculations, and had an independent auditor overturn one of its own over-attributed claims before publication. Within the sampled metallic dilute-limit models, the validated DFT analysis supports an adsorbate-induced tendency toward greater surface Cu exposure at both composition endpoints, with facet- and coverage-d

f77d4c22871c267c9eed56a0.title_original: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment
f77d4c22871c267c9eed56a0.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28331v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper we study three related questions using the UAV decision benchmark, UAVBench. First, are small structured decision models good candidates for these tasks? Second, can an ordinary local machine (a Mac) screen candidate models before we test them on physical devices? Third, what software and resource limits govern deployment? Our main Mac evaluation covers 24 model configurations on the same 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions from UAVBench. These include 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models, plus four open-weight structured decision models that received no additional UAVBench-specific training. A structured decision model, H2O Lightning 4B, achieved the highest accuracy we observed, scoring 77.65% on the Mac. This shows that these models are well suited to this kind of task. However, when we tried to deploy the decision models, we ran into conversion and runtime limits on the edge devices we tested, which we describe in detail. To test local screening, we ran matched evaluations of two generative models on both the Mac and a Qualcomm RB3 board. The accuracies did not match exactly, but the ranking did. LFM2 2.6B ranked above Qwen2.5 1.5B on both platforms. This supports using a local machine to s

ea1feb4b17231a8348edac9a.title_original: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
ea1feb4b17231a8348edac9a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28341v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. ea1feb4b17231a8348edac9a.title_ko: 도구 오류 뒤 답을 지어내는 LLM 에이전트…검증 우선 감독 효과 연구
ea1feb4b17231a8348edac9a.summary_ko: 연구진은 도구 오류를 주입한 2,100회 실험에서 에이전트의 올바른 복구율이 19~68%였고, 6~26%는 틀린 답을 사실처럼 제시했다고 보고했다. 특히 일부 데이터만 반환되는 오류에서 문제가 두드러졌다. 구조화된 도구 출력을 확인하는 감독 방식을 적용하자 정답 복구율은 45.6%에서 56.3%로 높아지고 허위 답변 비율은 17.3%에서 10.8%로 낮아졌다.
ea1feb4b17231a8348edac9a.background_ko: 도구를 사용하는 LLM 에이전트는 호출 실패 시 재시도나 도구 변경 등으로 복구해야 하므로, 연구진은 오류 유형별 실패 양상과 검증 기반 감독 효과를 조사했다.

36a2b82eea7c6e2433f7101a.title_original: SMAD: A Semantics-Guided Multi-Agent Framework for Unsupervised Time-Series Anomaly Detection
36a2b82eea7c6e2433f7101a.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28348v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) lacks a one-size-fits-all detector for heterogeneous data and anomaly types. Existing automation is limited by implicit objectives, potentially unreliable historical knowledge, or high computational costs. More fundamentally, it selects how to detect anomalies without explicitly defining what to detect. We propose SMAD, an LLM-based multi-agent framework that translates anomaly intent into executable, testable detection pipelines. Rather than selecting detectors against an implicit target, SMAD establishes a natural-language semantic contract grounded in measurable time-series properties, specifying target event patterns, expected score responses, and validation questions. This contract governs both detector construction and evaluation: LLM agents propose pipelines, while contract-matched synthetic interventions provide label-free evidence from the target series to assess semantic coverage and guide iterative self-refinement. A semantics-aware ensemble integrates validated candidates and attributes each alert to contributing detectors and supporting evidence. On univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks, SMAD improves detection performance over the strongest baseline by 11.5% and 9.6%, respectively, while outperforming general-purpose coding agents at 2-5x lower language-model token cost.

c0760fab598b680e8cef45fe.title_original: Engram: Multi-Stage Memory for Agentic Tuning of Heterogeneous Models
c0760fab598b680e8cef45fe.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now tune neural networks, yet without cross-session memory they spend costly trials rediscovering known lessons. Reuse is difficult because production models differ in architecture, training setup and inference budget. We present Engram, a memory system that links past trial outcomes with the hypotheses and rationale behind them and assesses whether this evidence applies to the current model. An online agent curates evidence at the decision points where it is needed: Initial Guidance supplies validated lessons at the start, Session Retrieval supplies related past sessions before each batch of hypotheses is generated, and Trial Candidate Review checks each trial candidate against matching past trials. Between sessions, an offline agent distills validated lessons, making the memory self-improving. On two ads models, Engram reaches the 32-trial result of a no-memory control with 47% fewer trials and also ends with a better model on average.

ecb59f84edb30538dfdc3800.title_original: Schedule, Rank, Profile: Continuous Evaluation of LLM Agents in Games
ecb59f84edb30538dfdc3800.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Games are a robust test for large language model agents: they require sequential decisions, adversarial or cooperative interaction, state tracking, reasoning under uncertainty, and long-horizon planning. However, a one-time game benchmark can go stale as models, prompts, environment implementations, and evaluation policies change, and refreshing it is costly: full round-robin evaluation scales poorly in the number of model pairs, and the resulting outcomes live on incompatible per-game scales. We present a framework for continuous evaluation of LLM agents in game settings, organized around three coupled components. First, an adaptive scheduler that maps pairwise Bradley-Terry uncertainty to reduced per-pair match targets, concentrating budget on comparisons that remain unresolved. Second, a Unified Leaderboard (ULB) that reduces heterogeneous outcomes to pairwise evidence and fits a game-balanced Bradley-Terry model by minorization-maximization with bootstrap intervals, so that high-throughput games cannot dominate the aggregate ranking. Third, a game skill-profile methodology that scores each game along diverse skill dimensions, making the capability coverage of the suite explicit and turning game selection into a design decision rather than an artifact of availability. In this paper, we specify the research design and outcome reduction of the current implementation and evaluate the framework on a ten-game suite spanning perfec

24ad93f58f1a0d535a209c4b.title_original: CausalNTP: A World-Model Recipe for Causal Next-Token Prediction under Noisy Training-data
24ad93f58f1a0d535a209c4b.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28369v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper shows that transformer networks trained with next-token prediction (NTP) and gradient descent do not learn to make predictions using only causally-relevant tokens in the left context, irrespective of the causal ordering of tokens during training, and identifies the learning deficiencies responsible. We introduce a causal world-model setup, for which, we characterize the Bayes-optimal predictor under the causal view of the data. We then prove that, a function that distills its predictions to non-causal views of data, when realized under Occam's Razor, recovers the true causal predictor. Based on this analysis we propose CausalNTP, a practical training algorithm that approximates this theoretical recipe and trains transformers to depend only the causally relevant tokens in left-context. Empirically in the world-model setup, CausalNTP achieves out-of-distribution generalization that vanilla NTP cannot due to its theoretical limits, regardless of data and model scale. We show similar gains and behavior in the natural language question-answering setting as a proof-of-concept.

28a30b358855fe198339241c.title_original: The Effect of Security-Focused Prompts on Reported Findings: A Controlled Experiment on 400 AI-Generated Web Applications
28a30b358855fe198339241c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.28408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic coding tools turn a specification into a running web application, so their defaults for authentication, sessions, input validation, and dependencies become its security posture. This study asks whether appending a fixed block of OWASP-aligned security requirements to the prompt changes what such tools produce, by how much, and with what side effects. Each of 100 frozen specifications was realized four times: two agentic tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI) crossed with two prompts sharing a byte-identical functional core, without (A) and with (B) the security block. A fixed static and dynamic pipeline scanned the 400 applications, yielding 6,721 triaged findings, analyzed with count and logistic mixed models and with a dependency diff. The block cut findings per application by a third (incidence-rate ratio 0.65, 95% CI 0.60-0.71), equally through both tools, and roughly doubled the declared dependency surface, so variant-B applications carried more high-severity dependency advisories. Adjusted for that surface the advisory rate did not rise (flat per application, 18% lower in aggregate), while high-severity findings in first-party source fell by nearly half. Security-focused prompting is therefore an inexpensive and portable improvement, but it enlarges the dependency surface that has to be audited against it, an effect of library selection rather than of the security requirements themselves.
28a30b358855fe198339241c.title_ko: AI 생성 웹앱 400개 실험…보안 프롬프트로 탐지 문제 감소, 의존성은 증가
