CVE-2026-116225.description: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in the BER decoder in Erlang/OTP snmp allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exhaust CPU via an SNMP message that contains an OBJECT IDENTIFIER with a very long sub-identifier. snmp_pdus:dec_oid_element/3 does not limit the number of base-128 octets in a sub-identifier, and snmp_pdus:dec_oid_elements/3 does not limit the number of sub-identifiers, so one sub-identifier can span the whole datagram. When the value exceeds the native integer size, each further octet copies a growing bignum, and decoding time grows quadratically with the sub-identifier length. The agent and the manager decode OIDs before they check community strings or SNMPv3 credentials, inside the single network interface process (snmpa_net_if or snmpm_net_if). That process does not read the next datagram until decoding completes. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to snmp from 4.25.1 before 5.18.2.3, 5.20.2.4, and 5.20.7. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to snmp before 4.25.1, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-116293.description: Out-of-bounds Write vulnerability in the external term format decoder in Erlang OTP erts allows an attacker who controls the input to binary_to_term/1,2 to abort the Erlang VM via a NEWER_REFERENCE_EXT term with a zero-length ID. decoded_size in erts/emulator/beam/external.c accepts a reference whose 16-bit Len field is zero, but dec_term always reads one ID word. dec_term then runs 4 bytes ahead of the position that decoded_size validated. It decodes the bytes that follow as terms that were never sized, and writes past the reserved process heap. The abort takes down every process on the node. Supervision, try/catch and the safe option do not prevent it. enif_binary_to_term() and the distribution protocol reach the same decoder, and distribution is assumed to run on trusted networks only. NEW_REFERENCE_EXT also accepts a zero length, but its range check on the first ID word rejects the shifted input. On 32-bit builds, a zero-length reference of either type at the end of the input, followed by trailing bytes, can write one word past the reserved heap. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to erts from 6.0 before 15.2.7.15, 16.4.0.8, and 17.1.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to erts before 6.0, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-116295.description: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences in HTTP Headers ('HTTP Request/Response Splitting') vulnerability in Erlang OTP inets (httpc module) allows HTTP Request Splitting. httpc writes request header names and values to the wire without neutralizing CR, LF or NUL characters. On the default path http_request:mk_key_value_str/2, and with the headers_as_is option httpc_request:http_headers/2, build each header line by plain concatenation of the name, ": ", the value and CRLF. A CR/LF in a name or value ends the header line early. An attacker who controls data that an application puts into a header passed to httpc:request/4,5 can add or override request headers, or append a second request on the same connection. Applications that pass only constant or validated header names and values are not affected. The request line is not affected, because uri_string rejects URLs that contain raw CR/LF. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.9, 9.6.2.5, and 9.8.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-116382.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Erlang OTP inets (httpd_script_env module) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to exhaust the atom table of an httpd server that serves ESI scripts. When mod_esi builds the environment for an ESI callback, httpd_script_env:http_env_element/3 checks that a request header name already exists as an atom, then creates the atom http_<header-name> with list_to_atom/1. Atoms are never garbage collected, and each new atom passes the existence check on a later request. So a header named node creates http_node, a header named http_node creates http_http_node, and so on. A stream of requests to any ESI URL grows the atom table until it reaches its limit (+t), and then the whole Erlang VM aborts, together with every application on the node. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to inets from 5.10 before 9.3.2.9, 9.6.2.5, and 9.8.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to inets before 5.10, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-117642.description: Uncontrolled Recursion vulnerability in the external term format decoder in Erlang OTP erts allows an attacker who controls the input to binary_to_term/1,2 to abort the Erlang VM via a fun term with funs nested in its integer fields. dec_term in erts/emulator/beam/external.c decodes terms iteratively, except for the OldIndex and OldUniq fields of NEW_FUN_EXT and the Arity field of EXPORT_EXT. For these fields it calls itself, and it checks that the result is a small integer only after the call returns. An input that places another fun in such a field, nested to sufficient depth, recurses once per level, exhausts the stack of the scheduler thread and crashes the VM. The input must be large enough to reach that depth. The abort takes down every process on the node. Supervision, try/catch and the safe option do not prevent it. enif_binary_to_term() and the distribution protocol reach the same decoder, and distribution is assumed to run on trusted networks only. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to erts from 6.0 before 15.2.7.15, 16.4.0.8, and 17.1.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to erts before 6.0, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-119443.description: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference vulnerability in xmerl_scan in Erlang OTP xmerl allows an attacker to exhaust the memory of the Erlang VM via an XML document that names an external DTD. With default options, xmerl_scan:string/1,2 and xmerl_scan:file/1,2 fetch and parse the external DTD named in a <!DOCTYPE root SYSTEM "..."> declaration. fetch_DTD/2 in lib/xmerl/src/xmerl_scan.erl passes every system identifier to the default fetch function, which maps file: and absolute URIs to local paths, and int_file_decl/3 then reads the whole file with file:read_file/1. This happens whether or not validation is enabled, and the allow_entities option, which is false by default since OTP 27, only governs <!ENTITY> declarations and does not stop the fetch. A document naming file:///dev/zero makes the node read without bound until the operating system kills it for lack of memory, and the parse never returns. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to xmerl from 1.3.7 before 2.1.3.4, 2.1.9.1, and 2.2.1. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to xmerl before 1.3.7, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-120961.description: Out-of-bounds Read vulnerability in the external term format decoder in Erlang OTP erts allows an attacker who controls the input to binary_to_term/1,2 to read memory after the input, and to change one byte there, via a FLOAT_EXT term without a terminating zero byte. decoded_size in erts/emulator/beam/external.c checks only that the 31 bytes of the FLOAT_EXT field are present. dec_term then passes the field to sys_chars_to_double, which scans to a NUL byte without a length limit. When the field has no NUL, the scan continues into the bytes after the field, and those bytes change the decoded float. When the radix character is found after the field and strtod does not accept it, sys_chars_to_double overwrites that byte (a , becomes a .). The VM can fault if the scan reaches an unmapped page. The safe option does not prevent this. enif_binary_to_term() and the distribution protocol reach the same decoder, and distribution is assumed to run on trusted networks only. The write is limited to the one radix byte. No arbitrary write or code execution was shown. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to erts from 6.0 before 15.2.7.15, 16.4.0.8, and 17.1.2. Whether OTP before OTP 17.0, corresponding to erts before 6.0, is affected is unknown.

CVE-2026-124286.description: Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in Erlang OTP ssl (ssl_handshake module) allows an on-path attacker to impersonate any server to a TLS 1.2 or DTLS client. When a server sends no Certificate message and a ServerKeyExchange without a signature, ssl_handshake:decode_server_key/3 reports the signature algorithm as anon, and ssl_handshake:verify_signature/5 returns true for anon without a public key. The client does not require a certificate for a certificate-authenticated key exchange, so the handshake completes for the ecdhe_rsa, ecdhe_ecdsa, dhe_rsa and dhe_dss key exchanges with a cipher suite the client offered. Certificate path validation, verify_fun and the hostname check do not run, and ssl:connect/3 returns {ok, Socket} with {verify, verify_peer} set. The TLS 1.3 client is not affected. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.14, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.0.3, corresponding to ssl from 5.3.4 before 11.2.12.10, 11.6.0.8, and 11.7.3.
CVE-2026-124286.summary_ko: Erlang OTP의 ssl 모듈에서 암호화 서명 검증 오류로 통신 경로상의 공격자가 TLS 1.2 또는 DTLS 클라이언트에 임의의 서버를 사칭할 수 있다. TLS 1.3 클라이언트는 영향을 받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-124286.background_ko: 인증서 기반 키 교환에서도 인증서를 요구하지 않고 공개키 없는 익명 서명을 유효하게 처리해 인증서 경로와 호스트명 검증이 생략된다.

CVE-2026-130411.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in woylie flop allows a remote attacker to execute code on the server via a crafted pagination cursor. Flop.Cursor.decode/2 in lib/flop/cursor.ex decodes the after and before parameters with :erlang.binary_to_term/2 in :safe mode. Its check rejects functions, PIDs, ports and references, but it accepts maps, and therefore structs of any module. Flop passes the decoded values to Ecto as query parameters. A cursor value that nests an Ecto.Query.DynamicExpr struct with a DBConnection.Stream struct as its binding fails the Ecto cast. Ecto then inspects the value for the error message, the Inspect implementation enumerates the stream, and DBConnection calls the module, function and arguments in the :log option of the stream. This issue affects flop: from 0.8.0 before 0.26.7, from 0.27.0 before 0.27.3, from 0.28.0 before 0.28.1, and from 0.29.0 before 0.29.2.
CVE-2026-130411.summary_ko: woylie flop의 페이지네이션 커서 처리에 신뢰할 수 없는 데이터 역직렬화 취약점이 있습니다. 원격 공격자가 조작된 커서를 통해 서버에서 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-130411.background_ko: 커서 역직렬화 검사가 임의 모듈의 구조체를 허용하고, Ecto의 형 변환 오류 메시지 생성 과정에서 해당 값의 처리가 함수 호출로 이어집니다.

CVE-2026-131902.description: XML Injection vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 allows an attacker who controls an object version id passed to ExAws.S3.delete_multiple_objects/3 to add objects to the batch delete. delete_multiple_objects/3 in lib/ex_aws/s3.ex builds the <Delete> request body by placing each object's version between <VersionId> tags without XML escaping. A version such as v1</VersionId></Object><Object><Key>important-file</Key></Object><Object><Key>x</Key><VersionId>v2 closes the caller's object and opens new ones, so S3 deletes objects the application never listed, including other users' objects in the same bucket. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.0 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-133555.description: Use of Externally-Controlled Input to Select Classes or Code ('Unsafe Reflection') vulnerability in elixir-ecto db_connection allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code via a forged DBConnection.Stream or DBConnection.PrepareStream struct. The Enumerable implementations of both structs in lib/db_connection.ex run with the options stored in the struct. The :log option accepts a {module, function, arguments} tuple, which DBConnection applies. When code enumerates a forged struct, DBConnection calls the chosen function. This issue is not exploitable in db_connection alone. It is, in theory, a vulnerability of the downstream component. The root cause is a component that decodes untrusted input with :erlang.binary_to_term/2 and does not restrict which terms the result contains. The :safe option does not reject structs, and these structs contain only plain terms. Structs of other libraries can possibly lead to the same result, so a component that decodes untrusted terms stays at risk independently of db_connection. This record exists because the struct was used in attacks on such components. This issue affects db_connection: from 1.1.0 before 2.10.3.

CVE-2026-135908.description: Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 are vulnerable to an uncontrolled resource consumption issue in Rex::Proto::Http::Request#normalize!. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can send an HTTP request with a deeply nested path that triggers repeated rescans of the request target, causing quadratic CPU consumption and temporarily degrading the availability of any affected HTTP listener. The issue is fixed in Metasploit Framework 6.5.10

CVE-2026-136131.description: hping3 through commit 3547c76 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in display_ipopt() that allows remote attackers to overflow the static 40-byte old_rr buffer via a crafted IP Record Route option. Attackers acting as the probed host, on-path, or spoofing the target can send replies with option lengths up to 255 to hping3 running with -G/--rroute, corrupting global memory and crashing hping3.

CVE-2026-136132.description: Pangolin before 1.21.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in isPathAllowed() in server/lib/pathMatch.ts that splits paths on literal slashes without percent-decoding or resolving dot segments. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send paths with encoded slashes and dot segments to match public bypass rules while backends serve protected paths.
CVE-2026-136132.summary_ko: Pangolin 1.21.0 미만의 경로 검사 함수 isPathAllowed()에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 경로 처리 차이를 악용해 보호된 경로에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136132.background_ko: server/lib/pathMatch.ts의 isPathAllowed()가 퍼센트 디코딩이나 점 세그먼트 해석 없이 문자 그대로의 슬래시만으로 경로를 나눈다.

CVE-2026-136133.description: NocoDB before 2026.10.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in passwordForgot() that allows unauthenticated attackers to revoke a user's sessions by requesting a password reset. Attackers who know a user's email can repeatedly request resets to sign out users, including super-admins, and permanently destroy their OAuth and MCP application authorizations.

CVE-2026-136155.description: In Valkey 9.1.0 and 9.1.1, the Lua script debugger builds its command table once and caches it with a pointer to the Lua interpreter state that was current at the time. SCRIPT FLUSH ASYNC recreates the scripting engine and frees the previous interpreter state without invalidating that cache, so the next debugger command dereferences freed memory. An authenticated user who can run scripting commands can use this to reliably crash the server, and by reclaiming the freed heap chunk with attacker-controlled bytes can escalate it to control of an indirect call, which may lead to remote code execution. The fix also addresses a second use-after-free in ldbLogStackValue. Valkey 8.0.x and 8.1.x use the previous debugger and are not affected.
CVE-2026-136155.summary_ko: Valkey 9.1.0과 9.1.1의 Lua 스크립트 디버거에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있다. 스크립트 명령 실행 권한이 있는 인증된 사용자가 서버를 중단시킬 수 있으며, 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136155.background_ko: 스크립팅 엔진 재생성 시 이전 Lua 상태를 가리키는 디버거 캐시를 무효화하지 않아, 다음 디버거 명령이 해제된 메모리를 참조한다.

CVE-2026-136156.description: In Valkey before 7.2.15, 8.0.x before 8.0.12, 8.1.x before 8.1.11, 9.0.x before 9.0.7, 9.1.x before 9.1.3 and 9.2.0-rc1, running in cluster mode, clusterCreatePublishMsgBlock computes the length of the cluster bus message for a PUBLISH or SPUBLISH as a size_t but passes it to createClusterMsgSendBlock as a uint32_t. When the channel and message together exceed 4 GiB, the length is truncated, a buffer far smaller than the message is allocated, and the full channel and message are then copied into it. An authenticated user who can publish, for example by building the arguments in a script, can overflow the heap with attacker-controlled bytes. This reliably crashes the server and may lead to remote code execution. Servers that do not run in cluster mode are not affected.
CVE-2026-136156.summary_ko: 클러스터 모드로 실행되는 Valkey의 일부 버전에 정수 잘림으로 인한 힙 버퍼 오버플로 취약점이 있다. 메시지 게시 권한이 있는 인증된 사용자가 서버를 중단시킬 수 있으며, 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136156.background_ko: 클러스터 메시지 길이를 size_t에서 uint32_t로 전달할 때 4 GiB를 넘는 길이가 잘려 작은 버퍼가 할당되고, 여기에 전체 데이터가 복사된다.

CVE-2026-136157.description: In Valkey 8.0.x before 8.0.11, 8.1.x before 8.1.10, 9.0.x before 9.0.6 and 9.1.x before 9.1.2, the RDMA transport's pending-data handler walks its connection list with an iterator that caches the next entry. A command processed from inside that loop, such as CLIENT KILL, can synchronously free another client's connection, and closing an RDMA connection did not remove it from the pending list, so the handler then uses freed memory. An authenticated user can use this to reliably crash the server, and the freed heap chunk can be reclaimed with attacker-influenced bytes. Only servers built with RDMA support (USE_RDMA) and configured with an RDMA listener are affected.

CVE-2026-136158.description: In Valkey JSON 1.0.0 through 1.0.2, a recursive JSONPath expression such as $..* returns both an array and elements nested inside it. The size-changing mutators (JSON.ARRAPPEND, JSON.ARRINSERT, JSON.ARRPOP, JSON.ARRTRIM and JSON.CLEAR) process the ancestor first, which can reallocate its element buffer and free the old storage while the descendant entries in the result set still point into it; the module then writes through those dangling pointers. An authenticated user who can run these commands can use this to reliably crash the server, and it has been developed into remote code execution as the user the server runs as. Servers that do not load the JSON module, including through valkey-bundle, are not affected.
CVE-2026-136158.summary_ko: Valkey JSON 1.0.0~1.0.2에 해제 후 사용 취약점이 있다. 관련 명령 실행 권한이 있는 인증된 사용자가 서버를 중단시키거나 서버 실행 계정 권한으로 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있으며, JSON 모듈을 로드하지 않은 서버는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-136158.background_ko: 재귀 JSONPath 결과의 상위 배열 변경으로 요소 버퍼가 재할당·해제될 때 하위 요소의 포인터가 남아 있어 해제된 메모리에 쓰기가 발생한다.

CVE-2026-136159.description: TypiCMS Core before 17.0.46 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability that allows authenticated users with "read users" permission to view plaintext api_token values for all users, including superusers, via the GET /api/users endpoint. Attackers can steal a superuser's non-expiring, non-rotatable api_token from the JSON response and use it to gain full superuser API access, enabling creation and deletion of users, roles, and all content.

CVE-2026-136160.description: Pyro through 1.9.2 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in ParamStoreDict.load() that calls torch.load with weights_only=False, unpickling arbitrary Python objects. Attackers can trick users into loading a crafted parameter file defining __reduce__ to execute code with the privileges of the Python process.

CVE-2026-136165.description: Fider before 0.40.0 contains an account takeover vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to sign in as existing users by linking OAuth identities through unverified email matches. Attackers can use a Google account carrying an unverified copy of a victim's email, including a tenant administrator's, to bind their identity via the OAuthToken handler and obtain persistent session access.

CVE-2026-136166.description: Wallabag from 2.0.0-beta.1 before 2.6.16 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to annotate other users' entries by referencing global entry IDs. Attackers can send requests to the /annotations/{entry} or /api/annotations/{entry} routes to inject annotations into victims' private entries, API output, and exports, and enumerate existing entry IDs.

CVE-2026-136167.description: vedo through 2026.6.3 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .npy or .npz files loaded with allow_pickle=True. Attackers can embed an object with a malicious __reduce__ method in mesh, assembly, scene or font files to run code with the victim's privileges when opened.

CVE-2026-136168.description: RedVector before 8.1.0 contains a hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute commands by supplying the default redvector-dev-token bearer token. Attackers can call /api/python/execute or /api/process/execute-async to run Python scripts and commands as the server user, even via malicious web pages abusing permissive CORS against loopback instances.

CVE-2026-136169.description: Cockpit CMS through 2.14.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated users with content create or update permission to inject script via unescaped linked item _id values. Attackers can save an item whose link _id contains a double quote and HTML markup, executing script when administrators view the content dashboard or collection list.

CVE-2026-136170.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in OpenGEXImporter.cpp because InternReadFile does not reset cached importer state between files. Attackers can supply OpenGEX files to applications reusing one Importer instance, causing freed node, camera, and material pointers to corrupt heap memory and crash.

CVE-2026-136171.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in BVHLoader.cpp that allows attackers to read freed aiNode objects because the mNodes vector is never cleared between files. Attackers can supply multiple BVH files to an application reusing one Importer instance, causing CreateAnimation to copy freed mName data into channel names, crashing the application or exposing heap contents.

CVE-2026-136172.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the OBJ exporter that allows attackers to corrupt memory via NaN vertex components breaking comparator ordering. Attackers can supply a crafted PLY file with NaN texture coordinates or vertex colors that, when exported to OBJ in libc++ builds, writes file-controlled data past a heap buffer and crashes the application.

CVE-2026-62273.description: XML Injection vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 allows an attacker who controls tag keys or values to inject forged tag entries into S3 object and bucket tagging requests. ExAws.S3.put_object_tagging/4 and ExAws.S3.put_bucket_tagging/2 in lib/ex_aws/s3.ex build the <TagSet> request body by interpolating tag keys and values directly into <Key> and <Value> elements via to_string/1, without applying the module's existing escape_xml_string/1 helper (which delete_multiple_objects already uses for object keys). An application that forwards user-supplied data as a tag key or value lets an attacker close the intended element and inject attacker-chosen <Tag> entries. For example, a tag value of blue</Value></Tag><Tag><Key>owner</Key><Value>admin turns one intended tag into two tags on the wire. Because S3 honors tags in access-control conditions (aws:RequestTag, s3:ExistingObjectTag) and cost-allocation reporting, an injected tag can forge an authorization-relevant tag or corrupt the intended tag set. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.2 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-63581.description: XML Injection vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 (ExAws.S3 module) allows an attacker to inject arbitrary XML configuration elements into S3 bucket-configuration request bodies via unescaped, caller-supplied values. This vulnerability is associated with program files lib/ex_aws/s3.ex and program routines ExAws.S3.put_bucket_logging/2, ExAws.S3.put_bucket_notification/2, ExAws.S3.put_bucket_replication/2, ExAws.S3.put_bucket_website/2. The bucket-configuration body builders construct their XML by interpolating caller-supplied values directly into the request body without escaping, and never route them through the module's own escape_xml_string/1 helper. A value containing XML metacharacters (<, >, &, quotes) can close the intended element early and open attacker-chosen elements, which the builder's trailing closing tag then closes, keeping the document single-rooted and well-formed. In a multi-tenant application where tenants configure their own bucket settings, an attacker who can influence one of the interpolated field values (for example the logging target, a notification ARN, a replication destination or Account, or a website redirect HostName) can inject arbitrary configuration nodes into a request the application signs and sends to AWS. The affected builders are reached through the public functions put_bucket_logging/2, put_bucket_notification/2, put_bucket_replication/2, and put_bucket_website/2. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.5.9 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-63582.description: Externally Controlled Reference to a Resource in Another Sphere vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 allows an attacker who controls an S3 bucket name to make presigned URLs and presigned POST forms point at a host of their choice. With virtual_host: true, s3_accelerate: true or bucket_as_host: true, ExAws.S3.presigned_url/5 and ExAws.S3.presigned_post/4 build the URL from the bucket name without checking it. A bucket such as attacker.example/x? turns the URL into https://attacker.example/x?.s3.amazonaws.com..., and the signature is computed for that host. Clients given the URL upload their files to, or download content from, the attacker's host, and every such URL discloses the access key id. With bucket_as_host: true any valid hostname works as the bucket name. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.0 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-63583.description: ExAws.S3.Utils.build_lifecycle_rule/1 in ex_aws_s3 interpolates caller-supplied lifecycle rule fields (the rule id, filter prefix, tag key and value, storage class, and noncurrent-version count) directly into the PutBucketLifecycleConfiguration XML body without escaping XML metacharacters. An application that populates any of these fields from untrusted input (for example a tenant-supplied object tag) lets an attacker break out of the surrounding element and inject arbitrary XML into the request, including an entirely new lifecycle action such as a delete-after-one-day expiration that destroys the bucket's objects. The public entry point ExAws.S3.put_bucket_lifecycle/2 flows directly into this builder. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.3.0 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-63584.description: Improper Neutralization of CRLF Sequences ('CRLF Injection') vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_s3 allows HTTP header injection via an attacker-controlled copy-source key. ExAws.S3.upload_part_copy/8 in lib/ex_aws/s3.ex builds the x-amz-copy-source request header by interpolating the source bucket and object key directly into "/#{src_bucket}/#{src_object}" with no percent-encoding. The sibling function put_object_copy percent-encodes the bucket and each path segment before assembling the same header, but upload_part_copy skips encoding entirely. When the source key is derived from untrusted input, reserved characters (spaces, ?, &, =) pass through verbatim and corrupt the copy-source reference, so the copy targets the wrong object or fails. A key containing \r or \n can split or inject additional headers into the outgoing HTTP request, depending on how the configured HTTP backend serializes headers. Applications that pass a source bucket or object key derived from untrusted input to ExAws.S3.upload_part_copy/8 are affected. Applications that only ever pass trusted, well-formed keys are not affected. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.0 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-63585.description: ExAws.S3 constructs S3 ACL grant headers (such as x-amz-grant-read and x-amz-grant-full-control) in format_grant_header/1 by interpolating grantee identifiers into a quoted, comma-separated list without escaping. Grantee email and id values are wrapped in double quotes and joined with a comma, but double-quote, comma, and CR/LF characters in the value are not neutralized. An application that passes an attacker-influenced grantee value (for example an email address taken from a "share this object" feature) into an ACL grant option (grant_read, grant_write, grant_read_acp, grant_write_acp, or grant_full_control) lets the attacker close the quoted token and inject an additional grantee, such as the attacker's own canonical id or the predefined AllUsers group URI, into the header. S3 then applies the injected grantee, granting an arbitrary principal the same permission (up to full control or public access) in an unintended ACL grantee-injection and privilege-escalation issue. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.0 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-65320.description: fastcore through 2.2.44 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the fastcore.xtras.untar_dir() archive extraction helper that allows attackers who supply a crafted tar archive to write files outside the intended extraction directory. The internal _unpack() function passes the archive to shutil.unpack_archive() without a tar extraction filter, member path validation, or a containment check, so archive members with absolute paths or ../ traversal sequences are written to arbitrary locations writable by the application process when running on Python versions before 3.14. Applications that extract untrusted archives with untar_dir() can have application files, configuration, or importable code overwritten, which can lead to code execution, data modification, or denial of service.
CVE-2026-65320.summary_ko: fastcore 2.2.44 이하의 untar_dir()에 경로 순회 취약점이 있다. Python 3.14 미만에서 압축 해제 경로 밖의 파일을 덮어써 코드 실행, 데이터 변조 또는 서비스 거부로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-65320.background_ko: 내부 _unpack() 함수가 tar 추출 필터, 파일 경로 검증, 추출 디렉터리 내부 여부 확인 없이 shutil.unpack_archive()를 호출한다.

CVE-2026-65621.description: ex_aws_s3 builds x-amz-meta-* request headers by interpolating user-supplied object metadata directly into header names and values without any validation. In ExAws.S3.Utils.build_meta_headers/1 (lib/ex_aws/s3/utils.ex), each :meta entry is turned into a header as {"x-amz-meta-#{k}", v} with no check for carriage return (CR), line feed (LF), or other illegal header bytes. Object metadata is routinely derived from end-user input (for example an upload service that lets users attach a comment or label to an object). When such input reaches ExAws.S3.put_object/4 or any other operation accepting the :meta option, a value containing CR/LF is carried unchanged into the outbound header list. If the configured HTTP adapter does not neutralize header values before writing them to the socket, the embedded CRLF starts a new header line, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary headers into (or split) the HTTP request the library sends to the S3 endpoint. This is an HTTP header (CRLF) injection leading to HTTP request splitting. The practical impact depends on the HTTP adapter, and no authentication is required beyond the ability to influence object metadata. This issue affects ex_aws_s3: from 2.0.0 before 2.6.0.

CVE-2026-65622.description: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_ses (ExAws.SES module) allows path injection into Amazon SES V2 request URLs. This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ex_aws/ses.ex and program routines ExAws.SES.delete_contact_list/1, ExAws.SES.get_contact_list/1, ExAws.SES.update_contact_list/2, ExAws.SES.create_contact/3, ExAws.SES.get_contact/2, ExAws.SES.update_contact/3, ExAws.SES.delete_contact/2 and ExAws.SES.list_contacts/1. The V2 contact-list and contact functions interpolate the caller-supplied list_name into the request path without URI-encoding it, unlike the email address in the same functions which is passed through ExAws.Request.Url.uri_encode/1. An application that forwards untrusted input as a contact-list name lets an attacker embed /, .. or ? to escape the intended contact-lists/<name> path segment. A value such as x/../suppression/addresses/victim%40example.com makes a delete_contact_list/1 call arrive at the account-wide suppression list. The request is still signed with the application's own AWS credentials and sent to the configured SES host, so the impact is cross-resource request forgery inside the caller's own AWS account, not arbitrary SSRF. Applications that only use hardcoded or strictly validated list names are not affected. This issue affects ex_aws_ses: from 2.3.0 before 2.5.0.

CVE-2026-75582.description: Frappe LMS before 2.65.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows Batch Evaluators to modify any evaluation because the LMS Certificate Evaluation doctype lacks a has_permission scoping hook. Attackers can call the whitelisted create_lms_certificate method with any evaluation name to issue certificates for unassigned evaluations or learners outside their batches.

CVE-2026-115747.description: Improper Restriction of Operations within the Bounds of a Memory Buffer vulnerability in the AArch64 JIT in Erlang OTP erts allows an attacker to crash the BEAM virtual machine via input that reaches a chained integer range guard, such as an oversized numeric character reference parsed by xmerl_sax_parser. In erts/emulator/beam/jit/arm/instr_common.cpp, BeamModuleAssembler::emit_is_ge_lt wraps its generated code in preserve_cache and marks only TMP1 as clobbered. When the compared value is not a small integer, the generated code calls the shared fragment is_ge_lt_shared, which also overwrites ARG1 and other caller-saved registers. The register cache keeps stale entries, so later instructions may use a clobbered register as an Erlang term and the emulator dies with a segmentation fault. A reference such as &#576460752303423488; takes this path in the ?is_char guard of the SAX parser. Only AArch64 builds that run the JIT are affected. The x86-64 JIT and interpreter builds do not contain the faulty code. This issue affects OTP from OTP 27.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to erts from 15.0 before 15.2.7.15, 16.4.0.8, and 17.1.2.

CVE-2026-125658.description: Use After Free vulnerability in Erlang/OTP erts allows an attacker who can create a file system entry with a chosen name to hang or abort the Erlang VM on macOS. On macOS, the VM decodes file names with do_utf8_to_list_normalize in erts/emulator/beam/erl_unicode.c. When a name starts with a combining mark, such as U+0301, cleanup_norm builds the first list cells but does not return its advanced heap pointer. The caller then releases the heap words that hold those cells, and the returned list refers to released process heap memory that the next allocation overwrites. file:list_dir/1, file:list_dir_all/1, file:del_dir_r/1 and filelib:wildcard/1 on a directory that contains such a name do not return, and the VM does not stop on SIGTERM. file:read_link/1 on a symbolic link with such a target aborts the VM with size_object: bad tag. Only loss of availability was demonstrated. This issue affects OTP from OTP 17.0 before OTP 27.3.4.20, OTP 28.5.0.9, and OTP 29.1.3, corresponding to erts from 6.0 before 15.2.7.15, 16.4.0.8, and 17.1.2.

CVE-2026-132157.description: The OSI Presentation Protocol analyzer in DINA-community's icsnpp-pres 1.0.0 plugin for Zeek uses an incompatible ASN.1 descriptor when decoding resynchronization acknowledgments. An unauthenticated attacker who can send crafted traffic observed by the analyzer can cause a type confusion that crashes the Zeek worker, resulting in a denial of service for traffic monitoring on that worker.

CVE-2026-132887.description: The DINA-community icsnpp-acse 1.0.0 plugin for Zeek does not release partially decoded ACSE protocol data units when ASN.1 Basic Encoding Rules (BER) decoding fails. An unauthenticated attacker who can send traffic observed by a Zeek worker with the ACSE analyzer enabled can cause memory exhaustion by repeatedly sending malformed ACSE traffic. This can terminate the worker and interrupt network monitoring.

CVE-2026-133002.description: The DINA-community icsnpp-mms 1.0.0 plugin for Zeek does not release partially decoded Manufacturing Message Specification (MMS) protocol data units when ASN.1 Basic Encoding Rules (BER) decoding fails. An unauthenticated attacker who can send traffic observed by a Zeek worker with the MMS analyzer enabled can cause memory exhaustion by repeatedly sending malformed MMS traffic. This can terminate the worker and interrupt network monitoring.

CVE-2026-135479.description: Merchant for WooCommerce before 2.3.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the Quick View module that allows unauthenticated attackers to read draft, pending, private, and scheduled WooCommerce products. The modal_content_ajax_callback() handler for the merchant_quick_view_content AJAX action is registered for unauthenticated users, is gated only by the merchant-nonce value exposed to every front-end visitor, and loads any supplied product_id with wc_get_product() without checking the product's post status or the user's read_post capability. Attackers can iterate product IDs to obtain the title, price, description, gallery images, and SKU of unpublished products when the Quick View module is enabled.

CVE-2026-135786.description: A vulnerability was identified in zhayujie CowAgent up to 2.2.1. This impacts the function _create_task of the file agent/tools/scheduler/scheduler_tool.py of the component Scheduler. Such manipulation leads to incorrect authorization. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 2.2.2 will fix this issue. The name of the patch is 566c941c1e09d295ea5d96eda4dd315260eab9b7. Upgrading the affected component is recommended. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

CVE-2026-135787.description: A security flaw has been discovered in hrshadhin CloudSchool up to 3.0.1. Affected is the function ReportController::marksheetPublic of the component Captcha Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument authorized_form results in improper authentication. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-136214.description: Astra WordPress theme before 4.14.0 contains an improper input neutralization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with contributor-level privileges to inject unescaped CSS by submitting a crafted overlay-opacity value in the ast-page-background-meta or ast-content-background-meta REST fields. Attackers can store a malicious payload that, when rendered, causes an uncaught TypeError leading to a fatal error and HTTP 500 denial of service on PHP 8.0+, or injects arbitrary CSS into the page's style block on PHP 7.x enabling UI redress and content spoofing.

CVE-2026-136226.description: By adding a From header with lowercase name before the actual From header, an attacker could make Thunderbird display a different sender than the one used to verify an OpenPGP signature. Anyone whose key the victim had accepted could send messages that appeared to be validly signed by any other sender. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.

CVE-2026-136227.description: By combining several weaknesses, a crafted email could, when opened, inject commands into the authenticated IMAP connection, and load a web page with JavaScript enabled in place of the message. A bare carriage return in a header let the sender set Thunderbird's internal message flags, marking the message as a feed item and allowing its remote content to load. A reference to an embedded part placed inside an attribute value disclosed the message's internal IMAP URL to the sender. The message ID part of IMAP URLs was not validated, so loading a crafted variant of that URL sent arbitrary IMAP commands, which could modify or delete messages and folders. Finally, a frame reloading the message, together with a legacy feed marker in its content, caused the message pane to load a sender-chosen web page with scripting enabled. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.
CVE-2026-136227.summary_ko: Thunderbird에서 조작된 이메일을 열면 인증된 IMAP 연결에 명령이 주입돼 메시지·폴더가 수정되거나 삭제될 수 있다. 또한 메시지 창에 JavaScript가 활성화된 공격자 지정 웹페이지가 표시될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136227.background_ko: 헤더의 단독 캐리지 리턴 허용, 속성 내 참조를 통한 내부 IMAP URL 노출, URL 메시지 ID 검증 누락, 레거시 피드 처리와 프레임 재로딩 동작이 결합돼 발생한다.

CVE-2026-136228.description: Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date for messages that were both signed and encrypted with OpenPGP/MIME. An attacker who had an old signed message could encrypt it to the victim and resend it with a current date, and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.

CVE-2026-136229.description: When a signed OpenPGP/MIME message had no Date header, or one that could not be parsed, Thunderbird did not compare the signature creation time with the message date. For S/MIME messages with more than one Date header, a later Date header could be used for the comparison. An attacker who had an old signed message could resend it and have it shown with a valid signature, despite the protection added for CVE-2022-2226. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.

CVE-2026-136230.description: When a CardDAV address book was accessed through an HTTP proxy that requested authentication, Thunderbird could answer the proxy with the CardDAV server's username and password. This affected both setting up a new address book and syncing existing ones, where a saved password could be sent without any user interaction. A malicious or compromised proxy could use this to obtain the address book credentials, even for address books served over HTTPS. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.

CVE-2026-136231.description: A received message could include an attachment that referred to an arbitrary local file under a misleading name. If the user dragged that attachment into a message being composed and sent it, the contents of the referenced local file were included in the outgoing message. This vulnerability was fixed in Thunderbird 161 and Thunderbird 153.8.

CVE-2026-123165.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be vulnerable to an unauthenticated HTTP response header injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate a victim's browser session.

CVE-2026-123166.description: SolarWinds Serv-U fails to properly sanitize user-controlled arguments, which could allow the injection of commands. This only affects Windows installations.

CVE-2026-123167.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability that, when exploited, can allow a domain administrator to access files that otherwise would require elevated privileges. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

CVE-2026-123168.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an insufficient validation vulnerability that, when exploited, could lead to privilege escalation into the root user in Linux installations. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

CVE-2026-123169.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by an authentication vulnerability in its TOTP-based multi-factor authentication mechanism due to insufficient brute-force protection.

CVE-2026-123170.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by a vulnerability allowing an attacker to repeatedly attempt authentication due to insufficient protection against password brute-force attacks.

CVE-2026-123171.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by a username enumeration vulnerability allowing an attacker to determine whether specific user accounts exist.

CVE-2026-123172.description: Solarwinds Serv-U is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability that, when exploited, could lead to the escalation of privileges to root for Linux installations. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

CVE-2026-123173.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an out-of-bounds memory read that could allow an attacker to disclose data from server memory.

CVE-2026-124615.description: The shell command ACL for the feature scope (etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg) restricts feature:install, feature:uninstall, feature:start and feature:stop to the admin role, but had no entry for feature:requirement-add or feature:requirement-remove. The provisioning resolver turns a requirement into the same install/start (or uninstall) action as feature:install / feature:uninstall: a bundle: requirement causes an arbitrary bundle to be downloaded and started, and a feature: requirement installs that feature. Because the two commands had no ACL, a user authenticated with only the viewer (and ssh) role could invoke them and cause Apache Karaf to download, install and start an attacker-chosen bundle, which then runs with the full authority of the Karaf process — thereby bypassing the admin-only authorization enforced on feature:install and bundle:install. This is the same class of issue as the feature:repo-add -i / feature:repo-remove -u bypass, on sibling commands not covered by that earlier fix.Mitigation:Upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.12 or 4.5.0 (or later), which restrict feature:requirement-add and feature:requirement-remove to the admin role. As an interim workaround on affected versions, add the following two lines to etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg; the change is picked up at runtime without a restart: requirement-add = admin requirement-remove = admin

CVE-2026-129833.description: A flaw was found in rsyslog. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can trigger a stack-based buffer overflow by sending a malformed log message containing an embedded IPv4-in-IPv6 address to an instance configured with the mmanon anonymization module. This flaw causes the logging service to crash, leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-130808.description: In Apache Karaf, the default command ACL configuration for the feature scope (etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg, defined in assemblies/features/standard/src/main/feature/feature.xml and the child-instance template instance/src/main/resources/org/apache/karaf/instance/resources/etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg) restricts feature:install, feature:uninstall, feature:start, and feature:stop to users with the admin role, while leaving feature:requirement-add and feature:requirement-remove without ACL entries. Because Karaf's command guard (SecuredSessionFactoryImpl) allows commands with no matching ACL rule (NO_MATCH) to execute, an authenticated SSH user holding only the ssh and viewer roles can execute feature:requirement-add bundle:<uri> (or feature:<name>). RequirementAdd forwards the requirement directly to FeatureService.addRequirements(), causing the resolver to download, install, and start an arbitrary bundle with the Karaf JVM process's full authority, bypassing the admin-only restrictions on feature:install and bundle:install. Similarly, feature:requirement-remove allows removing provisioning requirements and uninstalling features/bundles. MitigationUsers are recommended to upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.13 or 4.5.0. For existing deployments or upgrades that preserve existing files in etc/, add the following rules to etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg (and any child instance etc/org.apache.karaf.command.acl.feature.cfg files): requirement-add = admin requirement-remove = admin
CVE-2026-130808.summary_ko: Apache Karaf에서 낮은 권한의 인증된 SSH 사용자가 명령 접근 제어를 우회해 임의의 번들을 설치·실행하거나 기능·번들을 제거할 수 있다. 설치된 번들은 Karaf JVM 프로세스의 전체 권한으로 실행된다.
CVE-2026-130808.background_ko: 기본 feature 명령 ACL에 requirement-add와 requirement-remove 규칙이 빠져 있고, 명령 가드가 일치하는 ACL 규칙이 없는 명령의 실행을 허용한다.

CVE-2026-134019.description: PyTables is a Python package to manage extremely large amounts of data. In 3.11.1 and earlier, tables/attributeset.py treats a NumPy bytes scalar ending in a period as a pickled Python object and calls pickle.loads() when the attribute is accessed through AttributeSet.__getattr__ or AttributeSet.__getitem__. Opening an attacker-controlled HDF5 file and reading an affected metadata attribute can execute attacker-controlled code in the consumer’s process. No fixed version is available as of this review.
CVE-2026-134019.summary_ko: PyTables 3.11.1 이하 버전에서 공격자가 제어하는 HDF5 파일을 열고 특정 메타데이터 속성을 읽으면, 사용자 프로세스에서 공격자가 지정한 코드가 실행될 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-134019.background_ko: tables/attributeset.py가 마침표로 끝나는 NumPy 바이트 스칼라를 피클 객체로 간주하고 속성 접근 시 pickle.loads()로 역직렬화합니다.

CVE-2026-134034.description: HortusFox is a self-hosted web application for collaborative plant management. Prior to 6.2, the toggle_boolean_value() handler in app/controller/admin.php passes the name parameter of the /admin/environment/boolean/toggle route in app/config/routes.php to AppModel::updateSingle() in app/models/AppModel.php, which concatenates the parameter into the SQL UPDATE identifier position without validation. An unauthenticated attacker can induce a signed-in administrator to open a crafted link, causing SQL injection that permits expressions and subqueries to read database contents, including an administrator password hash, or modify settings to enable passwordless administrator access. The hash alone does not permit direct login. This issue is fixed in version 6.2.

CVE-2026-134959.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Webdeclic WPMasterToolKit wpmastertoolkit allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects WPMasterToolKit: from n/a through 2.26.1.

CVE-2026-135387.description: HortusFox is a self-hosted web application for collaborative plant management. Prior to 6.2, state-changing AdminController routes in app/config/routes.php accept GET requests. The affected AdminController in app/controller/admin.php does not invoke Asatru\Controller\PostValidator to check CSRF tokens. An unauthenticated attacker can induce a signed-in administrator to open a cross-site link, causing privileged actions such as changing environment settings, deleting users or locations, managing API keys, or clearing cached data. In the tested build, a cross-site POST to /admin/user/update can promote a user immediately after login; in default Chromium the POST succeeds within the approximately two-minute Lax+POST grace period but not with an aged cookie, and other browser configurations may permit the POST. Version 6.2 mitigates the documented GET path, but no complete anti-CSRF fix is documented.

CVE-2026-135388.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.0.0 until 3.1.13, the implementation selected signature verification based on the certificate public key while deriving the digest from the peer-controlled signature scheme without validating that the scheme, key type, and hash requirements were consistent. The affected verification functions are verifyKeySignature for ServerKeyExchange and verifyCertificateVerify for CertificateVerify. An unauthenticated network attacker who can redirect a DTLS handshake and obtain the genuine peer certificate can submit crafted handshake signatures that are accepted without possession of the certificate private key. This can let the attacker impersonate the peer and compromise the confidentiality and integrity of protected traffic; checking a WebRTC SDP certificate fingerprint does not prevent the attack because the genuine certificate is presented. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.
CVE-2026-135388.summary_ko: Pion DTLS 2.0.0 이상 3.1.13 미만에 서명 검증 취약점이 있다. DTLS 핸드셰이크 경로를 바꾸고 실제 상대 인증서를 확보할 수 있는 미인증 공격자는 상대를 사칭해 통신의 기밀성과 무결성을 침해할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135388.background_ko: 인증서 공개키로 서명 검증 방식을 정하고 상대가 지정한 서명 체계로 해시를 계산하면서, 서명 체계·키 유형·해시 요건 간 일관성을 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-135389.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.0 until 3.1.14, a server with a SessionStore saved the session ID and master secret after ClientKeyExchange, before receiving a valid Finished message and before enforcing the configured client-authentication checks. A remote client can omit its Certificate message, send ClientKeyExchange, leave the first handshake unfinished, and then resume the cached session using the master secret it learned during key exchange. The server must use a SessionStore and negotiate a certificate-based cipher suite. The attack can bypass client certificates required through RequireAnyClientCert or RequireAndVerifyClientCert, or a rejecting VerifyConnection callback. WebRTC users are not affected. The abbreviated handshake can allow unauthorized access to application data. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.14.
CVE-2026-135389.summary_ko: Pion DTLS 2.1.0 이상 3.1.14 미만에서 SessionStore와 인증서 기반 암호군을 사용하는 서버의 클라이언트 인증을 우회할 수 있다. 원격 클라이언트가 애플리케이션 데이터에 무단 접근할 수 있으며, WebRTC 사용자는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-135389.background_ko: 유효한 Finished 메시지 수신과 클라이언트 인증 검사 전에 세션 ID와 마스터 비밀값을 SessionStore에 저장한다.

CVE-2026-135390.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.0 until 3.1.14, a listener performing DTLS 1.2 resumption accepted a session created by an outbound client connection without checking which role created it. A malicious server previously contacted by the application can retain the outbound session secret, select the client-side cached session through its session key, and present it to the application's reachable listener when both connections share a SessionStore. The attacker must first complete an outbound connection. WebRTC users are not affected. The listener can accept application data without running its normal PSK callback or client-certificate authentication checks, allowing a peer trusted only for an outbound connection to gain unauthorized listener access. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.14.
CVE-2026-135390.summary_ko: Pion DTLS 2.1.0 이상 3.1.14 미만에서 발신 연결과 수신 리스너가 SessionStore를 공유하면, 애플리케이션이 이전에 연결한 악성 서버가 리스너 인증을 우회해 무단 접근할 수 있다. WebRTC 사용자는 영향받지 않는다.
CVE-2026-135390.background_ko: DTLS 1.2 세션 재개 시 세션을 생성한 역할을 확인하지 않아, 수신 리스너가 발신 클라이언트 연결에서 생성된 세션을 받아들인다.

CVE-2026-135391.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.0.0 until 3.1.13, peer certificates were parsed and their RSA public keys were passed to handshake signature and certificate-chain verification without an explicit modulus-size limit. A remote peer can provide a certificate with an unusually large attacker-chosen RSA modulus and an invalid signature; no corresponding private key or valid handshake signature is required to trigger the expensive operation. An RSA verification path must execute. A local ECDSA certificate does not prevent the peer from presenting an RSA certificate, and WebRTC deployments can be affected. Repeated or concurrent malicious handshakes can consume substantial CPU resources, delay legitimate connections, and reduce service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

CVE-2026-135392.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 2.1.4 until 3.1.13, the handshake cache copied and retained submitted messages without deduplicating entries, limiting the entry count, limiting total payload bytes, or stopping new insertions after handshake completion. A remote peer able to deliver suitable DTLS traffic can grow the cache through incoming handshake messages and repeated caching of outgoing retransmissions for the lifetime of the connection. The fragment reassembly buffer's separate size limit does not prevent this issue because completed messages are retained in the append-only handshake cache. Unbounded cache growth can exhaust application memory and cause a denial of service. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.
CVE-2026-135392.summary_ko: Pion DTLS에 핸드셰이크 캐시의 무제한 증가로 인한 메모리 고갈·서비스 거부 취약점이 있다. 특정 DTLS 트래픽을 전달할 수 있는 원격 피어가 이를 유발할 수 있으며, 3.1.13에서 수정됐다.
CVE-2026-135392.background_ko: 핸드셰이크 캐시가 중복 제거, 항목 수·총 데이터 크기 제한, 핸드셰이크 완료 후 삽입 중단 없이 메시지를 복사해 계속 보관한다.

CVE-2026-135393.description: Pion DTLS is a Go implementation of Datagram Transport Layer Security. From 1.2.2 until 3.1.13, the server state machine did not distinguish successful processing of the client certificate flight from completion of the handshake, so later traffic could revisit the same cached Certificate, ClientKeyExchange, and CertificateVerify messages. A malicious client can withhold Finished and send additional handshake traffic. Depending on the configured authentication policy, repeated work can include certificate parsing, handshake signature verification, and certificate-chain verification. The vulnerable endpoint must act as the DTLS server. Pion WebRTC applications are affected when they operate in that role. Repeated or concurrent attempts can consume excessive CPU resources, delay legitimate connections, and reduce service availability. The issue is fixed in version 3.1.13.

CVE-2026-135480.description: Insert Pages plugin for WordPress (insert-pages) before 3.11.6 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the insert_pages_handle_shortcode_insert() function that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to read draft, pending, scheduled, and private posts they do not own. Attackers can reference sequential post IDs in the [insert page] shortcode to render the full content, title, excerpt, and metadata of unpublished posts, since the function checks a generic read capability instead of enforcing the read_post meta capability tied to post author and status.

CVE-2026-135481.description: Listdom by Webilia plugin for WordPress before 6.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access or above to retrieve the email address and user ID of every registered user. Attackers can exploit the LSD_Ajax::autosuggest() handler by setting the source parameter to users and repeating requests with different term values to enumerate the full user base, including administrators, bypassing the 10-result limit.

CVE-2026-135788.description: A weakness has been identified in D-Link DIR-X1860 4.5.2. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /usr/sbin/anweb. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.
CVE-2026-135788.summary_ko: D-Link DIR-X1860 4.5.2의 /usr/sbin/anweb에 운영체제 명령어 삽입 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격이 가능하며 익스플로잇이 공개돼 있다.

CVE-2026-135789.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in D-Link R95 101B06. Affected by this issue is the function GetBluetoothAdapterSettings/GetBluetoothBloodPressure/GetBluetoothDeviceList/GetBluetoothScanDeviceList/SetBluetoothAdapterSettings/SetBluetoothUnpairDevice/SetTriggerBluetoothScan/SetBluetoothPairDevice of the file /bin/ssi of the component DHMAPI SOAP Handler. The manipulation of the argument inner_xml leads to os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

CVE-2026-135790.description: A vulnerability was detected in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This affects an unknown part of the file /cgi-bin/dashboard/ajax_chart_dump. The manipulation of the argument isntmeye results in os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-136177.description: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make the server send HTTP requests by supplying a url to /api/gitea/test-connection or /api/github/test-connection. Attackers can target internal network services and cloud instance metadata endpoints, reading response content leaked through upstream error messages returned by httpGet.

CVE-2026-136178.description: Endurain before 0.20.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT /api/v1/strava/link endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify Strava integrations using only a victim's strava_state value. Attackers can submit a leaked state with their own OAuth code to link an attacker-controlled Strava account, or an invalid code to remove the victim's integration.

CVE-2026-136179.description: EpicStaff 1.2.0 before 1.3.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in DocumentViewSet download and copy endpoints that allows authenticated users to access other organizations' documents. Attackers holding Knowledge Sources permissions in one organization can enumerate sequential document IDs to download or copy foreign documents, or insert documents into another organization's collection.

CVE-2026-136180.description: Movary before 0.78.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated non-admin users to make the server request internal hosts by submitting crafted Jellyfin or Plex server URLs. Attackers can target internal services directly since URL validation is disabled by default, or bypass it via DNS rebinding, redirects, or AAAA records to probe internal network state.

CVE-2026-136181.description: cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain upstream registry authTokens via the GET /-/registry endpoints lacking AdminAccess middleware. Attackers can request /-/registry or /-/registry/:id and replay the leaked authToken as a Bearer credential to enumerate, download, or publish packages upstream.
CVE-2026-136181.summary_ko: cnpmcore 3.46.0 이상 3.84.3 미만 및 4.0.0 이상 4.37.3 미만에서 인증되지 않은 공격자에게 상위 레지스트리 인증 토큰이 노출될 수 있다. 유출된 토큰으로 상위 레지스트리의 패키지 목록 조회·다운로드·게시가 가능하다.
CVE-2026-136181.background_ko: 레지스트리 조회용 GET /-/registry 계열 엔드포인트에 AdminAccess 미들웨어가 없어 인증 토큰이 노출된다.

CVE-2026-136182.description: HarnessRouter 0.4.2 before 0.32.2 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the self-hosted sign-in UI that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users via the unvalidated next query parameter. Attackers can send crafted login links with an external, protocol-relative, or backslash-prefixed next value so victims are sent to attacker sites after signing in, enabling phishing.

CVE-2026-136183.description: Mercur @mercurjs/core before 2.3.2 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated vendors to access other sellers by substituting the :id path parameter. Attackers can read payment and tax details, overwrite profiles and addresses, and invite, remove, or re-role team members to take over another vendor's store.

CVE-2026-136184.description: compose-farm 0.19.0 before 1.22.0 contains a cross-site WebSocket hijacking and cross-site request forgery vulnerability because its unauthenticated web UI performs no Origin validation. Malicious websites visited by users can open /ws/shell/{host} or /ws/exec sockets, or abuse unquoted service parameters and PUT /api/console/file, to execute commands on all managed hosts.
CVE-2026-136184.summary_ko: compose-farm 0.19.0 이상 1.22.0 미만에 교차 사이트 WebSocket 하이재킹과 교차 사이트 요청 위조 취약점이 있다. 사용자가 악성 웹사이트를 방문하면 관리 대상 모든 호스트에서 명령이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136184.background_ko: 인증 없는 웹 UI가 요청의 Origin을 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-136185.description: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

CVE-2026-136186.description: plugNmeet-server before 2.5.3 contains an authorization flaw in PollsController.HandleUserSubmitResponse that allows authenticated room participants to submit poll votes as other users by supplying an arbitrary UserId. Attackers can set UserId to another participant's id to cast votes on their behalf or block their legitimate votes, manipulating poll results.

CVE-2026-136187.description: Spug 4.0.0 before 4.1.1 contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to execute commands by supplying a crafted git URL to the /api/credential/check/ endpoint. Attackers can inject shell metacharacters into the data field passed to git ls-remote with shell=True, executing commands as the Spug service account, which is root in Docker deployments.

CVE-2026-136188.description: Spug before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated non-administrator users to read per-host SSH private keys through the GET /api/host/ endpoint. Users granted a host can read the cleartext pkey field returned by Host.to_view and log in directly over SSH, bypassing Spug's permissions and audit trail even after revocation.

CVE-2026-136189.description: Schmitech ORBIT before 2.17.15 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the permission_or_api_key dependency that allows any valid API key to access /admin management routes. Attackers holding a chat inference API key can read other keys in plaintext, rewrite config.yaml, and manage adapters and prompts to take over server administration.

CVE-2026-136190.description: RayLabsHQ gitea-mirror before 3.38.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the /api/sso/providers handlers that allows any authenticated user to access other users' SSO providers without ownership checks. Attackers can read every OIDC client secret in clear text and overwrite or delete providers, redirecting authorization and token endpoints to attacker-controlled servers.

CVE-2026-136191.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in gf_rtsp_do_deinterleave that allows malicious RTSP servers to hang clients by sending non-RTSP, non-interleaved data. Attackers can answer a client request with a few bytes not starting with '$', 'RTSP', or 'HTTP', causing the RTSP client thread to spin forever and consume a full CPU core.

CVE-2026-136192.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in SDP_ParseAttribute that allows attackers to cause unbounded memory growth via a NUL byte in an a=fmtp line. Attackers can supply a crafted .sdp file or malicious RTSP DESCRIBE response to hang gf_sdp_info_parse and exhaust memory, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-136193.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the STAP-A handling of gf_rtp_parse_h264 in rtp_depacketizer.c due to unchecked aggregation unit sizes. A malicious RTP sender or RTSP server can send STAP-A packets with oversized NAL unit lengths to disclose adjacent heap memory or crash the client.

CVE-2026-136194.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_amr that allows remote RTP senders or malicious RTSP servers to read beyond packet buffers by sending crafted AMR/AMR-WB payloads. Attackers can send short packets whose TOC entries all set the F bit, causing out-of-bounds frame data to be copied into decoder output, disclosing memory or crashing the client.

CVE-2026-136195.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to crash clients by sending MP4V-ES RTP payloads shorter than 4 bytes. A remote RTP sender or malicious RTSP server can send a short packet after a marker-bit packet, causing an unsigned wraparound in the VOP start-code search loop that reads past the buffer and causes denial of service.

CVE-2026-136196.description: GPAC through 26.07.0 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in gf_rtp_parse_mpeg4 that allows remote attackers to trigger excessive looping by advertising an undersized AU-headers-length. Attackers can send a crafted 22-byte AAC-hbr RTP packet from an RTP sender or malicious RTSP server to run about 2^28 iterations, pinning a CPU core and stalling clients.

CVE-2026-136197.description: Assimp through 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the glTF 1.0 importer that allows attackers to read adjacent heap memory by supplying an unchecked KHR_binary_glTF image bufferView. Attackers can craft a glTF or GLB file whose bufferView byteOffset or byteLength exceeds its buffer, disclosing heap memory through embedded texture data or crashing the process.

CVE-2026-136198.description: Assimp 6.0.0 through 6.0.6 contains an invalid mesh reference vulnerability in glTF2Exporter::ExportMeshes that causes out-of-bounds access when meshes without faces are skipped during export. Attackers can supply a PLY point cloud or degenerate glTF 2.0 TRIANGLE_STRIP model exported to gltf2 or glb2 to crash the application or trigger out-of-bounds memory reads and writes.

CVE-2026-136199.description: libical before 4.0.7 contains a denial of service vulnerability because icalparser_clean() does not reset the parser nesting level when reusing an icalparser. Attackers can submit a single malformed calendar with unclosed or mismatched BEGIN/END lines, causing later calendars to be silently dropped and memory to grow unbounded.

CVE-2026-136241.description: UWAS before 0.11.16 contains a WAF bypass vulnerability in the isAPContentType() function within internal/middleware/security.go that allows unauthenticated attackers to evade SQL injection, XSS, and shell/RCE body pattern detection by setting the Content-Type header to application/json, multipart/form-data, or other exempted types. Attackers can relabel the Content-Type of malicious requests to skip WAF body scanning entirely, causing the unfiltered payload to pass through byte-for-byte to the backend application without being logged as a WAF event.

CVE-2026-136271.description: Allot's Subscriber Management Platform (SMP) v18.3.53 stores sensitive configuration credentials protected by a product‑wide, hard‑coded master password. The master key is constructed using a hard-coded string value plus a default key value. This results in an effective encryption key that is recoverable from shipped scripts and configuration files. The platform uses a deprecated and cryptographically insecure algorithm (PBEWithMD5AndDES) and no documented mechanism exists to change the key. An attacker with read access to configuration files, backups, or diagnostic bundles can recover credentials and TLS keystore/truststore passwords, and access to subscriber-management operations and subscriber PII.

CVE-2026-50048.description: Genetec Security Center can expose access control unit credentials in plain text in server log files when specific non-default logging options are enabled. An attacker with local access to the affected log files could retrieve and use these credentials.

CVE-2026-82168.description: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability in ssl_config.properties. An unauthenticated local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to credential exposure.

CVE-2026-82169.description: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains an OS Command Injection – confirm single CWE vulnerability in Upgrade Service. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution.

CVE-2026-82170.description: Dell Virtual Storage Integrator for VMware vSphere Web Client, versions prior to 10.12.0.0, contains a Server-Side Request Forgery SSRF vulnerability in httpRest.js. A low privileged remote attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to internal services

CVE-2026-82313.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a business logic vulnerability that may allow access to a higher privileged account, which can then be used to execute commands or code. An account with high privileges and a configured SMTP server are required. The risk is lower in Windows installations.

CVE-2026-82314.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by denial-of-service vulnerability that may allow users with privileged access to cause too much memory usage, causing the server to reject new connections. A specific configuration is required, and an SMTP server must be set up.

By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the component to take ownership of critical folders. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root on the host system. Was ZDI-CAN-30268.

The specific flaw exists within the implementation of handle-based rename functionality. The issue results from the lack of proper locking when performing operations on an object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the current user on the host system. Was ZDI-CAN-30608.

CVE-2026-121756.description: Parallels Desktop CSHAShellExt Improper Access Control Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target guest system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the CSHAShellExt component. The issue results from improper access control. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the hypervisor. Was ZDI-CAN-30030.

CVE-2026-129392.description: Joomla! Core - [20261155] - Core - Improper ACL checks in com_fields in Joomla 3.7.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Permission checks for custom fields and field groups used the context of the request instead of the context of the changed record, allowing users to move or change fields of other components.

CVE-2026-129393.description: Joomla! Core - [20261156] - Core - RCE through media custom field parameters in Joomla 4.0.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Inadequate escaping of media field parameters in the generated form XML allowed manipulating the form definition, leading to a remote code execution vulnerability.
CVE-2026-129393.summary_ko: Joomla! Core 4.0.0~5.4.10 및 6.0.0~6.2.0에 미디어 사용자 정의 필드 매개변수를 통한 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 있다.
CVE-2026-129393.background_ko: 생성된 폼 XML에서 미디어 필드 매개변수의 이스케이프 처리가 불충분해 폼 정의를 조작할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-129394.description: Joomla! Core - [20261157] - Core - Path traversal in com_scheduler task log file name in Joomla 4.1.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Inadequate validation of the log file name of scheduled tasks allowed writing log entries to files outside the log folder.

CVE-2026-129395.description: Joomla! Core - [20261158] - Core - DoS in InputFilter tag cleaning in Joomla 1.5.0-5.4.10, 6.0.0-6.2.0 - Inefficient handling of unterminated tags in the tag cleaning of the input filter leads to a quadratic runtime, allowing denial of service attacks through large inputs.

CVE-2026-129425.description: Joomla Extension - regularlabs.com - PHP code injection via content inserted during article preparation in Sourcerer extension < 18.0.0 - Sourcerer decided whether PHP may run based on the author or last editor of the host article and applied that decision to complete code blocks that other extensions, such as Users Anywhere, inserted into the article while it was prepared. A user able to edit a value rendered by such an extension, for example the display name in their own user profile, could therefore have PHP executed in the context of a trusted article. Sourcerer 18.0.0 authorizes each executable block against its own source; Users Anywhere 3.1.0, ReReplacer 16.4.0 and Snippets 11.2.0 supply the source information needed to keep executing eligible saved content.

CVE-2026-129984.description: AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. In versions 0.6.67 to 0.11.2, organization and team billing-manager roles intended only for spend management are treated as ordinary members across workflow, run, library, and marketplace routes. Although the role matrix in autogpt_platform/autogpt_libs/autogpt_libs/auth/permissions.py withholds run access and workflow creation, those routes do not enforce the matrix and their underlying membership lookups ignore the caller's role. As a result, a team billing manager can read team workflows and other members' runs (including inputs, outputs, and per-node data), while an organization billing manager can view shared workflows and runs and create workflows and marketplace listings; neither can modify or delete other members' workflows. This issue is fixed in version 0.11.3.

CVE-2026-135792.description: A vulnerability has been found in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. CVE-2026-135792.summary_ko: Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10의 이메일 인증 코드 전송 기능에 운영체제 명령 삽입 취약점이 있어 원격 공격이 가능하다.
CVE-2026-135792.background_ko: user.cgi의 send_email_authcode 함수에서 Username 인자 조작으로 운영체제 명령이 주입된다.

CVE-2026-135793.description: A vulnerability was found in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10.
