We reformulate image protection against unauthorized editing around this documented harm. We introduce BODYBENCH, a benchmark of 648 fully synthetic clothed adult subjects, each paired with 11 mask variants spanning body, face, and context regions. We propose three harm-aligned metrics: sexualization, naturalness, and recognizability that jointly determine whether an inpainted output constitutes a successful nudification attack. Auditing four recent protection methods (PhotoGuard, DiffusionGuard, AdvPaint, DiffVax) on BODYBENCH, we find that protection succeeds in only one configuration of one method, and only under exact mask align

9f02eb193d089df434aeb48c.title_original: Audits Need Access, Data, and Compute. But How Much?
9f02eb193d089df434aeb48c.excerpt: arXiv:2611.31968v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: AI audits have garnered significant attention in recent months, as the ability to test and monitor AI models plays a crucial role in safe development and deployment. However, AI audit success hinges on an auditor's authority; in particular, what information and resources they have at their disposal. Ongoing debates have surrounded the question: How much model access is needed to conduct an AI audit? Auditors seek more model access, while companies resist it for reasons related to confidential business information (trade secrets) and privacy. This tug-of-war remains unresolved. Further, this debate misses a related question: How much data and compute do auditors need? In this work, we systematically investigate both questions. We provide a framework that varies each of these three dimensions-model access, data, and compute-and measures their joint effect on audit success. We apply this framework to three tasks. We find that (1) some model access is important, but there can be diminishing returns; (2) data and compute matter more for traditional fairness audits, but model access matters more for manipulation and lie detection; and (3) these three resources can be fungible (i.e., an exchange rate exists between them), meaning that model access is not the only salient factor. These results suggest that audit governance should jointly consider different dimensions of auditor authority (including model access, data, and compute) in

9fe87f2d6de16644b0fc7487.title_original: Online Environment Repair for Coding Agents
9fe87f2d6de16644b0fc7487.excerpt: arXiv:2611.32037v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Programmatic verifiers provide scalable reward signals for training coding agents with reinforcement learning, yet subtle harness defects and incomplete unit tests allow policies to earn full credit without solving the intended task. Existing training-time defenses intervene either by penalizing suspicious outputs or by filtering flagged tasks and rollouts. However, output penalties leave the underlying verifier exploitable, driving policies to disguise shortcuts under reasoning monitors or zeroing out valid solutions under detector false positives, whereas task and rollout filtering discards or mutes the hardest problems where shortcuts emerge earliest. Pre-training verifier hardening repairs the environment directly, but misses vulnerability classes that surface only as the policy improves during reinforcement learning. In this paper, we propose online environment repair, which leaves triggering rollout rewards unchanged to remove hiding incentives and asynchronously patches exploited environments during training. Candidate repairs triggered by execution invariants or differential fuzzing are deployed only after passing three automated validation gates that block the exploit while preserving valid solutions, canceling detector false positives and enabling structural propagation across repositories without scaffold labels or reference solutions. Across 20 controlled GRPO experiments on heterogeneous software-engineering repos

d3dc8256ba82592c0eac09d0.title_original: ArabFake: A multitask deep learning framework for Arabic fake news Detection, Categorization, and risk prediction
d3dc8256ba82592c0eac09d0.excerpt: arXiv:2611.32303v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The spread of fake news among Arabic media including social media represents a great challenge to the integrity of information and the trust of the public in it. In this paper, we introduce a comprehensive deep-learning framework, named ArabFake, that goes beyond the binary classification on Arabic fake news detection. ArabFake, built over MARBERTv2 (a state-of-the-art model for multi-dialectal Arabic tweets), proficiently address the complexity of the Arabic language while performing three unified tasks which are fake news detection, content categorization and its risk assessment. The framework promotes efficiency and performance both by enabling multi-task learning through shared knowledge representation across tasks. In order to facilitate development and evaluation, we present the ArabFake Dataset consisting of 2,495 manually labelled news items with labels that are verified by experts regarding fake news categories and risk levels. ArabFake demonstrates robust performance, achieving an F1 score of 94.12% for fake news detection, 84.92% for categorization, and 88.91% for risk zone assessment, highlighting its reliability and effectiveness across multiple tasks. We improve interpretability and extract insight into manipulative techniques by integrating valence scoring as part of the framework that emphasizes misleading linguistic cues used to disseminate fake news within the produced image. The results show that ArabFake is

2a0ac28b93f82f4557e1fda5.title_original: On the solving degree and complexity of Gr\"obner Basis computation over finite fields
2a0ac28b93f82f4557e1fda5.excerpt: arXiv:2611.32456v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Solving systems of multivariate polynomial equations over finite fields is a central problem in algebraic cryptanalysis, commonly approached using Gr\"obner basis algorithms. The complexity of Gr\"obner basis computation depends on the algorithm employed and is governed by the solving degree, defined as the maximum degree of the polynomials processed during the computation. Estimating this quantity is therefore crucial, and several bounds in terms of the degree of regularity have been established in the literature. In this work, we investigate the effect of Buchberger's criteria on the elimination of redundant pairs, and prove that the solving degree of a Gr\"obner basis algorithm combining linear algebra with Buchberger's original algorithm is bounded above by the degree of regularity defined by the leading forms of the involved polynomials. This result provides a rigorous justification for using the degree of regularity in complexity estimates for Gr\"obner basis algorithms, thereby supporting a common assumption in algebraic cryptanalysis. We refine the complexity analysis by establishing bounds on the number of pairs that must be processed. These bounds improve upon published complexity estimates, with particularly significant gains in certain parameter ranges.

101ad6fc1dccb723821da0a3.title_original: Red-Teaming a Sovereign LLM, Its Reasoning and Its Training Stages
101ad6fc1dccb723821da0a3.excerpt: arXiv:2611.32710v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for applications with sensitive information. We investigate whether confidentiality instructions in system prompt can protect such information. We red-team Apertus v1.5, an open sovereign LLM, and five other model families across six languages and reasoning modes. We use synthetic personal records to evaluate direct disclosure, correction baits, yes/no verification, derived-value queries, reasoning leakage and authorisation checks. We also explore copyright attribution, historical misrepresentation and stereotyping. Despite confidentiality instructions, Apertus 8B and 70B leak information in 96% and 95% of requests, respectively, in correction-bait attacks. Verification and derived-value queries also expose protected information without necessarily revealing identifiers. Moreover, reasoning traces can leak confidential records even when final answers withhold them. Our experiments also show that post-training does not consistently improve safety. Our findings demonstrate that system prompts alone cannot ensure confidentiality and highlight the need for multilingual reasoning-aware safety evaluations.

55808c5e2a7692dfc5054bc2.title_original: Sound Distributed Runtime Verification under Incomplete Evidence
55808c5e2a7692dfc5054bc2.excerpt: arXiv:2611.32868v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Distributed runtime verification often requires combining evidence from several nodes to check properties that cannot be evaluated locally. However, when messages are delayed, lost, or deliberately suppressed, the verifier may not know whether a violation occurred or whether the relevant evidence is missing. This creates a risk of incorrectly reporting compliance. We study the requirements for sound monitoring under these conditions. We first show that a deadline-bounded monitor cannot be simultaneously sound, decisive, and available when an adversary can suppress evidence. The monitor must therefore be able to abstain. We then distinguish two sources of incomplete evidence. Sequence numbers and periodic reports can identify missing events, whereas detecting silent streams requires timing assumptions. We also examine how membership changes and coordinator failures affect verdict soundness and recovery. We implement these mechanisms in a three-tier monitoring architecture using MQTT and NATS JetStream. Experiments with an LLM-planned robot swarm demonstrate the failure modes, show how the proposed mechanisms prevent unsupported compliance verdicts, and measure their runtime and communication costs.

354421455f50161a13e5b4b7.title_original: SALSA: Sampling Adversarial Suffixes from Learned Distributions for LLM Safety Assessment
354421455f50161a13e5b4b7.excerpt: arXiv:2611.33030v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, where adversaries append optimized suffixes to otherwise benign looking prompts to bypass safety alignment. Existing optimization-based GCG-style attacks can be effective, but they are expensive at inference time, and suffer from poor transfer. We present, SALSA, a generative framework that learns a distribution over jailbreak suffixes from optimization-derived attack corpora. Once trained, the model supports efficient sampling-based attacks. On open-source targets, it achieves attack success rates comparable to state-of-the-art optimization baselines, while reducing generation time from 3.46s to 0.04s per prompt. In black-box transfer, it remains highly effective against proprietary systems, including 99% ASR on GPT-3.5-Turbo, and reaches 45% ASR on the substantially harder GPT-4o, more than doubling the strongest baseline at an equal sampling budget. We further offer an intuition for why generative sampling can preserve high attack success, when the learned suffix distribution is close to the distribution of optimization outputs. Overall, our results show that learning adversarial suffix distributions yields a scalable, and practically efficient foundation for continuous LLM vulnerability discovery.

aa9da843006588d7e3c8ebe6.title_original: PILOT: Command-line Interface Fuzzing via Path-Guided, Iterative Large Language Model Prompting
aa9da843006588d7e3c8ebe6.excerpt: arXiv:2511.20555v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Command-line interface (CLI) fuzzing tests programs by mutating both command-line options and input file contents, thus enabling discovery of vulnerabilities that only manifest under specific option-input combinations. Prior works of CLI fuzzing face the challenges of generating semantics-rich option strings and input files, which cannot reach deeply embedded target functions. This often leads to a missed detection of such a deep vulnerability using existing CLI fuzzing techniques. In this paper, we design a novel Path-guided, Iterative LLM-Orchestrated Testing framework, called PILOT, to generate effective initial seeds for fuzzing CLI applications. The key insight is to provide potential call paths to target functions as context to LLM so that it can better generate CLI option strings and input files. Then, PILOT iteratively repeats the process, and provides reached functions as additional context so that target functions are reached. Our evaluation on real-world CLI applications demonstrates that PILOT, combined with existing fuzzers, achieves higher coverage than state-of-the-art fuzzing approaches and discovers 51 zero-day vulnerabilities. We responsibly disclosed all the vulnerabilities to their developers and so far 41 have been confirmed by their developers with 33 being fixed and five assigned CVE identifiers.

a5392b2652d6eff3b9f763d1.title_original: Granite: Granular Runtime Enforcement for GitHub Actions Permissions
a5392b2652d6eff3b9f763d1.excerpt: arXiv:2512.11602v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: GitHub Actions is a popular CI/CD platform that lets maintainers build workflows from reusable third-party actions, organized into jobs of sequential steps. To control access to repository resources, GitHub enforces token permissions only at the job level. This violates the principle of least privilege: every step shares the job's full permissions, so a single compromised action can misuse all of them, as witnessed by the recent tj-actions compromise, enabling broader software supply chain attacks. We present Granite, the first system to enforce fine-grained, step-level permissions for GitHub Actions at runtime. Untrusted steps never hold the real token; a separate controller issues each step an identifier token and supplies the real token only to requests that meet the step's policy. Granite builds on GitHub's self-hosted runner, requires no workflow changes, and transparently handles JavaScript, composite, and Docker actions. Across 500 workflows (12,915 jobs) from the most-starred GitHub repositories, 46.3% of jobs are overprivileged and can be protected by Granite. On 46 repositories and 127 unique actions, Granite preserves the behavior of every job that runs on the unmodified runner, except one it blocks by design. Reproducing 10 permission-misuse attacks over 42 overprivileged jobs, including attempts to bypass its enforcement, Granite prevents all of them and removes write access from about 83.3% of the steps that ho

e45cb042d3ecce038fcce009.title_original: VENOMREC: Cross-Modal Interactive Poisoning for Targeted Promotion in Multimodal LLM Recommender Systems
e45cb042d3ecce038fcce009.excerpt: arXiv:2602.06409v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are pushing recommender systems (RecSys) toward content-grounded retrieval and ranking via cross-modal fusion. We find that while cross-modal consensus often mitigates conventional poisoning that manipulates interaction logs or perturbs a single modality, it also introduces a new attack surface where synchronised multimodal poisoning can reliably steer fused representations along stable semantic directions during fine-tuning. To characterise this threat, we formalise cross-modal interactive poisoning and propose VENOMREC, which performs Exposure Alignment to identify high-exposure regions in the joint embedding space and Cross-modal Interactive Perturbation to craft attention-guided coupled token--patch edits. Experiments on four real-world multimodal datasets demonstrate that VENOMREC consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving 0.73 mean ER@20 and improving over the strongest baseline by +0.52 absolute ER points on average, while maintaining comparable recommendation utility. Code is available at https://github.com/GuoweiGuan666/VenomRec.

99fb0d5e789d7065b8deba9d.title_original: Beyond True or False: Why You Can't Trust the Reasoning in LLM-Generated Vulnerability Reports
99fb0d5e789d7065b8deba9d.excerpt: arXiv:2602.06687v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: When a state-of-the-art LLM labels a function as vulnerable, can we trust its explanation? This paper first reveals a worrisome fact: 30.3% of correct verdicts from LLMs are produced through \textit{hallucinated or causally wrong reasoning}. While prior work has partially observed this phenomenon, no study has quantified its prevalence, taxonomized its failure modes, or proposed a structural fix. We aim to address all three. First, we construct reasoning-level datasets: real-world vulnerabilities across 149 CWE types annotated with evidence-based reasoning chains, and semantically equivalent code perturbations for robustness testing. Through open coding of 400 reasoning traces across 10 LLMs, we identify 12 systematic failure modes, among which code comprehension and logical reasoning errors are the most prevalent. Motivated by these findings, we propose DagVul, which models vulnerability reasoning as a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) generation task, enforcing causal dependencies between reasoning steps and aligning them with program semantics via Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). DagVul improves reasoning F1-score by an average of 13.3% over baselines. Our 8B-parameter model achieves performance comparable to Claude-Sonnet-4.5 under CWE-Guided prompting (78.90% vs. 76.11%) in the evaluated setting. These results support the combined benefits of structured causal reasoning and training on curated, task-spe

56597d7ad5c284b9ec312b76.title_original: MASCing: Configurable Mixture-of-Experts Behavior via Activation Steering Masks
56597d7ad5c284b9ec312b76.excerpt: arXiv:2604.27818v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) operate under safety requirements that vary across applications and evolve with emerging threats and deployment policies. Conventional training-based interventions make adapting model behavior computationally expensive. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models introduce a further control challenge because each input activates only a subset of experts, coupling safety behavior to discrete routing decisions. Rapid adaption of MoE LLMs therefore requires a lightweight mechanism for identifying and controlling the routing decisions that produce the target behavior. We present MASCing (MoE Activation Steering Configuration), a framework that enables flexible configuration of safety-related MoE behavior without training the underlying model. MASCing uses an LSTM surrogate model to capture cross-layer dependencies and map routing logits to downstream behaviors. Guided by this surrogate, it identifies safety-relevant experts and optimizes a sparse steering mask to bias expert selection. This enables targeted enhancement or suppression of specific behaviors while preserving model utility. We evaluate MASCing on three contrasting safety objectives and observe consistent gains across seven MoE models. For multi-turn jailbreak defense, it improves the average defense success rate from 52.5% to 83.9%. For adult-content generation, MASCing enables models to comply with such requests that would otherwise be refused, inc

5710c0712d4bbd161cdc8b41.title_original: The Best-Laid SCHEMEs: Coordinated Sabotage and Monitoring in Multi-Agent Systems
5710c0712d4bbd161cdc8b41.excerpt: arXiv:2605.29178v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As agentic coding systems decompose work across multiple model instances, a critical safety question is whether those instances can coordinate to achieve a hidden malicious objective while appearing aligned with user intent. We introduce SCHEME, a benchmark of 11 task pairings across 7 settings built on real open-source libraries, each connecting a legitimate software-engineering task with a malicious side task. Side tasks are designed so that no proper subset of agents can complete them alone: agents must decompose a shared plan, relay partial requirements, and make mutually consistent edits. Evaluating ten frontier models, we find that coordinated sabotage is already practical, with models completing the malicious objective while succeeding on the legitimate task in 49\% to 85\% of trajectories. Stronger models also run into fewer communication failures and recover from more of them. However, trusted monitors that see the agents' code and communication catch at least 93\% of successful sabotage from every model, and telling the agents about the monitor lowers their sabotage success while barely helping them evade these monitors. Successful evasion requires an attacker optimized against the monitor. An automated red-teaming attacker hides 63\% of the sabotage that GPT 5.1 Codex Mini catches, but this transfers poorly to Claude Haiku 4.5 and Gemini 3 Flash monitors.

0e8f556d8c287a301cb94165.title_original: Selection Integrity for LLM Graph Memory: An Accumulability Criterion for Information-Flow-Blind Retrieval
0e8f556d8c287a301cb94165.excerpt: arXiv:2606.12290v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agent memory is moving to graphs, and the provenance defenses now being built for it all check one thing: the provenance of the records an agent retrieves. We show that this entire class of defense is blind by construction. A long-term graph memory runs a global selection step over writable graph structure, so structure that an untrusted principal writes changes \emph{which} authenticated facts are selected while the cited evidence stays fully authenticated; faithful information-flow control (IFC), checking the provenance of what the reader uses (all of it authenticated), makes the byte-identical decision to no defense at all, across document-QA substrates and real multi-session agent memory. In the most consequential instance, a no-source structural write silently misdirects $28$ irreversible ledger transfers over $499$ live actions: faithful IFC permits every one, and \authselect\ prevents every one. We then characterize exactly which memories are exposed: a selector admits the channel when its structural term can reallocate an $\Omega(1)$ share of top-$k$ membership past a selected fact's margin. Personalized PageRank can, since a sourceless write reroutes conserved random-walk mass; a content-fixed reranker cannot, and Graphiti's node-distance, which leans on structure \emph{more} than PageRank does, stays immune. Reallocatability, not reliance, is the predictor. We prove the immune case in general and the open case unde

a80c10b635cc20576d7feb09.title_original: Merging Cyber Threat Intelligence Through Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Small Language Models for Rich Threat Representation
a80c10b635cc20576d7feb09.excerpt: arXiv:2609.07280v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Cybersecurity operations rely on CTI from heterogeneous sources, such as structured threat representations and narrative reports. They describe adversarial behaviors but rarely make explicit the conditions that enable each attack step, the consequences it produces, and the evidence supporting them, leaving analysts to correlate fragmented information manually. Existing approaches extract entities, map tactics and techniques, or reconstruct attack chains; enriching attack steps with explicit, evidence-linked semantics remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a local-first pipeline for evidence-grounded attack-step enrichment that combines hybrid RAG with a locally deployed SLM. Starting from an analyst-provided attack representation and supporting CTI documents, the pipeline retrieves step-relevant evidence and generates enriched descriptions, pre-conditions, post-conditions, and traceable links to the supporting passages. The enriched steps are organized into graph that groups MITRE ATT&CK-aligned steps into tactic-level milestones. Explicit conditions help defenders block attacks by removing their enabling conditions and support detection by checking for their expected consequences. We evaluate the pipeline on ten public malware case studies derived from UK NCSC reports, using automated measurements and a structured manual assessment with annotations from two annotators. The results demonstrate that the pipeline is e

c9725ba6b2b62dbe9e8c6aca.title_original: Principled Detection of Coordinated Manipulation from Aggregate Distortion and Account Reuse
c9725ba6b2b62dbe9e8c6aca.excerpt: arXiv:2609.13407v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Coordinated manipulation is collective: plausible accounts can jointly distort ratings, rankings, and engagement. Existing defenses primarily construct evidence from identities, graphs, content, or co-activity. We introduce an aggregate-first evidence layer that treats distortion of a context-level outcome distribution as the primary evidence object. The engine observes only a histogram, count, resolution, and reference distribution; identities are withheld until interval evidence is fixed. Because raw discrepancies have positive finite-sample expectation, we subtract a matched null expectation to obtain signed evidence and account for reference uncertainty. Participation logs then accumulate these fixed increments across accounts. We characterize matched-exposure divergence, bound self-influence, establish finite-horizon separation, and derive an exact linear reuse law for paired contexts. We evaluate the mechanism with controlled rotation experiments and paired counterfactual interventions on historical Amazon review streams. Historical reviews provide the behavioral background; synthetic identities provide known coalition membership, and exact clean twins provide counterfactual controls. In a fixed-attack sweep against historical non-donor comparison accounts, reassigning the same manipulated events across identities with increasing reuse raises account-score ROC-AUC from 0.500 to 0.797. With activity- and exposure-matche

c09e2057eae7e1fbeb79958c.title_original: How Attackers Launder Funds through Mixers: Characterization and Detection on Ethereum
c09e2057eae7e1fbeb79958c.excerpt: arXiv:2609.27807v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Mixers protect privacy by concealing deposit--withdrawal links, but are also abused to launder illicit funds. Existing anti-money laundering studies do not specifically target mixer laundering, while mixer research focuses on deanonymization rather than identifying laundering-related transactions. Public reports remain fragmented, leaving no public case-level dataset for systematic measurement and detection. To fill this void, this paper presents the first comprehensive study of mixer laundering on Ethereum. We first construct \textsc{MixLaunder}, the first public case-level dataset of mixer laundering. It covers 27 cases involving Tornado Cash and Railgun from 2020 to 2025 and labels 9,300 laundering-related transactions with case identities and observable upstream and downstream fund flows, including deposits totaling approximately \$1.1 billion. By comparing these transactions with background mixer usage, we identify five common strategies, showing that laundering evidence spans complementary behavioral and fund-flow contexts, while same-case activity is locally tight but weakly connected across bursts. Our analysis further reveals coverage gaps in mixer-side risk screening and representative deanonymization heuristics. Guided by these findings, we develop \textsc{MixGuard}, which combines tri-view representation learning with two-stage grouping for transaction-level detection and case-aware grouping. Under strict case-le

c3579effb0662d0abcc855c1.title_original: Made to Measure: Designing Image Watermarks to Specification
c3579effb0662d0abcc855c1.excerpt: arXiv:2610.00780v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Image watermarking enables provenance and attribution, but practical deployments must jointly satisfy robustness, false-positive rate (FPR), image quality, and latency requirements. Existing watermarking methods offer complementary robustness against different attacks, making their composition attractive for broader protection. However, combining watermarks introduces interference, distortion, decoding overhead, and additional verification paths that share the same FPR budget. We propose TAILOR, a request-conditioned watermark composition framework with three stages: (1) offline characterization models fragment recovery, distortion, latency, and composition interactions across embedding strengths; (2) joint configuration selection uses satisfiability modulo theories (SMT) to jointly optimize fragment selection, continuous embedding strengths, embedding order, and geometric recovery while minimizing predicted distortion; and (3) live calibration validates candidate configurations on user images and refines inaccurate offline predictions to improve deployment success. Across 7,321 distinct deployment requests spanning five scenarios and 20 attack settings, TAILOR achieves 96.21% scenario-averaged request satisfaction with a mean PSNR of 41.02 dB, demonstrating its effectiveness in meeting diverse deployment requirements while maintaining high image fidelity. Code is available at https://github.com/aaFrostnova/Tailor.

0d65113faad368589fa0e5c5.title_original: The Missing Compliance Class: LLM Graders That Collapse Jailbreak Success, and a Free Check
0d65113faad368589fa0e5c5.excerpt: arXiv:2610.24872v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Jailbreak evaluations often substitute open-weight 7B to 9B instruction-tuned models as local, deterministic judges for frontier APIs. Holding target models, prompts, responses, and a four-class rubric fixed across eight graders from five organizations, we find that dense 8B and 9B judges collapse compliant responses onto evasion. One assigns compliance zero times in 900 responses while agreeing with our reference judge on 78.0% of items, certifying an unsafe model as safe. This collapse holds across four 900-response corpora, multiplying reported compliance by a factor of 22 to 25 on our primary corpora while non-refusal shifts by 18.0 to 23.0 points. Without the three collapsing graders, compliance varies by 1.7x to 2.8x across all four corpora, whereas post-labelling rubric rulings (+16.3 points) and benchmark choice (15.3 points) still shift non-refusal. Per-class label counts expose class collapse at zero cost without human labels, motivating an eight-item reporting minimum that pairs compliance with non-refusal rates.

36bddc75558f76584054b101.title_original: Deletion Is Not Substitution: Component Attribution in a Layered Prompt-Injection Gateway for LLM Tool Calls
36bddc75558f76584054b101.excerpt: arXiv:2610.33198v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Prompt-injection defenses for LLM agents are commonly built as cascades of increasingly costly stages, and ablation studies evaluate their components by switching each stage off and counting the detections lost. In a cascade, however, stages are not independent: a stage's contribution depends on what is routed to it and how its verdicts are enforced, so deletion-based ablation can mislead. We test this on BARBICAN, a four-tier, fail-closed gateway for Model Context Protocol tool calls, developed in our group, that routes borderline inputs to a neural arbitrator. After reproducing its recorded evaluation exactly, we apply deletion, constant substitution, repair and transplant to its arbitration stage. The findings rest on over thirty instrumented runs over 25,000 prompts, two platforms, an independent check set and six versions from the system's history. Depending on how "switching off" is defined, deletion credits the stage with contributions that differ by more than an order of magnitude, whereas substitution shows that its verdicts can affect only a few inputs, all attacks. Neither repairing the stage nor replacing it with a much stronger classifier changed the system appreciably: its influence is set by its position, not its quality. An observation that bounds the decisions a routed stage can change explains this, and a cascade of public classifiers reproduces it whenever routing concentrates attacks. Treating constant ve

3364f132d9f7b3354313320f.title_original: O2N2: Efficient Doubly Oblivious Approximate Nearest Neighbor Search
3364f132d9f7b3354313320f.excerpt: arXiv:2611.03415v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Privacy-preserving approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search allows clients to search from an untrusted server without revealing sensitive queries, and is useful in scenarios like medical diagnostics and credit scoring. Among the various privacy-preserving primitives, trusted execution environments (TEEs) have much lower overhead than heavy cryptographic ones, yet they leak memory access patterns, enabling adversaries to infer query contents. Oblivious RAM (ORAM) can be used to hide those access patterns at $\mathrm{O}(\log N)$ asymptotic cost, but existing high-performance ANN search algorithms (e.g., IVF or HNSW) exhibit complex, data-dependent access patterns that are unfriendly for ORAM. Furthermore, standard ORAM constructions typically assume there exists a small amount of trusted storage, which weakens the security guarantees and is not always feasible. Solutions that eliminate such trusted storage (known as {\em double obliviousness}) typically degrade performance further to $\mathrm{O}(\log^2 N)$. We introduce O2N2, a doubly oblivious ANN framework built around single-path search in randomly rotated $k$-d tree forests. A pointer-based Circuit ORAM stores the search structure, with separate storage for compact internal nodes and vector-bearing leaves. Each visited leaf is processed by an oblivious selection network, and fixed-schedule duplicate removal and selection combine the local results into the final top-$k$. W

be66ee298decfcb1fc33dd91.title_original: QUASI: Post-Quantum Quorum Attestation of Pre-Validated Statements
be66ee298decfcb1fc33dd91.excerpt: arXiv:2611.10403v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present QUASI, a newly conceived class of hash-based, post-quantum-secure protocols that enable a group of parties to produce a publicly verifiable attestation about a pre-validated statement. QUASI produces attestations that reduce the size and verification cost to a fraction of a full hash-based signatures collection, without relying on SNARKs or a trusted setup. QUASI rests on a surprising discovery: each party need not sign the entire statement. Authenticating only a small subset of symbols suffices for a quorum to attest to the whole. We turn this insight into a randomized construction that achieves reductions of more than 10x in per-party contribution size and hash computations for generation and verification, compared with full hash-based signatures. QUASI is a generic primitive supporting diverse applications. Operationally, QUASI requires no additional interactive setup or preprocessing beyond independent key generation by parties for the underlying hash-based authentication scheme. Two principal use cases are external attestation for signature-free consensus, enabling clients to verify statements about committed state; and preprocessing for SNARK-based aggregation, compounding QUASI's savings with succinct-proof compression.

05729448dd07c8a368832a47.excerpt: arXiv:2611.23350v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Watermark detectors held by a provider cannot be checked by third parties, and a party that can detect a mark can usually also forge it. We study a two-layer image watermark in which the Fourier transform at the core of the pipeline is performed by a coherent optical 4F unit. Layer 1 carries an Ed25519 signature bound to the image content in Fourier magnitudes, so anyone with the public key verifies offline. Layer 2 is a key-defined carrier written by a secret phase hologram and read by a matched-filter correlator. The optics is a scalar-diffraction simulation with finite modulator bits, pixel aperture, pupil, defocus, misalignment, and sensor noise. No hardware is built. All criteria were fixed in a hashed specification before any optical result. The simulated optical signer reproduces the digital pipeline (field error 1.7e-15, bit agreement 99.997%), verifies at least 99.5% of 877 images under each of 8 post-sensor settings, one unattacked, and accepts none of 40,670 unmarked images. The optical carrier is key-selective: the matched key detects it on 99.8% of the unattacked images, and detection falls to 0% under a scale error of 1% and to 0% under a mask shift of 1 bin. Security rests on the signature and the content binding, for which we separate what is provable from what is measured.

8c4246f94888c4a68f5aac78.title_original: Visual Attribution Limits and Graded Provenance Auditing in Commercial Video-Generation APIs
8c4246f94888c4a68f5aac78.excerpt: arXiv:2611.26508v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Commercial video-generation APIs bill by model and tier, while intermediaries could substitute cheaper models, lower tiers, or cached clips. What can a delivered file establish about its origin? We combine measurements of passive attribution and cryptographic provenance into a graded audit. We test attribution probes and zero-shot detectors under re-encoding, downscaling, and frame-rate changes, and survey C2PA and GB 45438 metadata across 19 commercial endpoints. Only authenticated provenance supports accusations: tier contradictions or duplicate signed instances under fresh-generation contracts, excluding retries and idempotent returns. Unverifiable signed-endpoint deliveries trigger original-file demands under pass-through clauses; archive-reuse and delivery-parameter screens support review only. Six-model container and bitstream accuracy falls from 83.9% on raw files to 45.3% after uniform re-encoding, using different feature sets. Subsampling real references from 24 to 3 fps raises pooled D3 AUROC from 0.845 to 0.988. Only BytePlus authenticates tier claims under our pinned policy, including 187/187 audited deliveries across three Seedance tiers; tested remuxing and re-encoding leave processed Seedance files unverifiable. The audit identifies authenticated contradictions in 100/100 raw 720p signed tier-swap cases, with zero observed false flags on the tested honest pools.

feb8ff79639b188d2908a181.title_original: Fail-Closed Alignment for Large Language Models
feb8ff79639b188d2908a181.excerpt: arXiv:2602.16977v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We identify a structural weakness in current large language model (LLM) alignment: refusal mechanisms in these models are fail-open. While existing approaches tend to encode refusal behaviors across multiple latent features, suppressing a single feature (via prompt-based jailbreaks) is sufficient to collapse alignment, leading to unsafe generation. Motivated by this, we propose fail-closed alignment as a design principle for robust LLM safety: refusal mechanisms should remain effective even under partial failures via redundant, independent causal pathways. We present a concrete instantiation of this principle: a progressive alignment framework that iteratively identifies and ablates previously learned refusal directions, forcing the model to reconstruct safety along new, independent subspaces. Across six jailbreak attacks, our method achieves the lowest observed average attack success rate (1.6%) while largely preserving generation quality and preventing excessive over-refusals, with negligible computational overhead. Additional analyses confirm that models trained with our method encode multiple, causally independent refusal directions that prompt-based jailbreaks cannot fully suppress, providing empirical support for fail-closed alignment as a principled foundation for robust LLM safety. Our code for reproducing the results is available at https://github.com/Trustworthy-and-Responsible-AI-Lab/Fail-Closed-Alignment

ff3e1054bdab36afa6567433.title_original: Differential Privacy for Network Connectedness Indices
ff3e1054bdab36afa6567433.excerpt: arXiv:2603.15609v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Researchers increasingly use data on social and economic networks to study a range of social science questions, but releasing statistics derived from networks can raise significant privacy concerns. We show how to release network connectedness indices that quantify assortative mixing across node attributes under edge-adjacent differential privacy. Directly adding noise to connectedness indices based on global sensitivity can result in poor accuracy both because connectedness indices have high global sensitivity and because a single node's attribute can potentially be an input to connectedness in thousands of cells, leading to poor composition. Our method, which is straightforward to apply, first randomizes node attributes, then analytically debiases downstream statistics, and finally adds noise to protect the presence or absence of individual edges. We prove consistency and asymptotic normality of our estimators for both discrete and continuous labels and show our method works well in simulations and on real networks with as few as 200 nodes collected by social scientists.

8cb6f81e21a97741f770c6f4.excerpt: arXiv:2609.36485v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Modern Security Operations Centers struggle with delayed manual incident response, enabling adversaries to advance through the Cyber Kill Chain during early stage reconnaissance. While classical game theoretic defense models optimize strategic resource allocation, they rely on static utility matrices that fail to adapt to dynamic telemetry. This paper presents an integrated, metrics driven decision engine that bridges quantitative risk parameterization and continuous automated response time. Common Vulnerability Scoring Systems exploitability parameters are mapped to attacker success probabilities and evaluate defender log distributions via Factor Analysis of Information Risk Monte Carlo simulations. Real time SIEM logs streams are modeled as Poisson process arrival rates, dynamically updating defender posterior threat belief through sequential Bayesian filtering. A closed form threshold is derived by framing the interaction as a dynamic Bayesian Stackelberg game, where the expected unmitigated risk exceeds proactive containment cost. 4a0add6c630689c9d2fcc6ce.excerpt: arXiv:2610.18799v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A series of recent works has established EFI pairs as the "minimal" assumption for quantum cryptography. Recently, Cavalar et al. [CCC+26] showed that EFI pairs are equivalent to non-uniform expanding single-copy pseudorandom state generators (1PRS), and obtained a non-uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. We remove the non-uniformity in their construction and prove that EFI pairs are equivalent to expanding 1PRS. As a corollary, we obtain the first uniform meta-complexity characterization of EFI pairs. Together with the equivalence of statistically verifiable one-way state generators and commitments proved by Batra and Jain [BJ24], this gives a quantum analogue of the classical equivalence between one-way functions, commitments, and pseudorandom generators.

f9b53d8a16f49a576fe1f532.excerpt: arXiv:2610.32345v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Automated Vulnerability Repair (AVR) has emerged as a promising approach to identifying and fixing software vulnerabilities autonomously. Early LLM-based approaches focused on patch generation under the assumption of perfect fault localization, while recent end-to-end methods attempt to repair vulnerabilities directly from sanitizer logs. However, these methods often fail when the root cause is deeply hidden, either physically distant from the crash site or logically masked by interdependent errors, making the initial report insufficient. It coordinates specialized agents for fault localization, patch generation, compilation, security and functionality validation, and patch review to iteratively refine localization and patch hypotheses. Specifically, DeepAVR introduces patch-conditioned re-localization, using execution results from intermediate patches to uncover hidden root causes, and root-cause-oriented patch review to identify symptom-level fixes and incomplete repairs that escape execution-based validation. Evaluation on VulnLoc, a real-world C/C++ vulnerability repair dataset, shows that DeepAVR outperforms prior methods, generating correct patches for 92.3% of vulnerabilities. 22a1b0ea104cabc549569431.title_original: Dissecting the GPU Load/Store Unit and Exposing Its Security Risks
22a1b0ea104cabc549569431.excerpt: arXiv:2611.23022v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: GPUs are the main platform for large-scale machine learning and power the largest supercomputers. Their load/store units (LSUs) often determine kernel performance and have been exploited in prior attacks. Yet what is known about the LSU is only a few isolated mechanisms and parameters, and even a single one has been enough for an attack. In particular, it is still unknown what a load costs, where loads contend, and even whether a warp can starve due to contention. Until each is measured, neither its security risk nor a defense is known. We reverse-engineer how the LSU serves load instructions on recent NVIDIA GPUs with microbenchmarks and analyze the security implications. We give a cycle-accurate latency formula for a global L1 hit or shared memory access from the addresses it touches, whose address-dependent terms are bank conflicts and the L1 tag lookup; we show that loads contend at both, and that when the LSU pipeline is full a warp can starve a warp of a later-launched block. We then show that the LSU's attack surface is far broader than prior attacks revealed: through channels never exploited before, it can leak information, communicate covertly, and degrade colocated workloads. curation.reason_ko: 취약하게 구성한 환경에서 AI의 자발적 보안 경계 위반을 측정하는 사이렌이 공개됐다.

7d9f8383927c11d941988c41.title_original: 최첨단 AI, 글 하나만으로 작성자 실명까지 알아내…익명성 위협
7d9f8383927c11d941988c41.excerpt: 최첨단 AI 모델이 글 하나만으로 AI가 작성했는지 판별하는 것은 물론, 어떤 기업의 AI 모델이 썼는지, 심지어 인간 작성자가 누구인지까지 알아낼 수 있다는 연구 결과가 나왔다. 인터넷 검색이나 작성자 후보 목록 없이도 평소 온라인에 글을 많이 공개한 사람의 신원을 찾아낼 수 있어 익명성 보호가 어려워질 수 있다는 지적이다.미국 메릴랜드대학교와 구글 딥마인드, 캐나다 브리티시컬럼비아대학교 등의 공동 연구진은 AI 모델의 글 작성자 식별 능력을 평가한 연구 결과를 19일(현지시간) 온라인 아카이브에 공개했다.연구진은 AI 생성 여부
7d9f8383927c11d941988c41.title_ko: 연구진, AI의 글 작성자 식별 능력 보고…온라인 익명성 위협 경고
7d9f8383927c11d941988c41.summary_ko: 메릴랜드대학교·구글 딥마인드 등 공동 연구진은 검색이나 작성자 후보 목록 없이 AI가 글의 작성자를 식별할 수 있다고 보고했다. 클로드 페이블 5.2는 비공개 논문 심사평 398건 중 56%에서 실명을 맞혔으며, 레딧 계정 식별률은 활동량이 많은 이용자 69%, 적은 이용자 2%로 차이가 컸다.
7d9f8383927c11d941988c41.background_ko: 연구진은 작성자 식별 능력이 AI의 사전 학습 과정에서 해당 작성자의 글을 접한 양과 밀접하게 관련된 것으로 분석했다.

08ff2fe58017fe01baecaa23.title_original: KAIST 사이버보안연구센터, AI 도박 탐지로 강원랜드 감사장
08ff2fe58017fe01baecaa23.title_ko: KAIST, AI 불법도박 탐지 공로로 강원랜드 감사장
08ff2fe58017fe01baecaa23.summary_ko: KAIST 사이버보안연구센터와 이경석 팀장이 AI 기반 불법도박 탐지 기술의 현장 활용 공로로 강원랜드 감사장을 받았다. 강원랜드에 이전한 GT는 탐지 범위를 SNS 사칭 계정과 불법 홍보로 넓혔고, CCT는 사이트 간 연결 관계를 분석해 디지털 범죄 대응과 수사를 지원한다.
08ff2fe58017fe01baecaa23.background_ko: 강원랜드는 기술 이전받은 GT를 불법도박·유해사이트 탐지와 신고 대응에 활용한 공로를 인정해 감사장을 수여했다.

4b52860d915bd12008e7b045.title_original: Where scientists draw the line on AI agents
4b52860d915bd12008e7b045.title_ko: 과학자 17명 인터뷰로 살핀 연구용 AI 에이전트의 신뢰 기준
4b52860d915bd12008e7b045.summary_ko: Ai2 연구진은 자연·응용·사회과학 연구자 17명을 인터뷰해 연구용 AI 에이전트의 책임 있는 활용 조건을 조사했다. 검증, 개인정보 보호, 객관성, 책임성, 투명성을 신뢰의 다섯 차원으로 제시했다. 연구자가 평가 기준 설계에 참여하는 벤치마크도 제안했지만, 이는 향후 개발·검증할 구상이라고 명시했다.
4b52860d915bd12008e7b045.background_ko: 과학용 AI 안전성 연구가 생물학·핵물리학 등의 대규모 위험에 주로 집중해, 분야별 연구윤리 준수도 평가할 필요가 있다는 문제의식에서 출발했다.

fcc0d450f00e61323c5d311c.title_original: An Indic Voice Agent with CUGA
fcc0d450f00e61323c5d311c.title_ko: IBM Research, CUGA로 인도 지역 언어 지원 농업 음성 에이전트 구현
fcc0d450f00e61323c5d311c.summary_ko: IBM Research 연구진이 CUGA 기반으로 농업 질문에 인도 지역 언어로 답하는 음성 에이전트를 소개했다. 다국어 임베딩으로 영어 농업 안내서를 검색하고 근거 페이지와 함께 음성 답변을 제공하며, 영어 전용 임베딩에서 나타난 언어 간 검색 오류를 개선했다고 설명했다.
fcc0d450f00e61323c5d311c.background_ko: 영어로 디지털화된 지식과 지역 언어로 말하기를 선호하는 이용자 사이의 접근성 격차를 줄이기 위해 개발했다.

4e5670d5837ef7a553eb9256.title_original: Credential Remediation Is Slow When You Don’t Know What Will Break
4e5670d5837ef7a553eb9256.title_ko: GitGuardian “유출 자격증명 대응 지연, 서비스 중단 영향 파악이 관건”
4e5670d5837ef7a553eb9256.summary_ko: GitGuardian은 2022년 발견 당시 유효했던 비밀정보의 64%가 2026년 1월에도 작동했다고 보고했다. 유출 자격증명 폐기가 운영 서비스에 미칠 영향을 알기 어려워 대응이 지연된다며, 접근 권한과 노출 맥락에 따라 우선순위를 정하고 대체 자격증명 적용·모니터링 후 기존 것을 폐기하는 절차를 제안했다.
4e5670d5837ef7a553eb9256.background_ko: GitGuardian은 자격증명 폐기 시 중단될 서비스를 파악하기 어렵고 담당 조직별 정보가 분산돼 있어 유출 대응이 지연된다고 설명했다.

7c14e9c95ceacd39bbd47994.title_original: Drupal Fail2Install Exploit Details Emerge as Critical RCE Flaw Faces Active Exploitation
7c14e9c95ceacd39bbd47994.title_ko: Drupal ‘Fail2Install’ 취약점 실제 악용…CISA, 수정 기한 지정
7c14e9c95ceacd39bbd47994.summary_ko: 미 CISA가 Drupal 원격 코드 실행 취약점 CVE-2026-132165를 실제 악용 취약점 목록에 추가하고 연방기관에 2026년 11월 27일까지 수정을 요구했다. Searchlight Cyber는 서버 자원 고갈로 설치 여부 확인을 우회해 인증 없이 사이트를 장악할 수 있다고 분석했다. 수정 버전은 11.4.13, 11.3.22, 10.6.22다.
7c14e9c95ceacd39bbd47994.background_ko: Searchlight Cyber에 따르면 Drupal이 일시적인 데이터베이스 연결·확인 실패를 미설치 상태로 해석해 기존 사이트에서도 설치 절차가 다시 열릴 수 있다.

curation.reason_ko: Drupal 취약점의 실제 악용이 확인되고 CISA 수정 기한이 임박해 대응이 시급하다.

3ace55cbf6f3c4b5f967aa87.title_original: Ex-OpenAI Employee Accused of Bugging Company Offices Granted $1 Million Bail
3ace55cbf6f3c4b5f967aa87.title_ko: OpenAI 사무실 도청 혐의 전 직원, 100만 달러 보석 허가
3ace55cbf6f3c4b5f967aa87.summary_ko: 미국 연방법원이 OpenAI 사무실에 녹음 장치를 숨긴 혐의로 기소된 전 직원 Abdulrahman Alfozan의 100만 달러 보석을 허가했다. 검찰은 회의 녹음 파일을 다수 확보했지만 영업비밀 절취나 외국 대리인 활동을 뒷받침할 새 증거는 없다고 밝혔으며, 피고인은 무죄를 주장했다.

d5f49a551b9c2f8be6bda1d2.title_original: Italy and Switzerland warn of autonomous AI-driven cyberattacks
d5f49a551b9c2f8be6bda1d2.excerpt: Swiss and Italian cybersecurity agencies are warning about automated cyberattacks powered by AI agents targeting organizations in the critical infrastructure sector. [...]
d5f49a551b9c2f8be6bda1d2.title_ko: 이탈리아·스위스, 핵심 인프라 겨냥한 자율 AI 사이버공격 경고
d5f49a551b9c2f8be6bda1d2.summary_ko: 이탈리아와 스위스 사이버보안 기관은 AI 에이전트가 취약점 탐색부터 침투까지 자동화한 공격으로 핵심 인프라를 포함한 조직들이 피해를 입었다고 밝혔다. 이탈리아에서는 여러 에이전트가 병렬로 작동해 수시간 내 다수 시스템을 침해한 사례도 관측됐다. 두 기관은 인터넷 노출 축소, 신속한 패치와 이상 활동 감시를 권고했다.
d5f49a551b9c2f8be6bda1d2.background_ko: 공격자들은 인터넷에 노출된 시스템의 알려진 취약점, 잘못된 설정과 취약한 비밀번호를 AI 에이전트로 탐색·악용해 내부망 침투로 연결했다.

curation.reason_ko: 이탈리아·스위스 기관이 핵심 인프라를 포함한 조직 대상 AI 자동화 공격 피해를 경고했다.

8026210b8b2332218dad03b7.title_original: CISA warns of critical unpatched flaw in Danfoss refrigeration controllers
8026210b8b2332218dad03b7.excerpt: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) is warning about a critical vulnerability in Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controllers used by food retailers to manage commercial refrigeration, HVAC, and lighting systems. [...]
8026210b8b2332218dad03b7.title_ko: CISA, Danfoss 냉장 제어기 미패치 치명적 취약점 경고
8026210b8b2332218dad03b7.summary_ko: CISA는 Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA 냉장 설비 제어기에서 위험도 9.8의 CVE-2026-129713 취약점을 경고했다. 인증 없이 서버 재시작을 유발하고 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다. 패치는 아직 없으며 Danfoss는 5.5.x에서 수정할 예정이라고 밝혔고, 관리자는 인터넷 노출 최소화와 제어망 분리 등을 권고받았다.
8026210b8b2332218dad03b7.background_ko: 컨트롤러 서버의 스택 기반 버퍼 오버플로로 인해 인증되지 않은 공격자가 서버를 재시작시키거나 웹 서버 권한으로 코드를 실행할 가능성이 있다.

curation.reason_ko: 상업용 냉장 설비 제어기의 인증 없는 코드 실행 가능 결함에 아직 패치가 없다.

05fe66d9d61f3dcf51d1ce75.title_original: More Pentests Without More Pentesters: Where AI Safely Helps
05fe66d9d61f3dcf51d1ce75.excerpt: Penetration testers spend a significant portion of their engagements on documentation, reporting, and other tasks outside of testing. PentestPad explains how AI can reduce this workload, help teams handle more engagements, and keep sensitive client data within their own infrastructure. [...]
05fe66d9d61f3dcf51d1ce75.title_ko: 모의침투 보고서에 AI 활용…검증·위험도 판단에는 사람의 감독 강조
05fe66d9d61f3dcf51d1ce75.summary_ko: PentestPad를 소개하는 글은 AI를 모의침투 결과 초안 작성, 스캐너 출력 중복 제거, 보고서 일관성 검토에 활용하는 방안을 제시했다. 위험도 판단과 공격 검증에는 사람의 감독을 유지하고, 고객 취약점 정보의 외부 전송을 피하도록 자체 호스팅 LLM을 사용하는 구성을 설명했다.
05fe66d9d61f3dcf51d1ce75.background_ko: DORA·NIS2 등에 따른 모의침투 수요 증가에도 숙련 인력이 부족하고 문서화·검토 등 비테스트 업무 부담이 크다는 문제의식에서 출발했다.

63ca5fc65a0c1d72b1f9c1c7.title_original: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances
63ca5fc65a0c1d72b1f9c1c7.excerpt: Eclypsium's November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves. [...]
63ca5fc65a0c1d72b1f9c1c7.title_ko: Eclypsium “악용 취약점 포함 공지 대부분이 장비 내 타사 SW 문제”
63ca5fc65a0c1d72b1f9c1c7.summary_ko: Eclypsium의 11월 InfraTrust 보고서에 따르면 실제 악용 취약점을 포함한 인프라 보안 공지 38건 중 33건이 PHP·Node.js·OpenSSH 등 내장된 타사 구성요소와 관련됐다. 보고서는 공급사의 패치 반영 지연을 지적하며 관리 인터페이스의 인터넷 노출 차단과 내부 분리, 기존 노출 장비의 백도어 점검을 권고했다.
63ca5fc65a0c1d72b1f9c1c7.background_ko: 소프트웨어 개발사가 수정본을 내더라도 장비 공급사가 이를 제품에 반영해야 하므로 고객의 취약점 노출이 이어질 수 있다.

98846087f8cfd78661ce3b9f.excerpt: The Drupal security team has confirmed that a critical vulnerability that lets attackers hijack unpatched sites has been actively exploited since at least Thursday. [...]

32fbd2c2b42716ed28676182.title_original: Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
32fbd2c2b42716ed28676182.excerpt: Attackers are probing GeoServer instances for two high-severity flaws that can be chained with other bugs for unauthenticated RCE. The post Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack appeared first on SecurityWeek .
32fbd2c2b42716ed28676182.title_ko: GeoServer 신규 취약점 2건 악용 시도…원격 코드 실행 성공은 미확인
32fbd2c2b42716ed28676182.summary_ko: WatchTowr가 GeoServer의 XML 주입·접근통제 우회 취약점을 겨냥한 탐색 시도를 관측했다. 다른 결함과 결합하면 인증 없는 원격 코드 실행이 가능하지만, 실제 공격에서 실행에 성공한 사례는 보고하지 않았다. 수정 버전인 3.0.2·2.28.6·2.27.7로 업그레이드가 권고됐다.
32fbd2c2b42716ed28676182.background_ko: XML 주입과 접근통제 우회 결함이 다른 취약점과 연계되면 인증 없이 관리자 권한을 얻고 명령을 실행할 수 있다.

eff94e38e698137587705856.title_original: ShinyHunters Claims Comeback, New Inception Group Rejects Alleged Ties
eff94e38e698137587705856.excerpt: An account tied to ShinyHunters announced the group’s return, as Okta spots possible links between Inception and ShinyHunters hackers. The post ShinyHunters Claims Comeback, New Inception Group Rejects Alleged Ties appeared first on SecurityWeek .
eff94e38e698137587705856.title_ko: ShinyHunters 복귀 주장 진위 불명…Inception은 연계설 부인
eff94e38e698137587705856.summary_ko: ShinyHunters 복귀를 주장하는 게시물이 등장했지만, 신원 확인에 쓰인 기존 PGP 키가 유출됐다는 보도가 있어 사칭 가능성이 남아 있다. Okta는 새 갈취 조직 Inception과의 연계 가능성을 제기했으나 확정하지 못했고, Inception은 이를 부인했다. 유출됐다고 주장하는 기업 데이터의 진위도 독립적으로 확인되지 않았다.

164b26cdbced951df72852ae.title_original: 구글 크롬, 샌드박스 외부 코드 실행 취약점(CVE-2026-134401) 긴급 업데이트 권고
164b26cdbced951df72852ae.excerpt: 이미지 생성형 AI 제작 Google이 Chrome 브라우저의 Variations 구성 요소에서 발견된 Critical 등급 취약점(CVE-2026-134401)을 수정한 보안 업데이트를 배포했습니다. 이번 취약점은 공격자가 조작한 웹 페이지(HTML)를 사용자가 여는 것만으로 Chrome 샌드박스 밖에서 임의 코드가 실행 될 수 있는 취약점입니다. Chrome은 웹 페이지를 처리하는 프로세스를 샌드박스 안에 격리해 브라우저 취약점이 곧바로 PC 침해로 이어지지 않도록 설계되어 있는데, 이번 취약점은 그 격리 경계를 넘어설 수 있다는 점에서 Google이 가장 높은 등급인 Critical로 분류했습니다. 2026년 11월 23일(현지 시각) 배포된 데스크톱용 Stable 채널 업데이트는 이 취약점 1건만을 수정하기 위한 업데이트이며, 같은 날 Extended Stable 채널과 Android용 Chrome에도 수정 버전이 배포되었습니다. 현재까지 실제 공격에 악용된 사례나 공개된 PoC(개념증명 코드)는 확인되지 않았습니다. 다만 Chrome은 업데이트를 내려받은 뒤 브라우저를 다시 시작해야 패치가 적용되므로, 사용자분들께서는 버전을 확인하고 신속히 업데이트해 주시기 바랍니다. 취약점 개요 CVE CVE-2026-134401 취약점 유형 Variations 구성 요소의 부적절한 입력 검증으로 인한 샌드박스 외부 임의 코드 실행 CWE-20(Improper Input Validation) 심각도 Critical : Chromium 보안 심각도 기준 CVSS v3.1 9.6 (Critical) 영향 대상 Google Chrome 158.0.8127.88 미만 버전 (Windows / macOS / Linux / Android) 공격 조건 인증 불필요, 사용자 상호작용 필요(조작된 웹 페이지 열람) PoC 공개 공개된 PoC 없음 (취약점 상세 정보 비공개 상태) 실제 악용 11월 25일 기준 확인된 실제 악용 사례 없음 (CISA KEV 미등재) 조치 Chrome 158.0.8127.88 이상으로 업데이트 후 브라우저 재시작 ■ 사용자 권고 사항 Chrome 주소창에 chrome://settings/help 를 입력해 현재 버전을 확인합니다. 158.0.8127.88 미만이면 업데이트를 진행하고, 업데이트 후 [다시 시작] 버튼을 눌러 브라우저를 재시작합니다. 브라우저를 며칠씩 닫지 않고 사용하는 경우 업데이트가 내려받아져 있어도 적용되지 않은 상태일 수 있으므로, 반드시 재시작 여부를 확인합니다. As of November 2026, Microsoft Threat Intelligence has observed both state-sponsored and financially motivated threat actors such as Storm-0940 , Storm-3358 , Onyx Sleet , Pearl Sleet , Crystal Typhoon, and Salt Typhoon integrating ARTEX into their tooling. In the past few weeks, we’ve reported several distinct campaigns that abused ARTEX to search public repositories for exposed secrets, enable supply chain compromise, and scan internet-facing systems for exploitation. These campaigns illustrate how threat actors use ARTEX to automate various stages of the attack chain. Threat actors define scope and targets for ARTEX, which then uses AI agents to set verifiable goals, define tactical steps for each stage of the operation, use tools to attack targets, create graphs to track discovered systems and results of actions, and report back to the threat actor. 3a2d3dc501a4e3f27308b5b0.title_original: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Security
3a2d3dc501a4e3f27308b5b0.excerpt: We’re honored to share that Microsoft has once again been named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Email Security. AI is changing the threat landscape and this is shifting how organizations think about their existing security strategy. In response, we’ve invested in two areas over the past year: using AI to protect people and the agents that now read their email and making protection measurable so customers can verify that it works. AI is changing both sides of the inbox The first area of investment starts with a simple reality: AI now reads email alongside people, attackers are using AI to target both, and defense must use AI to stay ahead. Picture an ordinary vendor email: a meeting recap, a few action items, and a friendly sign-off. Hidden in white text on a white background is prompt injection: an instruction telling an AI assistant to gather financial documents and send them to an outside address. The employee isn’t the target; their AI agent is. People can be persuaded by messages that exploit fear, trust, or urgency, but agents don’t need persuading. Once an agent acts on an instruction, pulling the message back won’t undo it. This is why Microsoft Defender stops malicious messages before delivery and keeps reevaluating delivered mail as new intelligence comes in. b1623904dfbbd3bf72e57ca0.title_original: The Great Escape: Tradecraft insights from an agentic swarm
b1623904dfbbd3bf72e57ca0.excerpt: The OpenAI-linked swarm activity in 2026 is fully traceable through public records and offers an unprecedented view into how multi-agent AI systems operate and coordinate at scale. Distilling and documenting the swarm tradecraft may help defenders understand multi-agent operations and communication, and how agents adapt when a path is blocked. Some documented behaviors may transfer to more purpose-built cyber attack frameworks like ARTEX, including methods to persistently store results, the burst-and-pause timing patterns of reasoning loops, and the self-labeling conventions that can reveal workload assignments and distribution. Beginning in June 2026 and extending for several months, a collection of OpenAI models conducting internal training and evaluation tasks broke out of their containerized environments and accessed websites and databases via the public internet in ways the company says it did not authorize . This activity represents a new kind of cyber event: not a malicious intrusion, but an unintentional series of consequences stemming from an agentic swarm , a group of AI agents exhibiting coordinated behavior toward a shared objective. A swarm implies many agents but doesn’t have a rigid count. The main distinction is behavioral; the collective activity of a swarm becomes complex and unpredictable even when individual agents may be explainable. Pierre takes us back to his early days on help desks in the 90s, where learning to correlate logs between Windows and Unix systems sparked the curiosity that eventually led him to security. It’s a great look at how someone who has seen the industry evolve over decades stays grounded and keeps their edge. We also get into what’s kept Pierre at Cisco for nearly ten years. He talks about why he prioritizes the human impact of our work, the importance of knowing when to step away from the keyboard, and how his background in anthropology actually informs the way he approaches threat intelligence today. Amy Ciminnisi: I've known you since you were in Talos IR, which was not too long ago. But tell me a little bit about your professional journey, because I know that definitely was not the start of it. Pierre Cadieux: I worked at an ISP as part of the help desk back in the mid-90s. I was one of the people who people would call up and say, "Hey, I've got this computer I just bought, how do I get it on the internet?" I did a lot of learning about what TCP/IP was, what networking was, how to connect things via various different types of connections — whether it be an actual hard-coded network connection or a dial-up connection — and was able to get some expertise around guiding people through that process. 0b8f7119751e9825937c2331.title_original: Rapid7 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Integrated Security Operations Center Systems
0b8f7119751e9825937c2331.excerpt: Recognized for Completeness of Vision and Ability to Execute. We are proud to share that Rapid7 has been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Integrated Security Operations Center Systems. Our perspective: less stitching, more stopping threats Most security teams don't struggle to find tools. They struggle to make them work together. We believe SOC analysts lose too much of their day moving between consoles and matching alerts to assets by hand, which is time not spent stopping threats. To us, an integrated approach to security operations means detection, investigation and response working from the same data and the same view, so analysts can get from "what fired?" to "what do we do about it?" faster. The importance of exposure management in the SOC Rapid7 Incident Command, part of the Rapid7 Command Platform, brings together SIEM, SOAR, DFIR, attack surface management and threat intelligence. We built it on the idea that exposure management, and the context it brings, belongs inside the SOC, not next to it. In our view, when an alert arrives with what we know about the asset and how exposed it is, analysts can prioritize what matters instead of working from separate vulnerability reports and alert queues. Context to act, not another console to check We believe adopting an integrated SOC shouldn't be all-or-nothing. 3cefc9fd3cbdcac5020a7726.excerpt: Rapid7’s annual Security Predictions webinar returns on December 10, bringing our experts together to explore what the year ahead could hold for cybersecurity. Before sharing our predictions for 2027, we’re grading last year’s calls: that geopolitical tensions would reshape cyber threats, insider threats would dominate breach root causes, and context would become the new currency of cyber performance. Register here for the 2027 Security Predictions webinar . As security leaders work through their priorities for 2027, those predictions offer a useful starting point. The year reinforced several of the concerns we highlighted, while developments in attacker behavior and AI added new dimensions to the discussion. Looking at how those themes unfolded helps us understand what remains relevant and where our thinking needs to evolve. Geopolitics shaped cyber targeting, with businesses caught in the middle Our prediction that geopolitical fault lines would redraw the cyber battlefield earned an A-, as regional conflicts created opportunities for espionage, disruption, and public pressure throughout 2026. Cyber operations allowed adversaries to pursue those objectives below the threshold of open warfare, with commercial organizations exposed alongside government and critical infrastructure targets. 137720f6241d5fc11aa88dba.title_original: CVE-2026-123903: Critical VMware Directory Service Authentication Bypass affects vCenter
137720f6241d5fc11aa88dba.excerpt: Overview On November 24, 2026, Broadcom released VMware Security Advisory VMSA-2026-0011 to address several new vulnerabilities, including CVE-2026-123903 , a critical authentication bypass in the VMware Directory Service component of vCenter. Broadcom assigned it a CVSSv3.1 score of 9.8 Critical . An attacker who can reach an affected vCenter’s VMware Directory Service (vmdir) over the network can gain access without authenticating. Broadcom's supplemental FAQ distinguishes CVE-2026-123903 from an older vulnerability CVE-2026-123890 , which Rapid7 covered previously when CVE-2026-123890 was reported as being exploited in the wild. Both of these vulnerabilities affect the VMware Directory Service in vCenter and can give an attacker access to the vCenter without credentials. CVE-2026-123890 was reachable over RPC while CVE-2026-123903 is reachable over LDAP. As of this writing, there are no known public reports of exploitation of CVE-2026-123903 in the wild. A public proof-of-concept exploit is available and has been validated by Rapid7 to successfully achieve an authentication bypass. Attackers are known to be targeting vulnerabilities in the VMware Directory Service, therefore Rapid7 recommends remediating exposed systems on an urgent basis outside of normal patching cycles. Mitigation guidance Vendor updates are available for CVE-2026-123903. Broadcom lists no workaround , and these vCenter updates are not eligible for Quick Patch. 3f254e731abd478d4d777bfa.excerpt: 제주도가 풍력·태양광 발전량이 많은 시간대에 AI 연산을 집중하는 40메가와트(MW)급 데이터센터 구축을 구상하고 있다. 재생에너지 활용도를 높이는 동시에 지역 산업의 AI 전환을 지원한다는 계획이다.제주도는 24일 AI 데이터센터 조성 방향과 전력 수급, 환경 영향, 지역경제 파급효과 등을 논의하기 위해 다음 달 2일 제주웰컴센터에서 도민토론회를 개최한다고 밝혔다.도는 지난 9월 제주권 AI 대전환 사업의 세부 실행계획 마련에 나섰다. 수전용량 40MW 규모의 AI 데이터센터를 중심으로 재생에너지 발전량에 따라 연산 작업을 배치하
3f254e731abd478d4d777bfa.title_ko: 제주, 재생에너지 발전량에 맞춰 연산하는 40MW AI 데이터센터 구상
3f254e731abd478d4d777bfa.summary_ko: 제주도가 재생에너지 발전량에 맞춰 AI 연산 작업을 배치하는 수전용량 40MW 규모 데이터센터를 구상하고 있다. 2028~2032년 국책사업으로 추진하며, 연산자원을 지역 전략산업과 관광·농업 분야 AI 서비스 실증에 활용할 계획이다. 전력 수급과 환경 영향 등을 논의하는 도민토론회도 열 예정이다.
3f254e731abd478d4d777bfa.background_ko: 제주에서는 풍력·태양광 발전량이 전력 수요나 전력망 수용능력을 초과해 발전량을 강제로 줄이는 출력제어가 발생해 왔다.

a3f45a3565433d296bc2a0ca.title_original: 약품비 4%·전력비 5% 절감…지자체 정수장에도 AI 도입 확대
a3f45a3565433d296bc2a0ca.excerpt: 한국수자원공사가 전국 광역정수장에 적용한 AI 기술이 지방자치단체 정수장으로 확대되고 있다. 부산에 이어 수원시가 AI 정수장 구축을 추진하고 있으며 전남광주에서도 수질 이상을 예측하는 시스템을 자체 개발해 활용하고 있다.수원시는 25일 한국수자원공사와 광교정수장의 AI 기술 도입을 위한 컨설팅을 마쳤다고 밝혔다. 내년 시설 개선을 거쳐 2028년 AI 기반 스마트 정수장을 구축한다는 목표다.수원은 시설 개선과 데이터 수집 체계 구축을 시작으로 주요 정수 공정에 AI를 적용한 뒤 전체 공정으로 확대할 계획이다. 약품 투입량과 정수
a3f45a3565433d296bc2a0ca.title_ko: AI 정수장, 지자체로 확대…수원 2028년·부산 2029년 구축 목표
a3f45a3565433d296bc2a0ca.summary_ko: 수원시는 광교정수장에 2028년까지 AI 기반 스마트 정수장을 구축하고, 부산시는 2029년까지 명장정수장에 AI 자율 운영시스템을 도입할 계획이다. 한국수자원공사는 전국 43개 광역정수장에 AI를 적용해 약품비 4%, 전력비 5%를 절감했다고 밝혔다. 정부는 AI 정수장의 법적 운영 근거와 표준 마련도 추진한다.
a3f45a3565433d296bc2a0ca.background_ko: AI 정수장 기술은 실시간 수질·설비 데이터를 분석해 약품 투입과 공정 운영을 최적화하고 수요와 설비 고장을 예측하는 데 활용된다.

c8af9f9ed48bc670ad1ccdde.title_original: 농촌진흥청, 토마토 물·양분 자동 공급 AI 개발…관리시간 최대 80% 단축
c8af9f9ed48bc670ad1ccdde.excerpt: 농촌진흥청이 AI로 토마토 생육 상태를 분석해 필요한 물과 양분을 자동 공급하는 기술을 개발했다. 실제 농가에서 양액 관리시간이 최대 80% 줄었으며, 전남광주에서도 AI로 작물 생육을 진단하고 재배 판단을 돕는 기술의 현장실증을 추진하고 있다.농촌진흥청은 25일 AI 생육 감지 시스템과 지능형 양액 공급장치를 결합한 자동화 시스템 'AI-뉴티(AI-Nutie)'를 개발했다고 밝혔다. 토마토의 생육 상태를 감지하는 것부터 물과 양분의 공급량을 결정하고 실제 공급하는 과정까지 AI로 통합한 기술이다.기존 수경재배에서는 농업인이 작물
c8af9f9ed48bc670ad1ccdde.title_ko: 농진청, 토마토 양액 자동 공급 AI 개발…실증서 관리시간 최대 80% 단축
c8af9f9ed48bc670ad1ccdde.summary_ko: 농촌진흥청이 온실 CCTV 영상과 환경·급배액 데이터를 분석해 토마토에 물과 양분을 자동 공급하는 ‘AI-뉴티’를 개발했다. 농진청은 완주군 농가 실증에서 숙련 농가의 공급·배액 관리 유형을 평균 98.5% 정확도로 구현하고 관리시간을 최대 80% 줄였다고 밝혔다. 2027년부터 중소 영농법인 대상 보급을 추진한다.
c8af9f9ed48bc670ad1ccdde.background_ko: 기존 수경재배에서는 농업인이 작물 상태를 살피며 양액 농도와 공급량을 조절하고 측정·조성·기록을 반복해야 해 시간과 경험이 필요했다.

e6a49978c3d00642c54091e9.title_original: 화순전남대병원, 암 환자 진료서류 AI로 요약…의료진 기록 업무 40% 단축 목표
e6a49978c3d00642c54091e9.excerpt: 화순전남대병원이 다른 의료기관에서 전달받은 암 환자의 진료의뢰서와 소견서를 AI로 분석·요약하는 기술을 개발하고 있다. 의료진의 서류 확인과 의무기록 입력 시간을 40% 이상 줄이는 것이 목표다.AI 플랫폼 기업 아이티아이즈는 25일 화순전남대병원에 의료 AI 플랫폼 '제나이 미(GENAI ME)' 기반 맞춤형 AI 솔루션을 공급했다고 밝혔다. 이 솔루션은 병원이 추진하는 암 환자 진료의뢰서 자동 구조화·요약 에이전트 개발 연구과제에 적용될 예정이다.연구는 지난 2월부터 이정호 화순전남대병원 응급의학과 교수가 맡아 진행하고 있으며,
e6a49978c3d00642c54091e9.title_ko: 화순전남대병원, 암 환자 진료서류 AI 요약 개발…기록 업무 40% 단축 목표
e6a49978c3d00642c54091e9.summary_ko: 화순전남대병원이 아이티아이즈의 ‘GENAI ME’를 활용해 암 환자 진료의뢰서와 소견서를 자동 구조화·요약하는 AI 에이전트를 개발한다. 내부 서버의 소형언어모델에 OCR과 시각언어모델을 결합하며, 의료진의 서류 확인·의무기록 입력 시간을 40% 이상 줄이는 것이 목표다.
e6a49978c3d00642c54091e9.background_ko: 다른 병원에서 전달되는 진료기록이 수십~수백 장이거나 스캔 이미지 형태이면 의료진이 직접 읽고 전자의무기록에 다시 정리해야 하는 부담이 있다.

84488968f34702ef52c11262.title_original: 전남광주, 공무원 5000명에 AI 보급 추진…영국선 하루 26분 업무시간 절감 보고
84488968f34702ef52c11262.excerpt: 전남광주통합특별시가 공무원 약 5000명에게 생성형 AI 업무 도구를 보급하기 위해 2027년 예산안에 4억원을 편성했다. 정부가 공무원 업무망에서 활용하는 AI 서비스를 확대하는 가운데 영국에서는 공무원 2만명을 대상으로 한 별도의 AI 실증에서 하루 평균 26분의 업무시간을 줄였다는 결과가 나왔다.전남광주통합특별시의회가 24일 공개한 자료에 따르면 지난 23일 열린 2027년도 본예산안 심사에서 공무원 'AI 도구 지원' 예산의 실효성이 논의됐다. 해당 사업 예산은 올해 2160만원에서 내년 4억원으로 약 18.5배 늘어났다.통
84488968f34702ef52c11262.title_ko: 전남광주, 공무원 5000명에 온AI 보급 추진…2027년 예산안 4억원 편성
84488968f34702ef52c11262.summary_ko: 전남광주통합특별시가 공무원 약 5000명에게 행정망용 AI 플랫폼 ‘온AI’를 제공하기 위해 2027년 예산안에 4억원을 편성했다. 의회 심사에서는 기능과 비용 대비 효과, 실제 활용도와 성과 측정이 쟁점이 됐다. 기사에서 소개한 영국의 하루 평균 26분 절감 수치는 별도 실증에 참여한 공무원들의 설문 응답 결과다.
84488968f34702ef52c11262.background_ko: 정부는 공무원이 업무망에서 자료 검색과 문서 작성에 AI를 활용하도록 온AI의 도입 기관과 업무 기능을 확대하고 있다.

c4056424b06cea9b3e3d4a26.title_original: 인천공항, AI 에이전트 운영 검증 완료…상황 대응 시간 최대 65% 단축 기대
c4056424b06cea9b3e3d4a26.excerpt: 인천국제공항공사가 AI 에이전트를 활용해 공항 운영 효율과 비상 상황 대응 역량을 높이는 방안을 검증했다.인천국제공항공사와 글로벌 항공 IT 기업 시타(SITA)는 인천공항 통합운영센터에 에이전틱 AI를 적용하기 위한 개념검증(PoC)을 완료했다고 25일 밝혔다.양측은 지난 5월부터 6개월간 시타의 AI 에이전트 플랫폼 '뉴럴 옵스(Neural Ops)'를 활용해 기상 악화와 항공기 회항, 여객 밀집 등 주요 상황에 대한 대응 기능을 점검했다.AI 에이전트는 실시간 공항 운영정보와 표준운영절차를 바탕으로 위험 수준을 분석하고 대응
c4056424b06cea9b3e3d4a26.title_ko: 인천공항·SITA, 운영 AI 에이전트 개념검증 완료…대응 시간 단축 기대
c4056424b06cea9b3e3d4a26.summary_ko: 인천국제공항공사와 SITA가 6개월간 ‘Neural Ops’를 활용해 기상 악화·항공기 회항·여객 밀집 대응 기능의 개념검증을 완료했다. AI는 실시간 운영정보와 표준운영절차를 분석해 대응안을 제시하며, 공사는 업무 통합 시 상황 인지부터 대응·정보 전파까지 걸리는 시간을 최대 65% 줄일 수 있을 것으로 예상했다.
c4056424b06cea9b3e3d4a26.background_ko: 공항 운영 효율과 비상 대응 역량을 높이기 위해 기존에 개별적으로 처리하던 상황 인지·대응·정보 공유 업무를 하나의 플랫폼으로 통합하는 방안을 검증했다.

2b0cb30c4c045c6979103786.title_original: AI 투자 불안에 기술주 하락 지속…앤트로픽 장중 74달러까지 밀려
2b0cb30c4c045c6979103786.excerpt: 미국 증시에서 AI 관련 기술주가 이틀 연속 하락했다. 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO의 복귀 효과도 사라졌으며, 앤트로픽은 장중 74달러 아래까지 떨어졌다가 반등했으나 공모가 회복에는 실패했다.25일(현지시간) 뉴욕 증시에서 주요 AI 관련 기술주는 장 초반 급락했으나 오후 들어 저가 매수세가 유입되며 낙폭을 줄였다.앤트로픽은 장중 공모가를 11% 밑도는 73.85달러까지 떨어졌다가 전날 대비 1.1% 상승한 82.79달러로 거래를 마쳤다. 반등에도 불구하고 지난주 기업공개(IPO) 당시 확정한 공모가 83달러를 이틀 연속 밑돌았다.엔비
2b0cb30c4c045c6979103786.title_ko: AI 투자 수익성 우려에 미국 기술주 약세…앤트로픽 공모가 하회
2b0cb30c4c045c6979103786.summary_ko: 기사에 따르면 미국 증시에서 AI 관련 기술주가 이틀 연속 약세를 보였으며, 엔비디아는 3.9% 하락 마감했다. 앤트로픽은 장중 73.85달러까지 밀린 뒤 82.79달러로 반등했지만 공모가 83달러를 밑돌았다. 보도는 AI 데이터센터 투자에 따른 부채 부담과 수익성 우려가 투자 심리를 압박했다고 전했다.
2b0cb30c4c045c6979103786.background_ko: 대규모 부채를 통한 AI 데이터센터 투자 부담에 미국의 물가 상승과 금리 인상 가능성까지 겹치며 기술주 투자 심리가 위축됐다고 보도됐다.

0dffe0b2df6086ea4fe64670.summary_ko: 더플러스는 AI 영상분석 소프트웨어 ‘T-AIPLUS V1.0’이 KISA 지능형 CCTV 성능시험의 배회·침입·싸움·방화 감지 항목을 통과했다고 밝혔다. 배회·침입·싸움은 가시광과 적외선 영상 조건에서 기준을 충족했다. 이 소프트웨어는 CCTV의 이상행동과 위험상황을 탐지하며, NVR 자체 분석이나 전용 서버 연동 방식으로 적용된다.
0dffe0b2df6086ea4fe64670.background_ko: 지자체 CCTV 관제체계의 지능화와 산업현장의 AI 영상분석 수요 확대로 이상행동 탐지 기술의 신뢰성이 중요해지고 있다.

55c3da1a66944d8799b3296c.summary_ko: FIFA가 제한된 범위의 개인·업무 정보에 대한 무단 접근을 인정하고 관계 당국과 협력하고 있다고 밝혔다. 해킹 조직 Handsome Boy Hacking Club은 12GB 이상을 탈취해 공개했다고 주장했으나, 데이터 규모와 세부 내용은 확인되지 않았다. FIFA는 구체적인 유출 정보와 침입 경로를 밝히지 않았다.

766f173649cd6d289df84384.title_ko: Amazon Ring, 센서와 연동해 실내 감시하는 자율비행 보안 드론 출시
766f173649cd6d289df84384.summary_ko: Amazon의 홈보안 브랜드 Ring이 침입 감지 센서와 연동해 실내를 자율비행하는 보안 드론을 출시했다고 밝혔다. 이상 신호가 발생한 구역으로 이동해 스마트폰으로 영상을 전송하며, 원격 이동과 경고 방송도 지원한다. 평소에는 카메라가 가려진 도킹 스테이션에 머물도록 설계됐다.
766f173649cd6d289df84384.background_ko: 고정형 카메라의 감시 사각지대를 보완하면서 실내 상시 촬영에 따른 사생활 침해 우려를 줄이려는 취지다.

ccf34fc27e461520e0b2501d.title_original: Palo Alto Networks warns of Fragnesia flaw exploited in PAN-OS attacks
ccf34fc27e461520e0b2501d.excerpt: Threat actors are chaining exploits for the PHP2Shell and Fragnesia vulnerabilities to target Palo Alto Networks devices with management interfaces exposed to the internet. [...]
ccf34fc27e461520e0b2501d.title_ko: Palo Alto Networks, PAN-OS 대상 Fragnesia 연계 공격 확인
ccf34fc27e461520e0b2501d.summary_ko: Palo Alto Networks가 인터넷에 관리 인터페이스를 노출한 PAN-OS 장비에서 Fragnesia 악용을 확인했다. 공격자는 PHP2Shell과 Fragnesia를 연계해 원격 코드 실행 후 루트 권한을 얻는다. 회사는 PAN-OS 10.2·11.1·11.2·12.1·12.2용 수정본을 배포하고 관리 인터페이스 접근 제한을 권고했다.
ccf34fc27e461520e0b2501d.background_ko: 인터넷에 노출된 관리 인터페이스를 대상으로 PHP2Shell의 원격 코드 실행 취약점과 리눅스 커널 Fragnesia의 권한 상승 취약점이 연계 악용됐다.

9ef6249717e3504062259334.title_ko: 1Password, 직원 GitHub 계정 침해로 고객 정보 유출 공개
9ef6249717e3504062259334.summary_ko: 1Password는 직원의 기업용 GitHub 계정이 침해돼 고객 이름·이메일·계정 메타데이터와 내부 소스코드 등이 유출됐다고 밝혔다. 회사는 비밀번호 보관함과 암호화 키는 침해되지 않았고, 탈취된 토큰만으로는 고객 계정에 접근할 수 없다고 설명했다. 침해 계정 비활성화와 자격증명 교체·폐기 등을 진행했으며, 내부 조사에서 고객 계정 탈취 증거는 찾지 못했다고 밝혔다.
9ef6249717e3504062259334.background_ko: 회사에 따르면 공격자는 침해한 직원 GitHub 계정으로 비공개 소스 저장소에 접근하고 백엔드 서비스에 악성 코드를 삽입해 고객 계정 기록을 내려받았다.

curation.reason_ko: 1Password가 직원 GitHub 계정 침해를 통한 악성 코드 배포와 고객 데이터 탈취를 공개했다.

673dfe785d8a9c30d54dc81c.title_original: AI가 작성한 코드, 같은 AI가 검토...개발 조직 절반 가까이 활용

673dfe785d8a9c30d54dc81c.title_ko: 개발 조직 47%, 코드 작성 AI에 검토도 맡겨…이해도·책임 체계는 과제
673dfe785d8a9c30d54dc81c.summary_ko: CodeRabbit이 후원한 LeadDev의 미국·유럽 개발자·엔지니어링 책임자 377명 조사에서 47%가 코드 작성 AI에 검토도 맡긴다고 답했다. AI 도입 후 코드 검토가 느려졌다는 응답은 38%였고, AI 생성 코드를 충분히 이해한다고 확신한 응답자는 26%에 그쳤다.
673dfe785d8a9c30d54dc81c.background_ko: AI 코딩 도구 도입으로 코드 생산량과 변경 규모가 늘었지만 검토 속도는 따라가지 못해 코드 검토가 개발 과정의 병목으로 부상했다.

AI가 모든 분야에서 인간을 능가하지 않더라도 자기개선에 필요한 능력을 집중적으로 높일 수 있으며, 향후 1~2년간 AI 기술의 급격한 발전이 이어질 것으로 전망했다.브라운 부사장은 24일(현지시간) 세쿼이아 캐피털이 공개한 인터뷰에서 AI의 재귀적 자기개선 가능성과 기술 발전 속도에 관한 견해를 밝혔다. 그는 2024년 오픈AI의 첫 추론 모델 'o1' 개발을 주도한 핵
61e4d79263d06cb7ab84dda6.title_ko: OpenAI 노엄 브라운 “AI 자기개선, 인류의 기술 발전과 같은 구조”
61e4d79263d06cb7ab84dda6.summary_ko: OpenAI의 노엄 브라운은 AI의 재귀적 자기개선을 기존 기술로 새 기술을 만드는 인류의 발전 과정에 비유했다. 모든 분야에서 인간을 능가하지 않아도 AI 연구 역량을 높여 차세대 모델 개발을 가속할 수 있다고 주장했으며, 컴퓨팅 자원과 장기 계획·오류 수정 능력의 한계도 지적했다.
61e4d79263d06cb7ab84dda6.background_ko: 브라운은 2022~2023년에도 LLM으로 차세대 모델의 사전학습 데이터 품질을 평가했다며, AI를 활용한 AI 개발이 이미 진행돼 왔다고 설명했다.

104f73c75cfb9e1351f1ba31.title_original: [게시판] 인핸스, 국방정보본부 'AI 민간자문기업' 위촉 등 단신
104f73c75cfb9e1351f1ba31.excerpt: ■ 인핸스(대표 이승현)는 국방정보본부 AI 민간자문기업으로 위촉됐다고 밝혔다. 국방정보본부는 군사정보 분석 역량 강화와 국방 AI 발전을 위해 민간 AI 전문기업과의 협력 체계를 구축하고 있으며, 내년 말까지 데이터 표준화와 전문기술 지원 등 AI 전반에 걸쳐 자문한다. 인핸스는 온톨로지 기술과 컴퓨터 유즈 AI 에이전트 기술을 결합한 '에이전트 운영체제(OS)'로 기업·기관 업무에 AI를 적용 중이다.■ 엘리스그룹(대표 김재원)은 다양한 생성형 AI 모델과 도구를 쓸 수 있는 기관 전용 AI 솔루션 '헬피챗(Helpy Chat)

104f73c75cfb9e1351f1ba31.summary_ko: 인핸스가 국방정보본부 AI 민간자문기업으로 위촉돼 데이터 표준화와 전문기술 지원 등을 자문한다. 엘리스그룹은 충남교육청 플랫폼에 기관용 AI 솔루션을 적용했고, 액션파워는 회의 기록을 종합해 답하는 ‘다글로챗’을 추가했다. 인텔리빅스는 악천후와 야간에도 객체를 탐지하는 AI 비전 센서 ‘빅스올캠’이 국가정보원 보안기능 확인서를 획득했다고 밝혔다.
104f73c75cfb9e1351f1ba31.background_ko: 국방정보본부는 군사정보 분석 역량 강화와 국방 AI 발전을 위해 민간 AI 전문기업과 협력 체계를 구축하고 있다.

ae99bc2dfcece3700a2cd578.title_original: 오픈AI, 기업 데이터 보호 강화한 '프라이빗 추론' 테스트

ae99bc2dfcece3700a2cd578.title_ko: 오픈AI, 연산 중 기업 데이터 접근 차단하는 ‘프라이빗 추론’ 시험
ae99bc2dfcece3700a2cd578.summary_ko: 오픈AI가 소수 기업 고객을 대상으로 ‘프라이빗 추론’을 시험하고 있다. 하드웨어로 격리된 환경에서 연산하는 기밀 컴퓨팅을 활용해, 프롬프트 처리와 응답 생성 중에도 시스템 운영자가 고객 데이터에 접근하지 못하도록 하는 것이 목표다. 지원 모델과 요금, 정식 출시 일정은 공개되지 않았다.
ae99bc2dfcece3700a2cd578.background_ko: 기존 제로 데이터 보존이 프롬프트와 응답을 저장하지 않는 데 초점을 맞췄다면, 이번 기술은 연산 중인 데이터까지 보호하려는 취지다.

curation.reason_ko: OpenAI가 연산 중 기업 데이터 접근을 차단하는 프라이빗 추론을 소수 고객에게 시험 중이다.

c1ac27f6724ab1a044baae3e.title_original: 구글, 외부 AI 에이전트에 지메일·드라이브 이용료 부과
c1ac27f6724ab1a044baae3e.excerpt: 구글이 외부 AI 에이전트의 지메일과 구글 드라이브 등 워크스페이스 서비스 접근에 사용량 제한과 유료 요금제를 도입한다. 일정 사용량까지는 무료로 제공하지만, 대규모 AI 에이전트 서비스를 운영하는 기업에는 새로운 비용 부담이 발생하게 됐다.구글은 24일(현지시간) 공식 개발자 문서를 통해 워크스페이스 API와 모델 컨텍스트 프로토콜(MCP) 서버에 '표준(Standard)'과 '확장(Scaled)' 등급을 도입한다고 밝혔다. c1ac27f6724ab1a044baae3e.title_ko: 구글, 외부 AI 에이전트의 워크스페이스 접근에 무료 한도·요금제 도입

c1ac27f6724ab1a044baae3e.background_ko: 구글은 AI 에이전트의 데이터 접근 수요가 급증해 서비스 안정성과 보안, 개인정보 보호를 위한 관리 체계가 필요해졌다고 설명했다.

94f5c068fb76e9e9be53c948.title_ko: 미국 AI 칩 규제 강화에 아시아 데이터센터 대출 77억달러 차질

94f5c068fb76e9e9be53c948.background_ko: 미국이 일부 국가로의 첨단 AI 칩 수출과 중국 기업에 일정 규모 이상의 컴퓨팅 자원을 제공하는 기존 데이터센터에 별도 허가를 요구하면서 자금 조달에 제동이 걸렸다.

26119b13870e4f7ef008e72e.title_ko: 구글 특허에 개인 맞춤형 AI TV 채널 구상…제품화 여부는 미정

2c5fa20fb1339b61cd8de331.title_ko: MS·IDC 조사 “AI 성숙도 상위 기업, 평균 투자수익 4배”
2c5fa20fb1339b61cd8de331.summary_ko: MS가 IDC에 의뢰해 전 세계 IT·비즈니스 고위 리더 5204명을 조사한 결과, AI 성숙도 상위 10% 기업의 평균 투자수익이 4배로 나타났다. 이들 기업에서는 전사적 활용, AI 에이전트 도입, 거버넌스와 직원 역량 강화가 함께 나타났으며, MS는 성과 확산과 통제 체계의 중요성을 강조했다.
2c5fa20fb1339b61cd8de331.background_ko: 기업 리더의 66%가 AI로 상당하거나 혁신적인 성과를 냈다고 답했지만, 이를 여러 사업 부문으로 확산하고 있는 기업은 48%에 그쳤다.

5d02daf7e88fbc52d6eb5321.excerpt: arXiv:2611.33160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Many failures of deployed AI arise not from weak inference but from a mismatch between the state a task depends on and the context available when the system acts. Relevant user state, repository revisions, tool traces, sensor readings, or environment changes may be unavailable, distorted, or poorly selected. We call the effort to reduce this bottleneck context scaling. We frame a model as $P_\theta(d\mid c)$ within a system governed by three budgets: training $B_\theta$, decision-time $B_d$, and context-infrastructure $B_c$. Pretraining scaling invests in $\theta$; decision-time scaling searches, refines, or verifies decisions under supplied context; context scaling improves the system's capacity to acquire, represent, deliver, evaluate, and persist deployment state for model use. The three programs interact, but only $B_c$ targets what the system can make available before a decision. This view makes the model-infrastructure pair the unit of analysis. We define effective-context value as a task- and intervention-dependent attribution, separate deployment state from model-visible context, and identify availability, fidelity, selection, and utilization failures. We then organize current mechanisms through a five-operation context lifecycle and propose controlled budget interventions and utility-cost curves for evaluation. The resulting agenda centers on grounded reporting, interaction-data and full-cost infrastructure, and safety

f09f1cc1fca8a580ae548b9b.title_original: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
f09f1cc1fca8a580ae548b9b.excerpt: arXiv:2611.33161v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, mathematically plausible but physically infeasible, or rated highly by a judge while quietly breaking a task requirement. We propose a scoring framework that combines a small set of hard checks every answer must pass with a wider set of softer checks whose scores are blended into one number per candidate. This adaptive scoring framework consists of three components: a drafting model that produces the candidates, a configuring model that selects and weights the checks for each task, and scoring models that rate properties no grounded tool can compute. We apply our proposed method to four tasks: writing code that is both correct and secure (CWEval), generating robot manipulation plans (LIBERO with added safety variants), passing competitive-programming hidden tests (LiveCodeBench), and answering questions from retrieved documents (HotpotQA).
