CVE-2026-135935.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Webba Plugins Webba Booking webba-booking-lite allows Code Injection.This issue affects Webba Booking: from n/a through 6.5.8.

CVE-2026-135964.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.5.

CVE-2026-135965.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.5.

CVE-2026-135966.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.5.

CVE-2026-135967.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Code Injection.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.5.

CVE-2026-135969.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons bdthemes-element-pack-lite allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Element Pack Elementor Addons: from n/a through 10.0.13.

CVE-2026-135970.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons bdthemes-element-pack-lite allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Element Pack Elementor Addons: from n/a through 10.0.13.

CVE-2026-135972.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in miniOrange Page Restriction WordPress (WP) page-and-post-restriction allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Page Restriction WordPress (WP): from n/a through 1.6.2.

CVE-2026-135975.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in PublishPress PublishPress Revisions revisionary allows Stored XSS.This issue affects PublishPress Revisions: from n/a through 4.3.5.

CVE-2026-135976.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Cool Plugins Language Switcher for Polylang language-switcher-for-divi-polylang allows Code Injection.This issue affects Language Switcher for Polylang: from n/a through 1.1.4.

CVE-2026-135977.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Cool Plugins Conditional Fields for Elementor Form – Display Conditions conditional-fields-for-elementor-form allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Conditional Fields for Elementor Form – Display Conditions: from n/a through 1.7.8.

CVE-2026-135981.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in PublishPress PublishPress Permissions press-permit-core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects PublishPress Permissions: from n/a through 5.0.2.

CVE-2026-135984.description: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in John-Michael L'Allier Create mediavine-create allows Code Injection.This issue affects Create: from n/a through 3.1.4.

CVE-2026-135985.description: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in John-Michael L'Allier Create mediavine-create allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects Create: from n/a through 3.1.4.

CVE-2026-136694.description: A weakness has been identified in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT up to 0.8.2. This impacts the function skill_upload of the file packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/agentic_data_api.py of the component Skill Upload Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument filename can lead to path traversal. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.8.3 will fix this issue. This patch is called fc6a5017d5a8509d34700694bbd8a637bde311fb. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. This is a regression of CVE-2026-51862 because the fix shipped in 0.8.1 was reverted in 0.8.2 and the corrected code exists only on the unreleased main branch.
CVE-2026-136694.summary_ko: eosphoros-ai DB-GPT 0.8.2 이하의 Skill Upload Handler에 경로 탐색 취약점이 있다. 원격 공격자가 이를 악용할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136694.background_ko: 0.8.1에 포함됐던 CVE-2026-51862 수정이 0.8.2에서 되돌려져 취약점이 재발했다.

CVE-2026-136862.description: In Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper versions 0.1.0 to 0.2.0, as shipped with Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server versions 0.65.0 to 0.83.0, the Git credential helper selects stored credentials by re-parsing the requested URL with a regular expression that can be confused by `:` and `@` characters in the URL path. An attacker who can make an ORT Server worker fetch a crafted Git URL, for example through a submodule of a repository that is analyzed, can obtain credentials stored for a different host, such as `github.com`, which Git then sends to the attacker-controlled server. The issue is fixed in Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper 0.2.1 and Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server 0.84.0.
CVE-2026-136862.summary_ko: Eclipse Apoapsis ORT Server Credential Helper에서 작업자가 조작된 Git URL을 가져오면 다른 호스트의 저장 인증정보가 공격자 제어 서버로 전송될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136862.background_ko: 저장 인증정보를 선택할 때 사용하는 URL 재분석 정규식이 경로의 콜론과 @ 문자를 잘못 해석한다.

CVE-2026-136903.description: Open Babel through 3.2.1 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in OBForceField::Setup() that leaves stored constraints bound to freed atoms when set up with an empty molecule. Attackers can supply a molecule file yielding an empty molecule so later SteepestDescent() or ConjugateGradients() calls read freed memory, causing crashes or incorrect results.

CVE-2026-136904.description: POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() and InflatingInputStream::reset() that fails to discard unconsumed compressed input after decompression errors. Attackers can supply one corrupt zlib, gzip or zip-deflate stream to applications reusing an InflatingInputStream, causing all later stream reads, including valid ones, to fail.

CVE-2026-136905.description: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains an incomplete cleanup vulnerability in ly_out_reset() in src/out.c that tests a stale errno ESPIPE value after a successful seek. Applications reusing one output handler for different clients rewind but do not truncate the file, leaking leftover bytes of a previous client's output.

CVE-2026-136906.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a file descriptor leak in ly_in_new_filepath() and ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that fails to close descriptors when file mapping fails. Attackers who can supply files parsed through lyd_parse_data_path() or lys_parse_path() can repeatedly submit empty files to exhaust descriptors, causing later file and socket operations to fail.

CVE-2026-136907.description: CESNET libyang through 6.4.13 contains a return of wrong status code vulnerability in ly_in_filepath() in src/in.c that reports success when a new file cannot be opened or mapped. Attackers who make an application switch a reused input handler to a nonexistent or empty file cause it to parse the previously loaded file's data as the requested input.

CVE-2026-136908.description: libyang through 6.4.13 contains a release of invalid pointer vulnerability in ly_in_memory() and ly_in_memory_chunk() in src/in.c that return the current read position instead of the previous start address. Attackers supplying YANG data parsed from a heap buffer can cause applications freeing the returned pointer to pass an interior address to free(), aborting the process.

CVE-2026-136909.description: Assimp 5.1.0 through 6.0.6 contains a memory leak vulnerability in AMFImporter::ParseFile that overwrites the previous XML parser pointer without releasing it. Attackers can supply repeated AMF files to applications using a long-lived Assimp::Importer to retain parsed documents and exhaust memory.

CVE-2026-136910.description: POCO C++ Libraries through 1.15.4 contain a denial of service vulnerability in InflatingStreamBuf::reset() that fails to clear stale buffered data from a previous failed stream. Attackers can supply one corrupt compressed stream to an application reusing an InflatingOutputStream, causing subsequent valid streams to fail decompression.

CVE-2026-136911.description: Boost.JSON 1.75.0 through 1.92.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in monotonic_resource::release() because it does not reset next_size_ when returning blocks upstream. Attackers can send repeated JSON documents larger than the initial block, growing allocation sizes geometrically until every later allocation fails with bad_alloc.

CVE-2026-136912.description: Paid Memberships Pro before 3.8.8 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read restricted post excerpts because restriction is reapplied only through the_excerpt filter. Attackers can request RSS or Atom feeds, oEmbed URLs, or pages rendering the Post Excerpt block to read opening text or manual excerpts of member-only posts.

CVE-2026-136913.description: JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated end users to invoke the internal upd_user_info operation because ImListenerImpl.PublishArrived forwards any client-supplied topic as the RPC method. Attackers holding a valid connect token can supply another user's id to UpdUserInfo to overwrite that user's nickname, portrait, extension fields and settings.

CVE-2026-136914.description: JuggleIM im-server before 1.8.17 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to invoke the internal g_del_members operation by supplying it as a client topic. Attackers holding a valid connect token can send crafted WebSocket or HTTP publish requests with arbitrary group and member ids to remove any users from any group in the application.

CVE-2026-136915.description: HortusFox through 6.4 contains an information exposure vulnerability in BackupModule::start that allows unauthenticated attackers to download workspace backups stored in the public/backup directory. Attackers can enumerate one-second-precision creation timestamps used as filenames to retrieve archives containing locations, plants, gallery, tasks, inventory and calendar data.

CVE-2026-136916.description: HortusFox (hortusfox-web) through 6.4 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in UserModel::restorePassword that builds reset links from the client-controlled Host header. Unauthenticated attackers can request a reset with a forged Host header to capture the victim's reset token and take over accounts including administrators.

CVE-2026-136917.description: Part-DB (Part-DB-server) before 2.20.6 contains an open redirect vulnerability in several controllers that pass user-supplied _redirect or redirect_back parameters to redirect() without validating local paths. Attackers can craft links to endpoints like /tools/batch_eda_edit using scheme-relative or protocol-relative values that bypass the nelmio_security guard, sending authenticated victims to attacker-controlled phishing sites.

CVE-2026-136918.description: FCEUX before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in SetBoardName() in src/unif.cpp that allows crafted UNIF ROM files to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .unf file with a 0xFFFFFFFF MAPR chunk length, wrapping the allocation to zero and corrupting heap memory to crash the emulator or execute code.

CVE-2026-136919.description: FCEUX 2.5.0 before 2.8.0 contains an integer overflow in iNESLoad() in src/ines.cpp that allows a crafted NES 2.0 ROM to write past a heap buffer. Attackers can persuade users to open a .nes file using exponent-multiplier PRG ROM size notation with mappers 53, 198, 228 or 547 to corrupt memory, crashing the emulator and possibly executing code.

CVE-2026-136920.description: OneDev before 17.2.4 contains an argument injection vulnerability in commit query handling that allows authenticated attackers to inject git options through branch or tag names. Attackers can push a branch named like --output=<path> and query it via the commits page or REST API to overwrite server-writable files, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-136921.description: nconf through 1.0.0-beta.2 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in the Memory store merge() function in lib/nconf/stores/memory.js that lacks __proto__ key rejection. Attackers controlling merge keys like '__proto__:isAdmin' or nested __proto__ properties can inject properties into Object.prototype, altering application logic or causing errors.

CVE-2026-136922.description: PyBioNetGen 0.8.7 contains a code injection vulnerability in ParameterBlock.add_item() and ModelBlock.add_item() that allows attackers to execute Python code by passing parameter expressions to sympy.sympify(). Attackers can supply a crafted BNG-XML model file with Python code in a Parameter expr or value attribute to execute code as the user when loaded with bionetgen.bngmodel().

CVE-2026-136923.description: asar-py before 0.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in AsarArchive.extract() and extract_archive() that allows attackers to write files outside the destination directory via crafted archive headers. Attackers can supply a .asar archive with '..' path components or malicious symlink targets to write files such as usercustomize.py, leading to code execution.

CVE-2026-66419.description: Remote Mouse for macOS before 3.511 contains a URL scheme validation bypass vulnerability in the opn sub-command of the web command handler, SystemCommandHandler::performWebPanelRemoteFunction_, which checks only for the presence of http:// or https:// substrings rather than validating the actual URL scheme before passing input to NSWorkspace.openURL. Attackers who can reach the TCP command service on port 1978 can send a crafted file:// URL containing a decoy http:// substring to launch arbitrary local applications, open local files with their default handlers, or invoke other applications' registered URL schemes as the logged-in user, requiring no authentication unless a connection password is configured.

CVE-2026-82489.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the report module (openimis-be-report_py) where the /api/report/reportbro/preview endpoint evaluates printIf expressions server-side using simpleeval with an insufficient name-prefix blocklist. An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JWT signing keys.
CVE-2026-82489.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전 보고서 모듈에 인증 없는 원격 코드 실행 및 임의 파일 읽기 취약점이 있다. 공격자는 root 권한으로 명령을 실행하고 데이터베이스 자격 증명과 JWT 서명 키를 탈취해 호스트를 완전히 장악할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82489.background_ko: 보고서 미리보기에서 simpleeval로 표현식을 평가할 때 적용하는 이름 접두사 차단 목록이 불충분하다.

CVE-2026-82490.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the OpenSearch reporting dashboard proxy, where the nginx auth_request only verifies login status without checking the declared right before attaching a hardcoded administrative credential to the proxied request, and the backend OpenSearch cluster has its security plugin disabled via a hardcoded compose setting. Any authenticated account, including self-registered or zero-rights users, can exploit this flaw to gain read, write, and delete access to the OpenSearch cluster.
CVE-2026-82490.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전의 OpenSearch 보고 대시보드 프록시에 인가 누락 취약점이 있다. 자체 가입 계정이나 권한이 전혀 없는 사용자를 포함해 로그인한 모든 계정이 OpenSearch 클러스터의 데이터를 읽고 쓰고 삭제할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82490.background_ko: 프록시가 권한을 검사하지 않고 로그인 여부만 확인해 고정된 관리자 자격 증명을 붙이며, 백엔드 OpenSearch 보안 플러그인도 비활성화되어 있다.

CVE-2026-82491.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the core export mixin (openimis-be-core_py, core/gql/export_mixin.py) that allows authenticated users with a single ordinary read right to traverse arbitrary foreign key relations by supplying caller-controlled dotted field paths that are rewritten into Django ORM syntax without an allow-list. Attackers can exploit this to export another user's JWT signing key via a path such as user_created.i_user.private_key, enabling them to forge valid authenticated sessions for other accounts, including administrators, without detection through failed-login events or invalidation by password reset.
CVE-2026-82491.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전의 내보내기 기능에 정보 노출 취약점이 있다. 일반 읽기 권한 하나만 가진 인증된 사용자가 다른 사용자의 JWT 서명 키를 추출해 관리자 등 다른 계정의 유효한 인증 세션을 위조할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82491.background_ko: 호출자가 지정한 필드 경로를 허용 목록 검사 없이 Django ORM 구문으로 변환해 임의의 외래 키 관계 탐색을 허용한다.

CVE-2026-82492.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an improper validation vulnerability in the deduplication service (openimis-be-deduplication_py, deduplication/services.py) that allows a caller holding only the narrow right 170001 to bypass column path validation by exploiting the fact that only the first segment of a dotted relation path is checked before the full unvalidated path is used in the query. Attackers can supply a crafted dotted column path such as user_created__i_user__private_key to traverse relations and retrieve an administrator's JWT signing key, enabling forgery of a valid administrator session without a password that survives password resets and generates no failed-login event.
CVE-2026-82492.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전의 중복 제거 서비스에 검증 미흡 취약점이 있다. 170001 권한만 가진 사용자가 관리자 JWT 서명 키를 추출해 비밀번호 재설정 후에도 유효하고 로그인 실패 기록을 남기지 않는 관리자 세션을 위조할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82492.background_ko: 관계 경로의 첫 구간만 검사한 뒤 검증되지 않은 전체 경로를 쿼리에 사용한다.

CVE-2026-82493.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.
CVE-2026-82493.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전의 보고서 모듈에 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 있다. 제한적인 보고서 추가·편집·조회 권한 중 하나만 가진 공격자가 저장한 악성 보고서가 이후 열람되거나 예약 작업으로 렌더링되면 root 권한으로 임의 명령이 실행될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82493.background_ko: overrideReport가 보고서 정의를 적절한 검증 없이 저장하고, 렌더링 시 사용하는 simpleeval의 이름 접두사 차단 목록을 우회할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-82494.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module (openimis-be-api_fhir_r4_py) that allows an authenticated attacker with limited district-level access to receive subscription notifications for data outside their authorized scope due to the absence of row-level security checks such as has_perms, get_queryset, ROW_SECURITY, district, or health-facility scoping on the notification delivery path. Attackers can register a standing FHIR subscription to continuously receive claim data and can further direct notification pushes to internal network addresses.
CVE-2026-82494.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전 버전의 FHIR R4 모듈에 인가 누락 취약점이 있다. 제한된 지역 권한을 가진 인증된 공격자가 권한 밖의 청구 데이터를 지속 수신하고 알림을 내부 네트워크 주소로 보낼 수 있다.
CVE-2026-82494.background_ko: 알림 전달 경로에 행 수준 보안 검사와 지역·의료시설 범위 제한이 없다.

CVE-2026-82495.description: openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a broken access control vulnerability in the FHIR R4 module that allows any authenticated attacker to delete Coverage policy records due to an empty permissions_delete list being vacuously granted by user.has_perms([]). Attackers can issue a DELETE request to the Coverage/<uuid>/ endpoint to permanently and irrecoverably remove insurance policy records.
CVE-2026-82495.summary_ko: openIMIS 2026-10 이전 버전의 FHIR R4 모듈에 접근 통제 취약점이 있어, 인증된 모든 공격자가 Coverage 보험 계약 기록을 영구 삭제할 수 있다. 삭제된 기록은 복구할 수 없다.
CVE-2026-82495.background_ko: 빈 permissions_delete 목록이 user.has_perms([])에서 권한 승인으로 처리된다.

CVE-2026-127280.description: C-More EA9 Programming Software V6.80 does not adequately validate data read from a project file before using it in heap memory operations. A crafted file causes a heap buffer overrun during file open, resulting in heap corruption and instability within the application. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by convincing a user to open a malicious project file delivered through common distribution channels such as email, file sharing, or removable media.

CVE-2026-132889.description: A flaw was found in librelp. When using the GnuTLS driver, an improper error handling vulnerability causes the library to terminate the entire host process upon encountering a Transport Layer Security (TLS) record-level error, rather than disconnecting only the affected session. A remote peer capable of establishing a TLS connection can exploit this flaw by sending a corrupted or invalid record, crashing the host application and leading to a Denial of Service (DoS).

CVE-2026-135150.description: In Eclipse Ditto versions 1.1.0 to 3.9.9, the nginx reverse proxy configurations shipped with Ditto (Helm chart, Docker Compose, Kubernetes and OpenShift deployment files) forward a client-supplied `x-ditto-pre-authenticated` header to the Ditto gateway on locations that do not apply nginx authentication, such as `/api/2/connections`. nginx selects the location based on the normalized request URI but forwards the raw URI, while the gateway does not treat an encoded slash (`%2f`) as a path separator. A crafted request path is therefore routed by nginx through such an unauthenticated location and by the gateway to the regular Things and Policies HTTP API, including routes that send live messages to devices. When pre-authentication is enabled (the default of the Helm chart and the Docker Compose setup), an unauthenticated remote attacker can impersonate arbitrary policy subjects and read, modify and delete Things, read Policies, send messages to devices and create entities. Additionally, the optional Ingress of the Helm chart (Ditto 3.9.0 to 3.9.9) routes requests directly to the gateway without setting or removing that header, and the WebSocket Ingress of the Helm chart of Ditto 3.3.0 to 3.8.15 does not set it, allowing the same impersonation without path manipulation when pre-authentication is enabled. This bypasses the fix for CVE-2026-120753.
CVE-2026-135150.summary_ko: Eclipse Ditto 1.1.0~3.9.9에서 사전 인증이 활성화된 경우 인증 우회로 임의의 정책 주체를 사칭할 수 있다. 인증 없는 원격 공격자는 Things 조회·수정·삭제, Policies 조회, 기기 메시지 전송 및 엔터티 생성을 할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135150.background_ko: nginx와 게이트웨이의 URI 해석 차이 및 인증 없는 경로의 사전 인증 헤더 전달, 일부 Ingress의 헤더 설정·제거 누락으로 발생한다.

CVE-2026-136695.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Lawouach ws4py up to 0.6.0. Affected is the function WebSocketBaseClient.connect of the file ws4py/client/__init__.py of the component Wss Client. The manipulation leads to improper certificate validation. The attack can be initiated remotely. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

CVE-2026-64845.description: KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the CertificateSigningRequest controller that allows attackers with permission to create CertificateSigningRequest objects to escalate privileges by exploiting automatic approval of requests carrying a kubesphere.io/username label without verifying the requester's identity or subject match. Attackers can submit a CertificateSigningRequest for the kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client signer with an arbitrary subject such as a platform administrator to obtain a cluster CA-signed client certificate, enabling authentication as the chosen identity and full cluster administrator privilege escalation.
CVE-2026-64845.summary_ko: KubeSphere 4.0.0~4.1.3의 CertificateSigningRequest 컨트롤러에 인가 누락 취약점이 있다. 해당 객체 생성 권한이 있는 공격자는 임의 신원에 대한 클러스터 CA 서명 클라이언트 인증서를 발급받아 클러스터 관리자 권한을 획득할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-64845.background_ko: 특정 사용자 이름 레이블이 있는 인증서 서명 요청을 요청자 신원이나 인증서 주체의 일치 여부를 확인하지 않고 자동 승인한다.

CVE-2026-132888.description: A flaw was found in librelp. When configured to use Transport Layer Security (TLS) with certificate validation and the GnuTLS driver, the library fails to verify the peer certificate chain. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this issue by presenting an invalid or self-signed certificate, allowing them to bypass authentication and act as a trusted log source or collector.
CVE-2026-132888.summary_ko: librelp에서 GnuTLS 드라이버와 인증서 검증을 사용하는 TLS 구성에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 신뢰할 수 있는 로그 송신원이나 수집기로 가장할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-132888.background_ko: 인증서 검증이 설정돼 있어도 GnuTLS 드라이버를 사용하는 TLS 연결에서 상대 인증서 체인을 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-135133.description: An invalid memory release in the MongoDB PHP Driver extension occurs when certain string-typed options or type-mapping settings are given non-string values. A party who can run PHP code in a process that loads the extension may corrupt process memory. This can lead to reading or changing process memory, running commands as the PHP process user, or crashing the process.

CVE-2026-135134.description: A NULL pointer dereference and invalid memory release in the server discovery component of the MongoDB C Driver may allow an unauthenticated party that controls a server endpoint, or that can alter unencrypted network traffic, to cause a client application to terminate by sending a crafted discovery response.

CVE-2026-135142.description: An incorrect authorization weakness in the embedded relation handling of the Laravel MongoDB library may allow a user with basic application privileges to alter records belonging to other users. After an embedded relation is pre-loaded, a routine write on that record is issued without the constraint that limits it to the record the user is permitted to change. This may result in unintended modification or loss of stored data for other users of the same application.

CVE-2026-135144.description: A query builder component in a MongoDB integration library for a PHP web framework does not run the query-modification callbacks that an application registers with the framework before sending read, update, and delete operations to the database. As a result, a filter that an application relies on to limit which records a request may touch can be omitted silently. A user with basic application privileges may be able to read or change records that the application intended to keep out of reach.
CVE-2026-135144.summary_ko: PHP 웹 프레임워크용 MongoDB 통합 라이브러리가 쿼리 수정 콜백을 실행하지 않아 접근 제한 필터가 누락될 수 있다. 기본 애플리케이션 권한만 가진 사용자가 제한 대상 레코드를 조회하거나 변경할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135144.background_ko: 쿼리 빌더가 조회·갱신·삭제 작업을 데이터베이스로 보내기 전에 프레임워크에 등록된 쿼리 수정 콜백을 실행하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-135145.description: A polymorphic relationship query helper in the MongoDB Eloquent integration for Laravel resolves a record's type identifier inconsistently between the code that stores a relationship link and the code that searches for one. An application that relies on a relationship-absence query to restrict which records a request may see or change can therefore have that restriction silently fail, allowing a user with basic application privileges to read and to modify or remove records the restriction was meant to cover.
CVE-2026-135145.summary_ko: Laravel용 MongoDB Eloquent 통합의 다형적 관계 쿼리 오류로 관계 부재 여부를 이용한 접근 제한이 무력화될 수 있다. 기본 애플리케이션 권한을 가진 사용자가 제한 대상 레코드를 조회·수정·삭제할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135145.background_ko: 관계 링크를 저장하는 코드와 검색하는 코드가 레코드의 유형 식별자를 서로 다르게 해석한다.

CVE-2026-135147.description: A data-query neutralization weakness in the query builder of the MongoDB integration for a PHP web framework allows values supplied to certain bulk counter-update helpers to be interpreted by the database as query expressions rather than stored as plain text. An application that passes externally supplied data into these helpers may write unintended values into stored documents and may result in unintended disclosure of other data held on the same document. No credentials are required of the party supplying the value.
CVE-2026-135147.summary_ko: PHP 웹 프레임워크용 MongoDB 통합 기능에서 외부 입력이 쿼리 표현식으로 해석될 수 있다. 애플리케이션이 이를 일부 일괄 카운터 갱신 도우미에 전달하면, 인증정보 없는 입력 제공자가 저장 문서를 변조하거나 같은 문서의 다른 데이터를 노출시킬 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135147.background_ko: 쿼리 빌더의 입력 처리가 미흡해 일부 일괄 카운터 갱신 도우미에 전달된 값이 일반 텍스트가 아닌 데이터베이스 쿼리 표현식으로 해석된다.

CVE-2026-135222.description: MongoDB C Driver contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the credential-selection logic used by its AWS authentication mechanism. A process-wide credential cache can take precedence over the credentials supplied for an individual connection, so a connection configured with one set of credentials may instead be authenticated under an identity cached earlier in the same process. A party able to cause the application process to open an additional connection may thereby obtain unintended privileges.

CVE-2026-135223.description: An improper handling of repeated fields in encryption key documents in the MongoDB encryption support library may allow memory to be retained without release. A party able to write to the key storage collection, or a database endpoint returning such a document, may cause the memory use of the calling application process to grow for each document parsed, which may reduce performance of that process.

CVE-2026-135224.description: The MongoDB C Driver does not confirm that the party signing a supplied certificate revocation status response is authorized to answer for the certificate being checked. An unauthenticated party that operates the TLS endpoint a client connects to can therefore have a withdrawn certificate accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of the application's database traffic and in the loss of the revocation decision.
CVE-2026-135224.summary_ko: MongoDB C Driver의 인증서 폐기 상태 검증 취약점으로, 인증되지 않은 TLS 접속 대상 운영자가 폐기된 인증서를 승인받을 수 있다. 애플리케이션의 데이터베이스 통신이 노출되고 폐기 판단이 무력화될 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135224.background_ko: 제공된 인증서 폐기 상태 응답의 서명자가 검사 대상 인증서에 관해 응답할 권한이 있는지 확인하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-135228.description: A vulnerability in the MongoDB integration package for the Laravel framework allows an unauthorized user to bypass mass assignment attribute protections. When an application uses attribute deny-lists to guard sensitive model fields, specially crafted request payloads containing database operator keys can circumvent these protections. An unauthorized user with network access to an affected application endpoint can modify guarded attributes, potentially leading to privilege escalation within the application
CVE-2026-135228.summary_ko: Laravel용 MongoDB 통합 패키지에서 대량 할당 속성 보호를 우회할 수 있다. 취약한 애플리케이션 엔드포인트에 네트워크로 접근 가능한 무권한 사용자가 보호된 속성을 변경해 애플리케이션 내 권한을 높일 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135228.background_ko: 속성 차단 목록 기반의 대량 할당 보호가 데이터베이스 연산자 키를 포함한 요청 데이터를 제대로 차단하지 못한다.

CVE-2026-135399.description: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.10, RoleGuard authorizes requests using the role claim embedded in an access token instead of the user's current database role in packages/core/src/lib/core/context/request-context.ts through RequestContext.hasRoles. After an administrator demotes a user, an already-issued token can continue to pass role checks for up to the token's 24-hour default lifetime, including on DELETE /api/tenant and other RolesEnum.SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN guarded routes, which can preserve tenant-destructive and billing privileges after revocation. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.10.

CVE-2026-135400.description: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.44.3, per-request JWT validation in packages/core/src/lib/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts accepts the result of UserService.getIfExists in packages/core/src/lib/user/user.service.ts without requiring User.isActive to be true and User.isArchived to be false. When a token contains an organizationId claim, the active and archived status check applies to the UserOrganization record rather than the User entity. After an administrator deactivates an account through PATCH /api/user/:id, an existing access token can continue to authenticate API requests at the account's previous privilege level until expiration, up to 24 hours by default. This issue is fixed in version 111.44.3.

CVE-2026-135401.description: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.9, OrganizationPermissionGuard in packages/core/src/lib/shared/guards/organization-permission.guard.ts checks allowManualTime, allowModifyTime, and allowDeleteTime only when the caller's role is EMPLOYEE and unconditionally authorizes other roles. A tenant administrator who grants ALLOW_MANUAL_TIME, ALLOW_MODIFY_TIME, or ALLOW_DELETE_TIME to MANAGER, DATA_ENTRY, VIEWER, or another non-employee role can therefore leave the organization-wide policy disabled while that role still creates, modifies, or deletes time records, undermining payroll and billing integrity. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.9.

CVE-2026-135402.description: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.13, POST /api/integration/github/webhook in packages/plugins/integration-github/src/lib/probot/probot.discovery.ts passes request bodies through ProbotDiscovery.receiveHook to probot.receive without verifying x-hub-signature-256 against the configured webhook secret. Because the route is public and uses the attacker-controlled installation.id to locate integrations, an unauthenticated remote attacker who knows or guesses an installation identifier can forge installation deletion events that remove a tenant's GitHub integration or forge issues events that insert fabricated issue data into the tenant's automation pipeline. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.13.

CVE-2026-135403.description: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.44.2, getTracker in packages/core/src/lib/throttler/throttler-behind-proxy.guard.ts accepts CF-Connecting-IP without verifying that a trusted Cloudflare edge supplied it; when CF-Connecting-IP is absent, app.set('trust proxy', true) can let an attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-For value determine req.ip. In deployments where a trusted intermediary does not overwrite these headers, or where the firewall permits direct API access, varying the applicable header on repeated POST /auth/login requests gives an unauthenticated remote attacker a distinct throttle bucket for each attempt, so the five-attempts-per-60-seconds limit does not trigger and no account lockout, CAPTCHA, or exponential backoff limits password guessing. This issue is fixed in version 111.44.2.

CVE-2026-135404.description: Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.42.11, singleton-scoped ExportService stores the per-request identifiers this.idCsv and this.idZip as BehaviorSubjects and keeps derived directory names in instance fields, while singleton-scoped ImportService stores per-request paths in this._dirname and this._extractPath. Concurrent requests by different tenant administrators to /export, /export/template, /export/filter, or /import can interleave while asynchronous file operations are in progress, allowing one tenant's export archive to be delivered, overwritten, or deleted by another operation, or causing one tenant's import to read another tenant's uploaded CSV data and persist it under the wrong tenant. This issue is fixed in version 111.42.11.

CVE-2026-135897.description: The MongoDB Rust driver's connection-string parser can include database password text and authentication property values in the error messages it returns when a connection string is malformed. The optional error-redaction feature does not fully remove this text. A party with read access to the application's logs or error output may obtain part or all of a database credential.

CVE-2026-136267.description: Improper sanitization of mixed data and markup elements when processing content in Kiro Web before 2026-10-30, in combination with agents running specific models such as DeepSeek v3.2, GLM-5, MiniMax M2.1, MiniMax M2.5, or Qwen3-coder-next, may allow a remote unauthenticated actor to execute arbitrary commands in a subscriber's hosted development environment via crafted content being repeated back to the user by the agent. AWS has addressed this issue. No customer action is required.
CVE-2026-136267.summary_ko: 2026년 10월 30일 이전 Kiro Web을 DeepSeek v3.2 등 특정 모델의 에이전트와 함께 사용하면, 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 구독자의 호스팅 개발 환경에서 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다. AWS가 문제를 해결했으며 고객 조치는 필요하지 않다.
CVE-2026-136267.background_ko: Kiro Web이 콘텐츠를 처리할 때 혼합된 데이터와 마크업 요소를 적절히 정제하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-136329.description: A flaw was found in the file-gif-load plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted JIF image file, a 32-bit integer overflow occurs during the pixel buffer size calculation, while the zlib output limit is computed separately without wrapping. This leads to an undersized heap allocation, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow when the compressed image data is decompressed. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.
CVE-2026-136329.summary_ko: GIMP의 file-gif-load 플러그인에서 JIF 이미지 처리 중 힙 버퍼 오버플로가 발생할 수 있다. 애플리케이션 충돌에 따른 서비스 거부나 임의 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136329.background_ko: 픽셀 버퍼 크기 계산에서 32비트 정수 오버플로로 힙 버퍼가 작게 할당되지만, 별도로 계산되는 zlib 출력 한도에는 오버플로가 발생하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-136696.description: A vulnerability was detected in Zhengzhou Weiwei Information Technology mayicms up to 5.8E. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /box.php?part=member. The manipulation of the argument userid results in sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-136834.description: Sandbox protection in Jenkins Pipeline: Groovy Plugin 4403.v471713a_cea_19 and earlier can be circumvented through interface field initializers, allowing attackers with permission to define and run sandboxed Pipelines to bypass the sandbox protection and execute arbitrary code in the context of the Jenkins controller JVM.
CVE-2026-136834.summary_ko: Jenkins Pipeline: Groovy Plugin 4403.v471713a_cea_19 이하에서 샌드박스 보호를 우회할 수 있다. 샌드박스 Pipeline 정의·실행 권한이 있는 공격자는 Jenkins 컨트롤러 JVM에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136834.background_ko: 인터페이스 필드 초기화 구문을 통해 샌드박스 보호를 우회할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136835.description: Jenkins Script Security Plugin 1436.v1082791135e4 and earlier does not reject @Builder annotations whose builderStrategy member names an arbitrary class when the annotation is referred to using a partially qualified class name, allowing attackers with permission to define and run sandboxed scripts, including Pipelines, to execute code outside the sandbox if a suitable class is present on the classpath of the component that evaluates the script.
CVE-2026-136835.summary_ko: Jenkins Script Security Plugin 1436.v1082791135e4 이하에서 샌드박스 탈출이 가능하다. 샌드박스 스크립트 정의·실행 권한이 있는 공격자는 평가 구성요소의 클래스 경로에 적절한 클래스가 있으면 샌드박스 밖에서 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136835.background_ko: 일부만 한정된 클래스 이름으로 참조한 @Builder 애너테이션에서 임의 클래스를 지정하는 builderStrategy 값이 차단되지 않는다.

CVE-2026-136836.description: Jenkins Gradle Plugin 2.21.1282.v024680ce00a_b_ and earlier does not configure its XML parser to prevent XML external entity (XXE) attacks when processing Maven extension configuration files from build workspaces.

CVE-2026-136837.description: Jenkins Warnings Plugin 13.10251.va_452d3553728 through 13.10365.v85cd7a_c8110b_ (both inclusive) allows defining inline Groovy parsers whose Groovy scripts are compiled on the Jenkins controller without sandbox protection, allowing attackers able to define inline Groovy parsers to execute arbitrary code in the context of the Jenkins controller JVM.
CVE-2026-136837.summary_ko: Jenkins Warnings Plugin 13.10251.va_452d3553728~13.10365.v85cd7a_c8110b_에서 인라인 Groovy 파서를 정의할 수 있는 공격자는 Jenkins 컨트롤러 JVM에서 임의 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136837.background_ko: 인라인 Groovy 파서의 스크립트가 샌드박스 보호 없이 Jenkins 컨트롤러에서 컴파일된다.

CVE-2026-136838.description: Jenkins Subversion Plugin 1327.vc36e0019a_653 and earlier does not restrict URLs to HTTP or HTTPS schemes in the Sventon repository browser, allowing attackers with Item/Configure permission to determine the existence of paths on the Jenkins controller file system.

CVE-2026-136839.description: Jenkins Subversion Plugin 1327.vc36e0019a_653 and earlier does not restrict URLs to HTTP or HTTPS schemes in the Sventon2 repository browser, allowing attackers with Item/Configure permission to determine the existence of paths on the Jenkins controller file system.

CVE-2026-136840.description: Jenkins Configuration as Code Plugin 2134.ve13a_2fc90835 through 2147.v8a_8d38668c72 (both inclusive), except 2140.2142.v3836c98f1b_30, resolves variables, including references to files on the Jenkins controller file system, environment variables, system properties, and values from configured secret sources, in YAML documents submitted to its configuration validation endpoint, and returns resolved values in error responses, allowing attackers with Overall/SystemRead permission to read arbitrary files on the Jenkins controller file system, environment variables, system properties, and values from configured secret sources.
CVE-2026-136840.summary_ko: Jenkins Configuration as Code Plugin의 구성 검증 엔드포인트에서 Overall/SystemRead 권한을 가진 공격자가 컨트롤러의 임의 파일, 환경 변수, 시스템 속성 및 설정된 비밀 소스의 값을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136840.background_ko: 구성 검증 엔드포인트가 제출된 YAML 문서의 파일 참조 등 변수를 해석하고 그 값을 오류 응답에 포함해 반환한다.

CVE-2026-136841.description: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Nested View Plugin 241.v178f0b_a_cd76a_ and earlier allows attackers to create views.

CVE-2026-136842.description: Jenkins Performance Plugin 1024.ve69e11844523 and earlier does not limit URL schemes for the external report links it creates based on Taurus XML format performance reports, allowing the `javascript:` scheme, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by attackers able to control these reports.

CVE-2026-136843.description: A cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Jenkins Spira Importer Plugin 4.0.0 and earlier allows attackers to have Jenkins connect to an attacker-specified URL.

CVE-2026-136844.description: A missing permission check in Jenkins Spira Importer Plugin 4.0.0 and earlier allows attackers with Overall/Read permission to have Jenkins connect to an attacker-specified URL.

CVE-2026-136845.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraApiAction#doOverview, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136846.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraApiAction#doTrends, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136847.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraApiAction#doExport, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136848.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getDeploymentFrequency, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136849.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getLeadTime, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136850.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getMttr, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136851.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getChangeFailureRate, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136852.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getSlowestStages, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136853.description: Jenkins Pipeline DORA Metrics Plugin 40.vdfd2cb_f019d5 and earlier does not correctly perform permission checks in DoraDashboardAction#getMostFailingStages, allowing attackers with Overall/Read permission to view information about jobs they do not have Item/Read permission to.

CVE-2026-136854.description: Jenkins Rich Text Publisher Plugin 1.5 and earlier does not escape job names in error messages rendered by the Rich Text Portlet, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by attackers with View/Configure permission.

CVE-2026-62151.description: mysql_fdw builds string literals for queries sent to the remote MySQL server with an escaping routine that is not character-set aware. When the connection uses a multi-byte character set such as GBK, SJIS or Big5 and MySQL's default backslash escaping is in effect, a crafted value whose trailing byte is 0x5C absorbs the escaping backslash and leaves the following quote unescaped. The routine handles every pushed-down string constant, including ordinary WHERE-clause literals, so an authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can break out of the literal and run arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server with the credentials of the user mapping. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw forces NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES into the session sql_mode and escapes string literals by doubling single quotes.
CVE-2026-62151.summary_ko: mysql_fdw의 문자열 이스케이프 오류로 원격 MySQL 서버에서 SQL 삽입이 가능하다. 다중 바이트 문자셋과 기본 백슬래시 이스케이프를 사용할 때, 외부 테이블의 SELECT 권한만 가진 인증 사용자가 사용자 매핑의 인증정보로 임의 SQL을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-62151.background_ko: 쿼리 문자열 리터럴의 이스케이프 루틴이 문자셋을 고려하지 않아 다중 바이트 문자셋에서 따옴표가 이스케이프되지 않을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-62152.description: mysql_fdw accepts several security-sensitive connection options from roles that are not superusers. A role with USAGE on the mysql_fdw foreign data wrapper can set init_command, which runs arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server at every connection, including connections made with other users' mappings on a shared foreign server. The same role can set mysql_default_file, ssl_key, ssl_cert, ssl_ca and ssl_capath, which name files read from the PostgreSQL server host, allowing server-side file reads and connection redirection. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, only superusers can set init_command, mysql_default_file, ssl_key, ssl_cert, ssl_ca and ssl_capath.
CVE-2026-62152.summary_ko: mysql_fdw의 보안 관련 연결 옵션에 대한 권한 제한이 미흡하다. 해당 외부 데이터 래퍼에 USAGE 권한이 있는 비슈퍼유저가 다른 사용자의 매핑으로 원격 SQL을 실행하거나 PostgreSQL 서버 파일을 읽고 연결 대상을 바꿀 수 있다.
CVE-2026-62152.background_ko: 슈퍼유저가 아닌 역할에도 SQL 실행 및 PostgreSQL 서버의 파일 읽기에 쓰이는 보안 관련 연결 옵션 설정을 허용한다.

CVE-2026-62153.description: mysql_fdw inserts several values into statements sent to the remote MySQL server without escaping them: the dbname and table_name options in ANALYZE, the remote schema name and the LIMIT TO and EXCEPT table names in IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, and the sql_mode option in the SET sql_mode command. A user who can create or alter foreign tables or foreign servers, or run IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, can break out of the string literal and run arbitrary SQL on the remote MySQL server with the credentials of the user mapping. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw escapes these names and accepts only letters, digits, underscores and commas in sql_mode.

CVE-2026-62154.description: During IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA, mysql_fdw copies column metadata returned by the remote MySQL server into the CREATE FOREIGN TABLE statements it runs locally without quoting it. The COLUMN_DEFAULT value is placed directly in the DEFAULT clause, and the name of the generated ENUM type is inserted unquoted. A malicious or compromised MySQL server, or an attacker who can tamper with the connection, can return crafted information_schema metadata and run arbitrary SQL in the local PostgreSQL session of the user who runs IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA. The issue is fixed in mysql_fdw 2.10.0. From mysql_fdw 2.10.0, mysql_fdw quotes these values before building the statements.
CVE-2026-62154.summary_ko: mysql_fdw의 외부 스키마 가져오기 과정에서 원격 메타데이터를 통한 SQL 삽입이 가능하다. 악성·침해된 MySQL 서버나 연결을 변조할 수 있는 공격자가 작업을 실행한 사용자의 로컬 PostgreSQL 세션에서 임의 SQL을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-62154.background_ko: 원격 MySQL 서버의 열 기본값과 생성할 ENUM 타입 이름을 인용 처리 없이 로컬 CREATE FOREIGN TABLE 문에 삽입한다.

CVE-2026-62155.description: mongo_fdw builds the mongodb:// connection URI by inserting option values without percent-encoding them, so URI metacharacters (@ : / ? # & =) in a value are parsed as part of the URI structure. A role that is not a superuser but has USAGE on a foreign server can set the username and password options in its own user mapping. An @ or other metacharacter in those values can point the connection at a host the attacker controls, allowing connection redirection, credential capture and man-in-the-middle attacks. Server-level options such as the address, database and replica set can be injected the same way. The issue is fixed in mongo_fdw 5.6.0. From mongo_fdw 5.6.0, mongo_fdw builds the URI with the libmongoc URI API, which encodes credentials, and rejects URI metacharacters in the other option values.

CVE-2026-62156.description: hdfs_fdw builds string literals for IN and = ANY(array) clauses pushed down to the remote Hive or Spark server without escaping single quotes. An authenticated user with only SELECT on a foreign table can supply a crafted array value that breaks out of the literal and changes the HiveQL query, which then runs on the remote server with the foreign server's credentials. The same release fixes two lower-severity issues: the JDBC connection string, including the trustStorePassword value, was written to logs, and credentials stayed in memory in cleartext after the connection was established. The issue is fixed in hdfs_fdw 2.4.0. From hdfs_fdw 2.4.0, hdfs_fdw escapes single quotes in these literals, masks trustStorePassword in logs and clears credentials from memory after connecting.
CVE-2026-62156.summary_ko: hdfs_fdw에서 외부 테이블의 SELECT 권한만 가진 인증 사용자가 원격 Hive·Spark 서버의 HiveQL 쿼리를 변조해 외부 서버 인증정보로 실행할 수 있다. JDBC 연결 문자열의 trustStorePassword 로그 노출과 연결 후 인증정보의 메모리 내 평문 잔류 문제도 있다.
CVE-2026-62156.background_ko: 원격 쿼리의 IN 및 = ANY(array) 절에서 작은따옴표를 이스케이프하지 않고, trustStorePassword를 로그에 기록하며 연결 후 메모리에 남은 평문 인증정보를 지우지 않는다.

CVE-2026-62157.description: mongo_fdw converts _id values to 12-byte MongoDB ObjectIds with libbson functions that read a fixed number of bytes without checking the input length: 12 bytes for a bytea _id, and 24 characters for name-typed values and $oid fields in JSON. A shorter value causes a read past the end of the input, which can crash the PostgreSQL backend or include adjacent memory in the query sent to MongoDB. Any user who can supply an _id value or predicate on a foreign table can trigger it. The issue is fixed in mongo_fdw 5.6.0. From mongo_fdw 5.6.0, mongo_fdw accepts only valid 24-character hexadecimal ObjectIds and 12-byte bytea values.

CVE-2026-73517.description: KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a command injection vulnerability in the terminal v1alpha2 file download endpoint where the path query parameter is inserted via fmt.Sprintf into sh -c tar commands executed inside the target container, and the DownloadFile handler fails to perform its own pods/exec authorization check. Attackers with only pod get permission, including built-in read-only project-viewer, workspace-viewer and cluster-viewer roles, can supply shell metacharacters in the path parameter to execute arbitrary commands inside any viewable container without holding pod exec permission.
CVE-2026-73517.summary_ko: KubeSphere 4.0.0~4.1.3의 터미널 파일 다운로드 기능에 명령 주입 및 인가 누락 취약점이 있다. 읽기 전용 역할 등 Pod 조회 권한만 있는 공격자도 Pod 실행 권한 없이 조회 가능한 컨테이너에서 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-73517.background_ko: 다운로드 경로 매개변수를 셸 명령에 직접 삽입하고, DownloadFile 처리기가 자체적으로 pods/exec 권한을 확인하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-110470.description: Stack-based buffer overflow in the mkevent helper in Checkmk <2.5.0p21, <2.4.0p42 and 2.3.0 (EOL) allows an attacker who controls the check output of a monitored host to crash mkevent, causing the notification to be lost, or to redirect the notification to an IPv4 address of their choice, if notifications are forwarded to the Event Console.

CVE-2026-135135.description: Mongoid builds an incomplete automatic encryption schema for certain embedded document associations. As a result, values that the application declared as encrypted may be written to the database in cleartext, with no error or warning returned to the application. A party holding only basic read privileges on the affected collection, and no access to the encryption keys, may then obtain those values in readable form.
CVE-2026-135135.summary_ko: Mongoid에서 암호화 대상으로 선언한 값이 오류나 경고 없이 평문으로 저장될 수 있다. 해당 컬렉션에 기본 읽기 권한만 있는 사용자도 암호화 키 없이 값을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135135.background_ko: 일부 내장 문서 연관관계에 대해 자동 암호화 스키마가 불완전하게 생성된다.

CVE-2026-135138.description: Mongoid does not consistently apply its read-only attribute protection when attribute names are supplied dynamically by the caller. In an application that forwards caller-supplied attribute names into a document update, a user with basic application privileges may change values held inside a field the model declared immutable. This may result in unintended modification of data the application treats as trusted, such as flags used for its own access decisions.

CVE-2026-135139.description: Mongoid contains an incorrect authorization weakness in the handling of caller-supplied filters for bulk removal through a referenced association. Conditions already attached to the association can take precedence over the filter the caller supplied, so records the caller did not select may be removed. A user with basic privileges in an application built on the library may cause unintended removal of records belonging to the same parent record.

CVE-2026-135140.description: Mongoid may omit a field from the client-side encryption settings it generates for a collection when that same field is also used as a reference to another record. The value is then stored in readable form instead of encrypted, and the application receives no indication that this has happened. A party with ordinary authenticated read access to the affected collection may be able to view data that was intended to be protected.

CVE-2026-135141.description: A logic flaw in the query-building layer of the Mongoid object-document mapper causes a model-level default restriction that is meant to return no records to be silently discarded when it is combined into a query. A user with basic application privileges who sends an ordinary request may read, change, or remove records that the restriction was intended to withhold.
CVE-2026-135141.summary_ko: Mongoid의 쿼리 구성 논리 오류로 레코드를 반환하지 않도록 설정한 모델 기본 제한이 무시될 수 있다. 기본 애플리케이션 권한을 가진 사용자가 제한 대상 레코드를 조회·변경·삭제할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135141.background_ko: 쿼리 구성 계층이 레코드를 반환하지 않도록 설정된 모델 기본 제한을 쿼리와 결합할 때 별도 알림 없이 제거한다.

CVE-2026-135146.description: An improper certificate revocation check in the MongoDB Python Driver's optional TLS revocation-checking support allows an unauthenticated party that operates the network endpoint a client connects to, and that holds a revoked but still-dated certificate trusted by that client, to have the connection accepted. This may result in unintended disclosure of application credentials and other session data, and in the client treating responses from that endpoint as genuine.
CVE-2026-135146.summary_ko: MongoDB Python Driver의 선택적 TLS 폐기 확인 기능이 클라이언트가 신뢰하지만 폐기된 유효기간 내 인증서를 허용할 수 있다. 이로 인해 자격 증명과 세션 데이터가 노출되거나 공격자 측 응답이 진짜로 받아들여질 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135146.background_ko: 선택적 TLS 인증서 폐기 확인 기능에서 인증서의 폐기 여부를 부적절하게 검사한다.

CVE-2026-135225.description: An information exposure weakness in the connection string handling of the MongoDB Ruby Driver can place credential material from the application's own configuration into the text of a parsing error, where an existing redaction control does not apply. A party able to read the application's error output or logs may thereby obtain database credential text together with deployment coordinates. The condition arises entirely within the embedding application process and requires no database authentication.

CVE-2026-135226.description: A type-confusion weakness in the Extended JSON parsing component of BSON for Ruby allows a party who can supply parser input to influence how a serialized document is framed. Content placed in one value may be read back as additional or replacement document fields. An unauthenticated party supplying input to an application that parses untrusted Extended JSON and stores the result may cause unintended modification of stored data.
CVE-2026-135226.summary_ko: Ruby용 BSON의 Extended JSON 파서에 타입 혼동 취약점이 있다. 신뢰할 수 없는 입력을 파싱해 결과를 저장하는 애플리케이션에서는 인증되지 않은 입력 제공자가 저장 데이터의 의도치 않은 변경을 유발할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135226.background_ko: 타입 혼동으로 직렬화된 문서의 구조가 달라져 한 값의 내용이 추가 필드나 기존 필드를 대체하는 필드로 해석될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-135227.description: An improper restriction of dynamically determined object attributes in the object-document mapping library's association handling allows structured input supplied in place of a simple identifier value to be turned into an object that is treated as an already-stored record of a caller-chosen model class. In applications that pass unfiltered request data into the affected association handling, an unauthenticated party may cause unintended modification or removal of stored records, and may render an individual record unreadable through that association.

CVE-2026-135898.description: An out-of-bounds read in the native C BSON decoding extension of the MongoDB Python Driver may allow an unauthenticated party who can supply crafted BSON data to the decoder to cause the application process to terminate. In some configurations, nearby process memory may be included in error messages, which may result in limited unintended disclosure of data.
CVE-2026-135898.summary_ko: MongoDB Python Driver의 네이티브 C BSON 디코딩 확장에 범위 밖 읽기 취약점이 있어, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 애플리케이션 프로세스를 종료시킬 수 있다. 일부 구성에서는 오류 메시지에 인접 메모리가 포함돼 제한적인 정보 노출이 발생할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136697.description: A flaw has been found in LibrePhotos up to 1.2.1. Affected by this issue is the function write_metadata of the file apps/backend/api/metadata/writer.py of the component ExifTool Metadata Write-Back. This manipulation of the argument person_name causes argument injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. Upgrading to version 1.3.0 can resolve this issue. Patch name: f83dafca9f1a6dd0441b7e4d5c13992896a7d76f. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

CVE-2026-136721.description: A vulnerability was determined in coleifer peewee up to 4.5.3. This affects the function _print_table of the file pwiz.py of the component File Import Handler. This manipulation causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The reported GitHub issue was closed with the reason "completed". However, it was not possible to determine the PR or commit which could have fixed this issue.

CVE-2026-136722.description: A vulnerability was identified in Zhengzhou Weiwei Information Technology mayicms up to 5.8E. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file member.php. Such manipulation of the argument code leads to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

CVE-2026-81405.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments using the server-declared fragment length without an upper bound. A malicious RPC service on a scanned host can declare fragments of up to roughly 2.1GB, and up to 400 fragments per call, causing the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the read path is reached by rpcinfo.nse during version detection (-sV) and is shared by the NFS, rusers and NetWorker scripts.

CVE-2026-81406.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length field supplied by the server. A malicious DB2 Administration Server on a scanned host can declare a packet length of up to roughly 4.29GB, causing the script to buffer that much data and the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the script runs during version detection (-sV).

CVE-2026-81407.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private exponent. A passive observer of the network traffic between Nmap and an Apple Filing Protocol server can compute the shared secret from the hardcoded exponent and the server's public value and decrypt the password supplied to scripts such as afp-showmount.nse and afp-brute.nse through the afp.username and afp.password arguments, without man-in-the-middle access or cryptanalysis.
CVE-2026-81407.summary_ko: 7.992 이전 Nmap의 NSE afp.lua 라이브러리에 암호화 키 하드코딩 취약점이 있다. Nmap과 Apple Filing Protocol 서버 사이의 트래픽을 감청하는 것만으로 관련 스크립트에 제공된 비밀번호를 복호화할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-81407.background_ko: NSE afp.lua 라이브러리의 DHCAST128 로그인이 공개적으로 알려진 고정 Diffie-Hellman 개인 지수를 사용한다.

CVE-2026-81408.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains a loop with an unreachable exit condition in the parameter-list parsing of the NSE drda.lua library, which keeps growing its parameter list while processing a malicious DRDA response. A malicious DRDA service on a scanned host can make the loop consume memory without bound on 64-bit builds, exhausting the Nmap process and discarding NSE results for every other host in the same scan batch without reporting an error; the library is reached by service probes during version detection (-sV).

CVE-2026-81409.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a server-supplied redirect target without checking that it stays on the scanned host. A malicious web server on a scanned host can redirect Nmap to an arbitrary host and port, including internal and loopback addresses the attacker cannot reach directly, making Nmap send a HEAD request followed by a POST request there; response content is not returned to the attacker. The script runs in the default script category (-sC, -A).

CVE-2026-81410.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the LOCATION URL in a UPnP response without checking that it points to the responding host. An attacker on the local network who answers the script's discovery broadcast can supply a LOCATION URL for an arbitrary host, port and path, including internal and loopback addresses, making Nmap send a GET request there; response content is not returned to the attacker.

CVE-2026-81411.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the read position. A malicious RDP server on a scanned host can include a single malformed zero-length block in an otherwise valid handshake, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process that the script-timeout option does not interrupt; the library is used by rdp-enum-encryption.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).
CVE-2026-81411.summary_ko: 7.992 이전 Nmap의 NSE rdp.lua 라이브러리에 무한 루프 취약점이 있다. 악성 RDP 서버로 인해 Nmap 프로세스가 CPU를 100% 사용하는 무한 루프에 빠질 수 있으며, script-timeout 옵션으로도 중단되지 않는다.
CVE-2026-81411.background_ko: NSE rdp.lua 라이브러리의 ConfCreateResponse GCC 블록 파서가 각 블록 처리 시 읽기 위치가 전진하는지 확인하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-81412.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

CVE-2026-81413.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted.

CVE-2026-81414.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without a size limit and builds it by repeated string concatenation. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data in response to the initial SOA lookup made by dns-zone-transfer.nse, before any AXFR request is sent, causing unbounded memory growth and quadratic CPU cost in the Nmap process.

CVE-2026-81415.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the server sends a protocol-conformant DEVICETYPE IS response without an LU suffix. A TN3270E server on a scanned host, including a non-malicious one that sends such a response, causes a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

CVE-2026-81416.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malformed Repeat to Address (RA) order. A malicious TN3270 server on a scanned host can embed a single 6-byte malformed RA order in an ordinary screen-write data stream after a normal negotiation, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

CVE-2026-81417.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, leaving a zero-yield spin. A malicious TFTP exchange reached by snmp-ios-config.nse after an SNMP write sequence can leave a dead coroutine that freezes the entire Nmap invocation, before port scanning begins for any target in the run; the hang is prevented when the script-timeout option is set.

CVE-2026-81418.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the TLV.AUTH parser of the NSE eigrp.lua library, whose length arithmetic cancels out the running read position. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single crafted EIGRP Update of roughly 36 bytes over unauthenticated multicast, causing unbounded table growth that exhausts the memory of the Nmap process when broadcast-eigrp-discovery.nse is running.

CVE-2026-81419.description: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the LSUpdate.parse function of the NSE ospf.lua library, which does not advance when it reads an LSA header with a zero length. An attacker on the same layer 2 segment can send a single spoofed, unauthenticated OSPF LS Update packet, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process as soon as broadcast-ospf2-discover.nse captures it.

CVE-2026-107633.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.11 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with developer-role permissions to self-approve their own merge request and merge code into protected branches due to incorrect authorization when a security policy prohibited author self-approval.

CVE-2026-119452.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 13.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to obtain another user's authenticated session cookie and gain unauthorized access to that user's account due to improper session storage handling in the dependency proxy authentication flow when a redirect-pending state was triggered.

CVE-2026-129982.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.2 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with a fine-grained personal access token to read and apply merge request suggestions from projects outside the token's scope due to incorrect authorization checks.

CVE-2026-131867.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 19.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that on instances with incoming email enabled could have allowed an authenticated user with CI job access to obtain sensitive information belonging to another user due to improper scope validation.

CVE-2026-132156.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 13.8 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to cause denial of service due to missing server-side input validation on on-call rotation values.

CVE-2026-132822.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.7 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to cause denial of service due to missing resource limits in the error tracking integration.

CVE-2026-133463.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/form-data POST requests to the bucket. An authenticated S3 identity that a bucket policy restricts, such as to a key prefix or by source IP, can create or overwrite objects it is denied by sending the upload as a POST instead of a PUT. This issue has been fixed in version 4.46.

CVE-2026-133464.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, FileStore.ValidatePassword in the SFTP server does not reject zero-length secrets before comparing them, causing an empty login password to match any account configured without one, such as public-key-only or certificate-only users. Because password authentication is enabled by default, a remote attacker who knows a valid username can log in without a key or secret and obtain an SFTP session with that user's home directory and path permissions. This issue is fixed in version 4.46.
CVE-2026-133464.summary_ko: SeaweedFS 4.46 이전 SFTP 서버에 비밀번호 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 유효한 사용자 이름을 아는 원격 공격자는 비밀번호가 없는 계정에 키나 비밀정보 없이 로그인해 해당 사용자의 홈 디렉터리와 경로 접근 권한으로 SFTP 세션을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-133464.background_ko: 비밀번호 인증이 기본 활성화된 상태에서 FileStore.ValidatePassword가 길이 0인 비밀정보를 비교 전에 거부하지 않아 빈 비밀번호가 비밀번호 미설정 계정과 일치한다.

CVE-2026-133465.description: Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool. In versions prior to 4.5.7, the on-alert action command tokenizer in secure.py treats quote characters as argument boundaries without escaping. A monitored stat value, such as a mount point name, that is quoted in an action command template can contain a quote character that breaks out of its quote boundary and injects additional arguments into the process the action invokes. No shell operator is needed for this attack. This issue has been fixed in version 4.5.7.

CVE-2026-135221.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 18.10 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to perform server-side request forgery against internal network resources due to insufficient URL validation in MCP server OAuth handling.

CVE-2026-135486.description: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a client-supplied extracted_data object without verifying invoice ownership, enforcing the invoice_edit permission or checking whether the invoice has been soft deleted. Authenticated attackers who know an invoice identifier can overwrite seller and buyer details, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals and custom metadata of invoices, including archived invoices marked is_deleted = 1, undermining the integrity of financial records.

CVE-2026-135487.description: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.

CVE-2026-135636.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to send requests to internal network resources due to insufficient validation in repository import.

CVE-2026-136723.description: A security flaw has been discovered in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.6. This issue affects the function saveData of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component User Management. Performing a manipulation of the argument roles results in missing authorization. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 4.7.7 is capable of addressing this issue. The patch is named 762a32a374f68cd2cbad12c0d710dcd537f3b127. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

CVE-2026-136724.description: A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. The impacted element is the function update of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component Admin User Management. The manipulation results in missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as 70910338c1e136d5bdd6ed795768e7a81445f422. The affected component should be upgraded.

CVE-2026-136725.description: A vulnerability was identified in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. Affected by this issue is the function fillModelFromData of the file src/Services/AdminService.php. The manipulation of the argument id/remember_token/enabled leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 can resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 9b0c98dc3e2710b2ba8d7579da89ec6a4042fcc8. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-16744.description: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 17.4 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that on instances with receptive cluster agents enabled could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to make requests to internal network services through the GitLab agent server due to insufficient validation of destination addresses.

CVE-2026-77230.description: Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combined with a gadget chain like the bundled Commons Collections 3.1-RC1 library can lead to code execution as the Camunda service account.
CVE-2026-77230.summary_ko: Camunda의 영구 웹 세션 기능에 안전하지 않은 역직렬화 취약점이 있다. 웹 세션 인덱스 쓰기 권한을 가진 공격자는 특정 조건에서 Camunda 서비스 계정 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-77230.background_ko: 보조 저장소에 Java 직렬화 형식으로 저장한 세션 속성을 ObjectInputFilter 없이 ObjectInputStream으로 역직렬화한다.

CVE-2026-99805.description: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: net: limit priority VLAN untag depth The priority VLAN receive path can repeatedly remove VID 0 tags and retry packet processing.
