CVE-2026-133342.description: Joomla Extension - joomdonation.com - Unauthenticated SQL injection in event registration in Events Booking < 5.12.0 - The event_id submitted through the public registration form was not cast to an integer before being added to an SQL query for the registration's custom fields, allowing unauthenticated SQL injection.

CVE-2026-135203.description: In Eclipse Ditto versions 0.3.0-M1 through 3.8.15 and 3.9.0 through 3.9.9, the JavaScript payload mapper of the connectivity service executes user-supplied mapping scripts in a Mozilla Rhino engine without a ClassShutter. A mapping script can catch an engine error and use the Java exception object exposed on it to reach arbitrary Java classes and methods via reflection, bypassing the documented sandbox restriction that mapping scripts cannot access Java packages or classes. This allows a user permitted to create or modify connections (by default the Ditto DevOps realm) to execute arbitrary code in the connectivity service, gaining access to its credentials and to the Ditto cluster.

CVE-2026-115685.description: In affected versions of Octopus Server, authenticated users without permissions to perform write actions on specific endpoints are able to do so due to insufficient permission validation

CVE-2026-119630.description: The Timetics – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling System plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized modification of data and user account creation in versions up to, and including, 1.0.67 This is due to the public `POST /wp-json/timetics/v1/bookings` route being registered with `permission_callback => function () { return true; }` and the handler (`create_item()` → `save_bookings()` → `booking_appointment()`) passing the attacker-controlled `email` directly into `Customer::make()`, which (a) grants the `timetics-customer` role to any existing WordPress user matched by email — including administrators and staff — and overwrites that account's `first_name`/`last_name` user meta, and (b) calls `wp_insert_user()` with role `timetics-customer` when the email is new, regardless of the site's `users_can_register` setting. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create arbitrary WordPress user accounts, assign the `timetics-customer` role to existing accounts (including administrators), and overwrite their profile metadata.

CVE-2026-120081.description: The Duplicate Post plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data[custom][names][prefix]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the site owner to have enabled both 'User Level Permissions' for the Subscriber role and the 'Show reference to original item?' option, and the targeted administrator must view the edit screen of the chained copy post in the classic editor.

CVE-2026-120120.description: The AutomatorWP – No-Code Workflow Automation, Integration & Webhooks Plugin, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'post_field_conditions[0][field]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The vulnerability requires a two-step exploit: a crafted field value must first be stored via the wp_ajax_automatorwp_update_item_option AJAX endpoint, and then the target automation must be triggered to fire the vulnerable SQL query.

CVE-2026-120570.description: The Enfold theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'templateName' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The AJAX save handler validates a nonce and requires only the edit_posts capability, meaning a Contributor can legitimately obtain the nonce from their own post-edit screen and store a malicious template name that subsequently fires in every privileged user's session.

CVE-2026-122065.description: The MoreConvert Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'empty_icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is exploitable even in version 2.0.4 where a patch was attempted, because the sanitizer's single html_entity_decode pass combined with esc_attr()'s double_encode=false behavior leaves entity-encoded inner markup intact, which the counter JavaScript then decodes and assigns to innerHTML, turning inert encoded text back into executable DOM elements.

CVE-2026-123175.description: The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_text (shortcode attribute of [vc_cta])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The style="classic" shortcode attribute must be used to trigger the vulnerable code path that feeds custom_text through vc_get_css_color into the inline style attribute; wp_kses_post applied at save time does not neutralize the payload because the attacker's value contains no HTML tags, only a double quote inside a shortcode attribute, leaving the injected content intact in post_content.

CVE-2026-125293.description: The WPMR Google Feed Manager for WooCommerce – Sell on Google Merchant Center & Shopping plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'feed (title field inside the JSON-encoded feed array)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.24.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. sanitize_text_field() is applied on storage but strips only angle brackets and newlines, leaving single quotes and parentheses intact — the exact characters needed to break out of the onclick JavaScript string context constructed by wppfm_feedListTable() and installed via jQuery .append().

CVE-2026-128096.description: The Advanced Custom Fields: Font Awesome Field plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'acf[field_klzacffa_iconcls] (profile.php) / acf.profile_icon_class (REST)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable when the plugin is configured in FontAwesome 4.x or 5.x compatibility mode and the icon field's return format is set to 'Icon Class', which is the documented usage pattern for rendering icon classes in theme templates.

CVE-2026-128111.description: The Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upload-file' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires that the targeted contact form be configured to accept a non-script extension such as .gpx (or any extension outside the HTML/XML/PHP blocklist), and the uploaded file is served without a Content-Type header, causing browsers to MIME-sniff and execute it as text/html.

CVE-2026-130036.description: The WordClever – AI Content Writer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.5. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to overwrite and permanently destroy the administrator's license configuration, blanking the stored license key, setting the license status to inactive, and clearing the current plan — disabling the plugin's paid AI generation features site-wide.

CVE-2026-130045.description: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[].value (XML-RPC wp.newPost -> post meta 'options' -> JSON->theme)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is stored via the XML-RPC wp.newPost endpoint, which bypasses Admin_Controller::sanitize_options() entirely because the CPT inherits default 'post' capabilities, making any Author-level account sufficient to write the malicious 'theme' value.

CVE-2026-130050.description: The WP Optin Wheel – Gamified Optin Email Marketing Tool for WordPress and WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_fields[options] -> fields[].placeholder' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wof_lite_wheel custom post type inherits standard post capabilities due to an unset capability_type, meaning any Author-level user can publish a malicious wheel via XML-RPC in a single request, exposing every front-end page that renders the wheel to all visitors.

CVE-2026-130056.description: The W4 Post List plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (for metakeyinput=<attacker-chosen key>)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with custom-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the attacker's post to be included in the W4 Post List query and the active list template to reference the attacker's chosen meta key via a [post_meta key="..."] tag; because WordPress core applies no kses filtering to custom field values on save, a raw XSS payload is preserved in the database unmodified and rendered verbatim on every page load.

CVE-2026-131613.description: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Business Directory & Classified Ads plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that the admin option 'post-for-unregister' is enabled (Functions::is_enable_post_for_unregister() returns true). On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with subscriber-level access and above.

CVE-2026-131688.description: The Secure MCP Server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor and other AI Agents plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.8 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for attackers (with access to a valid MCP bearer token) to escalate privileges to the token owner's Administrator role — bypassing NHI ability allow-list and scope restrictions entirely — by submitting any valid MCP bearer token (including scope-restricted connection-test tokens) to arbitrary WordPress endpoints such as admin-ajax.php. This requires possession of a valid MCP bearer token, which is routinely issued to any administrator who connects an MCP client to the site. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete Administrator role.

CVE-2026-131806.description: The CubeWP Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'cwp_custom_form[form_data_id]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.13 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce required by the submission handler is publicly emitted in the inline script data of any page rendering the cwpCustomForm shortcode, making it trivially obtainable by unauthenticated visitors and rendering the nonce check ineffective as an authentication barrier.

CVE-2026-132207.description: The Broken Link Notifier plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content_links[] / header_links[] / footer_links[]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The script executes in the administrator's wp-admin session only when the administrator clicks the Replace Link action on the injected row, meaning successful exploitation requires tricking an administrator into performing that action. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-132655.description: The GamiPress – Gamification plugin to reward points, badges & ranks in WordPress, now with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 8.1.7 via the 'access' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to extract private GamiPress log entries belonging to other users, including admin award, revoke, and event-trigger records marked as private.

CVE-2026-133404.description: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to modify the XAGIO_SEO_SEARCH_PREVIEW_ENABLE post meta on arbitrary posts, disabling the plugin's SEO title and meta description output for those posts.

CVE-2026-133405.description: The Xagio SEO & AEO – AI SEO for Google Rankings & AI Visibility plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'metavalue (metakeyinput=XAGIO_SEO_SCRIPTS_HEADER)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.0.54 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-133922.description: The WPFunnels – Funnel Builder for WooCommerce with Checkout & One Click Upsell plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to sensitive information disclosure in versions up to, and including, 3.13.8 This is due to the wpfnl_register_dashboard_widgets() function registering the 'WPFunnels Overview' dashboard widget on the wp_dashboard_setup hook with no capability check on either the registration or the wpfnl_dashboard_overview_widget() callback, which queries the wpfnl_stats and wpfnl_optin_entries tables and echoes the store's completed-order count, total revenue, order-bump revenue, upsell/downsell revenue and total lead/optin count directly into the dashboard. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above (contributor-level on sites running WooCommerce, where WC_Admin::prevent_admin_access() blocks subscribers from reaching /wp-admin/index.

CVE-2026-134054.description: The Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized access of data due to a missing authorization check on the UACF7_CUSTOM_FIELDS shortcode in versions up to, and including, 3.5.59 The shortcode handler accepts an attr value of the form 'post_id/meta_key', normalizes the parts with absint() and sanitize_key(), and calls get_post_meta() without verifying that the current user is authorized to read that post (no current_user_can('read_post', $id) or post_status check). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to read arbitrary post meta, including private/draft post meta and third-party plugin PII (e.

CVE-2026-134058.description: The Premium Packages - Sell Digital Products Securely plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 7.3.4 This is due to the cancel_subscription(), toggleAutoRenew() and toggleManualRenew() AJAX handlers performing no ownership or capability check on the user-supplied `orderid` parameter — the only gate is a plugin-wide NONCE_KEY nonce that is emitted to any visitor on every product page. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to cancel other customers' subscriptions, flip `auto_renew` and toggle the `manual_renew` meta on any order by supplying its ID.

CVE-2026-135267.description: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'name (REST /wp/v2/tags) / tax_input[post_tag] (post save)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable because WordPress's wp_filter_kses stores entity-encoded payloads (e.g., <img src=x onerror=...>) verbatim as literal text in the database, but Relevanssi's relevanssi_entity_decode() subsequently converts them into live HTML markup before the unescaped return branch of relevanssi_the_tags() splices them into the tag list consumed by the theme.

CVE-2026-135269.description: The WPC Linked Variation for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wpclv_link[source]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.6.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The wpclv custom post type is accessible to Contributor-level users, meaning a Contributor can craft a malicious Linked Variation post whose payload fires in the session of any higher-privileged user (e.g., Administrator or Editor) who opens the post edit screen to review it.

CVE-2026-135620.description: The Relevanssi – A Better Search plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.28.9. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to use the found_posts count in the JSON response as a boolean exact-match oracle to confirm specific post meta key/value pairs and enumerate which published posts carry a given meta key, including private underscore-prefixed meta such as API keys, tokens, and plugin configuration secrets.

CVE-2026-135651.description: The CodeColorer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 0.12.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires that the attacker has already had one prior comment approved from the same name and email pair, as WordPress's comment_previously_approved check auto-approves subsequent comments from recognized commenters.

CVE-2026-135655.description: The Easy SwipeBox plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'title attribute of <a> inside an approved comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin's default-enabled image autodetection applies the Swipebox handler to all front-end anchor elements whose href matches an image extension — including those inside approved comments — meaning no non-default configuration is required to expose the attack surface. A first-time commenter's submission is held for moderator approval, but once approved the stored payload executes for any user who clicks the image link.

CVE-2026-135668.description: The Advanced Form Integration — Connect Forms to 300+ Apps plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mapped CF7 fields (e.g. target, mkey, payload)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires an administrator to have pre-configured an AFI integration that maps all three ACF action slots (postId, selector, and value) to public form fields via the plugin's 'Use a form field…' option, which is a non-default configuration.

CVE-2026-136224.description: The Calculated Fields Form – AI Form Builder for WordPress – Contact, Payment, Quote, Quiz & More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'x' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.6.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Exploitation requires the WordPress site to have a published form configured with a URL-backed text field (using the predefined url.x attribute) wired through a calculated-field equation that calls set_timeslots(); without this non-default form configuration, the vulnerable sink is unreachable.

CVE-2026-136519.description: The Advanced Product Fields (Product Addons) for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'wapf[field_<id>]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives sanitization via a whitespace-prefixed tag gadget, is normalized into real HTML elements by wp_kses_post() and force_balance_tags() at render time, and is then executed by WordPress core's tags-box.js when it encounters the forged #tagsdiv-post_tag element on the order screen.

CVE-2026-136544.description: The Classified Listing – AI-Powered Classified ads & Business Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'formData[description]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.3.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload survives server-side sanitization because wp_kses_post permits span elements with class and data-* attributes; script execution is triggered only when a privileged user (Administrator or Editor) clicks the .reveal-phone span on the pending listing's preview page, causing rtcl-public.js to pass the attacker-controlled data-options value directly into jQuery.append. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-137280.description: The Dashboard Widgets Suite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'dws-notes-user[note]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is exploitable when an Administrator has configured the plugin's Edit Role setting to Subscriber, a documented UI-exposed option, which causes the role check to map to current_user_can('read') — a capability any authenticated Subscriber possesses — and the nonce required by wp_verify_nonce() is legitimately available to the Subscriber on their own dashboard, so no nonce bypass is needed. ✓ Auth empirically confirmed by PoC — reached as Subscriber+.

CVE-2026-137431.description: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used to handle OpenID Connect authentication flows. The issue occurs because the security check that prevents attackers from pre-seeding security parameters in a redirect URL can be bypassed by adding an extra question mark character to the parameter name. This allows an attacker to trick a user's browser into using an attacker-controlled login code. As a result, a victim may be unknowingly logged into an attacker's account, leading to account confusion or the exposure of sensitive data entered by the victim.

CVE-2026-137435.description: A flaw was found in the SAML identity brokering component of Keycloak. When Keycloak is configured to use a database with case-insensitive collation, it may incorrectly match a SAML subject name to an existing user account if the names differ only by case. This issue allows an attacker to log in as a different user by providing a case-distinct version of a victim's username in a signed SAML assertion, leading to unauthorized account access.

CVE-2026-110702.description: The EWWW Image Optimizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.9.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. WordPress core comment kses permits the payload's tag and attribute structure unchanged at save time, meaning the malicious content bypasses save-time sanitization and is only activated when the plugin's output-buffer filter processes the page on render.

CVE-2026-111846.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPExperts NOWPayments for WooCommerce nowpayments-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects NOWPayments for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.4.1.

CVE-2026-119064.description: The Newsletters plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to time-based blind SQL Injection via the 'instance[lists]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.18.2 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. The wpmlgetlistfields AJAX handler performs only a nonce check with no capability check, and the required refreshfields nonce is emitted on every wp-admin page including /wp-admin/profile.php, making the endpoint trivially reachable by any authenticated Subscriber.

CVE-2026-119110.description: The Points Management System For Gamification, Ranks, Badges, and Loyalty Rewards Program – myCred plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'key' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.0.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the Link Clicks hook to be enabled and that the attacker, as a Subscriber-level user, can access any front-end page rendering the [mycred_link] shortcode, which localizes the nonce needed to reach the AJAX endpoint.

CVE-2026-120571.description: The Maps Plugin using Google Maps for WordPress - WP Google Map plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to SQL Injection via the array keys of the `categories` entries parsed from an imported JSON file in versions up to, and including, 1.9.9 This is due to the wgm_handle_import() function sanitizing only the known-named VALUES (`name`, `icon`) of each category object while passing the attacker-controlled JSON object KEYS directly to `$wpdb->insert()`, which interpolates them as column names into the generated INSERT statement without escaping embedded backticks. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above (when the plugin's own 'Minimum Role for Map Editor' setting has been configured to 'Subscriber', one of five values the plugin's settings UI offers), to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database, including administrator password hashes.

CVE-2026-120746.description: The MW WP Form plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 5.1.8 via the 'mw-wp-form_session_mw-wp-form-<FORM_ID>' parameter due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to overwrite or delete arbitrary WordPress transients in wp_options — including core-managed transients such as wp_styles_for_blocks — enabling injection of attacker-controlled CSS into every front-end page and permanent anchoring of poisoned transient values that never re-expire. The plugin's CSRF check does not prevent exploitation because MW_WP_Form_Data::__construct() registers _save_to_session() on the PHP shutdown hook before the CSRF check runs, causing the transient write to fire even after wp_safe_redirect()+exit; the GET path via the [mwform_formkey] shortcode has no CSRF check at all.

CVE-2026-121532.description: The Co-Authors, Multiple Authors and Guest Authors in an Author Box with PublishPress Authors plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'nickname' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.20.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is possible because sanitize_text_field() passes entity-encoded sequences such as < and > through unchanged, allowing a Subscriber to store a breakout payload in their WordPress nickname that is later decoded into live HTML markup by wp_localize_script() and injected into the DOM via jQuery's replaceWith().

CVE-2026-121978.description: The Ultra Addons for Contact Form 7 plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'dfile (any CF7 file field)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.5.58 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful script execution additionally requires a web server that returns no explicit Content-Type header for the targeted audio/video extension, causing the browser to sniff and render the uploaded file as text/html; default Apache configurations without mod_headers or without honoring .htaccess satisfy this condition. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-124266.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Arraytics WP Event Solution wp-event-solution allows Object Injection.This issue affects WP Event Solution: from n/a through 4.1.30.

CVE-2026-124756.description: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Takashi Kitajima MW WP Form mw-wp-form allows HTTP DoS.This issue affects MW WP Form: from n/a through 5.1.8.

CVE-2026-124836.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 inserts message-derived values into LDAP filters used by the ldap_compare and ldap_read mail-rule operations without LDAP filter escaping. An unauthenticated remote sender can alter an LDAP-backed rule query when a deployed rule uses attacker-controlled message data, potentially changing policy decisions or exposing data returned to later rule processing.

CVE-2026-124837.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 copies an insufficiently sanitized DKIM identity into authentication results and may preserve the injected result in an ARC seal. An unauthenticated remote sender can create misleading authentication claims that downstream systems may trust when DKIM verification and ARC sealing are enabled.

CVE-2026-124838.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 exposes an unauthenticated, world-writable local configuration socket whose root daemon accepts shell commands. An attacker with local low-privilege code execution can execute arbitrary commands as root and take complete control of the appliance.

CVE-2026-124839.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 interpolates a stored GINA account address into a root boot-job shell command without neutralization. An authenticated internal attacker who can prepare the required account state, arrange for the migration marker to be absent, and cause a reboot can execute arbitrary commands as root.

CVE-2026-124840.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 reuses a broad legacy GINA session purpose across registration and recovery workflows. A remote attacker who knows an account security answer can use a recovery session in a different account workflow to replace credentials and account recovery data, and may delete the account when self-deletion is enabled.

CVE-2026-124841.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 permits LDAP wildcard characters in legacy GINA identifiers and inserts those values into account, token, certificate, and key lookup filters without escaping. An unauthenticated remote attacker can alter which directory entry is selected and may disclose account existence or cause later workflow logic to use an unintended entry.

CVE-2026-124842.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 exposes legacy GINA password-reset paths that can replace a registered account credential without authenticating the requester. A remote attacker who knows the account address can force a reset when a configured administrator or valid stored creator is present, disrupting access and revoking active API tokens; the replacement credential is sent only to a pre-existing trusted recipient.

CVE-2026-124843.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 uses a source-visible hard-coded fallback secret for legacy GINA token and Large File Transfer cryptographic operations when expected key material is unavailable or unusable. A remote attacker can forge accepted account tokens while the fallback path is active and can decrypt LFT content protected with the shared fallback.

CVE-2026-124844.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 writes legacy GINA multipart uploads before authenticating the caller and does not remove files created by failed or unauthenticated requests. An unauthenticated remote attacker can accumulate persistent upload files and exhaust the backing filesystem, disrupting GINA and other services sharing that storage.

CVE-2026-124845.description: SEPPmail Secure Email Gateway before 15.1.2 normalizes hyphenated and underscore forms of a trusted GINA routing header to the same backend variable. A remote attacker can create a merged invalid selector that makes legacy GINA and GINAv2 fall back to the default domain policy, potentially crossing tenant or policy boundaries in multi-domain deployments.

CVE-2026-125034.description: The Forminator Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form & Custom Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'textarea-1' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution is not automatic on page load; the injected script runs only when an administrator actively clicks the stored ThickBox link, at which point WordPress ThickBox JS decodes the entity-encoded title attribute and writes it into #TB_ajaxWindowTitle via innerHTML in the administrator's origin. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-125803.description: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in iHomefinder, Inc. Optima Express optima-express allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Optima Express: from n/a through 9.0.1.

CVE-2026-127113.description: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.205 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Unauthenticated exploitation requires the plugin's "Allow posting without logging in" (post_logged_out) option to be enabled; on default installs the vulnerability is exploitable by Subscriber-level users and above.

CVE-2026-128097.description: The Lazy Loader plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'author' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 8.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A first-time comment from a new email address is held for moderator approval under WordPress's default settings; however, once an administrator approves it, any visitor — including an administrator — loading the post will trigger execution, enabling full Administrator-level account creation.

CVE-2026-128099.description: The Redux Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '{opt_name}[{field_id}][filter][{filter}][value]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.18 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-128109.description: The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the plugin's "Enable Comment for Lesson" option to be active, which is disabled by default.

CVE-2026-128833.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPBrewer Pay with LINE Pay wpbr-linepay-tw allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Pay with LINE Pay: from n/a through 1.3.3.

CVE-2026-129028.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Datasolution Colissimo Officiel : Méthodes de livraison pour WooCommerce colissimo-shipping-methods-for-woocommerce allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Colissimo Officiel : Méthodes de livraison pour WooCommerce: from n/a through 3.2.0.

CVE-2026-129329.description: The Ocean Extra plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.6.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The shortcode-escape bracket syntax ([[...]]) additionally bypasses wptexturize's own quote conversion, providing an alternative payload path that preserves raw double-quote characters and breaks out of the title attribute on the anchor element rendered by the Recent Posts Thumbnails widget. Exploitation by unauthenticated attackers requires that a separate plugin providing a public guest-post form with a Featured Image field is installed and configured to accept anonymous submissions as published posts. On a default installation, where that is not configured, the vulnerability requires attackers with contributor-level access and above.

CVE-2026-131758.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Brainstorm Force SureRank surerank allows Stored XSS.This issue affects SureRank: from n/a through 1.11.1.

CVE-2026-131767.description: Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Aman FunnelKit Automations wp-marketing-automations allows Object Injection.This issue affects FunnelKit Automations: from n/a through 3.9.0.1.

CVE-2026-131821.description: The (Simply) Guest Author Name plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'url' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.51 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is only exploitable when the non-default 'Disable Guest Author for comments' plugin option is enabled and the post being viewed has a guest author assigned.

CVE-2026-131838.description: The MoreConvert Wishlist for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'attribute_<custom_variation_name>' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability only affects shops that have at least one published variable product using a custom product-level attribute (non-taxonomy, non-pa_ prefixed) marked as Used for Variations; stores using only global taxonomy attributes follow a different code path and are not exploitable.

CVE-2026-131866.description: The GeoDirectory – WP Business Directory Plugin and Classified Listings Directory plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.206 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. An entity-encoded payload nested inside kses-allowed tags such as <div>, <span>, or <a data-*> survives wp_kses_post on save because kses treats the encoded content as plain text; the save handler additionally re-pins the listing to its existing published status and writes directly to the parent listing ID, ensuring the injected content is immediately and permanently publicly visible without re-approval.

CVE-2026-133409.description: The Parsigate plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'trackId (Zibal). Equivalent unauthenticated fields for other gateways (e.g. ZarinPal 'Authority', Sep 'RefNum') are logged the same way.' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires the non-default 'ParsiGate Log' option to be enabled in plugin settings, at least one WooCommerce order placed via a Parsigate gateway (e.g. Zibal) that remains in a pending state, and an administrator to subsequently view the Tools > ParsiGate Log page.

CVE-2026-134469.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Sayontan Sinha Photonic Gallery & Lightbox for Flickr, SmugMug & Others photonic allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Photonic Gallery & Lightbox for Flickr, SmugMug & Others: from n/a through 3.37.

CVE-2026-134472.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Kit Kit (formerly ConvertKit) convertkit allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Kit (formerly ConvertKit): from n/a through 3.5.2.

CVE-2026-134479.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Ultimate Member Ultimate Member ultimate-member allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Ultimate Member: from n/a through 2.14.1.

CVE-2026-134490.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Imran Tauqeer CubeWP Forms cubewp-forms allows Stored XSS.This issue affects CubeWP Forms: from n/a through 1.1.13.

CVE-2026-134491.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Dimitri Grassi Salon booking system salon-booking-system allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects Salon booking system: from n/a through 10.31.17.
