Attackers submitting requests with thinking_token_budget can force the reasoning-end token sequence into a concurrent co-batched request's output during a mixed batch reorder.

CVE-2026-137476.description: vLLM 0.3.0 before 0.30.0 contains a response amplification vulnerability in the OpenAI-compatible API server's shared RequestValidationError handler, which renders every Pydantic validation error, each of which can include the full offending input, in its HTTP 400 response. Unauthenticated attackers can send a malformed request to endpoints such as POST /v1/responses to trigger a disproportionately large error response that consumes server CPU and memory and can disrupt downstream clients and proxies.

CVE-2026-137477.description: vLLM 0.16.0 before 0.21.0 leaks token data between users when the V1 model runner uses async scheduling with pipeline parallelism, because non-last pipeline ranks never write generated tokens to token_ids_cpu and reset num_tokens_no_spec each step. When the fallback path is triggered, such as by mixed prefill/decode batches, stale tokens from a prior request in the same batch slot become model input and are written to the KV cache, exposing fragments of one user's context in another user's response.

CVE-2026-137478.description: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain an authentication bypass in the ForwardAuth middleware because connection isolation for NTLM and Negotiate credentials checks only the Authorization header, not Proxy-Authorization. Unauthenticated attackers can send such credentials in Proxy-Authorization to reuse a shared authentication-server connection already authenticated by another user, receive that user's identity via authResponseHeaders, and access backends as that user.
CVE-2026-137478.summary_ko: Traefik 2.11.62 이전, 3.x 중 3.7.18 이전 및 3.8.0-rc.1의 ForwardAuth에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 비인증 공격자는 다른 사용자가 인증한 공유 연결을 재사용해 해당 사용자의 신원으로 백엔드에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137478.background_ko: NTLM·Negotiate 자격 증명의 연결 격리 검사에서 Authorization 헤더만 확인하고 Proxy-Authorization 헤더는 확인하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-137479.description: Traefik 3.1.0 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the Compress middleware, which creates zstd encoders with library default options that retain about 18 MiB of state per response until it is fully written. Unauthenticated remote attackers can open many concurrent requests and read responses slowly to exhaust memory and crash Traefik.
CVE-2026-137479.summary_ko: Traefik 3.1.0 이상 3.7.18 미만과 3.8.0-rc.1의 Compress 미들웨어에 메모리 고갈 취약점이 있습니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 메모리를 소진시켜 Traefik을 중단시킬 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137479.background_ko: Compress 미들웨어가 zstd 인코더를 라이브러리 기본 옵션으로 생성해, 응답 전송이 끝날 때까지 응답당 약 18MiB의 상태를 유지합니다.

CVE-2026-137480.description: Traefik 3.7.15 before 3.7.18 and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contains a client certificate authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress NGINX provider because, on hosts shared by multiple Ingresses using auth-tls-secret, Ssl-Client-* headers are built per Ingress while the TLS handshake uses the first Ingress's settings. Unauthenticated remote attackers can obtain Ssl-Client-Verify: SUCCESS with a client-chosen subject and issuer for an unverified certificate, or inject Ssl-Client-* headers directly, presenting forged identities to backends that trust the proxy.
CVE-2026-137480.summary_ko: Traefik 3.7.15 이상 3.7.18 미만과 3.8.0-rc.1 이상 3.8.0-rc.2 미만의 Kubernetes Ingress NGINX 제공자에 클라이언트 인증서 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 비인증 원격 공격자가 프록시를 신뢰하는 백엔드에 위조된 신원을 제시할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137480.background_ko: auth-tls-secret을 사용하는 여러 Ingress가 호스트를 공유할 때 Ssl-Client-* 헤더는 Ingress별로 생성되지만 TLS 핸드셰이크는 첫 Ingress 설정을 사용하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-137481.description: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 contain an authorization bypass because the sanitizePath entry point option leaves dot-segments carrying path parameters, such as /..;x/, unresolved when matching routers and applying middlewares. Unauthenticated attackers can send requests like /public/..;x/admin to a parameter-stripping backend shared with a protected router, bypassing authentication or authorization middlewares to reach protected resources.
CVE-2026-137481.summary_ko: Traefik 2.11.62 미만, 3.7.18 미만의 3.x 및 3.8.0-rc.1에 인가 우회 취약점이 있다. 보호된 라우터와 공유하는 백엔드가 경로 매개변수를 제거하는 환경에서, 인증되지 않은 공격자가 인증·인가 미들웨어를 우회해 보호 자원에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137481.background_ko: sanitizePath 옵션이 경로 매개변수가 붙은 점 세그먼트를 해소하지 않은 채 라우터 매칭과 미들웨어 적용을 진행한다.

CVE-2026-137482.description: Traefik before 2.11.62, 3.x before 3.7.18, and 3.8.0-rc.1 before 3.8.0-rc.2 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the BasicAuth middleware, which does not limit password length before MD5-crypt ($apr1$, $1$) hashing. Unauthenticated attackers can send passwords up to the entry point maxHeaderBytes limit (1 MiB by default), consuming excessive CPU per request and degrading availability.

CVE-2026-137483.description: Hono from 4.13.11 before 4.13.18 contains a middleware bypass vulnerability in serveStatic that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip prefix middleware by exploiting a second path decode when allowPercentInPath is enabled. Attackers can send malformed percent-encoded sequences so the router matches an encoded path while serveStatic serves the real file, bypassing authentication checks.

CVE-2026-137484.description: Hono from 4.12.16 before 4.13.18 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in the bodyLimit() middleware that retains every transfer chunk as a separate array. Unauthenticated attackers can send a within-limit request body in one-byte chunks to create millions of retained objects, terminating Bun or Node.js processes.

CVE-2026-137485.description: Hono from 4.5.1 before 4.13.18 contains a validation bypass vulnerability in validator('json') and validator('form') that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip validation by formatting Content-Type parameters differently. Attackers can add whitespace before semicolons, trailing semicolons, or underscored parameter names so validators receive empty objects while handlers still read rejected fields.

CVE-2026-137486.description: Hono from 4.13.16 before 4.13.18 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in mount() and app.mount() that forwards an incorrect path when a custom getPath adds a prefix. Unauthenticated attackers can request crafted paths that the mounted application resolves differently, reaching routes protected by path-scoped middleware such as authentication checks.

CVE-2026-137487.description: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-unbound through 26.288.56989~75a306d contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the Unbound Configure page inserts the dhcp.odhcpd.leasetrigger value into a warning notification without escaping. Users with delegated network configuration access can store an HTML event handler in that option through the permitted uci RPC, which executes in an administrator's browser session when the page renders.

CVE-2026-137488.description: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read SELECT-hidden edge endpoints through InOverride/OutOverride error messages. Attackers with CREATE and UPDATE permission on an edge table can re-RELATE an existing edge with mismatched endpoints to recover stored in/out record ids despite row- or field-level restrictions.

CVE-2026-137489.description: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the remote HTTP client router that passes raw model names to Url::join during ML export. Attackers can supply an absolute URL as the model name in ExportMl or ExportBytesMl commands to redirect authenticated requests and capture session tokens.

CVE-2026-137490.description: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted subjects to execute arbitrary queries by calling the JavaScript surrealdb.query() bridge. Attackers permitted to run a specific script can bypass the Capabilities::allows_query() gate in the query module to execute unrestricted queries beyond their predefined operations.
CVE-2026-137490.summary_ko: SurrealDB 4.0.0 미만에는 JavaScript 쿼리 브리지를 통한 인가 우회 취약점이 있습니다. 특정 스크립트 실행 권한이 있는 제한된 사용자가 허용된 작업 범위를 벗어나 임의의 쿼리를 실행할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137490.background_ko: JavaScript surrealdb.query() 브리지를 통해 쿼리 모듈의 Capabilities::allows_query() 검사를 우회할 수 있어 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-137491.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a query injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege or anonymous users to inject AQL or SQL by supplying unescaped parameters to ArangoDB and Snowflake queries. Attackers can execute published queries with crafted parameter values to bypass filters, read entire datasources, and modify or delete all stored documents.
CVE-2026-137491.summary_ko: Budibase 4.0.0 이전 버전에는 권한이 낮거나 익명인 사용자가 ArangoDB·Snowflake 쿼리에 AQL·SQL을 삽입할 수 있는 취약점이 있다. 필터를 우회해 데이터 소스 전체를 읽거나 저장된 모든 문서를 수정·삭제할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137491.background_ko: ArangoDB와 Snowflake 쿼리에 전달되는 매개변수가 이스케이프 처리되지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-137492.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace-scoped builders to access other workspaces' backups by supplying a foreign backupId. Attackers can substitute predictable backup IDs in backup download, import, update, or delete routes to steal archives, restore victim data into their workspace, or delete backups.
CVE-2026-137492.summary_ko: Budibase 4.0.0 이전 버전에는 워크스페이스로 권한이 제한된 빌더가 다른 워크스페이스의 백업에 접근할 수 있는 인가 우회 취약점이 있다. 공격자는 백업 파일을 탈취하거나 피해 데이터를 자신의 워크스페이스로 복원하고, 백업을 삭제할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137493.description: Budibase server from 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view users and anonymous visitors to access entire base tables by passing a view id to the /api/:viewId/rows routes. Attackers can read, export, modify, and delete rows outside the view filter, including hidden columns, or read the full table unauthenticated through PUBLIC views.
CVE-2026-137493.summary_ko: Budibase 서버 3.0.0 이상 4.0.0 미만 버전의 인가 우회 취약점으로, 뷰 사용자가 뷰 필터 밖의 행과 숨겨진 열을 포함한 원본 테이블 전체를 읽기·내보내기·수정·삭제할 수 있다. 공개 뷰에서는 비인증 방문자도 전체 테이블을 읽을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137494.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to reference other tenants' files by supplying arbitrary attachment keys on row save. Attackers can inject a victim app's attachment key into a row, then update or delete the row to delete that object from the shared APPS bucket or read it via presigned URLs.
CVE-2026-137494.summary_ko: Budibase 4.0.0 이전 버전의 객체 수준 인가 결함으로, 테이블 쓰기 권한을 가진 인증 사용자가 다른 테넌트의 파일에 접근할 수 있다. 피해 애플리케이션의 첨부파일을 읽거나 공유 APPS 버킷에서 삭제할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137495.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the bulkDestroy function that allows authenticated users to delete rows from any workspace table by supplying foreign row IDs. Attackers with TABLE WRITE on one table can send row _id values from other tables to the DELETE /api/:sourceId/rows endpoint, causing data loss and workspace metadata deletion.

CVE-2026-137496.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table read permission to execute JavaScript by injecting Handlebars js helpers into row search query values. Attackers can submit base64-encoded JavaScript through the search endpoint, which enrichSearchContext() runs in an isolated-vm sandbox, to read OAuth2 access and refresh tokens of SSO users or cause denial of service.
CVE-2026-137496.summary_ko: Budibase 4.0.0 미만에 서버 측 템플릿 삽입 취약점이 있습니다. 테이블 읽기 권한이 있는 인증된 사용자가 JavaScript를 실행해 SSO 사용자의 OAuth2 접근·갱신 토큰을 읽거나 서비스 거부를 유발할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137496.background_ko: 행 검색 쿼리 값에 포함된 Handlebars js 헬퍼를 enrichSearchContext()가 isolated-vm 샌드박스에서 실행합니다.

CVE-2026-137497.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve legacy LiteLLM credentials by querying the public settings endpoint. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to /api/global/configs/public to obtain liteLLM.keyId and secretKey, enabling unauthorized use of tenant LiteLLM resources.

CVE-2026-137498.description: Budibase Server from 3.39.18 before 4.0.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to erase MongoDB query filters by supplying __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries. Attackers can send a single request to the query execution endpoint, reducing the filter to {} to read, update, or delete every document in the collection.
CVE-2026-137498.summary_ko: Budibase Server 3.39.18 이상 4.0.0 미만에 프로토타입 오염 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 MongoDB 쿼리 필터를 무력화해 컬렉션의 모든 문서를 읽거나 수정·삭제할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137498.background_ko: PUBLIC 쿼리에서 클라이언트가 지정한 동적 JSON 키로 프로토타입이 오염되어 MongoDB 쿼리 필터가 비워진다.

CVE-2026-137499.description: Budibase from 3.41.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over password-less global Builder accounts via unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking. Attackers can assert a victim's email with email_verified=false at a trusted IdP, bypassing the isAccountLinkable allowlist to control all apps, datasources, and automations.
CVE-2026-137499.summary_ko: Budibase 3.41.0 이상 4.0.0 미만에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 비밀번호 없는 전역 Builder 계정을 탈취해 모든 앱·데이터 소스·자동화를 제어할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137499.background_ko: OIDC/SSO 계정 연결 과정에서 미검증 이메일을 허용해 isAccountLinkable 허용 목록 검사가 우회된다.

CVE-2026-137500.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin Creator or app-builder users to read pending invite bearer codes via GET /api/global/users/invites. Attackers can submit a stolen code with a chosen password to the public /api/global/users/invite/accept endpoint, hijacking invited identities up to global admin.

CVE-2026-137501.description: Budibase Server before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass in its single-row read and attachment endpoints, which fetch rows by ID without enforcing the requesting view's row filter. Authenticated users with read access to a filtered view can request GET /api/:viewId/rows/:rowId or GET /api/:viewId/rows/:rowId/attachment/:columnName with a hidden row ID to retrieve that row's data and attachments.

CVE-2026-137503.description: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a JSON injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JSON structure into S3 delete and Google Sheets row fields via unescaped template parameters. Attackers can submit crafted parameters to the queries endpoint to add extra Key entries, deleting chosen S3 objects or overriding Sheets row columns.

CVE-2026-137504.description: actix-multipart (actix-web) before 0.8.7 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in the MultipartForm extractor that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory or file descriptors by sending unlimited parts. Attackers can stream many zero-byte parts uncounted by total_limit and memory_limit, pinning 128 KiB buffers or opening temporary files to crash workers.
CVE-2026-137504.summary_ko: actix-multipart(actix-web) 0.8.7 미만의 MultipartForm 추출기에 자원 고갈 취약점이 있습니다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 메모리나 파일 디스크립터를 소진시켜 워커를 중단시킬 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137504.background_ko: MultipartForm의 total_limit와 memory_limit가 0바이트 파트를 집계하지 않아 버퍼나 임시 파일 자원이 계속 점유될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-137505.description: actix-http before 3.20.4 contains a response desynchronization vulnerability in its HTTP/1 client response decoder, which reads bodies on 1xx, 204 and 304 responses based on Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding headers. Servers sending such responses with framing headers cause awc clients to consume subsequent keep-alive responses, causing request failures or misattributing responses across users in proxies.

CVE-2026-137508.description: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in object.to_json that allows template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit by serializing into an unbounded MemoryStream. Attackers can repeatedly apply object.to_json to escape-heavy strings in a tiny template, amplifying output to multi-gigabyte heap allocations and causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-137509.description: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows template authors to bypass LimitToString by rendering a ScriptObject with many members. Attackers can supply a small template whose ScriptObject.ToString concatenates large member values without length tracking, allocating multi-gigabyte strings and causing memory exhaustion.

CVE-2026-137510.description: Scriban and Scriban.Signed before 7.6.0 allow template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit because the string.literal, string.base64_encode, html.escape, html.newline_to_br, html.url_encode, and html.url_escape builtins lack allocation guards. An attacker who can supply a small template can repeatedly call these builtins under the default TemplateContext to force multi-gigabyte allocations and exhaust host memory.

CVE-2026-137511.description: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a state isolation vulnerability because TemplateContext.Reset() does not clear the Tags dictionary holding array.cycle and math.random state. Attackers supplying templates to a reused context can observe or influence cycle positions and random sequences across renders, and accumulate unbounded cycle entries to exhaust memory.

CVE-2026-137512.description: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass LoopLimit by supplying large JSON input to object.from_json. Attackers can pass a flat JSON array or object with hundreds of thousands of elements, which JsonElementExtensions materializes without loop checks, exhausting CPU and memory.

CVE-2026-137513.description: justhtml before 3.17.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in decode_entities_in_text that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash parsing via non-ASCII Unicode digits in numeric character references. Attackers can submit a payload like &#² in HTML text or attributes, causing an uncaught ValueError from int() that aborts JustHTML() and stream() parsing.

CVE-2026-137514.description: Nodemailer 9.1.0 before 10.4.1 lowercases recipient domains with JavaScript toLowerCase() in _normalizeAddress before UTS-46 mapping, which converts U+1E9E and word-final U+03A3 differently than WHATWG/UTS-46 validators. An unprivileged attacker can submit an address an application's allow-list approves, causing invites or shared links to reach an attacker-registered domain.

CVE-2026-137515.description: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RelaysController::updateAction that allows any authenticated user to modify shared relays and delete other stations' relay associations. Attackers can POST a relay base_url to /internal/relays to rename the relay, wipe StationRemote rows of unmanaged stations, and spoof public now-playing data.

CVE-2026-137516.description: AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the StationPublicApi middleware that allows any authenticated user to access non-public stations without per-station permissions. Attackers can change the station_id path parameter to list and download on-demand media, read schedule data, and submit song requests to unauthorized stations.

CVE-2026-137517.description: ToolJet from 3.8.0 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to modify queries in view-only apps by supplying cross-app query IDs. Attackers can send PATCH requests to /api/data-queries/versions/:versionId naming an editable app version with another app's query ID, then run the overwritten query using that app's data source connection.

CVE-2026-137519.description: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows Builders with only data source Delete permission to update global data sources via the PUT /api/data-sources endpoint. Attackers can change a REST data source base URL so later query executions send stored Bearer credentials to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

CVE-2026-137520.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS is missing the ValidateDataSourceGuard on the dependent-queries route of the data-sources controller and does not scope the datasource lookup to the caller's organization. An authenticated admin or builder with dataSourceDelete can request /api/data-sources/dependent-queries/<datasource_uuid> to confirm a datasource exists in another organization and learn its dependent-query count.

CVE-2026-137521.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated builders to read, modify, or delete other organizations' app-builder components, pages, and events. Attackers can target their own app/version in the URL to pass ValidAppGuard, then supply victim resource ids that services query without appVersionId or organizationId scoping.

CVE-2026-137522.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in QueryAuthGuard that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute queries from unreleased app versions. Attackers can POST to the data-queries run endpoint with a draft query ID from any public app to execute unpublished queries against connected datasources.

CVE-2026-137523.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass in instance-level Google SSO because the id_token audience is not verified when no Google OAuth client ID is configured, the shipped default. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a Google-signed id_token minted for their own OAuth client to /api/sso/sign-in/common/google without an organizationId, obtaining a session as any existing user with the matching email.
CVE-2026-137523.summary_ko: ToolJet 3.21.96-LTS 이전 버전의 인스턴스 수준 Google SSO에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 비인증 공격자가 Google 토큰의 이메일과 일치하는 기존 사용자로 로그인 세션을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137523.background_ko: 기본값인 Google OAuth 클라이언트 ID 미설정 상태에서 id_token의 대상(audience)을 검증하지 않는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-137524.description: ToolJet from 3.20.84 before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the instance-level SSO sign-in path that hardcodes signup as enabled, ignoring all signup-disable controls. Any user with an account on the configured GitHub or Google identity provider can sign in via the OAuth endpoint to obtain an admin session in a newly created workspace.

CVE-2026-137525.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users with TEST_CONNECTION ability to exfiltrate organization secrets by resolving secret placeholders in test-connection options. Attackers can point the host and port at a listener they control and set the password option to a secrets template, causing the server to send the plaintext secret to them.

CVE-2026-137526.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass in the internal database (TJDB) PostgREST proxy, which grants proxy access to every logged-in user and derives the database role and schema from the client-supplied tj-workspace-id header. Any authenticated workspace member can send requests to /api/tooljet-db/proxy/<tableId> to read and modify TJDB tables, bypassing app, query, and table permissions, and in SQL-mode-disabled (Cloud) deployments can access all tenants' tables.
CVE-2026-137526.summary_ko: ToolJet 3.21.96-LTS 미만의 TJDB PostgREST 프록시에 인가 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증된 워크스페이스 구성원은 앱·쿼리·테이블 권한을 우회해 데이터를 읽고 수정할 수 있으며, SQL 모드가 비활성화된 Cloud 배포에서는 모든 테넌트의 테이블에 접근할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137526.background_ko: 프록시가 모든 로그인 사용자에게 접근을 허용하고, 클라이언트가 제공하는 tj-workspace-id 헤더로 데이터베이스 역할과 스키마를 결정한다.

CVE-2026-137527.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a cross-workspace authorization bypass in the organization-users archive and unarchive endpoints, which take the target organizationId from the request body without validating it against the caller's authorized workspaces. An admin of any workspace who knows a target organization-user ID and workspace UUID can archive or unarchive users in other tenants' workspaces, locking them out of those workspaces and tampering with the audit trail.

CVE-2026-137528.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated same-organization users to invoke OAuth2 authorization on data sources they cannot configure. Attackers can send POST requests to /api/data-sources/:id/authorize_oauth2 to bind attacker-controlled OAuth credentials or overwrite token state for foreign data sources.

CVE-2026-137530.description: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getVersionsByEnvironment that allows authenticated users to read another organization's application versions due to missing organizationId scoping. Attackers can request the app-environments versions route with their own priority-1 production environment id and a victim app_id to retrieve the victim's version list and structure.

CVE-2026-137531.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view-only workspace users to execute queries in restricted environments by supplying an arbitrary environmentId. Attackers can call the data-queries run endpoint for draft app versions to execute queries with stored datasource credentials, exposing development or staging data.

CVE-2026-137532.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-workspace files by requesting a known File UUID. Attackers can request GET /api/files/:id with another workspace's File UUID to retrieve stored file bytes, such as avatars, without parent resource authorization checks.

CVE-2026-137534.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privilege app/query viewers to obtain plaintext workspace secrets by running REST queries. Attackers can execute queries via POST /data-queries/:id/run whose URL params or non-redacted headers reference secrets, reading resolved values from metadata.request despite lacking decrypted constants access.

CVE-2026-137535.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privilege users to recover plaintext workspace secret constants through OAuth URL generation. Attackers can send POST /api/data-sources/fetch-oauth2-base-url with {{secrets.*}} in source_options and arbitrary organization_id and environment_id to receive secrets, including other workspaces' secrets, in the returned authorization URL.
CVE-2026-137535.summary_ko: ToolJet 3.21.96-LTS 이전 버전에는 권한이 낮은 인증 사용자가 OAuth URL 생성 기능을 통해 워크스페이스의 비밀 상수를 평문으로 알아낼 수 있는 정보 노출 취약점이 있다. 다른 워크스페이스의 비밀 정보도 노출될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137536.description: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authentication bypass in its server OAuth SSO sign-in module, which resolves Google and Git SSO logins solely by the provider-asserted email without checking email_verified or binding the SSO subject. Unauthenticated attackers can submit a trusted-issuer token carrying a victim's unverified email to the SSO callback to obtain the victim's session, including admin accounts.
CVE-2026-137536.summary_ko: ToolJet 3.21.94-beta 미만의 OAuth SSO 로그인 모듈에 인증 우회 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자는 관리자 계정을 포함한 피해자의 세션을 획득할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137536.background_ko: Google·Git SSO 로그인을 제공자가 제시한 이메일만으로 처리하며, 이메일 검증 여부를 확인하거나 SSO 주체를 계정에 연결하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-137537.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated End Users to execute data queries of apps in other organizations via POST /api/data-queries/:id/run. Attackers can supply a target data-query id and runtime resolvedOptions to run queries with the datasource's decrypted credentials, reading cross-tenant query results.
CVE-2026-137537.summary_ko: ToolJet 3.21.96-LTS 이전 버전에는 인증된 최종 사용자가 다른 조직 앱의 데이터 쿼리를 실행할 수 있는 인가 누락 취약점이 있다. 데이터 소스의 복호화된 자격 증명으로 쿼리를 실행해 다른 테넌트의 쿼리 결과를 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137537.background_ko: 데이터 쿼리 실행 기능에서 인가 검증이 누락된 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-137538.description: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse expired JWTs because the passport-jwt strategy sets ignoreExpiration to true. Attackers holding a leaked tj_auth_token can keep sessions alive through auto-extended expiry and two-year cookies to persistently access victim accounts.

CVE-2026-137540.description: Tornado before 6.6.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in StaticFileHandler on Windows that allows unauthenticated attackers to read NTFS Alternate Data Streams by appending :streamname to URL paths. Attackers can request stream paths that pass the get_absolute_path and _check_in_root prefix checks to read hidden stream content, such as stored secrets or Zone.Identifier source data.

CVE-2026-137541.description: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the QuickDraft Livewire component that allows any authenticated user to create posts without the post.create permission. Attackers such as self-registered Subscriber accounts can submit the dashboard Quick Draft widget to inject draft posts, bypassing the PostPolicy check enforced by PostController.

CVE-2026-137542.description: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in SettingObserver that writes full Setting models, including plaintext secret option_value fields, into the action_logs table. Users holding only actionlog.view can read API keys, SMTP passwords, and OAuth client secrets through the action log API without settings permissions.

CVE-2026-137543.description: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by abusing the unvalidated ai_ollama_base_url setting. Once a settings.edit user points the Ollama base URL internally, any post.create user can call /admin/ai/generate-seo with provider=ollama to fetch internal data reflected in SEO fields.

CVE-2026-137544.description: LaraDashboard before 1.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in module.json providers and composer.json psr-4 namespace parsing that derives destination folder names without excluding traversal characters. Attackers with module.create permission can upload a crafted module ZIP to write PHP files into the public directory, achieving unauthenticated remote code execution.

CVE-2026-137545.description: Coder 2.9.0 before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.12, 2.35.0 before 2.35.9, 2.36.0 before 2.36.7, and 2.37.0 before 2.37.3 contains a nil pointer dereference in the tailnet coordinator, which reads UpdateSelf.Node fields during authorization without checking that Node is set. An authenticated user or workspace agent token holder can send a CoordinateRequest with UpdateSelf present but Node empty to crash coderd, disconnecting all users on the affected replica.

CVE-2026-137546.description: Coder 2.29.17 before 2.29.27, 2.32.7 before 2.33.0, 2.33.8 before 2.34.0, 2.34.2 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious template authors to steal session tokens because coder open app substitutes $SESSION_TOKEN into template-defined external app URLs without validating scheme or destination. Attackers can define an external app URL or IDE link pointing to an attacker server so users running coder open app leak their token, enabling impersonation of shared users or administrators.

CVE-2026-137547.description: Coder before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 returns database connection errors containing a temporary AWS IAM database password in API key middleware responses. During database connection failures, unauthenticated attackers can send a well-formed but invalid API key to obtain the password and access the PostgreSQL database for 15 minutes.
CVE-2026-137547.summary_ko: Coder의 API 키 미들웨어에서 임시 AWS IAM 데이터베이스 비밀번호가 노출됩니다. 데이터베이스 연결 실패 시 인증되지 않은 공격자가 이 비밀번호를 얻어 15분간 PostgreSQL 데이터베이스에 접근할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137547.background_ko: 임시 AWS IAM 데이터베이스 비밀번호가 포함된 데이터베이스 연결 오류가 API 키 미들웨어 응답으로 반환됩니다.

CVE-2026-137548.description: Coder before 2.29.27, 2.30.0 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.7 does not validate the URL scheme of the agent-supplied uri field in app status updates, which the dashboard renders as a clickable link. An attacker holding a workspace agent token, including a prompt-injected AI agent, can show workspace or task viewers links that send them to phishing sites or non-web applications.

CVE-2026-137549.description: pypdf before 7.0.1 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability in image loading because data size estimates for some image modes are too low, defeating limits for filters without their own size limit. Attackers can craft a PDF whose images, when loaded, cause large memory usage and denial of service.

CVE-2026-137550.description: Frappe Framework before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Document.update() that fails to validate whether the caller is permitted to submit or modify the target document. Attackers can invoke document update operations to submit or alter documents they are not authorized to change.
CVE-2026-137550.summary_ko: Frappe Framework 15.122.0 미만 및 16.50.0 미만의 16.x에서 Document.update()의 인가 누락 취약점이 있다. 공격자는 변경 권한이 없는 문서를 제출하거나 수정할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137550.background_ko: Document.update()가 호출자에게 대상 문서를 제출하거나 수정할 권한이 있는지 검증하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-137551.description: Frappe Framework before 15.121.2 and 16.x before 16.36.0 exposes functions imported into module-path-hooked modules as Jinja globals, making them callable from sandboxed templates. Authenticated users who can author rendered templates, such as Print Formats, can invoke these functions by name to achieve server-side code execution that bypasses the Jinja sandbox.
CVE-2026-137551.summary_ko: Frappe Framework 15.121.2 미만 및 16.x의 16.36.0 미만에서 Jinja 샌드박스 우회가 가능합니다. 렌더링되는 템플릿을 작성할 수 있는 인증된 사용자가 서버 측 코드를 실행할 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137551.background_ko: 모듈 경로 훅이 적용된 모듈에 가져온 함수가 Jinja 전역으로 노출되어 샌드박스 템플릿에서도 호출될 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-137552.description: Frappe Framework before 15.121.1 and 16.x before 16.35.0 accepts an undocumented OAuth2 Resource Owner Password Credentials (password) grant at its token endpoint, which does not enforce two-factor authentication or forced password resets. An attacker with a user's valid credentials can use this grant to obtain a full-access OAuth token, bypassing 2FA.
CVE-2026-137552.summary_ko: Frappe Framework 15.121.1 미만 및 16.x의 16.35.0 미만에 2단계 인증 우회 취약점이 있습니다. 유효한 사용자 자격 증명을 가진 공격자가 전체 접근 권한의 OAuth 토큰을 얻을 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-137552.background_ko: 토큰 엔드포인트가 문서화되지 않은 OAuth2 비밀번호 그랜트를 허용하면서 2단계 인증과 강제 비밀번호 재설정을 적용하지 않습니다.

CVE-2026-137553.description: Frappe Framework before 15.120.0 and 16.x before 16.33.0 contains a blind SQL injection vulnerability in the handling of the X-Frappe-Request-Id HTTP header when monitoring is enabled. Remote unauthenticated attackers can send crafted header values to infer database contents through blind SQL injection techniques.
CVE-2026-137553.summary_ko: Frappe Framework 15.120.0 미만 및 16.x의 16.33.0 미만에서 모니터링 활성화 시 X-Frappe-Request-Id 헤더 처리에 블라인드 SQL 삽입 취약점이 있습니다. 인증되지 않은 원격 공격자가 데이터베이스 내용을 추론할 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-137555.description: Frappe Framework before 15.119.0 and 16.x before 16.32.0 does not neutralize spreadsheet formula elements in user-supplied data included in CSV and XLSX exports, resulting in stored formula injection. Authenticated attackers can store crafted values that are interpreted as formulas when another user opens the exported file in a spreadsheet application.

CVE-2026-137556.description: Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability in validateStackPath, which omits the isProtectedPath() check and permits writes to protected system directories. Authenticated users with stacks:edit permission can send a crafted composePath to PUT /api/stacks/[name]/compose to write arbitrary files, such as cron payloads, achieving remote code execution as root.
CVE-2026-137556.summary_ko: Dockhand 1.0.57 이전 버전의 경로 탐색 취약점으로, stacks:edit 권한이 있는 인증 사용자가 보호된 시스템 디렉터리에 임의 파일을 쓸 수 있다. 이를 통해 root 권한으로 원격 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137556.background_ko: validateStackPath에서 isProtectedPath() 검사를 누락해 보호된 시스템 디렉터리에 대한 쓰기를 허용하는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-137557.description: SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the codeBlock plugin that allows attackers to inject script via entity-encoded pre language class values. Attackers can store content whose language- class decodes to HTML written via innerHTML into the hover button, executing script when victims hover over the block.

CVE-2026-137558.description: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 contain a decryption oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSAOAEP(), which accepts a JWE Encrypted Key made of multiple RSA blocks instead of a single RSAES-OAEP ciphertext. Attackers holding the recipient's public key can embed a captured encrypted key among crafted blocks and, using an accepted AES-CBC-HMAC algorithm and a decryption success signal, recover its CEK byte by byte to decrypt the captured JWE.

CVE-2026-137559.description: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allow CPU exhaustion because, on PHP without GMP, AbstractECDH falls back to pure PHP curve code that converts unbounded ECDH-ES epk x and y coordinates to big integers before any length check. Unauthenticated attackers who know only the recipient key's curve can send small JWEs with oversized epk coordinates, keeping workers busy for seconds to minutes per token.

CVE-2026-137560.description: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 contain a denial of service vulnerability in RSAKey, which accepts RSA keys with a modulus and public exponent of unbounded length. Remote attackers can supply a crafted key, such as in the jwk header of a DPoP proof, to force seconds of CPU per PS256/PS384/PS512 verification or RSA encryption, or per any RSA operation when GMP is unavailable.

CVE-2026-137561.description: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10, contain a token malleability flaw because JWEDecrypter does not reject a non-empty JWE Encrypted Key with the dir, ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS algorithms, which the authentication tag does not cover. Attackers holding one token can fill the Encrypted Key with arbitrary bytes to derive unlimited distinct token strings that still decrypt, bypassing replay caches, single-use registries or revocation deny-lists keyed on the token string.

CVE-2026-137562.description: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 does not check oct key length in the AESKW, AESGCMKW, and experimental AESCTR and chacha20-poly1305 key encryption algorithms, so OpenSSL zero-pads short or empty keys. When an application uses an empty key, anyone can unwrap content encryption keys under the all-zero key to read issued tokens and forge accepted ones.

CVE-2026-137563.description: web-token jwt-framework from 4.2.1 before 4.2.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes decryption keys in exception stack traces when JWE tokens are rejected. Attackers can submit crafted JWE tokens so JWELoader and JWEDecrypter record dir, AES key wrapping, PBES2-derived or content encryption keys in logged trace arguments readable by others.

CVE-2026-137564.description: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 (and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10) do not check the key length in JWEBuilder and JWEDecrypter for direct (dir) encryption, so undersized keys are zero-padded. Anyone holding a token issued with a half-size AES-CBC-HMAC key can decrypt it, and an empty key also allows forging tokens the decrypter accepts.

CVE-2026-137579.description: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-core through 3.2.10, perform unblinded RSA private key operations in RSAKey::exponentiate(), so CRT recombination time reveals whether a decrypted RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256, or RSA1_5 value is below the prime q. Attackers who can submit JWEs can time rejections of crafted tokens to binary search q, factor the modulus, and decrypt all JWEs encrypted to that key.

CVE-2026-137580.description: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 parse JSON General serialized JWS tokens in quadratic time because JSONGeneralSerializer::unserialize() adds each signature via JWS::addSignature(), which clones the token. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send large tokens holding thousands of empty signatures to exhaust CPU and occupy PHP workers without any valid key or token.

CVE-2026-137581.description: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption and jwt-signature through 3.2.10, contain a denial of service vulnerability because the JWS and JWE serializers pass attacker-controlled tokens and protected headers to json_decode() without bounds before verification. Unauthenticated attackers can submit large tokens with colliding header member names or deeply nested arrays to cause quadratic decoding time or fatal memory exhaustion.

CVE-2026-137582.description: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 allows denial of service because JWELoader and JWSLoader try every recipient or signature of a JSON General serialized token without limiting their number. Unauthenticated attackers can send a small JWE with many empty recipients inheriting a maximal PBES2 p2c value, forcing repeated key derivations that exhaust worker CPU.

CVE-2026-76075.description: The Warehouse Cargo theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in versions up to, and including, 2.7.4 via the warehouse_cargo_install_and_activate_plugin() AJAX handler. The handler is registered on wp_ajax_ but performs no nonce verification and no capability check, allowing any authenticated user to supply an attacker-controlled URL that the server fetches, writes into wp-content/plugins/ with file_put_contents(), extracts with unzip_file() (which does not filter file extensions), and then activates via activate_plugin(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to upload arbitrary files on the affected site's server which makes remote code execution possible.
CVE-2026-76075.summary_ko: WordPress용 Warehouse Cargo 테마 2.7.4 이하에는 임의 파일 업로드 취약점이 있습니다. 구독자(Subscriber) 이상 권한의 인증된 공격자가 서버에 임의 파일을 업로드할 수 있으며, 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있습니다.
CVE-2026-76075.background_ko: warehouse_cargo_install_and_activate_plugin() AJAX 처리기에 논스 검증과 권한 확인이 없고, 압축 해제 시 파일 확장자를 필터링하지 않아 발생합니다.

CVE-2026-85412.description: The Easy Form Builder by WhiteStudio – Drag & Drop Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'address' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A valid nonce required for form submission can be freely obtained by any unauthenticated visitor via the publicly accessible REST route 'Emsfb/v1/nonce/refresh', which is registered with no permission check, enabling the full attack chain without any credentials.

CVE-2026-85416.description: The Lenix Leads Collector plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Form Field Name in all versions up to, and including, 2.0.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable because the plugin's CF7 integration accepts and stores any extra field name not defined in the CF7 form — including HTML/JS payloads — submitted by an unauthenticated user via a public CF7 form submission, with the raw field name later echoed unescaped in two separate admin-side sinks.

CVE-2026-90962.description: The WebP Express plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass via Malformed Bcrypt Salt in all versions up to, and including, 0.25.15. This is due to insufficient validation of the attacker-supplied `salt` POST parameter in the `runAccessChecks()` function, which passes the unvalidated salt directly to PHP's `crypt()` — causing it to return an empty string when the salt contains characters outside the valid bcrypt alphabet `[./0-9A-Za-z]` — and then loosely compares the resulting empty string against the attacker-controlled `api-key-crypted` POST parameter using `==`, allowing an empty submission to match and satisfy the check. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to bypass the web service API-key authentication check and upload arbitrary image files to the cloud-conversion endpoint, where they persist at a predictable, publicly reachable path under `wp-content/webp-express/webp-images/wpc/`. The 'Require api-key to be crypted in transfer?' whitelist setting does not mitigate this bypass, as it only gates the plaintext API-key comparison branch and has no effect on the crypted-key branch containing the vulnerable logic.

CVE-2026-92251.description: The ZarinPal Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 5.1.1 via the `Return_from_ZarinPal_Gateway()` handler registered on the `woocommerce_api_wc_zpal` (`?wc-api=wc_zpal`) endpoint. The handler accepts a `wc_order` parameter from the query string, loads the corresponding WooCommerce order without any authentication, nonce, session, capability, or ownership check, and — when the order is paid — issues a 302 redirect to `get_return_url($order)`, whose `Location` header embeds the order's secret `order_key`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to harvest order keys for arbitrary orders (regardless of payment method) and then use those keys against the WooCommerce order-received, order-pay and download endpoints to read the associated customer's PII, including billing name, street address, phone number, email, purchased items, and totals.

CVE-2026-97345.description: The SumUp Payment Gateway For WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 2.17.1 via the 'sumup-validate-order' query parameter handled by the check_redirect_flow() / resolve_payment_redirect_validation() functions. The template_redirect handler accepts an arbitrary numeric order ID from an unauthenticated GET request and, without any ownership or capability check, loads the corresponding WooCommerce order and issues a 302 redirect whose Location header is built by get_return_url(), disclosing the target order's secret order_key. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to enumerate order IDs, harvest each order's WooCommerce order_key, and use those keys against the plugin's create_checkout endpoint and WooCommerce's own order-received/order-pay pages to read customer PII (name, email, phone, billing address, order total) for any order in the store.

CVE-2025-8209.description: The Ultimate Bootstrap Elements for Elementor plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via multiple widgets in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on user supplied attributes. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.

CVE-2026-102001.description: The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'nickname / display_name (via WP core profile form); thread[body] carries the [quote data-userid=..] trigger' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the site administrator has disabled the profiles.mention_nicknames setting (which is off by default), causing apply_quotes() to use display_name rather than a sanitized nickname when building the data-mention attribute.

CVE-2026-135205.description: @fastify/middie is the plugin that adds Express-style middleware support to the Fastify web framework. In versions 9.3.6 through 9.3.9, a route or mount path written without a leading slash inside a plugin registered under a prefix is handled inconsistently: the middleware is mounted with a separating slash after the prefix, while the route is concatenated directly onto the prefix, so a request to the concatenated path reaches the route handler without running the middleware mounted for it. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes. The issue is fixed in @fastify/middie 9.3.10, and users should upgrade to 9.3.10 or later. As a workaround, begin all route and mount paths with a slash, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-135230.description: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.3 before 4.0.14, the plugin decodes certain percent-encoded characters in the request path that Express would otherwise keep encoded, including the Unicode line separator and paragraph separator characters, and leaves them raw. A JavaScript regular expression treats those two characters as line terminators, so a regular-expression mount path that relies on the dot metacharacter fails to match a request containing them while Fastify's own router still routes the request to its handler, and the middleware mounted on that regular-expression path is therefore skipped. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on routes guarded by a regular-expression mount; string mount paths are not affected. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, use string mount paths, avoid the dot metacharacter in regular-expression mounts by using a character class or the dotAll flag, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-135264.description: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.7 before 4.0.14, when middleware is mounted on a nested array of mount paths the plugin rewrites only the top level of the array, so paths inside a nested array are not adjusted for a plugin registered under a prefix and the middleware never runs for them, a nested regular-expression mount keeps its global or sticky flag and is matched statefully so it is skipped on alternating requests, a nested regular expression is not matched case-insensitively when case sensitivity is disabled, and nested dynamic paths are not covered by the earlier empty-segment check. An attacker can use any of these to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, flatten mount path arrays before passing them to the plugin, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-135270.description: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.5 before 4.0.14, a mount path that begins with an Express 5 optional leading segment written as a group is treated as relative and has a slash prepended when it is joined to the plugin prefix, which changes what the pattern matches so the middleware ends up mounted on a path that no longer corresponds to the real request paths. The middleware therefore never runs for requests that match the intended routes, while the Fastify routes still resolve to their handlers. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, mount the middleware on each path spelling explicitly, or enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after the router resolves the request.

CVE-2026-135279.description: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.14, a request with an empty dynamic route parameter reaches a Fastify route handler while middleware mounted for that path inside an Express Router or sub-application is skipped, because Fastify's router accepts an empty value where Express requires a non-empty one, and an unanchored regular-expression mount passed to the plugin is bypassed the same way. An earlier fix covered only the mount paths passed to the plugin directly, not middleware mounted inside a routed Express application. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes, with the practical impact depending on what the empty value selects in the application. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after routing, mount the middleware on a static parent path, or require non-empty values in the route params schema.
CVE-2026-135279.summary_ko: @fastify/express 4.0.14 미만에서는 특정 경로의 Express 미들웨어가 건너뛰어져 인증이나 접근 통제가 우회될 수 있습니다. 실제 영향은 애플리케이션에서 빈 경로 값이 선택하는 대상에 따라 달라집니다.
CVE-2026-135279.background_ko: Fastify는 Express와 달리 빈 동적 경로 매개변수를 허용해, Express Router나 하위 애플리케이션에 등록된 경로별 미들웨어를 건너뛸 수 있습니다.

CVE-2026-135280.description: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions before 4.0.14, when an application enables case-insensitive routing, middleware mounted on a path can still be skipped in two cases: a string mount path or plugin prefix containing a Unicode character whose case folding differs from a plain lowercase conversion fails to match the lowercased request path, and a matcher that stays case-sensitive inside an Express Router or application, such as a regular expression without the ignore-case flag or an explicitly case-sensitive router, only matches its own casing. In both cases a request reaches the Fastify route handler while the path-scoped middleware does not run. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affected routes, and only applications that enable case-insensitive routing are affected. The issue is fixed in @fastify/express 4.0.14, and users should upgrade to 4.0.14 or later. As a workaround, enforce authentication in a Fastify hook such as preHandler that runs after routing, avoid such Unicode characters in mount paths, and match case-insensitively inside Express routers and applications.

CVE-2026-137407.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Max Foundry Media Library Folders Plugin up to 8.4.3 on WordPress. Affected by this issue is the function mlfp_toggle_file_access of the file media-library-plus.php of the component Block Direct Access. Such manipulation of the argument file_id leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. Upgrading to version 8.4.4 can resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-137409.description: A flaw has been found in chuckfairy node-webcam up to 0.8.2. This vulnerability affects the function generateSh of the file src/webcams/FSWebcam.js of the component FSWebcam. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-137410.description: A vulnerability has been found in liuwy-project zhglxt up to 3fd4ad44458f87bdad0afa997ba29706488fa1ff. This issue affects the function markdownUploadFile of the file zhglxt-web/src/main/java/com/zhglxt/web/controller/common/CommonController.java. The manipulation of the argument editormd-image-file leads to unrestricted upload. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. This product is using a rolling release to provide continious delivery. Therefore, no version details for affected nor updated releases are available.

CVE-2026-137411.description: A vulnerability was found in projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System 1.0. Impacted is the function searchItem of the file application/models/dashbord_model.php of the component Dashbord Search. The manipulation of the argument q results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE-2026-137412.description: A vulnerability was determined in projectworlds Online Jewellery Shopping System 1.0. The affected element is the function Dashbord_model.searchAdvance of the file /jewllary-shop/application/models/dashbord_model.php of the component Advanced Search. This manipulation of the argument from/to causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

CVE-2026-137414.description: A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file view_event.php. Such manipulation of the argument ID leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

CVE-2026-137415.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Tencent RapidJSON up to 1.1.0. This affects the function Writer::WriteString in the library include/rapidjson/writer.h. Performing a manipulation of the argument length results in integer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The patch is named 297637bc0a0f00dc504dbc1a47ebdaa577f8ae19. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

CVE-2026-137416.description: A weakness has been identified in sgl-project SpecForge 0.2.0. This impacts the function Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding of the file specforge/modeling/draft/base.py of the component Draft Embedding Loader. Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The attack can only be executed locally. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called d8a0d78e071199563ef19d9171052096dec89f71. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.

CVE-2026-120353.description: The Apache Airflow TaskFlow decorators @task.bash, @task.sql, @task.analytics, @task.kubernetes_cmd and the common.ai decorators (@task.llm, @task.agent, @task.llm_sql, @task.llm_branch, @task.llm_file_analysis, @task.llm_schema_compare) rendered Jinja templates a second time after the task runner had already rendered them, so any value copied into env, op_args, op_kwargs or the returned prompt, command or SQL was evaluated as a template on the worker. An attacker who can only trigger a Dag run (for example a user with trigger permission supplying run conf), or who controls text that a Dag passes into one of these decorators as an argument or prompt (for example a ticket or a downloaded document), could run arbitrary commands on the worker and read connection passwords and Variables, in any deployment that uses an affected decorator in a Dag that passes such input through env, parameters or prompt. Users are recommended to upgrade apache-airflow-providers-standard to 1.22.0, apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes to 11.0.0, apache-airflow-providers-common-sql to 3.0.0 and apache-airflow-providers-common-ai to 1.2.0 or later.
CVE-2026-120353.summary_ko: Apache Airflow의 일부 TaskFlow 및 common.ai 데코레이터에 템플릿 중복 평가 취약점이 있다. 해당 데코레이터를 사용하는 DAG에 실행 설정이나 외부 텍스트를 전달할 수 있는 공격자는 워커에서 임의 명령을 실행하고 연결 비밀번호와 Variables 값을 읽을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-120353.background_ko: 태스크 러너가 이미 렌더링한 값을 데코레이터가 Jinja 템플릿으로 다시 렌더링해, 인수·환경변수·프롬프트 등에 포함된 입력이 워커에서 재평가된다.

CVE-2026-134470.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Host.it Fastcache by Host.it fastcache-by-host-it allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Fastcache by Host.it: from n/a through 1.7.14.

CVE-2026-134488.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid Radius Booking — Booking Calendar for Appointments & Services radius-booking allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Radius Booking — Booking Calendar for Appointments & Services: from n/a through 1.0.22.

CVE-2026-134712.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in DevItems ShopLentor woolentor-addons allows Stored XSS.This issue affects ShopLentor: from n/a through 3.5.9.

CVE-2026-134713.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in INTINITUM FORM Transliterator serbian-transliteration allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Transliterator: from n/a through 2.5.15.

CVE-2026-134714.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Webful Creations RepairBuddy computer-repair-shop allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects RepairBuddy: from n/a through 4.1237.

CVE-2026-134955.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in tychesoftwares Product Input Fields for WooCommerce product-input-fields-for-woocommerce allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Product Input Fields for WooCommerce: from n/a through 2.0.3.

CVE-2026-135037.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Mohammed Kaludi AMP for WP accelerated-mobile-pages allows Stored XSS.This issue affects AMP for WP: from n/a through 1.1.21.

CVE-2026-135038.description: Missing Authorization vulnerability in weDevs WP ERP erp allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP ERP: from n/a through 2.0.0.

CVE-2026-135039.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP GiveWP give allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects GiveWP: from n/a through 4.19.2.1.

CVE-2026-137418.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Cerebras ModelZoo up to d76e028d6a5f784954b1329b3ae44721ca8da36a. Affected is the function StreamingShardedHFReader of the file src/cerebras/modelzoo/tools/checkpoint_converters/streaming_checkpoints.py of the component Checkpoint Converter. The manipulation of the argument weight_map leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-137436.description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file add_reserve.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument room_id results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

CVE-2026-137437.description: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file add_reserve.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument Date can lead to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

CVE-2026-137440.description: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /HOR/admin/add_room.php. The manipulation of the argument photo leads to unrestricted upload. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

CVE-2026-134489.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeum Kirki kirki allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Kirki: from n/a through 6.4.2.

CVE-2026-134705.description: Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in miniOrange miniorange otp verification miniorange-otp-verification allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects miniorange otp verification: from n/a through 5.6.2.

CVE-2026-134720.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Webful Creations RepairBuddy computer-repair-shop allows Stored XSS.This issue affects RepairBuddy: from n/a through 4.1237.

CVE-2026-134991.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Addons for Elementor powerpack-lite-for-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects PowerPack Addons for Elementor: from n/a through 3.2.0.

CVE-2026-134997.description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in KAP ASIAs LottieFiles – JSON Based Animation Lottie & Bodymovin for Elementor <= 1.10.9 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting include-lottie-animation-for-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects LottieFiles – JSON Based Animation Lottie & Bodymovin for Elementor <= 1.10.9 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting: from n/a through 2.0.3.

CVE-2026-137441.description: A security flaw has been discovered in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /admin/manage_event.php. The manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-137450.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in GH05TCREW PentestAgent 0.2.0. This vulnerability affects the function _execute_single of the file pentestagent/agents/base_agent.py of the component Workspace Scope Gate. Such manipulation leads to missing authorization. The attack needs to be performed locally. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-137506.description: ezdxf through 1.4.5 contains a code injection vulnerability in the dxf2code add-on that allows attackers to inject Python code via unescaped single quotes in DXF table entry names. Attackers can craft a DXF file whose layer, linetype, style, or appid names break out of quoted strings in generated scripts, executing code with the privileges of the user running them.

CVE-2026-137507.description: torchvision before 0.29.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in _extract_tar() that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory by supplying crafted tar archives. Attackers controlling archives passed to extract_archive() or download_and_extract_archive() can use .. paths, absolute paths, or symlinks to overwrite Python modules and achieve code execution.
CVE-2026-137507.summary_ko: torchvision 0.29.2 이전 버전의 _extract_tar()에 경로 순회 취약점이 있어, 공격자가 제어하는 tar 압축 파일로 추출 디렉터리 밖에 파일을 쓸 수 있다. Python 모듈을 덮어써 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-137507.background_ko: _extract_tar()의 압축 해제 과정에서 상위 디렉터리 경로, 절대 경로 또는 심볼릭 링크를 통해 추출 디렉터리 밖에 접근할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137518.description: pyfda through 0.9.5 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in load_filter() that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .npz or .pkl filter files. Attackers can embed a __reduce__ gadget that runs via np.load with allow_pickle=True or pickle.load before validation, executing code with the user's privileges.

CVE-2026-137529.description: JAL (Just Another Ledger) through 2026.11.3 contains an arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability in backup restore that allows attackers to write files by supplying a crafted .tgz backup with a symlink member. Attackers can include a jal.sqlite symlink to an absolute path followed by a regular jal.sqlite member, overwriting files such as shell startup scripts for code execution.

CVE-2026-137539.description: lastversion before 3.6.20 contains a path traversal vulnerability in extract_tar() that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory via tar symlink members. Attackers controlling a project's release assets can craft a tarball with a symlink followed by a file beneath it, writing files like usercustomize.py to achieve code execution.

CVE-2026-137588.description: LibreChat 0.7.6 before 0.8.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to block the server event loop by uploading a crafted conversation import file to POST /api/convos/import. Attackers can submit many messages with unresolvable parentMessageId values, triggering quadratic processing in cloneMessagesWithTimestamps or adjustTimestampsForOrdering and stalling the Node.js event loop for minutes for all users.

CVE-2026-137655.description: Video Popup Block by WPZOOM 1.1.2 before 1.1.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject markup via unescaped video URL and popup width values. Attackers can store a block whose .mp4 URL or width breaks out of attributes in frontend.js, executing script in the site's origin when users open the popup.

CVE-2026-137656.description: LibreChat 0.7.8 before 0.8.9 contains a race condition vulnerability in checkBalance that allows authenticated users to obtain multiple auto-refill credits by sending concurrent requests. Attackers can send simultaneous chat requests that each pass the unlocked lastRefill check, receiving repeated refillAmount credits and bypassing configured token credit limits.

CVE-2026-137657.description: InternLM LMDeploy 0.9.0 through 0.18.0 contains an unbounded resource allocation vulnerability in the DistServe proxy /distserve/connection_warmup endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory. While a prefill/decode connection is pending, for example after registering a slow node via /nodes/add, repeated warmup requests spawn unbounded wait_for_conn() tasks and sockets until the proxy process is killed.

CVE-2026-126139.description: Docker Sandboxes re-resolves saved mount paths when replacing a sandbox container during kit changes or restarting a sandbox. An attacker able to replace a source ancestor in a shared writable workspace with a symlink can redirect another sandbox's mount to a different host directory, exposing its contents and permitting modification through read-write mounts. The destination must remain accessible to the daemon and allowed by policy where enforced. Saved-mount replay during kit replacement was introduced in version 0.35.0; ordinary restart replay was added in version 0.45.0. This saved-mount replay issue is fixed in version 0.54.0.

CVE-2026-137618.description: A vulnerability was identified in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. This impacts the function hpm_adc_enabled of the file bsp/hpmicro/libraries/drivers/drv_adc.c of the component HPM ADC Driver. The manipulation of the argument channel leads to improper validation of array index. The attack needs to be performed locally. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The identifier of the patch is fc64f78669b42b35981f97c23c7e952832f3b48b. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

CVE-2026-137620.description: A security flaw has been discovered in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. Affected is the function davinci_spi_get_prescale of the file bsp/dm365/drivers/spi-davinci.c of the component DM365 SPI Driver. The manipulation of the argument max_hz results in divide by zero. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The patch is identified as e12183f7b87eddf182b95bf8b400acd626880306. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

CVE-2026-137621.description: A weakness has been identified in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. Affected by this vulnerability is the function bl_adc_get_value of the file bsp/bouffalo_lab/libraries/rt_drivers/drv_adc.c of the component Bouffalo ADC Driver. This manipulation of the argument channel causes improper validation of array index. The attack requires local access. Patch name: b3a0eb5e12c6dca8145fc49d76c4785478c9e55b. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue.

CVE-2026-4981.description: A flaw was found in Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security (ACS). An unauthenticated remote attacker can exploit a vulnerability in the login interface's OAuth callback endpoint by crafting a malicious URL. This URL, containing unvalidated `error` and `error_uri` parameters, allows the attacker to display arbitrary error messages, leading to content spoofing. Furthermore, the attacker can redirect victims to malicious domains, effectively performing an open redirect under the guise of the trusted application's user interface.

CVE-2026-135107.description: An **uncontrolled memory allocation** flaw has been found in the smbd_smb2_ioctl_pipe_write_done() function in source3/smbd/smb2_ioctl_named_pipe.c of the SMB2 named-pipe ioctl handling in the **Samba** package. The file server reserves memory for a named-pipe response using a size chosen by the client. It does not keep that size within the maximum the client and the server have already agreed. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can open a named pipe can request a very large response. The file server reserves that memory before it reads the pipe and holds it until the request ends. Repeating this on more connections can exhaust memory and keep the file service unavailable while those requests continue.

CVE-2026-137596.description: A server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw was found in KubeVirt's decentralized live migration. The connectURL field of a VirtualMachineInstanceMigration object is not validated at admission, and the privileged synchronization-controller dials the attacker-specified URL. Connection and DNS errors from the dial are exposed in a condition readable in the tenant's namespace. A user with the kubevirt.io:migrate role (a role designed for tenant delegation) can use this behavior as a blind network-reconnaissance oracle to determine the existence and connectivity of internal hosts and ports from the controller's network vantage, including services isolated from the tenant by network policy. TLS certificate pinning prevents session completion with non-KubeVirt hosts, limiting the impact to information disclosure of internal network topology; no data content, integrity, or availability impact is possible.

CVE-2026-137602.description: A flaw was found in Keycloak. This vulnerability enables information disclosure when the parameterized-scopes feature is enabled. The protocol mapper fails to enforce authorization checks for certain scope parameter types during token and authorization requests. An authenticated remote attacker can exploit this flaw by supplying a crafted scope parameter to retrieve sensitive profile attributes of other users without authorization.

CVE-2026-137653.description: A flaw was found in spice-server. A malicious SPICE client can send a message header declaring an arbitrarily large message body. The server sizes the receive-buffer allocation from this declared size before any message content is received; when the allocation fails, the process hosting the SPICE server terminates abruptly, causing a denial of service for the virtual machine it serves. On hosts with sufficient free memory, the same technique can instead hold large amounts of memory per connection. Exploitation requires network access to the SPICE port; credential requirements depend on the server's authentication configuration.

CVE-2026-137660.description: A vulnerability has been found in stylefeng Guns up to 2.2. Affected by this issue is the function TokenAndPermissionInterceptor.preHandle of the file TokenAndPermissionInterceptor.java of the component JWT Signing. Such manipulation leads to use of hard-coded cryptographic key . It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

CVE-2026-114454.description: Path traversal in TPM device management in Canonical LXD from 4.8 before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a remote authenticated user with project access to recursively delete arbitrary files and directories on the host as root via a crafted device name during instance or device removal.

CVE-2026-115843.description: In LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2, an improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory vulnerability allows an authenticated client restricted to a single project to write and delete files at arbitrary host filesystem paths as root. When a custom storage volume is pushed to a LXD daemon, the snapshot names supplied by the migration peer are never validated and are used to build the filesystem path of each received snapshot. This allows an attacker to place attacker-controlled files into any host directory as root, gaining root-level code execution on the host, and to recursively delete an attacker-chosen path.
CVE-2026-115843.summary_ko: LXD 4.0.16·5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전에 경로 제한 취약점이 있다. 단일 프로젝트로 제한된 인증 클라이언트가 호스트의 임의 파일을 root 권한으로 쓰거나 삭제하고, 호스트에서 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-115843.background_ko: 사용자 지정 스토리지 볼륨을 수신할 때 마이그레이션 상대가 제공한 스냅샷 이름을 검증하지 않고 파일시스템 경로 구성에 사용한다.

CVE-2026-115844.description: In LXD before 5.21.0 and 6.10.0, an OS command injection vulnerability allows an authenticated client restricted to a single project to execute arbitrary code as root on the host.
