The raw.dnsmasq bridge network configuration key is not restricted to server administrators and is copied verbatim into the dnsmasq configuration file, so a user whose project keeps the default features.networks=false can have a bridge network created in the default project with an injected dhcp-script directive. This allows an attacker to make the host dnsmasq execute attacker-chosen code as root on a DHCP lease event and fully compromise the host.
CVE-2026-115844.summary_ko: LXD 5.21.0 및 6.10.0 이전 버전에 운영체제 명령어 삽입 취약점이 있다. 단일 프로젝트로 권한이 제한된 인증 클라이언트가 호스트에서 루트 권한으로 임의 코드를 실행하고 호스트를 완전히 장악할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-115844.background_ko: raw.dnsmasq 브리지 네트워크 설정 키가 서버 관리자만 사용하도록 제한되지 않고, 설정값이 dnsmasq 설정 파일에 그대로 복사된다.

CVE-2026-122225.description: Symbolic link following in imported VM backup config drive preparation in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project-scoped permissions to disclose sensitive host files, including LXD server and cluster keys, and overwrite host files as root via importing and starting a VM backup with a symlinked config directory.
CVE-2026-122225.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 4.0.16·5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 VM 백업 처리에 심볼릭 링크 추종 취약점이 있다. 프로젝트 범위 권한을 가진 인증 사용자가 서버·클러스터 키 등 호스트의 민감 파일을 유출하거나 루트 권한으로 호스트 파일을 덮어쓸 수 있다.
CVE-2026-122225.background_ko: 가져온 VM 백업의 설정 드라이브를 준비하는 과정에서 설정 디렉터리의 심볼릭 링크를 따라가는 것이 원인이다.

CVE-2026-127151.description: Exposure of resource to wrong sphere in VM disk migration, export, and attach NBD servers in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an unprivileged local user in the host network namespace to read and modify a guest VM's disk and execute code inside the guest via connecting to abstract Unix sockets while an operation is active.

CVE-2026-127152.description: Improper privilege management during container rebuild in Canonical LXD before 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a local user with container permissions to gain root privileges on the host via rebuilding a never-started unprivileged container so it starts without a user namespace or privileged-container hardening.
CVE-2026-127152.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 컨테이너 재구축 과정에 권한 관리 취약점이 있다. 컨테이너 권한이 있는 로컬 사용자가 호스트의 root 권한을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127152.background_ko: 시작한 적 없는 비특권 컨테이너를 재구축하면 사용자 네임스페이스나 특권 컨테이너용 보안 강화 조치 없이 시작된다.

CVE-2026-127153.description: Path traversal in proxy and CDI GPU device name handling in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, and 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with access to a restricted project permitting proxy or GPU devices to read, overwrite, or delete arbitrary host files as root and terminate host processes via crafted device names containing path traversal sequences.

CVE-2026-127154.description: Improper link resolution in image metadata tarball unpacking in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, and 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with a restricted client certificate to write arbitrary host files as root and execute code on the host via a crafted rootfs symlink in an image metadata tarball.
CVE-2026-127154.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 이미지 메타데이터 압축 파일 해제에 링크 해석 취약점이 있다. 제한된 클라이언트 인증서를 가진 인증 사용자가 호스트의 임의 파일을 root 권한으로 쓰고 호스트에서 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127154.background_ko: 이미지 메타데이터 tar 압축 파일을 풀 때 rootfs 심볼릭 링크를 부적절하게 해석한다.

CVE-2026-127157.description: Exposure of sensitive information in token operation events in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user restricted to a project to gain full server access and cancel pending token operations via capturing certificate or cluster join token secrets broadcast to default project event listeners.
CVE-2026-127157.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 토큰 작업 이벤트에서 민감 정보가 노출되는 취약점이다. 프로젝트로 권한이 제한된 인증 사용자가 서버 전체 접근 권한을 얻고 대기 중인 토큰 작업을 취소할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-127157.background_ko: 인증서 토큰이나 클러스터 가입 토큰의 비밀값이 기본 프로젝트의 이벤트 수신자에게 전송되어 노출된다.

CVE-2026-127158.description: Exposure of sensitive information and missing requestor validation in instance, volume, and snapshot migration operations in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project event or operation read access to read migrating configuration and filesystem data and disrupt the migration via capturing per-connection websocket secrets from operation metadata and racing the migration's data channels.

CVE-2026-127160.description: Configuration injection in virtual machine disk device handling in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with VM creation permissions in a restricted project to bypass low-level VM restrictions and control the root QEMU process via quotes and line breaks in a disk device's guest path.

CVE-2026-127161.description: Exposure of sensitive information in live and stateful migration operations in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project event or operation read access to read a migrating instance's checkpointed runtime state and disrupt the migration via capturing the state connection secret from operation events or queries.

CVE-2026-127162.description: Improper output encoding in Prometheus metrics exposition in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a user controlling a virtual machine to forge host metric labels and break metrics scraping via unescaped guest-controlled filesystem mountpoints and network interface names.

CVE-2026-127163.description: Improper certificate validation in websocket connections in Canonical pylxd before 2.4.3 allows a network attacker to read command stdin and spoof command output via impersonating a remote LXD endpoint.

CVE-2026-133530.description: The Android application "Tokyo Fire Department Official App" contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a malicious application installed on a user's device to obtain sensitive information from the affected application.

CVE-2026-135372.description: Incorrect authorization in custom storage volume, backup, and storage bucket endpoints in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with a project-restricted certificate or per-object authorization to read, rename, move, replace, or delete other projects' storage resources and bypass cluster group restrictions via missing project or object ownership checks.

CVE-2026-135373.description: Path traversal in container device path resolution and VM disk format detection in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with project access, including an unprivileged local user through lxd-user, to read and modify arbitrary host files or Ceph RBD images and gain root privileges on the host via crafted device paths or QCOW2 backing file references.
CVE-2026-135373.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 4.0.16·5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전에 경로 순회 취약점이 있다. lxd-user를 통한 비특권 로컬 사용자를 포함해 프로젝트 접근 권한을 가진 인증 사용자가 호스트의 임의 파일이나 Ceph RBD 이미지를 읽고 수정하거나 호스트 root 권한을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135373.background_ko: 컨테이너 장치 경로 해석과 VM 디스크 형식 탐지 과정에 경로 순회 문제가 있다.

CVE-2026-135374.description: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in shared image handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user restricted to a single project to export private images, replace public image contents, remove other projects' images, and pin daemon memory via abusing fingerprint-based image sharing, partial fingerprints, and non-expiring push upload tokens.

CVE-2026-135375.description: Untrusted search path and context handling in host-side instance helpers in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access or root inside an unprivileged container to execute arbitrary code as root on the host, read daemon memory, remount read-only shifted disks as read-write, and disrupt other projects' mounts via file API, SFTP, syscall interception, and disk hot-plug operations.
CVE-2026-135375.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 4.0.16·5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전에서는 제한된 프로젝트의 인증 사용자나 비특권 컨테이너의 root가 호스트에서 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다. 데몬 메모리 읽기, 읽기 전용 디스크의 쓰기 가능 전환, 다른 프로젝트의 마운트 방해도 가능하다.
CVE-2026-135375.background_ko: 호스트 측 인스턴스 도우미가 신뢰할 수 없는 검색 경로와 컨텍스트를 부적절하게 처리한다.

CVE-2026-135376.description: Incorrect authorization in project restriction enforcement in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to bypass project limits and access forbidden storage pools, volumes, network addresses, and CPU resources via instance moves, backup imports with overrides, received snapshots, or unvalidated volatile keys.

CVE-2026-135377.description: Exposure of sensitive information in API responses, exports, and host-side artifacts in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated lower-privileged user or a local host user to read credentials, private keys, and other projects' metadata and inject arguments into Ceph administration commands via unfiltered endpoints, exported configurations, log files, process command lines, and unvalidated bucket parameters.

CVE-2026-135378.description: Incorrect authorization in NIC, managed network, network zone, and ACL handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user of a restricted project or root inside an instance to manipulate host interfaces and firewall rules, read fragments of root-owned files through error messages, and disrupt or intercept other projects' networks and DNS records via unvalidated device and network configurations.

CVE-2026-135379.description: Improper control of code generation and project restriction enforcement in container configuration handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the host, crash the daemon, and alter shared bridge DHCP assignments via image-supplied LXC configuration, concurrent rename races during updates, and unvalidated syscall or hardware address settings.

CVE-2026-135380.description: Incorrect authorization in instance, snapshot, and image operations in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project or per-object permissions to read and modify other clients' resources and execute arbitrary code as root on the host via missing entitlement checks on secondary objects and push-mode container migrations.

CVE-2026-135381.description: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resources in rsync transfer sockets, instance storage directories, proxy socket paths, and disk staging mounts in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an unprivileged local user to gain root privileges on the host, read or modify transferred volumes, alter host file permissions, and inject AppArmor rules via connecting to unauthenticated abstract Unix sockets, running setuid binaries, or racing path and mount operations.

CVE-2026-135382.description: Path traversal in backup, image, storage volume, and migration handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to read and write arbitrary host files as root and exhaust daemon memory via crafted symlinks, unvalidated path components, or oversized metadata.

CVE-2026-135383.description: Incorrect authorization in TLS certificate trust store and revocation handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated client with a restricted or revoked TLS certificate to gain unrestricted administrative access to the server or cluster via trust-lookup races, forwarded cluster identity headers, CA-issued certificate detaching, or stale revocation and session state.
CVE-2026-135383.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 4.0.16·5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 TLS 인증서 처리에 인가 결함이 있다. 제한되거나 폐기된 TLS 인증서를 가진 인증 클라이언트가 서버 또는 클러스터의 무제한 관리 권한을 얻을 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135383.background_ko: TLS 인증서 신뢰 저장소와 폐기 처리의 인가가 부정확하며, 신뢰 조회 경쟁 조건과 오래된 폐기·세션 상태 등이 영향을 준다.

CVE-2026-135384.description: Improper authentication in OIDC bearer token verification in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a remote attacker holding a token signed by the configured identity provider to authenticate to the LXD API and gain unauthorized control or impersonate users via presenting tokens issued for other applications, ID tokens, or unverified email claims.
CVE-2026-135384.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 OIDC 토큰 검증에 인증 결함이 있다. 설정된 ID 공급자가 서명한 토큰을 보유한 원격 공격자가 LXD API를 통해 무단 제어하거나 사용자를 사칭할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-135384.background_ko: OIDC bearer 토큰 검증이 부적절해 다른 애플리케이션용 토큰, ID 토큰 또는 검증되지 않은 이메일 클레임을 인증에 허용한다.

CVE-2026-135385.description: Incorrect authorization in backup export and network zone read endpoints in Canonical LXD before 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with view-only access to export instance and custom storage volume backups and read network zone TSIG peer keys via endpoints enforcing only view permissions.

CVE-2026-136972.description: Exposure of resource to wrong sphere in image template handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to read and overwrite host block and character devices via importing device nodes in an image's templates directory and accessing them through instance template endpoints.

CVE-2026-136973.description: Exposure of resource to wrong sphere in optimized ZFS backup imports in Canonical LXD before 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to mount an attacker-controlled filesystem over arbitrary host paths and execute code as root on the host via importing a filesystem ZFS stream declared as a block volume.
CVE-2026-136973.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 5.0.12·5.21.10·6.10.2 이전 버전의 최적화된 ZFS 백업 가져오기에 리소스 노출 취약점이 있다. 제한된 프로젝트 접근 권한을 가진 인증 사용자가 자신이 제어하는 파일시스템을 호스트의 임의 경로에 마운트하고 호스트에서 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136973.background_ko: 최적화된 ZFS 백업 가져오기에서 블록 볼륨으로 선언된 파일시스템 ZFS 스트림을 처리하면서 리소스가 잘못된 영역에 노출된다.

CVE-2026-136974.description: Configuration injection in liblxc instance configuration generation in Canonical LXD before 6.10.2, 5.21.10, 5.0.12, 4.0.16 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access or a local user of the LXD user socket to execute arbitrary commands as root on the host via line breaks in instance configuration keys and values.
CVE-2026-136974.summary_ko: Canonical LXD 6.10.2·5.21.10·5.0.12·4.0.16 이전 버전의 liblxc 인스턴스 설정 생성 과정에 설정 삽입 취약점이 있다. 제한된 프로젝트의 인증 사용자나 LXD 사용자 소켓의 로컬 사용자가 호스트에서 root 권한으로 임의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-136974.background_ko: liblxc 인스턴스 설정을 생성할 때 설정 키와 값의 줄바꿈을 통해 설정이 삽입될 수 있다.

CVE-2026-136975.description: Authentication bypass by spoofing in bridged NIC MAC filtering in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a privileged user inside an instance sharing a managed bridge to intercept and deny inbound network traffic addressed to a neighbour instance via sending frames with a spoofed source MAC address before filtering drops them.

CVE-2026-136976.description: Improper link resolution before file access in recursive file pull in Canonical LXD before 4.0.15, 5.0.11, 5.21.9, and 6.8 on case-insensitive client filesystems allows an authenticated user with write access to an instance directory or custom volume to write arbitrary files outside the target directory and execute code as the operator via case-variant symlinks.

CVE-2026-136977.description: Improper authentication in the guest API connection handling in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows a root user inside an unisolated instance to impersonate another instance and read its configuration, metadata, and devices across project boundaries via holding open connections across PID wrap-around.

CVE-2026-136978.description: Exposure of resource to wrong sphere in the instance file transfer API in Canonical LXD before 4.0.16, 5.0.12, 5.21.10, 6.10.2 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to read and write arbitrary host block or character devices, compromise the host, and hang file transfer requests via importing device nodes or named pipes outside /dev in an image or backup and opening them on a stopped instance.

CVE-2026-137114.description: Exposure of resource to wrong sphere in image and backup metadata handling in Canonical LXD before 6.10.2, 5.21.10, 5.0.12, 4.0.16 allows an authenticated user with restricted project access to read and overwrite arbitrary host files, access other projects' data, and block the daemon via importing device nodes, hard links, symlinks, or named pipes.

CVE-2026-137667.description: A vulnerability was detected in ONNX ONNXMLTools up to 1.16.0. This affects the function get_set_node of the file onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py of the component Model Visualization. The manipulation results in cross site scripting. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-137668.description: A flaw has been found in ONNX ONNXMLTools up to 1.16.0. This impacts the function visualize_model of the file onnxmltools/utils/visualize.py. This manipulation of the argument producer_name causes basic cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-137677.description: A vulnerability has been found in code-projects Simple Laundry System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file viewdetailforuser.php. The manipulation of the argument serviceId leads to sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used.

CVE-2026-106125.description: The Sneeit Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7 via the 'callback' parameter of the sneeit_compact_menu_mega_content AJAX action. The handler sneeit_compact_menu_mega_content_callback() is registered on the wp_ajax_nopriv_ hook and passes the attacker-supplied 'callback' value directly into call_user_func() after only a function_exists() check, with the single argument also attacker-controlled via a JSON-decoded 'args' parameter. There is no authentication, no capability check, no nonce, and no allow-list of callable functions. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary existing PHP/WordPress functions with controlled arguments.
CVE-2026-106125.summary_ko: WordPress용 Sneeit Framework 플러그인 8.7 이하 버전에 원격 코드 실행 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 자신이 제어하는 인수로 기존 PHP·WordPress 함수를 임의로 실행할 수 있다.
CVE-2026-106125.background_ko: AJAX 처리기가 인증·권한·nonce·호출 허용 목록 검사 없이 함수 존재 여부만 확인하고 외부 입력을 함수 호출에 직접 사용한다.

CVE-2026-113774.description: The Schema & Structured Data for WP & AMP plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 1.68. This is due to deserialization of untrusted input via the admin export (saswp_export_all_settings_and_schema) which calls unrestricted unserialize() on every raw post meta value, combined with saswp_review_form_process_data() which stores unauthenticated-visitor-supplied reviewer-name data through update_post_meta — the plugin sanitizes with sanitize_text_field(), which does not recognise PHP serialization syntax or the NUL property-name delimiters, and WordPress's maybe_serialize/is_serialized has no case for the legacy PHP 'C' custom-serialization token (ArrayObject), so the payload is persisted byte-for-byte and never wrapped in a protective extra serialize layer. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object into the processing of the plugin. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable plugin itself, but if a suitable chain exists via an additional plugin or theme installed on the blog, it could be used to delete arbitrary files, or achieve other impacts. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-115867.description: The Database for Contact Form 7, WPforms, Elementor forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.5 via the copy_files function. This is due to missing file extension validation in the copy_files function, which accepts attacker-controlled stream wrapper URIs as the file source and derives the destination filename without restricting executable extensions. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. The plugin places an .htaccess file in its uploads directory to block PHP execution, but this mitigation is ineffective on Nginx, LiteSpeed in certain configurations, and Apache servers with AllowOverride None, and the file is not restored if deleted.
CVE-2026-115867.summary_ko: WordPress용 Database for Contact Form 7, WPforms, Elementor forms 플러그인 1.5.5 이하 버전에서 인증 없이 임의 파일을 업로드할 수 있다. 실행 가능한 파일은 원격 코드 실행으로 이어질 수 있으며, 업로드 디렉터리의 PHP 실행 차단은 서버 구성에 따라 효과가 없다.
CVE-2026-115867.background_ko: copy_files 함수가 외부에서 제어하는 스트림 래퍼 URI를 파일 원본으로 허용하며, 대상 파일명의 실행 가능한 확장자를 제한하지 않는다.

CVE-2026-116494.description: The Forminator Forms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Account Approval Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 1.58.3 via the forminator_replace_custom_form_data() function. This is due to the function expanding the {all_fields} merge tag before {account_approval_link}, so a submitter-supplied field value containing the literal string {account_approval_link} is resolved into the real activation URL, including the secret activation key, in the user confirmation email. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to obtain the activation link for their own pending registration and activate the account via the ?page=account_activation&key= endpoint, bypassing the manual approval configured on the registration form. Exploitation requires a user-registration form with manual approval enabled and a user confirmation email that includes the {all_fields} merge tag (the default template). Note: On WordPress Multisite installations with site registration enabled, the self-activated account also becomes the Administrator of the subsite created during registration.

CVE-2026-126717.description: The Translate WordPress with Weglot 2.0 – Multilingual AI Translation plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.4.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires the target site to permit anonymous comment posting (comment_registration disabled) and have at least one Weglot destination language active; on sites with comment moderation enabled, an administrator must approve the carrier and trigger comments before the injected script executes for subsequent visitors.

CVE-2026-135616.description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.0 via deserialization of untrusted input that is injected into the Memcached object cache through request Host header key truncation. This allows authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject a PHP Object. The additional presence of a POP chain (the bundled Guzzle FileCookieJar, reached through the W3TC\CdnEngine_S3 autoload bridge) allows attackers to write arbitrary files and execute code. This requires the Object Cache to be enabled with the Memcached method backed by the pecl memcache extension and Minify to be enabled; using the same key collision, the attacker first escalates from Subscriber to Administrator.

CVE-2026-137702.description: Exim before 4.100.2 allows attackers to send SMTP traffic that triggers a heap out-of-bounds write in expansion code running as root.
CVE-2026-137702.summary_ko: Exim 4.100.2 이전 버전에서는 공격자가 보낸 SMTP 트래픽으로 인해 root 권한으로 실행되는 확장 코드에서 힙 범위 밖 쓰기가 발생할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-130039.description: The LiteSpeed Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.9.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires comments to be open, a comment author name containing a literal quotation mark stored via WordPress's ENT_NOQUOTES save pipeline, a raw HTTP client capable of sending unencoded " and > characters in the request path, and — under default WordPress moderation — prior moderator approval of the crafted comment.

CVE-2026-131578.description: The Simple Calendar – Google Calendar, Events, & ICS Feeds plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the '_ics_feed_file (DESCRIPTION property inside the uploaded .ics)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.3.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Successful exploitation requires the victim to click the attacker-controlled link rendered in the event description, as the javascript: href payload does not fire on page load alone.

CVE-2026-131863.description: The Easy Google Maps by Supsystic – Custom Markers, Clustering & Map Themes plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'file (tmp_name / name / type)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.18.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin globally widens the site's upload MIME allowlist to permit SVG files via an upload_mimes filter, meaning the attack surface exists for all uploads site-wide regardless of theme or other plugins.

CVE-2026-135618.description: The Extensions for Leaflet Map plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'extraclasses (also icon, iconcolor, number)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The existing sanitization is ineffective for this context: wp_kses_post preserves bare double quotes (no HTML tags are required in the payload), and wp_json_encode correctly escapes the value for the JavaScript string-literal layer but the reconstituted double quote remains live when Leaflet.ExtraMarkers builds its inner HTML, allowing a single-quoted shortcode attribute value to close the HTML attribute and inject attacker-controlled event handlers.

CVE-2026-135622.description: The Extensions for Leaflet Map plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'overview-latlng' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This is exploitable by Author-level users because WordPress does not apply kses filtering to post custom fields on save, allowing raw HTML payloads such as event-handler attributes to be stored verbatim and later reflected through the unescaped debug output path.

CVE-2026-136206.description: The Export Products, Orders & Customers for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 'start_date' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.4.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. Successful exploitation requires the victim — who must hold the manage_woocommerce capability (administrator or shop manager) — to both open the attacker-crafted URL and click the start_date input field on the Export Tools page, as the injected payload is delivered via an onclick handler rather than a page-load event. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.

CVE-2026-136215.description: The All-in-One Video Gallery – Video Player & Galleries for YouTube, Vimeo & Self-Hosted Videos plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload must be encoded as C-style escape sequences (e.g. \x3c/\x3e) at storage time so that wp_kses_post — applied on save for users lacking unfiltered_html — passes it through without stripping angle brackets; WordPress core's shortcode_parse_atts() then decodes the escapes into real HTML characters at render time.

CVE-2026-136992.description: The All-in-One Video Gallery – Video Player & Galleries for YouTube, Vimeo & Self-Hosted Videos plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'embedcode' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The plugin grants the Subscriber role the edit_aiovg_videos and edit_published_aiovg_videos capabilities on activation, and save_meta_data() accepts the 'embedcode' type without checking current_user_can('unfiltered_html'), meaning any Subscriber can store a malicious shortcode containing a data: URI in the hls attribute that hls.js later processes and Plyr writes into the DOM via innerHTML.

CVE-2026-137041.description: The E2Pdf – Export Pdf Tool for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-name (or any CF7 field referenced in the action's error_message/condition)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.00.05 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a typical deployment where an E2Pdf action with a 'PDF Access By URL' error message references a submitted Contact Form 7 field, as the payload is seeded via a single unauthenticated CF7 submission and triggered by any visitor who opens the resulting shareable download URL.

CVE-2026-137678.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in code-projects Online Job Portal 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file Admin/InsertUser.php. Such manipulation of the argument txtUserName/txtPassword leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

CVE-2026-137703.description: Flask-AppBuilder before 5.3.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in ImageManager.save_file that allows authenticated users to write image files outside IMG_UPLOAD_FOLDER via unsanitized multipart filenames. Attackers with add or edit permission on a ModelView with an ImageColumn can upload filenames containing ../ segments to create or overwrite image files like static assets.

CVE-2026-137704.description: D-Link DWM-222W developed by D-Link Corporation has a Use of Hard-coded Credentials vulnerability. Unauthenticated adjacent network attackers can use the administrator account embedded in the firmware to access the configuration backup endpoint and obtain plaintext passwords for all user accounts.

CVE-2026-137705.description: Smart Portal developed by Direk Tech has an Arbitrary File Read vulnerability.Unauthenticated remote attackers can exploit Relative Path Traversal to download arbitrary system files.

CVE-2026-137706.description: Smart Portal developed by Direk Tech has a Missing Authorization vulnerability. Authenticated remote attackers can add a specified account to the Active Directory Domain Admins group, thereby obtaining domain administrator privileges.
CVE-2026-137706.summary_ko: Direk Tech의 Smart Portal에 권한 검증 누락 취약점이 있다. 인증된 원격 공격자는 특정 계정을 Active Directory의 Domain Admins 그룹에 추가해 도메인 관리자 권한을 얻을 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137707.description: The Mail2000 developed by Openfind has a Reflected Cross-site Scripting vulnerability. Unauthenticated remote attackers can execute arbitrary JavaScript code in user's browser through phishing attacks.

CVE-2026-89228.description: An improper path validation defect in AccessibilityEnhanceProvider (com.vivo.accessibilityenhance.catcher.AccessibilityEnhanceProvider) of Accessibility Enhance allows a local malicious application to read arbitrary files outside the intended cache directory without any permission via a crafted content URI, which may lead to disclosure of user photos, documents and system information

CVE-2026-92549.description: The Easy Social Share Buttons for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting via the 'design' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 11.6 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that execute if they can successfully trick a user into performing an action such as clicking on a link. The vulnerable endpoint is reached via the ?subscribe-preview=true query parameter, which is processed on template_redirect with no capability or nonce check, making it accessible to unauthenticated users.

CVE-2026-111315.description: The Smaily Connect plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 3.24.0 This is due to the smaily_get_edit_user_id() function reading an attacker-controlled $_GET['user_id'] parameter without performing any ownership or capability check, and then feeding that id into smaily_get_userdata() (which calls get_user_meta()) when rendering the WooCommerce My Account 'edit-account' form via the smaily_print_user_frontend_fields() handler on the woocommerce_edit_account_form action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Subscriber-level access and above, to read other users' personally identifiable profile data (phone number, date of birth, and gender — including administrators') by appending ?user_id=<target> to the account-details URL.

CVE-2026-116771.description: The Product Options and Price Calculation Formulas for WooCommerce – Uni CPO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'price_disabled_msg' setting in versions up to, and including, 4.9.69 The uni_cpo_save_settings_data() AJAX handler applies html_entity_decode() to the output of uni_cpo_sanitize_text(), which itself already runs html_entity_decode() before wp_kses(); this double decode allows a double-entity-encoded tag to pass wp_kses as inert text and then be re-materialised as live HTML before being stored in the _cpo_price_disabled_msg post meta and later echoed via do_shortcode() on the single-product page without further escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Shop Manager-level access (edit_products) and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected product page.

CVE-2026-135626.description: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.0 This is due to the `SwpmLevelForm::role()` function applying only `sanitize_text_field()` to the user-supplied `role` parameter with no allowlist, permitting the `administrator` role to be stored verbatim into `swpm_membership_tbl` and subsequently applied to a member's WordPress account via `$user->add_role()` inside `update_wp_user_role()` — also without any role allowlist — when the `swpm_membership_level_changed` action fires. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access and above to create a membership level specifying the `administrator` WordPress role, assign themselves to that level, and thereby elevate their own WordPress account to full Administrator, gaining complete site control including the ability to install plugins, edit themes, and manage users. Exploitation requires that the site owner has lowered the plugin's "Admin Dashboard Access Permission" setting from its default `manage_options` capability to a lesser capability such as `edit_posts`, `edit_published_posts`, or `edit_pages`, which grants lower-privileged users access to the SWPM admin dashboard where the vulnerable level-creation form resides. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete administrator role.

CVE-2026-135627.description: The Simple Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.0 The vulnerability exists because the `bulk_operation_menu()` function accepts the `swpm_bulk_change_level_to` parameter from `$_REQUEST` with only `sanitize_text_field()` applied, and passes it to `SwpmMemberUtils::update_membership_level_and_role()` without the `id != 1` allowlist exclusion that every other level-selection path in the plugin enforces — leaving membership level 1, which the installer maps to the WordPress `administrator` role on every fresh install, freely selectable as a bulk-change target. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Contributor-level access and above to elevate their own WordPress account to the full Administrator role, gaining complete site control including plugin installation, user creation, and all other administrator capabilities. Exploitation requires that an administrator has first lowered the plugin's "Admin Dashboard Access Permission" setting from its default of `manage_options` to a lesser capability such as `edit_posts` (Contributor), `edit_published_posts` (Author), or `edit_pages` (Editor), which is a non-default granted-access configuration; the bulk screen's nonce protection (`swpm_bulk_change_level_nonce_action`) does not mitigate the issue because the nonce is emitted on the same page the delegated lower-role user can already reach. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive the complete administrator role.

CVE-2026-137679.description: A vulnerability was detected in code-projects Online Job Portal 1.0. This affects the function GetSQLValueString of the file JobSeeker/SearchJob.php of the component JobSeeker. Performing a manipulation of the argument cmbQual results in sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used.

CVE-2026-137713.description: Webmin through 2.670 before ae8feb1 allows XSS via an SVG attachment in a mail queue, relevant if an authenticated user uploads an SVG document and an administrator views it.

CVE-2026-19443.description: A flaw was found in CRI-O. An attacker with access to the kubelet or CRI-O socket can exploit a path traversal vulnerability in the checkpoint restore functionality. This allows the attacker to delete arbitrary files and directories on the host filesystem during a checkpoint restore operation. The vulnerability arises because the system processes entries from checkpoint archive metadata without validating that the files are confined to the container's root directory.

CVE-2026-105917.description: File Permission Vulnerability in RV3000 Log Monitor for VMware. This issue affects RV3000 Log Monitor for VMware(CIM): before 98-09; RV3000 Log Monitor for VMware: before 97-05.

CVE-2026-115283.description: Missing authentication vulnerability in BS2500/BS500 Virtage Firmware. This issue affects BladeSymphony BS2500: from 02-02 through 02-76; BladeSymphony BS500: from 01-01 through 02-76.

CVE-2026-115284.description: Missing authentication vulnerability in BS2500/BS500 Virtage Firmware. This issue affects BladeSymphony BS2500: from 02-02 through 02-76; BladeSymphony BS500: from 01-01 through 02-76.

CVE-2026-115285.description: DoS vulnerability in BS2500/BS500 Virtage Firmware. This issue affects BladeSymphony BS2500: from 02-02 through 02-76; BladeSymphony BS500: from 01-01 through 02-76.

CVE-2026-115286.description: DoS vulnerability in BS2500/BS500 Virtage Firmware. This issue affects BladeSymphony BS2500: from 02-02 through 02-76; BladeSymphony BS500: from 01-01 through 02-76.

CVE-2026-115287.description: DoS vulnerability in BS2500/BS500 Virtage Firmware. This issue affects BladeSymphony BS2500: from 02-02 through 02-76; BladeSymphony BS500: from 01-01 through 02-76.

CVE-2026-115288.description: Missing authentication vulnerability in BS2500/BS500 Virtage Firmware. This issue affects BladeSymphony BS2500: from 02-02 through 02-76*; BladeSymphony BS500: from 01-01 through 02-76*.

CVE-2026-119071.description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthorized File Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.0 via the `ajax_revert()` AJAX handler. The vulnerability exists because the `remove_optimizations()` function reads attacker-controlled values from the unprotected `w3tc_imageservice` post meta key — which carries no underscore prefix and no registered authorization callback, making it writable by any user with `edit_post` capability via WordPress's built-in custom-fields AJAX endpoint — and passes those values directly to `wp_delete_attachment()` with no check that the referenced ID is a child of the caller's own post, is an actual attachment, or that the caller holds `delete_post` capability on it. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Author-level access or above to permanently delete any WordPress attachment in the media library, including media files owned by other users along with their associated files on disk, regardless of ownership — a capability not available through the normal WordPress interface. The revert nonce is exposed via `wp_localize_script` on `/wp-admin/upload.php` to any user with `upload_files` capability, ensuring the nonce check that is present does not serve as a meaningful barrier to Author-level exploitation.

CVE-2026-119072.description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.0 via the 'utm_source (and the wp-resetpass-<hash> cookie on the victim side)' parameter. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract the live password-reset key (rp_key) embedded in the cached reset form, enabling full account takeover of the targeted administrator. Exploitation requires the page-cache engine to be configured as Disk: Basic, Memcached, Redis, or APC with the 'Cache URI with query string variables' option enabled, and the victim must visit an attacker-crafted URL containing utm_source=wp-locations.php while their wp-resetpass cookie remains active.

CVE-2026-130318.description: The W3 Total Cache plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'comment' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.11.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the W3 Total Cache CDN feature is enabled, as the vulnerable output-buffer filter is not active otherwise.

CVE-2026-136995.description: The Upsell Funnel Builder for WooCommerce – Create Upsells, Cross-Sells, Order Bumps, Frequently Bought, and Popups. plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'form_data' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.7 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The nonce gating the vulnerable AJAX endpoint is publicly emitted to any visitor loading a cart, checkout, or shortcode page, making the endpoint fully exploitable by unauthenticated attackers without any prior account or login.

CVE-2026-137680.description: A vulnerability has been found in RT-Thread up to 5.3.0. This issue affects the function ab32_get_adc_value of the file bsp/bluetrum/libraries/hal_drivers/drv_adc.c of the component ADC Driver. The manipulation of the argument channel leads to improper validation of array index. The attack can only be performed from a local environment. The identifier of the patch is 7f1f625f36232fd165a8a8313b1612846215aece. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

CVE-2026-137681.description: A vulnerability was found in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT up to 0.8.2. Impacted is the function _react_agent_stream_impl of the file packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/agentic_data_api.py of the component Agentic Data API React Agent. The manipulation of the argument database_name results in authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. Upgrading to version 0.8.3 is recommended to address this issue. The patch is identified as 61a0460e363552e2e9722905605c86622a216d40. The affected component should be upgraded.

CVE-2026-137682.description: A vulnerability was determined in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT up to 0.8.2. The affected element is the function editor_sql_run of the file packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/editor/api_editor_v1.py. This manipulation of the argument db_name causes improper access controls. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The pull request to fix this issue awaits acceptance.

CVE-2026-137683.description: A vulnerability was identified in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT up to 0.8.3. The impacted element is the function get_editor_tables of the file packages/dbgpt-app/src/dbgpt_app/openapi/api_v1/editor/api_editor_v1.py of the component Editor API. Such manipulation of the argument db_name leads to improper access controls. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

CVE-2026-137715.description: Webmin through 2.670 before 07d1949 does not escape a save_log.cgi log file path. This is relevant for code execution if a shared-hosting provider offers Webalizer module access.

CVE-2026-124802.description: The Dilemma Lite WordPress plugin through 1.1.1 does not sanitise or escape the choices of dilemmas submitted by visitors before outputting them in the admin dashboard and on the front end, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against administrators.

CVE-2026-125627.description: A **NULL pointer dereference** flaw has been found in the vlv_value_compare() function in vlv_pagination.c of the Virtual List View module in the **Samba** package. The function uses the sort value from the search result with no check that the result still contains that attribute. A low-privileged network attacker or user who can search the directory sends a Virtual List View search by value, sorted on an attribute the matching entries do not have. The LDAP worker that handles the search exits, which disconnects the directory clients that were using that worker, and the directory service starts a replacement worker. Another search of the same kind crashes the worker that accepts it, and each further crash waits longer before that worker is replaced, so repeating the search keeps the LDAP service from staying available. The same crash follows a search sorted on an attribute the attacker is not allowed to read. The directory removes that attribute from the result, and the comparison uses the missing value.

CVE-2026-137685.description: A weakness has been identified in WazirX App up to 4.4.2 on Android. This impacts an unknown function. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authorization. The attack needs to be launched locally. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

CVE-2026-137687.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in WOW-CMS BlizzCMS up to 1.2.1. Affected is the function Home::setconfig of the file application/modules/home/controllers/Home.php of the component Home Module. The manipulation leads to improper authorization. The attack can be initiated remotely.

CVE-2026-137689.description: A vulnerability was detected in bayang jelu up to 0.88.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function addResourceHandlers of the file src/main/kotlin/io/github/bayang/jelu/config/WebMvcConfig.kt of the component CSV Export File Handler. The manipulation results in missing authorization. The attack can be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 0.88.3 addresses this issue. The patch is identified as a4c72815bce084865874ef2d720c01c60b6d0c6c. You should upgrade the affected component.

CVE-2026-137721.description: A vulnerability in the Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager could allow an attacker to conduct a command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This vulnerability affects OpenScape 4000, versions V11 R0.22 through V11 R2.11 and V10 R1.68 and earlier, and OpenScape 4000 Manager, versions V11 R0.22 through V11 R2.11 and V10 R1.34 through V10 R1.68. This is MTLVULN-1786.
CVE-2026-137721.summary_ko: Mitel OpenScape 4000 및 OpenScape 4000 Manager의 Platform 구성요소에 명령어 삽입 취약점이 있다. 공격자는 이를 악용해 시스템 컨텍스트에서 임의의 명령을 실행할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137723.description: A vulnerability in the Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000 and OpenScape 4000 Manager could allow an attacker to conduct a command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This vulnerability affects OpenScape 4000, versions V11 R0.22 through V11 R2.11 and V10 R1.68 and earlier, and OpenScape 4000 Manager, versions V11 R0.22 through V11 R2.11 and V10 R1.34 through V10 R1.68. This is MTLVULN-1793.

CVE-2026-137724.description: A vulnerability in the Platform component of Mitel OpenScape 4000, and OpenScape 4000 Manager could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct an unauthorized access attack due to improper authentication mechanisms. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to obtain sensitive information and gain unauthorized access to system. This vulnerability affects OpenScape 4000, versions V11 R0.22 through V11 R2.11 and V10 R1.68 and earlier, and OpenScape 4000 Manager, versions V11 R0.22 through V11 R2.11 and V10 R1.34 through V10 R1.68. This is MTLVULN-1785.
CVE-2026-137724.summary_ko: Mitel OpenScape 4000 및 OpenScape 4000 Manager의 Platform 구성요소에 무단 접근 취약점이 있다. 인증되지 않은 공격자가 민감한 정보를 획득하고 시스템에 무단 접근할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-137738.description: In RealVNC Server before 7.19.1, UDP-based connections could potentially be exploited without authentication to execute code remotely or cause the software to crash. This could allow an attacker to remotely execute code as root on certain platforms or perform a denial of service attack. This issue affects RealVNC Viewer: from 8.4.0 through 8.6.1; RealVNC Classic Viewer: from 6.4.0 through 7.18.2; RealVNC Server: from 6.4.0 through 7.19.0; RealVNC Connect App: through 8.6.1; RealVNC iOS Viewer: from 3.7.0 through 4.9.5; RealVNC Android Viewer: from 3.5.0 through 4.9.5; RealVNC iOS Server: through 2.8.1; RealVNC Android Server: through 2.8.3; On-Demand Assist: through 3.4.1.
CVE-2026-137738.summary_ko: RealVNC Server의 UDP 기반 연결을 인증 없이 악용하면 원격 코드 실행이나 서비스 거부가 가능하다. 일부 플랫폼에서는 root 권한으로 코드를 실행할 수 있으며, Viewer 등 다른 RealVNC 제품도 영향을 받는다.

CVE-2026-77679.description: A path traversal (ZIP slip) vulnerability exists in Epiphany when installing WebExtension packages from .xpi files. In src/webextension/ephy-web-extension-manager.c, the decompress_xpi_thread() function extracts XPI archives (ZIP format) to disk using libarchive. For each archive entry, the output path is built by concatenating the intended extraction directory with the raw pathname from the archive: full_path = g_build_filename(path, archive_entry_pathname(entry), NULL); archive_entry_set_pathname(entry, full_path); ret = archive_write_header(ext, entry); The libarchive extraction options did not include ARCHIVE_EXTRACT_SECURE_NODOTDOT or ARCHIVE_EXTRACT_SECURE_SYMLINKS. As a result, archive entries containing parent-directory traversal sequences (for example "../../../../../.bashrc") are written outside the intended web_extensions extraction directory. A malicious .xpi file can therefore overwrite arbitrary files writable by the user running Epiphany, such as ~/.bashrc, ~/.config/autostart/*.desktop, or ~/.ssh/authorized_keys. This can lead to persistent code execution on subsequent shell startup or GNOME login. Exploitation requires the victim to install or open a crafted .xpi file. The reporter notes that opening an XPI can trigger extraction even when the WebExtensions feature is not enabled by default. Affected versions: Epiphany >= 47.rc. Fixed upstream in epiphany 50.6 and 49.9 via merge request !2143, which adds ARCHIVE_EXTRACT_SECURE_NODOTDOT and ARCHIVE_EXTRACT_SECURE_SYMLINKS to archive_write_disk_set_options(). Upstream report: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/epiphany/-/issues/2922

CVE-2026-77682.description: A code injection vulnerability exists in Epiphany when the user invokes form autofill from the context menu on a page containing a malicious HTML form. In embed/web-process-extension/resources/js/ephy_autofill.js, getSelector() builds a CSS selector by directly interpolating an element's id attribute: path.unshift(`#${el.id}`); When the user selects an autofill entry, the browser process in embed/ephy-web-view.c previously constructed JavaScript using sprintf with the selector embedded in single quotes: EphyAutofill.fill(PAGE_ID, 'SELECTOR', FILL_CHOICE); Because SELECTOR comes from attacker-controlled page content and is not escaped, a crafted id such as a'); PAYLOAD; var _=(' breaks out of the string literal and executes arbitrary JavaScript when the script is evaluated. The injected code runs in Epiphany's private autofill script world, which hosts EphyAutofill credential APIs and password manager save/request handlers. The reporter demonstrated a proof of concept that injects credentials into another domain and uses Ephy.permissionsManager to enumerate domains with special permissions. Full exfiltration of all saved passwords was not demonstrated but may be possible given the privileges of this context. Exploitation requires the victim to visit a malicious page, right-click on a form field, and choose an Autofill context menu item. This is a deliberate user action but does not require installing software or entering credentials manually. Affected versions: Epiphany >= 47.beta. Fixed upstream in epiphany 50.6 and 49.9 via merge request !2147, which replaces sprintf-based script evaluation with a WebKit user message and jsc_value_object_invoke_method() passing the selector as a typed string argument. Upstream report: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/epiphany/-/issues/2921

CVE-2026-115834.description: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. Display and Debug formatting of User IDs and notation data does not escape control characters. When an application prints those values, a crafted User ID or notation can misrender the identity or alter terminal output.

CVE-2026-80243.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow') vulnerability. A high privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Remote execution.

CVE-2026-95622.description: A flaw was found in ModemManager. When parsing a Cell Broadcast Message, some 3GPP data-coding-scheme values (8-bit and reserved character sets) are not handled. The process hits a reachable assertion and aborts. An attacker who can deliver a crafted Cell Broadcast PDU over the radio network, or via a modem AT channel, can cause ModemManager to exit. Repeated aborts can exhaust systemd's default start limit and leave the service failed.

CVE-2026-115835.description: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The ASCII-armor reader does not limit the length of a line. Parsing an armored message with a very long line can exhaust memory in the process. Memory use follows the input size, with a small constant factor, and is not a classic amplification.

CVE-2026-115836.description: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. The default ASCII-armor parser accepts Unicode dash characters in armor framing and ignores leading quote characters. A crafted byte stream can be parsed as one message by this tolerant parser and as a different message by a strict ASCII-armor parser. The strict mode is opt-in; the default parser remains tolerant.

CVE-2026-115841.description: A flaw was found in sequoia-openpgp. DSA signature verification does not reject a public key with generator 1 and public value 1 before calling the cryptographic backend. Upstream reports that the Nettle and OpenSSL backends, including the default Nettle build, accept this key. Under that key, a signature can verify for every message. Ordinary DSA keys are not affected. An application is exposed when that degenerate certificate is accepted as authoritative.

CVE-2026-132890.description: In Eclipse Dataspace Components (EDC) Connector 1.0.0-RC2 through 1.0.0-RC7, the HashiCorp Vault extension does not reject .. path segments in secret aliases. In a multi-participant (virtual) control plane where vault partitions share the runtime's Vault token, an authenticated participant can set a callback secret alias that escapes its own vault partition. The connector then reads secrets of other participants or of the runtime, such as STS client secrets or the encryption key, and sends them to an endpoint the attacker chooses.

CVE-2026-133842.description: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-system-helper. When a system-wide app, runtime, or extension uses the extra-data mechanism and its apply_extra logic creates a deeply nested directory tree, permission canonicalization can fail (for example with EMFILE). Affected Flatpak versions can still report success without clearing setuid/setgid bits, leaving a setuid-root executable under /var/lib/flatpak. A local attacker who can install or update such content system-wide, or who can already execute code as a local user in cooperation with that content, can escalate privileges to root.

CVE-2026-133845.description: A flaw was found in Flatpak’s flatpak-portal. When a sandboxed application invokes Spawn() and maps two different file descriptors to the same handle, dup2() can fail. Affected Flatpak versions do not handle that failure, so a file descriptor that was open inside flatpak-portal (commonly the unfiltered D-Bus session bus) can be passed into the subsandbox. A malicious or compromised Flatpak app with no special privileges can use this to escape the sandbox.

CVE-2026-133938.description: The backend language switch action (quick_change_language) of the JTL-Shop administration backend is executed without a CSRF token check, and the supplied language value is neither validated against the installed backend languages nor encoded on output. The value is stored in the session and in the account data of the administrator and rendered without output encoding in JavaScript strings and HTML attributes of backend pages. An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a logged-in administrator who opens a crafted web page; the code can perform actions with the privileges of that administrator.

CVE-2026-133939.description: The OPC (OnPage Composer) start menu, which JTL-Shop shows to logged-in backend users on storefront pages, writes the current page identifier (which contains the search term on search pages) and further values into single-quoted JavaScript strings without escaping. A single quote in the search term terminates the string. An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a backend user who opens a crafted link while logged in to the backend in the same browser; the code runs with the privileges of that user and can use the backend session token contained in the same script to send requests to the backend. Visitors and customers do not receive the start menu and are not affected.

CVE-2026-133940.description: The access rules of JTL-Shop (export/.htaccess and export/backup/.htaccess) release files with the extensions gz and zip for the export directory without withdrawing this release in the subdirectory export/backup, in which the shop stores database dumps and file backups. As a result, backup files in this directory can be downloaded without authentication by anyone who knows or guesses the file name. Up to version 5.5.5 the names of database backups consist only of a timestamp; from version 5.6.0 they contain a random component, which does not replace access control. The backups contain the complete shop database (customer data, orders, password hashes) and, for file backups, files of the shop. The access rules are only evaluated by Apache. On installations where another web server, for example nginx, delivers static files such as gz and zip directly (including nginx in front of Apache), the files remain accessible even with the corrected rules, unless the directory is blocked at server level.

CVE-2026-133941.description: The country manager page of the JTL-Shop administration backend (/admin/countries) writes the request parameter activeSortOrder without output encoding into a single-quoted JavaScript string and into HTML attributes. The overview page requires no CSRF token. An unauthenticated remote attacker can thereby cause script code to be executed in the browser of a logged-in backend user who opens a crafted link in the same browser (the session cookie carries no SameSite attribute by default); the code runs with the privileges of that user and can use the backend token of the same page to send requests to the backend. Visitors and customers are not affected.

CVE-2026-137609.description: In Eclipse Krazo Extensions up to and including 3.0.0, AsciiDocViewEngine passes MVC model values to Asciidoctor as document attributes without encoding them. Asciidoctor substitutes attribute references after it escapes HTML special characters and before it processes inline macros. As a result, attacker-controlled model values end up in the output as raw HTML and can inject AsciiDoc inline macros. This allows cross-site scripting in applications that render untrusted data through AsciiDoc views.

CVE-2026-59103.description: MONEO ERP exposes the Ping method of its _slave JSON-RPC service over WebSocket as @rpc.openpublic, so it can be called without a valid session. The method's only guard compares the calling application name with "_login", but that value is taken from the client-controlled params.appname field of the request. When the check passes, Ping stores an attacker-chosen session ID, user number and company in the server session store, and subsequent session validation accepts that session. An unauthenticated remote attacker can therefore create a valid session as any user, including administrators, in any company (tenant) hosted on the server and invoke authenticated RPC methods with that user's privileges, gaining read and write access to that company's data.

CVE-2026-80244.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Information exposure.

CVE-2026-80245.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input ('Classic Buffer Overflow') vulnerability. A high privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Remote execution.

CVE-2026-80246.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway - Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability. An unauthenticated local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Remote execution.

CVE-2026-137686.description: The fix for CVE-2014-0074 https://shiro.apache.org/security-reports.html#cve_2014_0074 was incomplete for ActiveDirectoryRealm, which still accepted an empty username and password as an anonymous LDAP bind. This issue affects all Apache Shiro versions through 3.0.1, only when ActiveDirectoryRealm is used without principalSuffix and the directory server allows anonymous binds. Mitigation: Upgrade to version 3.0.2 or later, which fixes the issue. Alternatively, set principalSuffix on the realm, or disable anonymous binds on the directory server.

CVE-2026-137826.description: Lookyloo is a web-based malware analysis and sandboxing platform. The pull-from-remote-instance feature allows a user to request a previously captured sample from another Lookyloo instance by specifying the target instance's URL and a capture UUID. Prior to the fix, the only restriction on the target URL was a check that the hostname, if it was a literal IP address, was not in a private range. Hostnames that resolved to private or internal addresses were not blocked, and no authentication or allowlist was enforced for anonymous users. This allowed any unauthenticated user to direct the Lookyloo server to issue HTTP requests (HEAD to the root path and GET to /json/<uuid>/status, followed by a capture download) to arbitrary internal or external hosts, effectively enabling a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) attack. An attacker could use this to probe internal network topology, access captures stored on internal Lookyloo instances, or leverage the server as a proxy to reach otherwise unreachable services. The vulnerability is in the website/web/__init__.py module, specifically the __get_remote_capture function and the associated pull endpoint. The security impact is unauthorized disclosure of capture data and internal service information from Lookyloo instances that are not intended to be publicly accessible.

CVE-2026-137888.description: Flowintel contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its HedgeDoc case-notes integration. When a user with editor or administrator privileges associates a HedgeDoc URL with a case, the application later issues a server-side HTTP GET request to that URL to retrieve note content. Before the fix, the stored URL was used directly without validation of its scheme, host, port, path, or userinfo, and the HTTP client followed redirects by default with no connect or read timeouts. An authenticated attacker could therefore cause the Flowintel server to issue requests to arbitrary internal or external endpoints (for example, cloud instance-metadata services, internal management interfaces, or other intranet hosts) and receive the response body, or follow a redirect chain to an unintended destination. The absence of timeouts also permitted resource-exhaustion against the server's outbound connection pool. Preconditions: - An authenticated account with editor or administrator role on the target case. - The HedgeDoc integration feature is enabled (no explicit configuration gate existed before the fix). Impact: - Disclosure of sensitive data served by internal or cloud-metadata endpoints. - Potential denial of service through unbounded outbound requests. Affected versions: Flowintel prior to 4.1.0.

CVE-2026-125633.description: A **Type Confusion** has been found in the dns_to_dnsp_convert() function in dnsdata.c of the DNS server RPC module in the **Samba** package. The function copies an HINFO record from the management request into the stored DNS record without converting the request name into the two strings the stored record uses. A low-privileged network attacker or user in the DnsAdmins group adds an HINFO record through the DNS management interface. The directory process that handles the add also serves the directory's other remote calls. That process exits, which disconnects the clients that were using it, and the directory service starts a replacement process. Another add of the same kind crashes the process that accepts it, and each further crash waits longer before that process is replaced, so repeating the add keeps the directory remote-call service from staying available.

CVE-2026-137905.description: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in parse_imf_asset_map_from_xml_dom() in libavformat/imfdec.c that does not check for a missing or empty Path element in an asset map Chunk. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF ASSETMAP.xml whose Chunk lacks a Path, passing a NULL URI to the path handling functions and crashing the process.

CVE-2026-137906.description: FFmpeg 5.0 before 8.1.3 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the IMF demuxer in libavformat/imfdec.c because open_virtual_track() accepts a virtual track with no resources. Attackers can supply a crafted IMF Composition Playlist whose virtual track lists no resources, causing set_context_streams_from_tracks() to dereference a NULL resource array and crash the process.

CVE-2026-137907.description: FFmpeg 3.0 before 8.1.3 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavfilter/vf_boxblur.c because query_formats() accepts pixel formats deeper than 16 bits while the blur temporary buffers hold only 2 bytes per pixel. Attackers can supply crafted 32-bit float media, such as PFM or OpenEXR images, that when processed by the boxblur filter overflow the temporary buffers, crashing applications or possibly executing code.

CVE-2026-137908.description: FFmpeg 7.1 before 9.1 contains a memory leak vulnerability in eb_receive_packet() in libavcodec/libsvtav1.c that returns without unreferencing the queued input frame when eb_send_frame() fails. Attackers can supply crafted video in which some frames lack Dolby Vision metadata to an SVT-AV1 encode with Dolby Vision RPU coding enabled, leaking each rejected frame's buffers or aborting in av_frame_move_ref() in builds with assertions enabled.

CVE-2026-137909.description: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xsub_encode() in libavcodec/xsubenc.c that only warns when a subtitle has no rectangles and then dereferences rects[0]. Attackers can supply crafted PGS or DVB subtitles that decode to empty subtitle events, crashing applications that pass decoded subtitles directly to the XSUB encoder.

CVE-2026-137910.description: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in pcx_encode_frame() in libavcodec/pcxenc.c that rounds each row up to an even number of bytes and run-length encodes that many bytes from the input frame. Attackers who control the width of images encoded to PCX by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the end of the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

CVE-2026-137911.description: FFmpeg before 9.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in xwd_encode_frame() in libavcodec/xwdenc.c that copies each RGB24 or BGR24 row using the padded XWD scanline size instead of the pixel row size. Attackers who control the width of video encoded to XWD by an application that supplies tightly packed frames can make the encoder read past the frame buffer, crashing the application or leaking heap contents into the output image.

CVE-2026-85561.description: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, in addition to the use of the proxy protocol being enabled between DNSdist and one of its backends, an outgoing TCP connection could be wrongly reused for a query received over the same incoming DNS over HTTPS connection but with a different X-Forwarded-For header, causing the backend to consider the query as coming from the same remote client than the first query received on the outgoing connection.

CVE-2026-85562.description: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and configured to trust incoming X-Forwarded-For headers, and the reverse proxy placed in front of DNSdist does not replace existing X-Forwarded-For headers but merely append a new header to the query, the first header was used by DNSdist instead of the last one, making it possible for a client to spoof its own IP address.

CVE-2026-85563.description: When DNS over HTTPS is enabled and a caching HTTP reverse proxy is used in front of DNSdist, it is possible to pollute the cache of the HTTP reverse proxy by sending DNS over HTTPS GET queries with a body. DNSdist should either refuse the query or ignore the HTTP body, but instead was processing the content of the HTTP body rather than the query present in the HTTP path.

CVE-2026-85564.description: An attacker can trigger a large memory use by cancelling QUIC streams while DNSdist is retrieving the response from its backend. Instead of releasing the memory corresponding to the cancelled stream right away, DNSdist was mistakenly keeping it around until the end of the QUIC connection.

CVE-2026-85565.description: An attacker can trigger a synchronization issue on outgoing TCP connections between DNSdist and its backend by sending oversized DNS over HTTPS queries. This could cause the backend to refuse queries, send a server failure, or just close the TCP connection.

CVE-2026-85566.description: An attacker might be able to forge its own source IP, smuggle DNS records or bypass EDNS options filtering via a specially crafted DNS query when EDNS Client Subnet is enabled between DNSdist and its backend.
